zh: 官鬼能为祸福，故观此可知其情状也。
yi: 官鬼能带来灾祸，也能带来福气，所以看它就能知道鬼神的情形。
en: The Pressure line can bring both harm and blessing, so by looking at it one can know the condition.

title: 旺相为神、休囚为鬼，阳爻是男、阴爻是女；鬼爻临长生是少年鬼、帝旺壮年鬼、衰弱老年鬼、胎养小儿鬼；乾宫西北方、巽宫东南方之鬼

rule.yi: 鬼爻旺相是神，休囚是鬼；阳爻是男，阴爻是女。鬼爻临长生是少年的鬼，临帝旺是壮年的鬼，临衰弱是老年的鬼，临胎、养是小孩的鬼。乾宫的鬼在西北方，巽宫的鬼在东南方。
rule.en: A Pressure line that is strong is a spirit; resting or trapped, it is a ghost. Yang is male and yin female. A Pressure line at Birth is a young person's ghost, at Peak a ghost of the prime of life, at decline an old person's ghost, and at Womb or Nurture a child's ghost. A ghost of the Qian palace lies to the northwest, and a ghost of the Xun palace to the southeast.

dispute.yi: 神和鬼、男和女是一件事还是两件事：旧注分成两条，旺相是神、休囚是鬼看旺衰，阳爻是男、阴爻是女看阴阳；王洪绪把它们连成一条，「阳为神为男，阴为鬼为女」。照旧注，一条旺相的阴爻是一个女的神；照王洪绪，阴爻就是女鬼。另外王洪绪没有旧注按长生、帝旺、衰弱、胎养分年龄的那一段。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether spirit-or-ghost and male-or-female are one matter or two: the old commentary makes two rules, strong or weak deciding spirit or ghost and yang or yin deciding male or female; Wang Hongxu joins them into one, 'yang is a spirit and male, yin is a ghost and female'. On the old commentary a strong yin line is a female spirit; on Wang Hongxu a yin line is a female ghost. Wang Hongxu also lacks the old commentary's passage that gives the age by Birth, Peak, decline and Womb and Nurture. The books do not decide between them.

note.yi: 「长生」「帝旺」是十二长生里的两位（长生、沐浴、冠带、临官、帝旺、衰、病、死、墓、绝、胎、养）；「衰弱」按字面译作衰。「隅」是角落（卜筮大全篇末生僻字注），「方隅」是方位。
note.en: Birth and Peak are two of the twelve life stages (Birth, Bath, Cap, Office, Peak, Decline, Sickness, Death, Tomb, Extinction, Womb, Nurture); 'weak' here is rendered as decline. 'Yu' is a corner (the book's glossary), and 'fangyu' means the direction.

zh: 旺神衰鬼，方隅乾巽堪推；
阴女阳男，老幼旺衰可决。
yi: 旺的是神，衰的是鬼，方位可以从乾宫、巽宫推出来；
阴爻是女、阳爻是男，年老年幼可以从旺衰判定。
en: The strong are spirits and the weak are ghosts; the direction can be worked out from the Qian and Xun palaces;
yin is female and yang male, and whether old or young is settled by strength or weakness.

hits.text: 旺神衰鬼，方隅乾巽堪推
阴女阳男，老幼旺衰可决
旺神衰鬼，方隅乾巽堪推
阴女阳男，老幼旺衰可决

zh: 凡鬼爻旺相，为神。
休囚，为鬼。
阳为男，阴为女。
临长生，少年鬼；
临帝旺，壮年鬼；
临衰弱，老年鬼；
胎养，小儿鬼。
乾宫，西北方；
巽宫，东南方鬼也。
yi: 凡是鬼爻旺相，就是神。
休囚，就是鬼。
阳爻是男的，阴爻是女的。
临长生，是少年的鬼；
临帝旺，是壮年的鬼；
临衰弱，是老年的鬼；
临胎、养，是小孩的鬼。
乾宫的鬼，在西北方；
巽宫的鬼，在东南方。
en: Whenever the Pressure line is strong, it is a spirit.
Resting or trapped, it is a ghost.
Yang is male, yin female.
At Birth, a young person's ghost;
at Peak, a ghost of the prime of life;
at decline, an old person's ghost;
at Womb and Nurture, a child's ghost.
A ghost of the Qian palace is in the northwest;
a ghost of the Xun palace is in the southeast.

zh: 凡鬼爻旺相是神，休囚是鬼，阳为神为男，阴为鬼为女。
乾宫西北方，巽宫东南方之鬼也。
yi: 凡是鬼爻旺相就是神，休囚就是鬼；阳爻是神、是男的，阴爻是鬼、是女的。
乾宫是西北方的鬼，巽宫是东南方的鬼。
en: Whenever the Pressure line is strong it is a spirit, and resting or trapped it is a ghost; yang is a spirit and male, yin is a ghost and female.
The Qian palace is a ghost of the northwest, and the Xun palace a ghost of the southeast.

title: 八宫推鬼神：乾宫许天灯斗愿、兑宫口愿伤神、坎北朝圣象、艮城隍宅土、离南殿、坤土地坟陵、震树神或杖死男鬼、巽缢死或颠仆之阴人

rule.yi: 按鬼所在的卦宫推：在乾宫，是许过点天灯、拜北斗的愿；在兑宫，是口头许的愿或者伤神；在坎宫，是北方朝拜的圣像；在艮宫，是城隍或宅里的土神；在离宫，是南边的殿宇；在坤宫，是土地神或坟墓陵园；在震宫，是树神，或者被杖打死的男鬼；在巽宫，一定是吊死的，或者癫狂跌倒而死的女人。把八宫仔细推敲，各路鬼自然会显应出来。
rule.en: Work it out by the palace in which the ghost lies. In the Qian palace there was a vow of a heavenly lamp or to the Dipper; in the Dui palace, a spoken vow or an injuring spirit; in Kan, the sacred image worshipped in the north; in Gen, the City God or the earth spirit of the house; in Li, the southern hall; in Kun, the Earth God or graves and tombs; in Zhen, a tree spirit or a male ghost beaten to death with a staff; in Xun, surely one who hanged himself, or a woman who fell in a fit. Work out the eight palaces carefully and the various ghosts will make themselves apparent.

note.yi: 王洪绪引经文时，把「震恐树神，或杖伤之男鬼」写成「震恐神煞杖伤之男鬼」，把「八宫」写成「八卦」，「颠仆」写成「癫仆」的另一写法；他自己的注只讲了乾宫一例，其余各宫的推法只见于旧注。旧注里的「木鬼许放风筝」「子丑二爻许拜北斗」经文里没有，是旧注自己添的。「呪咀」是咒骂诅咒；「囹圄」「癫」的解释见卜筮大全篇末生僻字注。旧注最后一段解释了为什么以兑而不以乾为伤神：乾三画连是完整的金，兑上缺是有损伤的金。
note.en: When Wang Hongxu quotes the verse he writes 'Zhen may well be a spirit-star beaten with a staff' where the Bushi Daquan has 'a tree spirit, or a male ghost beaten to death', and 'the eight trigrams' for 'the eight palaces'; his own commentary treats only the Qian example, and the workings for the other palaces are found only in the old commentary. 'A Wood ghost means a vow to fly a kite' and 'on the lines of Zi and Chou, a vow to the Dipper' are not in the verse and are the old commentary's own additions. 'Zhouzu' means cursing and imprecation. The last passage of the old commentary explains why Dui and not Qian is the injuring spirit: Qian's three unbroken lines are whole Metal, and Dui, open at the top, is damaged Metal.

zh: 若在乾宫，必许天灯斗愿；
如居兑卦。
定然口愿伤神。
坎是北朝，艮则城隍宅土；
离为南殿，坤则土地坟陵。
震恐树神，或杖伤之男鬼；
巽必缢死，或癫仆之阴人。
八宫仔细推详，诸鬼自能显应。
yi: 鬼若在乾宫，一定是许过点天灯、拜北斗的愿；
如果在兑卦，
一定是口头许的愿，或者是伤神。
在坎是北方朝拜的圣像，在艮就是城隍或宅里的土神；
离是南边的殿宇，坤就是土地神或坟墓陵园；
震要防是树神，或者被棍杖打伤的男鬼；
巽一定是吊死的，或者癫狂跌倒而死的女人。
把八个宫仔细推敲，各路鬼自然会显应出来。
en: If it is in the Qian palace, there has surely been a vow of a heavenly lamp or to the Dipper;
if it lies in the Dui trigram,
it is surely a spoken vow or an injuring spirit.
Kan is the sacred image of the north, and Gen is the City God or the earth spirit of the house;
Li is the southern hall, and Kun is the Earth God or graves and tombs;
Zhen may well be a tree spirit, or a male ghost beaten to death with a staff;
Xun is surely one who hanged himself, or a woman who fell in a fit.
Work out the eight palaces carefully, and the various ghosts will make themselves apparent.

hits.text: 若在乾宫，必许天灯斗愿
坎是北朝，艮则城隍宅土
离为南殿，坤则土地坟陵
巽必缢死或颠仆之阴人
八卦仔细推详，诸鬼自能显应
若在乾宫，必许天灯斗愿
坎是北朝，艮则城隍宅土
离为南殿，坤则土地坟陵
震恐树神，或杖伤之男鬼
巽必缢死，或癫仆之阴人
八宫仔细推详，诸鬼自然显应

zh: 此以八卦推之。
乾象为天，鬼在此宫，值火，许点天灯类。
金鬼亦然。
木鬼许放风筝。
子丑二爻，许拜北斗。
坤土属阴，故是坟陵土地。
艮土属阳，故是城隍宅土。
离居南，故推南殿。
坎子地，故推北朝圣象。
震为木，故树神；
带白虎或自刑，则杖死之鬼。
巽为绳，故主缢死之鬼；
不带鰧蛇，或非刑爻，则是风症死者。
兑为口，故有呪咀口愿，又属金，故推伤神。
盖乾三连，是浑成之金；
兑象上缺，是伤损之金；
故以兑为伤神，而不以乾为伤神。
yi: 这是按八卦来推。
乾的象是天，鬼在乾宫，遇到火，是许过点天灯之类的愿。
金鬼也是这样。
木鬼是许过放风筝的愿。
落在子、丑两个地支的爻，是许过拜北斗的愿。
坤土属阴，所以是坟陵和土地。
艮土属阳，所以是城隍和宅里的土神。
离在南方，所以推作南边的殿宇。
坎是子的位置，所以推作北方朝拜的圣像。
震属木，所以是树神；
带白虎或自刑，就是被杖打死的鬼。
巽象绳子，所以主吊死的鬼；
不带螣蛇，或者不是刑爻，就是得风症死的人。
兑象口，所以有咒骂和口头许的愿；又属金，所以推作伤神。
因为乾卦三画相连，是浑然一体的金；
兑卦的象上面缺了一口，是受了损伤的金；
所以把兑当作伤神，而不把乾当作伤神。
en: This is worked out by the eight trigrams.
Qian is the image of heaven; a ghost in this palace, meeting Fire, means a vow such as lighting a heavenly lamp.
A Metal ghost is the same.
A Wood ghost means a vow to fly a kite.
On the lines of Zi and Chou, a vow to pay homage to the Dipper.
Kun Earth is yin, so it is graves and tombs and the Earth God.
Gen Earth is yang, so it is the City God and the earth spirit of the house.
Li lies in the south, so it is taken as the southern hall.
Kan is the place of Zi, so it is taken as the sacred image worshipped in the north.
Zhen is Wood, so it is a tree spirit;
with the White Tiger or self-punishment, it is a ghost beaten to death with a staff.
Xun is a rope, so it means a hanged ghost;
without the Coiling Snake, or if it is not a punishing line, it is one who died of a wind disorder.
Dui is the mouth, so there are curses and spoken vows; it is also Metal, so it is taken as an injuring spirit.
For Qian has three unbroken lines and is whole, undivided Metal;
Dui is open at the top and is damaged Metal;
so Dui is taken as the injuring spirit, and Qian is not.

zh: 此以八卦推之，乾象为天神，在此宫属火，宜许点天灯斗愿类。
yi: 这是按八卦来推：乾的象是天神，鬼在这个宫又属火，该是许过点天灯、拜北斗之类的愿。
en: This is worked out by the eight trigrams: Qian is the image of the heavenly spirit, and a ghost in this palace, being Fire, should mean a vow such as lighting a heavenly lamp or to the Dipper.

title: 六神推鬼神：勾陈土神为祸、朱雀咒诅口舌、白虎血神、玄武死于不明之鬼（化兄弟则盗贼）、青龙善愿、螣蛇施相之神

rule.yi: 按鬼爻带的六神推：带勾陈，是土神在作祸；带朱雀，是有人咒骂诅咒；带白虎，是血神，有带血的女伤，在阳爻上是凶暴恶死的鬼；带玄武，是死得不明不白的鬼，变成兄弟或从兄弟变出来的，是盗贼；带青龙，是善愿；带螣蛇，是施相之神。
rule.en: Work it out by the six spirits the Pressure line carries. With the Hook Earth, an earth spirit is making trouble; with the Vermilion Bird, curses and imprecations; with the White Tiger, the blood spirit, a woman's injury with blood, and on a yang line a violent ghost who died an ugly death; with the Dark Tortoise, a ghost who died in an unclear way, and if it changes into Peer or has come out of Peer, a thief or bandit; with the Azure Dragon, a good vow; with the Coiling Snake, the spirit of Shixiang.

note.yi: 旧注把六神一个一个讲了，王洪绪只讲了勾陈一例。「带血女伤」书里没有再解释，按字面译。「施相」书里没有解释；旧注说现在民间酬谢螣蛇这一路神，用面捏一条小蛇献上，所以译成人名式的「施相之神」。王洪绪引经文时，「螣蛇则犯乎施相之神」写作「螣蛇则犯乎施相之人」，「白虎血亡」写作「白虎血神」；这几处字面不同，书里没有说哪个对。
note.en: The old commentary takes the six spirits one by one; Wang Hongxu treats only the Hook Earth. 'A woman's injury with blood' is not explained further in the book and is rendered literally. 'Shixiang' is not explained; the old commentary says that in present custom thanks to this spirit are given with a small snake moulded of dough, so it is rendered as a name. When Wang Hongxu quotes the verse he writes 'the Coiling Snake offends the person of Shixiang' for 'the spirit of Shixiang', and 'the White Tiger the blood spirit' for 'the White Tiger death by blood'; the books do not say which is right.

zh: 更值勾陈，必有土神见碍；
如临朱雀，定然呪咀相侵。
白虎血亡，玄武则死于不明之鬼。
青龙善愿，螣蛇则犯乎施相之神。
yi: 再遇到勾陈，一定有土神来作梗；
如果临朱雀，一定是咒骂诅咒来侵扰。
白虎是血亡，玄武就是死得不明不白的鬼；
青龙是善愿，螣蛇就是冒犯了施相之神。
en: Where the Hook Earth is added, an earth spirit is surely obstructing;
if it falls on the Vermilion Bird, curses and imprecations surely intrude.
The White Tiger is death by blood, and the Dark Tortoise is a ghost who died in an unclear way;
the Azure Dragon is a good vow, and the Coiling Snake means the spirit of Shixiang has been offended.

hits.text: 更值勾陈，必有土神见碍
如临朱雀，定然咒诅相侵
白虎血神，玄武则死于不明之鬼
青龙善愿，螣蛇则犯乎施相之
更值勾陈，必有土神见碍
如临朱雀，定然咒诅相侵
白虎血亡。玄武则死于不明之鬼
青龙善愿，螣蛇则犯乎施相之神

zh: 此以六神推之。
勾陈职专田土，鬼爻临之，乃是土神为祸。
朱雀为口舌，故有呪咀。
白虎为血神，故有带血女伤；
居阳则凶暴恶死之鬼也。
玄武是幽暗，故有不明死鬼；
化兄弟，或从兄弟化出，则是盗贼。
青龙是喜神，故有善愿。
鰧蛇推施相之神，今俗祷谢，必以面作小蛇，献之取验。
yi: 这是按六神来推。
勾陈专管田地土壤，鬼爻带着它，就是土神在作祸。
朱雀主口舌，所以有咒骂诅咒。
白虎是血神，所以有带血的女伤；
在阳爻上，就是凶暴、死得凶恶的鬼。
玄武是幽暗，所以有死得不明不白的鬼；
变成兄弟，或者从兄弟变出来，就是盗贼。
青龙是喜神，所以有善愿。
螣蛇推作施相之神，现在民间祷告酬谢，一定用面做成小蛇献上去，来求应验。
en: This is worked out by the six spirits.
The Hook Earth is charged with fields and soil; when the Pressure line carries it, an earth spirit is making trouble.
The Vermilion Bird is talk and quarrels, so there are curses.
The White Tiger is the blood spirit, so there is a woman's injury with blood;
on a yang line it is a violent ghost who died an ugly death.
The Dark Tortoise is obscurity, so there is a ghost who died in an unclear way;
if it changes into Peer, or has come out of a change from Peer, it is a thief or bandit.
The Azure Dragon is the spirit of joy, so there is a good vow.
The Coiling Snake is taken as the spirit of Shixiang; in present custom, when prayers are offered and thanks given, a small snake is always made of dough and offered up to gain proof.

zh: 此以六神推之。
勾陈职专田土，鬼爻临之，乃是土神为祸类。
yi: 这是按六神来推。
勾陈专管田地土壤，鬼爻带着它，就是土神作祸这一类。
en: This is worked out by the six spirits.
The Hook Earth is charged with fields and soil; when the Pressure line carries it, it is of the kind where an earth spirit makes trouble.

title: 五行推鬼神：金是伤司刀兵鬼、火是灶神香愿、木是枷锁、水是河伯江神；旧注细分火鬼二爻灶君、午火衰弱烧死鬼、木鬼带螣蛇吊死、水鬼衰弱落水鬼

rule.yi: 按鬼所属的五行推：金是被刀兵所伤的鬼，旺的是伤神，衰的是伤司手下的部众；火，一定是灶神或者香愿，落在二爻是灶君，衰弱的午火是被烧死的鬼；木是枷锁，东方的神鬼，变金或从金变出来的是戴枷锁的鬼，带螣蛇是吊死的鬼，木变木再加白虎是被夹死的鬼；水是河伯江神，旺相是江神河伯，衰弱是落水的鬼，在震、巽宫或木变水，是从船上掉下水淹死的鬼。
rule.en: Work it out by the element the ghost belongs to. Metal is a ghost wounded by blade and weapon: strong, an injuring spirit; weak, the followers of the Injuring Office. Fire is surely the Kitchen God or an incense vow: on the second line the Kitchen God, and a weak Wu Fire is a ghost burned to death. Wood is cangue and lock, a spirit or ghost of the east: changing into Metal or coming from Metal, a ghost in shackles; with the Coiling Snake, a hanged ghost; Wood changing into Wood with the White Tiger added, a ghost pressed to death. Water is the Lord of the River and the river god: strong, a river god; weak, a ghost who fell into the water; in the Zhen or Xun palace or Wood changing into Water, a ghost who fell from a boat and drowned.

dispute.yi: 要不要把五行落实到一位具体的神：旧注给出很具体的名目（火鬼在二爻是灶君，金旺是伤神、衰是伤司部众，水旺是江神河伯），王洪绪只留了金的一例；增删卜易的觉子认为不必把金官指为关公、岳公这一类具体的神，应该问病人心里疑的是哪位神，再占一卦验证（见 LY.ILL.ZS.24）。三处怎样落实到神，说法各不相同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether to fix an element to a particular named spirit: the old commentary gives very specific names (a Fire ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God; strong Metal is an injuring spirit and weak Metal the followers of the Injuring Office; strong Water is a river god), while Wang Hongxu keeps only the Metal example; the Master Awakened (Jue Zi) in the Zengshan Buyi holds that one should not name Metal Pressure as Guan Gong, Yue Gong or the like, but ask which spirit the patient has in mind and divine again to check (see LY.ILL.ZS.24). The three differ on how far to name the spirit, and the books do not decide.

note.yi: 「伤司」是主刀兵伤害的司，「部众」是它手下的众鬼；「香信」是香愿。「夹死鬼」旧注没有再解释，按字面译作被夹死的鬼。「河泊」是王洪绪引经文时对「河伯」的写法。「持世」是鬼爻落在世爻的位置，这里指鬼就是本地的，是社会中的香愿。
note.en: The 'Injuring Office' is the office in charge of wounds by blade and weapon and its 'followers' are the ghosts under it; 'incense pledge' is a vow of incense. 'A ghost pressed to death' is not explained further in the old commentary and is rendered literally. 'Hebo' is Wang Hongxu's way of writing 'Lord of the River' when he quotes the verse. 'Holding the Self position' means the ghost sits on the Self line's place, here meaning the ghost belongs to the locality: a vow made in the village society.

zh: 金乃伤司，火定灶神香愿；
木为枷锁，水为河伯江神。
yi: 金是伤司，火一定是灶神和香愿；
木是枷锁，水是河伯江神。
en: Metal is the Injuring Office, and Fire is surely the Kitchen God or an incense vow;
Wood is cangue and lock, and Water is the Lord of the River and the river god.

hits.text: 金乃伤司，火定灶神香愿
木为枷锁，水为河泊之神
金乃伤司，火定灶神香愿
木为枷锁，水为河伯江神

zh: 此以五行推之。
金主刀兵所伤之鬼；
旺是伤神，衰是伤司部众。
火鬼在二爻，是灶君，其余香信。
本宫内卦，是本境土地，神佛香愿；
他宫，别境香愿。
在六爻，远方香信。
在五爻，途中所许。
持世当境，社会中香愿也。
午火衰弱，必是烧死之鬼。
木鬼，东方神鬼。
化金，或从金化，是械锁鬼。
带鰧蛇，吊死之鬼。
木化木，又加白虎，夹死鬼。
水鬼旺相，江神河伯；
衰弱，落水鬼。
在震巽二宫，或木化水，必是船上堕水死鬼。
yi: 这是按五行来推。
金主被刀兵伤害的鬼；
旺的是伤神，衰的是伤司手下的部众。
火鬼在二爻，是灶君；其余的是香愿。
在本宫的内卦，是本地的土地神、神佛的香愿；
在别的宫，是别处的香愿。
在六爻，是远方的香信。
在五爻，是路上许下的愿。
持世，就是本境，是社里、会里的香愿。
午火衰弱，一定是被火烧死的鬼。
木鬼，是东方的神鬼。
变成金，或者从金变出来，是戴枷锁的鬼。
带螣蛇，是吊死的鬼。
木变木，再加白虎，是被夹死的鬼。
水鬼旺相，是江神河伯；
衰弱，是落水的鬼。
在震宫、巽宫，或者木变水，一定是从船上掉下水淹死的鬼。
en: This is worked out by the five elements.
Metal governs ghosts wounded by blade and weapon;
if strong it is an injuring spirit, if weak the followers of the Injuring Office.
A Fire ghost on the second line is the Kitchen God; otherwise it is an incense pledge.
In the inner trigram of the home palace, it is the local Earth God and an incense vow to a god or Buddha;
in another palace, an incense vow elsewhere.
On the sixth line, an incense pledge from afar.
On the fifth line, a vow made on the road.
Holding the Self position means the local area: an incense vow of the village society.
A weak Wu Fire is surely a ghost who was burned to death.
A Wood ghost is a spirit or ghost of the east.
Changing into Metal, or coming from a change from Metal, it is a ghost in shackles and locks.
With the Coiling Snake, a hanged ghost.
Wood changing into Wood, with the White Tiger added, a ghost pressed to death.
A strong Water ghost is a river god or the Lord of the River;
if weak, a ghost who fell into the water.
In the Zhen and Xun palaces, or Wood changing into Water, it is surely a ghost who fell from a boat and drowned.

zh: 此以五行推之。
金乃刀兵所伤之鬼，旺是伤神，衰是伤鬼类。
yi: 这是按五行来推。
金是被刀兵伤害的鬼，旺的是伤神，衰的是伤鬼这一类。
en: This is worked out by the five elements.
Metal is a ghost wounded by blade and weapon; if strong it is an injuring spirit, if weak a ghost of the wounded kind.

title: 鬼是土爻要分类：阴土阳土，震巽宫或木化土是树头土，临应冲世或日辰带土鬼冲克是飞来土，日月动变皆带土是五方土

rule.yi: 鬼爻是土的要分清是哪一类：阴爻上是阴土，阳爻上是阳土；在震宫、巽宫，或者从木变出来的，是树头（木头）上的土；落在应爻、冲世爻的位置上，或者日辰带着土鬼来冲来克，是飞来的土；日、月、动爻、变爻都带土，是五方的土。
rule.en: Where the ghost is an Earth line, tell which kind: on a yin line, yin earth, on a yang line, yang earth; in the Zhen or Xun palace, or coming from a change from Wood, earth at the head of a tree (wood-head earth); standing on the Other line and clashing the Self line, or with the Day carrying an Earth ghost that clashes or controls, flying earth; if the Day, Month, moving line and changed line all carry Earth, earth of the five directions.

note.yi: 卜筮大全经文写「当分厂类」，「厂」是「厥」字的误刻，卜筮正宗写作「厥类」，译作「哪一类」。旧注说「树头土」，王洪绪说「木头土」，书里没有解释，按字面译。旧注多出「在震巽二宫」这一条。两家都只把土分成了几种，没有说每一种土对应什么事，所以本库只记分类，不替它添意思。
note.en: The Bushi Daquan verse reads 'chang lei', where 'chang' is a mis-cut for 'jue' (as in the Bushi Zhengzong's 'jue lei'), rendered 'which kind'. The old commentary says 'earth at the head of a tree' and Wang Hongxu 'wood-head earth'; neither is explained and both are rendered literally. The old commentary adds 'in the Zhen and Xun palaces'. Both only divide Earth into kinds and do not say what each kind stands for, so the library records the classification and adds no meaning of its own.

zh: 若见土爻，当分厂类。
yi: 如果看到土爻，就该分清是哪一类。
en: If you see an Earth line, you should tell which kind it is.

zh: 土爻临鬼，阴是阴土，阳是阳土。
在震巽二宫，或从木化皆然，或树头土。
临应冲世，或日辰带土鬼相冲相克，是飞来土。
若日月动变皆带土，五方土也。
yi: 土爻带鬼，阴爻是阴土，阳爻是阳土。
在震宫、巽宫，或者从木变出来的，都一样，也可能是树头上的土。
落在应爻、冲世爻的位置，或者日辰带着土鬼来冲来克，是飞来的土。
如果日、月、动爻、变爻都带土，就是五方的土。
en: When an Earth line carries the ghost, a yin one is yin earth and a yang one is yang earth.
In the Zhen and Xun palaces, or when it comes from a change from Wood, it is likewise, or it may be earth at the head of a tree.
Standing on the Other line and clashing the Self line, or when the Day carries an Earth ghost that clashes or controls, it is flying earth.
If the Day, Month, moving line and changed line all carry Earth, it is earth of the five directions.

zh: 土鬼阴爻是阴土，阳爻是阳土，或从木化是木头土，临应冲世是飞来土，若日月动变者，五方土类也。
yi: 土鬼在阴爻上是阴土，在阳爻上是阳土；从木变出来的是木头土，落在应爻、冲世爻上是飞来土；如果日、月、动爻、变爻都是土，就是五方土这一类。
en: An Earth ghost on a yin line is yin earth and on a yang line yang earth; one coming from a change from Wood is wood-head earth; standing on the Other line and clashing the Self line it is flying earth; if the Day, Month, moving and changed lines are all Earth, it is of the kind of earth of the five directions.

title: 鬼墓是伏尸为祸、财库是藏神不安：鬼爻属金卦有丑动是鬼墓，妻财属木卦有未动是财库；不伤世则不为祸

rule.yi: 鬼的墓，是埋着的尸骨在作祸；财的库，是藏着的神不得安宁。看法：鬼爻属金，卦里有丑爻发动，就是鬼的墓；妻财属木，卦里有未爻发动，就是财的库；别的照这样推。但是不伤到世爻，就不会作祸。
rule.en: The ghost's tomb means a buried corpse is making trouble; Wealth's storehouse means a hidden spirit is unsettled. How to see it: if the Pressure line is Metal and a Chou line in the hexagram moves, that is the ghost's tomb; if the Wealth line is Wood and a Wei line in the hexagram moves, that is Wealth's storehouse; work out the others the same way. But if it does not harm the Self line, it does no harm.

note.yi: 旧注末了有两句王洪绪没有：一句指向家宅的断法，一句给了条件「不伤世则不为祸」。王洪绪把旧注的「财库」直接写成「木墓」，意思相同（未是木的墓）。「墓」这里指的是五行入墓的那一支：金墓在丑，木墓在未。
note.en: The old commentary ends with two sentences that Wang Hongxu lacks: one pointing to the household section and one giving the condition 'if it does not harm the Self line, it does no harm'. Wang Hongxu writes the old commentary's 'Wealth's storehouse' directly as 'the tomb of Wood', which means the same (Wei is the tomb of Wood). The 'tomb' here is the branch in which an element enters its tomb: Chou for Metal, Wei for Wood.

zh: 鬼墓乃伏尸为祸；
财库则藏神不安。
yi: 鬼的墓，是埋着的尸骨在作祸；
财的库，是藏着的神不得安宁。
en: The ghost's tomb means a buried corpse is making trouble;
and Wealth's storehouse means a hidden spirit is unsettled.

zh: 鬼爻属金，卦有丑动是鬼墓。
妻财属木，卦有未动是财库。
他仿此。
二事见家宅决中，今不尽述。
然不伤世则不为祸。
yi: 鬼爻属金，卦里有丑爻发动，就是鬼的墓。
妻财属木，卦里有未爻发动，就是财的库。
别的照这个办法推。
这两件事在家宅的断法里有讲，这里不全说了。
但是不伤到世爻，就不会作祸。
en: If the Pressure line is Metal and a Chou line in the hexagram moves, that is the ghost's tomb.
If the Wealth line is Wood and a Wei line in the hexagram moves, that is Wealth's storehouse.
Work out the others the same way.
These two matters are treated in the household section and are not fully described here.
But if it does not harm the Self line, it does no harm.

zh: 鬼爻属金，卦有丑动是金墓；
妻财属木，卦有未动是木墓。
余仿此。
yi: 鬼爻属金，卦里有丑爻发动，就是金的墓；
妻财属木，卦里有未爻发动，就是木的墓。
其余照这个办法推。
en: If the Pressure line is Metal and a Chou line in the hexagram moves, that is the tomb of Metal;
if the Wealth line is Wood and a Wei line in the hexagram moves, that is the tomb of Wood.
Follow this for the rest.

title: 修造动土必是煞遇勾陈、口舌起因是土逢朱雀：土鬼加勾陈因修造动土不安，初爻穿井、二爻作灶、三四爻当门、五爻路边、六爻篱墙下；临朱雀则动土时暗有口舌咒诅

rule.yi: 因为修造、动土出了事，是土鬼碰上了勾陈：落在初爻是挖井动土，二爻是砌灶动土，三、四爻是门口动土，五爻是路边动土，六爻是篱笆墙下动土；在兑宫是挖池动土，艮宫是筑墙动土，坤宫是造坟动土，坎宫加玄武是挖厕坑动土。以上如果带朱雀，就是动土的时候暗中有口舌和咒诅，或者有人多嘴惹事，因此成了祸。
rule.en: Trouble from building or breaking ground is an Earth ghost meeting the Hook Earth: on the first line, digging a well; the second, building a stove; the third and fourth, breaking ground at the door; the fifth, by the road; the sixth, beneath the fence or wall; in the Dui palace, digging a pond; in the Gen palace, building a wall; in the Kun palace, building a grave; in the Kan palace with the Dark Tortoise, digging a privy pit. If any of these carries the Vermilion Bird, then at the time of breaking ground there were hidden quarrels and curses, or someone talked too much and stirred up trouble, and this became the misfortune.

note.yi: 旧注列了一长串位置，王洪绪只讲了总的一句。旧注写「在初爻」「二爻」「三爻四爻」没有说指的是土鬼落在哪一爻，按上下文译作土鬼所在的爻位。「杀」这里就是「煞」，一种凶的力量。「呪咀」是咒骂诅咒。旧注的位置表里三爻、四爻都是「当门动土」，而上面六爻推鬼神一条里三爻是门、四爻是户，两处不完全对应；书里没有说明。
note.en: The old commentary gives a long list of positions and Wang Hongxu only the general sentence. The old commentary's 'on the first line', 'the second line' and 'the third and fourth lines' do not say which line is meant, and are rendered by context as the line on which the Earth ghost stands. 'Sha' here is the malign influence. 'Zhouzu' is cursing and imprecation. In the old commentary's list both the third and fourth lines are 'breaking ground at the door', while in the entry on the six lines the third is the gate and the fourth the door of the house, so the two do not correspond exactly; the book does not explain.

zh: 修造动土，必然杀遇勾陈；
口舌起因，乃是土逢朱雀。
yi: 因为修造、动土而出事，一定是煞遇上了勾陈；
口舌是非的起因，是土遇上了朱雀。
en: Trouble from building or breaking ground is surely a malign influence meeting the Hook Earth;
and the cause of quarrels is Earth meeting the Vermilion Bird.

hits.text: 修造动土，必然煞遇勾陈
口舌起因，乃是土逢朱雀
修造动土，必然杀遇勾陈
口舌起因，乃是土逢朱雀

zh: 此亦言土鬼也。
加勾陈，必因修造动土，以致不安。
在初爻，穿井不安。
二爻，作灶动土。
三爻四爻，当门动土。
五爻，路边动土。
六爻篱笆墙下动土。
兑宫，开池动土。
艮宫，筑墙动土。
坤宫，造坟动土。
坎宫加玄武，坑厕动土。
以上若临朱雀，则是动土时，暗有口舌，呪咀。
或多口惹事，以致为祸。
yi: 这也是说土鬼。
再加勾陈，一定是因为修造、动土，弄得不得安宁。
在初爻，是挖井弄得不安。
二爻，是砌灶动土。
三爻、四爻，是门口动土。
五爻，是路边动土。
六爻，是篱笆、墙下动土。
兑宫，是挖池塘动土。
艮宫，是筑墙动土。
坤宫，是造坟动土。
坎宫加玄武，是挖厕坑动土。
以上这些如果带朱雀，就是动土的时候，暗中有口舌是非、咒骂诅咒。
或者是有人多嘴惹事，因此成了祸。
en: This too speaks of an Earth ghost.
With the Hook Earth added, it is surely because of building or breaking ground that there is unrest.
On the first line, digging a well has caused the unrest.
The second line: building a stove and breaking ground.
The third and fourth lines: breaking ground at the door.
The fifth line: breaking ground by the road.
The sixth line: breaking ground beneath the fence or wall.
The Dui palace: digging a pond.
The Gen palace: building a wall.
The Kun palace: building a grave.
The Kan palace with the Dark Tortoise: digging a privy pit.
If any of the above carries the Vermilion Bird, then at the time of breaking ground there were hidden quarrels and curses.
Or a talkative person stirred up trouble, and this became the misfortune.

zh: 此亦土鬼也，如勾陈，必因修造动土以致不安。
yi: 这也是土鬼；带勾陈的话，一定是因为修造、动土才弄得不安。
en: This too is an Earth ghost; if with the Hook Earth, it is surely because of building or breaking ground that there is unrest.

title: 六爻推鬼神：初爻水鬼犯井神、二爻火鬼干司命（灶神）、三爻犯家堂、五爻求五路神、四爻遇世冲是出门撞见、六爻月合是远地相干

rule.yi: 按鬼落在哪一爻推：水鬼在初爻，冒犯了井神；火鬼在二爻，触犯了司命（灶神）；鬼在三爻（门），冒犯了家堂的香火；鬼在五爻（路上），要求五路神，金鬼是五道、火鬼是五圣、木鬼是五郎神众、水鬼是五路神司，衰弱就是路边的鬼；鬼在四爻，遇到冲世，一定是出门撞见的；鬼在六爻，逢月建生合，是远方的神来干犯，月建、日辰生合，是天神那里有愿。
rule.en: Work it out by the line on which the ghost falls. A Water ghost on the first line has offended the well god; a Fire ghost on the second has offended the Director of Fate (the Kitchen God); a ghost on the third (the gate) has offended the incense and fire of the household shrine; on the fifth (the road), seek the Gods of the Five Roads: a Metal ghost is the Five Paths, Fire the Five Sages, Wood the Five Lords and their company, Water the Officers of the Five Roads, and if weak a ghost of the roadside. A ghost on the fourth line meeting a clash with Self was surely met on going out; a ghost on the sixth line meeting a combination with the Month is a spirit from far away, and if the Month and the Day generate or combine with it there is a vow to a heavenly spirit.

note.yi: 经文「四遇世冲」，王洪绪引作「四遇世神」；「神祗」他也写作「神祇」的同一个意思。王洪绪比旧注少了几样：旧注按五行分五爻上的五道、五圣、五郎、五路，还有「衰弱则道路边鬼」和「月建日辰生合，乃天神中有愿」；王洪绪把五爻一律断作路头五圣。「司命」是管人命运的灶神一类的神，这里旧注和经文都把它对到二爻的灶神。
note.en: Where the verse says 'the fourth line meeting a clash with Self' (shi chong), Wang Hongxu quotes 'the fourth line meeting the Self spirit' (shi shen). Wang Hongxu has less than the old commentary: the old commentary divides the fifth line by element into the Five Paths, the Five Sages, the Five Lords and the Five Roads, adds 'if weak, a ghost of the roadside' and 'if the Month and Day generate or combine, there is a vow to a heavenly spirit'; Wang Hongxu judges every ghost on the fifth line as the Five Sages of the road-head. The 'Director of Fate' is a spirit in charge of people's destinies of the Kitchen God kind, and both the verse and the old commentary match it to the Kitchen God of the second line.

zh: 或犯井神，水在初爻遇鬼；
或干司命，火临二位逢官。
若在门头，须犯家堂部属；
如临道上，当求五路神祗。
四遇世冲，鬼必出门撞见；
六逢月合，神须远地相干。
yi: 也许冒犯了井神，是水在初爻遇到了鬼；
也许触犯了司命，是火在二爻遇到了官。
如果在门这一头，一定是冒犯了家堂的部属；
如果在路上这一位，该去求五路神。
四爻遇到冲世，鬼一定是出门时撞见的；
六爻逢到月建相合，神一定是从远处来犯的。
en: Perhaps the well god has been offended: Water on the first line meeting the ghost;
or the Director of Fate has been disturbed: Fire on the second place meeting Pressure.
If it is at the door, the retinue of the household shrine has been offended;
if it is on the road, one should seek the Gods of the Five Roads.
The fourth line meeting a clash with Self means the ghost was surely met on going out;
the sixth line meeting a combination with the Month means the spirit comes from a distant place.

hits.text: 或犯井神，水在初爻遇鬼
或干司命，火临二位逢官
若在门头，须犯家堂部属
如临道上，当求五路神祗
四遇世神，鬼必出门撞见
六逢月合，神须远地相干
或犯井神，水在初爻遇鬼
或干司命，火临二位逢官
若在门头，须犯家堂部属
如临道上，当求五路神祗
四遇世冲鬼，必出门撞见
六逢月合神，须远地相干

zh: 此以六爻推之也。
初爻水鬼，井泉童子不安。
二爻火鬼，灶神见责。
三爻为门，官鬼临之，当犯家堂香火。
四爻为户，若遇官克世冲世，必曾出门撞见鬼崇。
五爻临金鬼，五道；
火鬼，五圣；
木鬼，五郎神众；
水鬼，五路神司。
衰弱，则道路边鬼。
在六爻，定远方鬼。
月建日辰生合，乃天神中有愿。
yi: 这是按六个爻位来推。
初爻是水鬼，井泉童子不得安宁。
二爻是火鬼，灶神怪罪。
三爻是门，官鬼落在这里，是冒犯了家堂的香火。
四爻是户，如果官爻克世爻、冲世爻，一定是曾经出门撞见了鬼崇。
五爻临金鬼，是五道；
火鬼，是五圣；
木鬼，是五郎神众；
水鬼，是五路神司。
衰弱的话，就是路边的鬼。
在六爻，一定是远方的鬼。
月建、日辰生它、合它，是天神那里有愿。
en: This is worked out by the six line positions.
A Water ghost on the first line: the child spirit of the well and spring is unsettled.
A Fire ghost on the second line: the Kitchen God is reproaching.
The third line is the gate; when Pressure sits there, the incense and fire of the household shrine has been offended.
The fourth line is the door of the house; if Pressure controls or clashes the Self line, one surely met a ghostly influence on going out.
The fifth line with a Metal ghost: the Five Paths;
a Fire ghost: the Five Sages;
a Wood ghost: the Five Lords and their company;
a Water ghost: the Officers of the Five Roads.
If weak, it is a ghost of the roadside.
On the sixth line, it is surely a ghost from afar.
If the Month and the Day generate or combine with it, there is a vow to a heavenly spirit.

zh: 水鬼临于初爻断井神，火鬼临于二爻断司命，如鬼临三爻断家堂，如临五爻断路头五圣，临四爻断出门撞祟，临六爻断远处染邪。
yi: 水鬼在初爻，断是井神；火鬼在二爻，断是司命；鬼在三爻，断是家堂；在五爻，断是路头五圣；在四爻，断是出门撞上了邪祟；在六爻，断是在远处沾染了邪气。
en: A Water ghost on the first line is judged the well god; a Fire ghost on the second, the Director of Fate; a ghost on the third, the household shrine; on the fifth, the Five Sages of the road-head; on the fourth, running into an evil influence on going out; on the sixth, catching an evil taint in a far place.

title: 以卦身推是什么人的鬼：鬼克身是冤家债主、身克鬼是妻妾阴人，我生它是卑幼儿童僧道、它生我是祖宗尊长父母，无生合克刑是兄弟朋友

rule.yi: 拿卦身来推是什么人的鬼：鬼克卦身，是冤家债主的鬼，一定难以退去，病也不容易好；卦身克鬼，是妻妾一类女人的鬼；卦身生鬼，是晚辈、小孩、僧人道士的鬼（子孙）；鬼生卦身，是祖宗、长辈、父母的鬼（父母）；两者比和，是兄弟朋友的鬼，阴爻上是妯娌姊妹的鬼；没有生、合、克、刑，也一定是兄弟朋友。
rule.en: Work out whose ghost it is by the Body. A ghost that controls the Body is the ghost of an enemy or creditor, hard to drive off, and the illness will not easily settle; the Body controlling the ghost is the ghost of a wife, concubine or woman; the Body generating the ghost is the ghost of a junior, child, monk or Daoist (Output); a ghost generating the Body is the ghost of an ancestor, elder or parent (Resource); where the two are in harmony it is the ghost of a brother or friend (Peer), and on a yin line of a sister-in-law or sister; with no generating, combining, controlling or punishing, it is surely a brother or friend.

note.yi: 经文只说「身」，旧注和王洪绪都说明这是「卦身」。旧注多出的四句（阴爻是妯娌姊妹、子孙是小口卑幼、父母是尊长祖宗、财爻是妻妾阴人）和最后「惟鬼克身…病亦未易安」一句王洪绪没有。月卦身法本身，增删卜易的野鹤认为不验（见 LY.ILL.ZS.01）；他的鬼神章（LY.ILL.ZS.23–25）也没有用卦身去认是谁的鬼，而是按鬼爻的五行和旺衰认。
note.en: The verse says only 'the Body', and both the old commentary and Wang Hongxu make clear that it is the hexagram Body. The four sentences the old commentary adds (a yin line is a sister-in-law or sister, Output is the ghost of the young, Resource of elders and ancestors, the Wealth line of a wife, concubine or woman) and its last 'only a ghost that controls the Body... the illness will not easily settle' Wang Hongxu lacks. The month-Body method itself the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi held unreliable (see LY.ILL.ZS.01); his chapter on ghosts and spirits (LY.ILL.ZS.23-25) does not use the Body to tell whose ghost it is either, but goes by the element and strength of the Pressure line.

zh: 鬼克身，冤家债主；
身克鬼，妻妾阴人。
我去生他，卑幼儿童僧道；
他来生我，祖宗尊长爹娘。
若无生合克刑，必是弟兄朋友。
yi: 鬼克卦身，是冤家债主；
卦身克鬼，是妻妾一类的女人；
我去生它，是晚辈、小孩、僧人道士；
它来生我，是祖宗、长辈、父母。
如果没有生、合、克、刑，一定是兄弟朋友。
en: If the ghost controls the Body, an enemy or creditor;
if the Body controls the ghost, a wife or concubine, a woman;
if I generate it, a junior, a child, a monk or Daoist;
if it generates me, an ancestor, elder, father or mother.
if there is no generating, combining, controlling or punishing, it is surely a brother or friend.

hits.text: 我去生他，卑幼儿童僧道
他来生我，宗祖尊长爹娘
若无生合克刑，必是兄弟朋友
我去生他，卑幼儿童僧道
他来生我，祖宗尊长爹娘
若无生合克刑，必是弟兄朋友

zh: 此以卦身推之。
鬼生卦身为父母，卦身生鬼为子孙；
鬼克卦身为冤仇，卦身克鬼为妻妾。
二者比和为兄弟朋友；
阴爻是妯娌姊妹之鬼。
子孙，小口卑幼之鬼。
父母，尊长祖宗之鬼。
财爻，妻妾、阴人之鬼。
惟鬼克身，冤家债主之鬼，必难退遣。
病亦未易安。
yi: 这是按卦身来推。
鬼生卦身的是父母（父母爻），卦身生鬼的是子孙（子孙爻）；
鬼克卦身的是冤仇，卦身克鬼的是妻妾。
两者比和（五行相同）的，是兄弟朋友；
阴爻的，是妯娌、姊妹的鬼。
子孙，是小孩、晚辈的鬼。
父母，是长辈、祖宗的鬼。
财爻，是妻妾、女人的鬼。
只有鬼克卦身，是冤家债主的鬼，一定难以打发。
病也不容易好。
en: This is worked out by the Body.
A ghost that generates the Body is a parent (Resource); the Body generating the ghost is a descendant (Output);
a ghost controlling the Body is an enemy; the Body controlling the ghost is a wife or concubine.
Where the two are in harmony (the same element), it is Peer: brothers and friends;
a yin line is the ghost of a sister-in-law or a sister.
Output (descendants) means the ghosts of the young and juniors.
Resource (parents) means the ghosts of elders and ancestors.
The Wealth line means the ghosts of a wife, concubine or woman.
Only a ghost that controls the Body, the ghost of an enemy or creditor, is hard to be rid of.
The illness too will not easily settle.

zh: 此以卦身推之。
鬼生卦身为父母，卦身生鬼为子孙，鬼克卦身为冤仇，卦身克鬼为妻妾，二者比合为兄弟朋友姊妹之鬼。
yi: 这是按卦身来推。
鬼生卦身的是父母，卦身生鬼的是子孙，鬼克卦身的是冤仇，卦身克鬼的是妻妾，两者比合的是兄弟朋友姊妹的鬼。
en: This is worked out by the Body.

A ghost that generates the Body is a parent (Resource), the Body generating the ghost is a descendant (Output), a ghost controlling the Body is an enemy, the Body controlling the ghost is a wife or concubine, and where the two are in harmony it is the ghost of a brother (Peer), friend or sister.

title: 鬼带刑爻必非善终之鬼：旧注按地支分辰压死、午汤火烫、酉刀箭、亥落水、寅虎噬、巳蛇伤、戌犬咬、丑牛触，旺则为神道；王洪绪说按五行所属推

rule.yi: 鬼带刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼。怎么死的：旧注按鬼的地支分，辰是被墙壁压死，午是被热汤烈火烫死烧死，酉是被刀箭所伤，亥是投河落水，寅也许是被老虎咬死，巳是被蛇咬伤，戌是被狗咬，丑是被牛顶；旺相的成了神道，像刘郡王、猛将这样的神。王洪绪说要按鬼所属的五行去推是怎么死的。
rule.en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death. How he died: the old commentary goes by the ghost's branch — Chen, crushed by a wall; Wu, scalded or burned by hot water or fire; You, wounded by blade or arrow; Hai, threw himself into a river or fell into water; Yin, perhaps devoured by a tiger; Si, bitten by a snake; Xu, bitten by a dog; Chou, gored by an ox — and if strong it becomes a spirit-way, like the god Prince Liu, the Fierce General. Wang Hongxu says to work out the manner of death from the element the ghost belongs to.

dispute.yi: 怎么推是怎么死的：旧注按鬼爻的地支分（辰压死、午烫死、酉刀箭、亥落水、寅虎、巳蛇、戌犬、丑牛）；王洪绪说「当以五行所属推其何死鬼」，按五行推，不按地支。两种办法给出的名目不完全重合（例如增删卜易 LY.ILL.ZS.23 按五行说金是刀剑亡鬼、木是刑杖悬梁、水是水死、火是汤火焚烧、土是墙倒屋塌，和旧注的辰午酉亥有部分重合）。书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: How to work out how the ghost died: the old commentary goes by the branch of the Pressure line (Chen crushed, Wu scalded, You blade and arrow, Hai water, Yin tiger, Si snake, Xu dog, Chou ox); Wang Hongxu says 'work out the manner of death from the element it belongs to', by element and not by branch. The two methods do not give exactly the same categories (for instance the Zengshan Buyi, LY.ILL.ZS.23, goes by element — Metal a ghost of blade and sword, Wood of the staff or the hanging beam, Water of drowning, Fire of hot water and burning, Earth of a collapsed wall — which overlaps in part with the old commentary's Chen, Wu, You and Hai). The books do not decide.

note.yi: 「刑爻」这里指带刑的爻，书里没有列出哪些是刑。「刘郡王猛将之神」是民间信奉的神，书里没有解释，按字面译作刘郡王、猛将。这一条的经文只有「刑不善终」四字，和下一条「绝则无祀」在王洪绪那里连成一段注。
note.en: 'A punishing line' means a line carrying punishment (xing); the book does not list which they are. 'Prince Liu, the Fierce General' is a spirit worshipped among the people and is not explained in the book, so is rendered literally. The verse here is only the four characters 'punishment, no good death', and in Wang Hongxu it forms one passage of commentary with the next entry, 'extinction, no one to sacrifice'.

zh: 刑不善终；
yi: 鬼带刑，死得不好；
en: If it carries punishment, the death was not a good one;

zh: 鬼带刑爻，必非善终之鬼。
辰是墙壁压死鬼，午是汤火烧烫鬼，酉是刀箭所伤鬼，亥是投河落水鬼。
寅或虎噬，巳或蛇伤，戌或犬咬，丑或牛触。
旺则为神道，刘郡王猛将之神。
yi: 鬼带着刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼。
辰是被墙壁压死的鬼，午是被开水和火烧烫死的鬼，酉是被刀箭伤死的鬼，亥是投河落水而死的鬼。
寅，也许是被老虎咬死；巳，也许是被蛇咬伤；戌，也许是被狗咬；丑，也许是被牛顶。
旺相的，就成了神道，像刘郡王、猛将这样的神。
en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death.
Chen is a ghost crushed by a wall, Wu a ghost scalded or burned by hot water or fire, You a ghost wounded by blade or arrow, Hai a ghost who threw himself into a river or fell into water.
Yin may be one devoured by a tiger, Si one bitten by a snake, Xu one bitten by a dog, Chou one gored by an ox.
If strong, it becomes a spirit-way, such as the god Prince Liu, the Fierce General.

zh: 鬼带刑爻，必非善终之鬼，当以五行所属推其何死鬼；
yi: 鬼带刑爻，一定是没有善终的鬼，要按它所属的五行推是怎么死的鬼；
en: A ghost carrying a punishing line is surely one who did not die a good death; work out what kind of death from the element it belongs to;

title: 鬼不上卦看它伏在哪一爻下：伏父母下是家先、伏子孙下是小口小儿、伏空下是无收管的孤魂野鬼，临绝爻是无祀之鬼

rule.yi: 鬼爻不上卦，就看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知道是什么鬼祟：伏在父母爻下，是家里已故的祖先；伏在子孙（福神）爻下，是小孩一类；伏在空亡的爻下，是没有人收管的鬼，是孤魂野鬼；如果临在绝爻上，是没有人祭祀的鬼。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden and you will know what kind of ghost it is: hidden under the Resource line, the family's forebears; under the Output (fortune spirit) line, children and the like; under a Void line, a ghost that no one keeps, a lonely wandering ghost; and if it meets an Extinction line, a ghost to whom no one sacrifices.

note.yi: 这一条经文只有「绝则无祀」四字；王洪绪把它和上一条「刑不善终」并成一段注，后半是「不上卦看伏何爻下」，和旧注相同。卜筮正宗后面的书中例（小畜卦）用的是伏鬼的看法：官鬼酉金伏在第三爻辰土下面，辰酉相合，又被戊辰日合住；但断「房中藏着神像」用的是「伏合是藏匿之象、酉金是正气之神、第三爻是房室」，不是上面旧注这条里的父母下是家先、子孙下是小儿。
note.en: The verse here is only the four characters 'extinction, no one to sacrifice'; Wang Hongxu joins it with the previous entry, 'punishment, no good death', into one passage of commentary, whose second half, 'if absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden', is the same as the old commentary. The case that follows in the Bushi Zhengzong (Xiaoxu) uses the reading of a hidden ghost: the You Metal Pressure lies hidden beneath the third line, Chen Earth; Chen and You combine and the Wuchen day also holds it in combination; but the judgment 'a statue is hidden in the room' rests on 'hidden and combined is the image of concealment, You Metal is a spirit of proper energy, the third line is the bedroom', not on the old commentary's 'under Resource the family forebears, under Output children'.

zh: 绝则无祀。
yi: 鬼临绝，就是没有人祭祀的鬼。
en: If it meets Extinction, there is no one to make offerings to it.

zh: 鬼不上卦，看伏何爻下，便知是何鬼崇。
如伏父下，为家先。
伏福下，为小口类。
若伏空下，乃是无收管之鬼，是孤魂野鬼。
若临绝爻，乃无祀之鬼。
yi: 鬼爻不上卦，就看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知道是什么鬼崇。
如果伏在父母爻下，是家里已故的祖先。
伏在子孙（福神）爻下，是小孩这一类。
如果伏在空亡爻下，是没有人收管的鬼，是孤魂野鬼。
如果临在绝爻上，是没有人祭祀的鬼。
en: If the ghost is absent from the hexagram, look under which line it is hidden, and you will know what kind of ghostly influence it is.
If it is hidden under the Resource line, it is the family's forebears.
If hidden under the Output (fortune spirit) line, it is of the kind of small children.
If it is hidden under a Void line, it is a ghost with no one to keep it, a lonely wandering ghost.
If it meets an Extinction line, it is a ghost with no one to sacrifice to it.

zh: 不上卦看伏何爻下，便知是何鬼祟，如伏父下为家先，伏福下为小儿类。
yi: 鬼不上卦，看它伏在哪一爻下面，便知是什么鬼祟：伏在父母爻下是家先，伏在福神（子孙）下是小孩一类。
en: If it is absent from the hexagram, see under which line it is hidden and you will know what ghostly influence it is: hidden under the Resource line, the family's forebears; hidden under the Output (fortune spirit) line, children and the like.

zh: 寅月戊辰日，占病有何鬼神为祸，得小畜卦：
yi: 寅月戊辰日，占病人有什么鬼神作祸，得小畜卦：
en: In the Yin month, on the Wuchen day, he divined what ghost or spirit was making trouble in an illness, and obtained Xiaoxu:

zh: 断曰：凡卜鬼神以官爻为用，今官鬼伏辰爻之下，与飞神作合，又得日辰合住。
予想伏合乃藏匿之象，酉金是正气之神，第三爻为房室，即断曰：汝家房中藏有神像作祟。
彼曰：有铜达摩祖师在匣中。
命其送于寺内，其痛亦愈。
yi: 断说：凡是占鬼神，以官爻为用；现在官鬼伏在辰爻下面，和飞神合在一起，又被日辰合住。
我想，伏着又被合住，是藏起来的象；酉金是正气之神；第三爻是房室；就断说：你家房里藏着一尊神像在作祟。
他说：有一尊铜的达摩祖师像在匣子里。
叫他把像送到寺里去，他的病痛也好了。
en: Judgment: in all divining of ghosts and spirits the Pressure line is the Subject; now Pressure is hidden beneath the Chen line, combines with the flying line, and is further held by a combination with the Day.

I thought that being hidden and combined is the image of concealment; You Metal is a spirit of proper energy; the third line is the bedroom; so I judged: a statue of a spirit is hidden in a room of your house and is making trouble.
He said: there is a bronze figure of Patriarch Damo in a box.
I told him to send it to a temple, and his pain was cured as well.

title: 鬼临日月定然新死亡灵：卦无官鬼而日辰是鬼，必是新死的人为祸；日辰是鬼而卦中又有鬼，是近日新许的愿未酬

rule.yi: 鬼落在日辰上，一定是刚死不久的亡灵：卦里没有官鬼、日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的人在作祸；日辰是鬼、卦里又有鬼的，是因为祈祷，近来新许下的愿还没有还。
rule.en: A ghost that falls on the Day is surely a newly dead spirit: if there is no Pressure in the hexagram and the Day is the ghost, a newly dead person is surely making trouble; if the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is because of a prayer: a vow newly made lately has not been paid.

note.yi: 经文说的是「日月」，旧注和王洪绪都只讲日辰是鬼，没有说月建是鬼怎么办。旧注比王洪绪多一层原因：「必因祈祷」。这一条和病体章里「日辰带鬼，亟为祈祷」（LY.ILL.HJC.49、LY.ILL.HJC.50）是同一个看法，那里讲怎样认是哪一路神。
note.en: The verse speaks of 'Day and Month', but both the old commentary and Wang Hongxu speak only of the Day being the ghost and do not say what to do when the Month is. The old commentary gives one more reason than Wang Hongxu: 'surely because of a prayer'. This entry is the same view as 'when the Day carries the ghost, pray urgently' in the chapter on the patient's condition (LY.ILL.HJC.49 and LY.ILL.HJC.50), where the question of which spirit it is is treated.

zh: 如临日月，定然新死亡灵；
yi: 如果鬼落在日、月上，一定是刚死不久的亡灵；
en: If the ghost falls on the Day or the Month, it is surely a newly dead spirit;

hits.text: 如临日月，定然新死亡灵
如临日月，定然新死亡灵

zh: 卦无官鬼，而日辰是鬼者，必然新死亡人为祸。
若日辰是鬼，而卦中又有鬼，必因祈祷，而近日新许之愿未酬。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼，而日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的人在作祸。
如果日辰是鬼，而卦里又有鬼，一定是因为祈祷，近来新许下的愿还没有还。
en: If there is no Pressure in the hexagram but the Day is the ghost, a newly dead person is surely making trouble.
If the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is surely because of a prayer: a vow newly made lately has not been paid.

zh: 卦无官鬼而日辰是鬼者，必然新死亡灵为祸。
若日辰是鬼，而卦中又有鬼，是近日新许之愿未酬也。
yi: 卦里没有官鬼而日辰是鬼的，一定是刚死的亡灵在作祸。
如果日辰是鬼，而卦里又有鬼，是近来新许下的愿还没有还。
en: If there is no Pressure in the hexagram but the Day is the ghost, a newly dead spirit is surely making trouble.
If the Day is the ghost and the hexagram also has a ghost, it is a vow newly made lately that has not been paid.

title: 鬼自入墓刑决是狱中囚犯：未日占得木爻官鬼谓鬼自入墓，是死于囹圄的囚人之鬼，更带刑爻必死于非命；旺相发动则是庙神

rule.yi: 鬼自己入墓、带刑，一定是关在牢里的囚犯的鬼：比如在未日占卦，得到木爻的官鬼，叫做鬼自己入墓，一定是死在牢狱里的人的鬼；再带刑爻，一定是死于非命，或者死在坟墓之间；旺相又发动的，就是庙里的神。
rule.en: A ghost that enters its own tomb or is punished is surely the ghost of a prisoner in jail: if one divines on a Wei day and gets a Wood Pressure line, the ghost is said to enter its own tomb, and it is surely the ghost of one who died in prison; if it also carries a punishing line, he surely died an unnatural death or died among graves; and if strong and moving, it is a temple god.

note.yi: 「囹圄」是监狱（卜筮大全篇末生僻字注）。「自入墓」的例子是：未是木的墓，在未日占卦，得木爻官鬼，被日辰带进了墓。旧注多一句「更带刑爻，必死于非命，或死于坟墓间者」，王洪绪没有。
note.en: 'Lingyu' is a prison (the book's glossary at the end of the chapter). The example of 'entering its own tomb' is: Wei is the tomb of Wood, so on a Wei day, with a Wood Pressure line, the ghost is taken into its tomb by the Day. The old commentary has one more sentence, 'if it also carries a punishing line, he surely died an unnatural death or died among graves', which Wang Hongxu lacks.

zh: 自入墓刑，决是狱中囚犯。

rule.en: A Wealth line beside it combining with the ghost is surely a lover met under the moon; a Peer on the Other line generating it is a good friend of the village society. If a Wealth line moves and combines with the Pressure line, or Wealth changes into Pressure or Pressure into Wealth so that they combine with each other, it is surely a person who had an illicit affair with the patient who is making trouble; if it is controlled by the Self line and carries the Dark Tortoise, it is the ghost of one who died because of adultery.

title: 鬼动化出六亲即以化出者断：化兄是朋友兄弟妯娌、化鬼加玄武是盗贼、化父母是伯叔、加螣蛇是匠人作魇魅；父化官虽非螣蛇亦是匠人作弊

rule.yi: 鬼爻发动，变出哪一个六亲，就按变出来的这个断：变成兄爻，是朋友、兄弟、妯娌、公婆这一类；变成鬼再加玄武，是盗贼；变成父母，是伯叔这些亲属，再加螣蛇，是他家屋里有工匠做了魇魅的手脚，使家里的人不得安宁；父母变成官，即使没有螣蛇，也是工匠作了弊。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves and turns into one of the six relations, judge by what it turns into: into Peer, friends, brothers, sisters-in-law and parents-in-law; into Pressure with the Dark Tortoise, a thief; into Resource, uncles and other relatives, and with the Coiling Snake added, a craftsman in his house has worked a nightmare-spell so that the household is uneasy; if Resource changes into Pressure, even without the Coiling Snake, a craftsman has played a trick.

note.yi: 「穿窬」是穿墙洞、爬墙头去偷，指小偷。「魇魅」是用邪术暗中害人（卜筮大全篇末的生僻字注只分别解释了「魇」「魅」两个字）。「姑嫜」是丈夫的母亲和父亲（嫜，丈夫的父亲，见生僻字注）；王洪绪的名单里没有它。「匠人作魇魅」是古人的一种说法：工匠在造房子时暗中做手脚害主人，这条书里没有再解释。这一条的核心是：鬼动变出什么，就按变出来的那一类亲属去认。
note.en: 'Chuanyu' is to break through a wall or climb over it to steal, meaning a thief. 'Yanmei' is to harm someone secretly with evil arts (the book's glossary explains only the two characters separately). 'Gujiang' are the husband's mother and father (the glossary defines 'zhang' as the husband's father); Wang Hongxu's list lacks them. 'A craftsman worked a nightmare-spell' is an old way of saying that a craftsman secretly does something against the owner while building the house, which the book does not explain further. The heart of this entry is that whatever the moving ghost changes into decides which kind of relative it is.

title: 太岁鬼临是祖传旧例、日辰官并是口许初心：太岁、日辰都带鬼，是眼下许下酬谢祖辈老规矩的愿还没办完

rule.yi: 太岁上带鬼，是祖辈传下来的老规矩；日辰上并着官，是当初口头许下的心愿。如果太岁、日辰都带鬼，就是眼下许下要酬谢祖辈老规矩的愿，还没有办完。
rule.en: A ghost on the Tai Sui is an old custom handed down from the ancestors; Pressure joined to the Day is the original intention of a spoken vow. If the Tai Sui and the Day both carry the ghost, then a vow has been made for now to repay the ancestral custom, and it is not yet completed.

note.yi: 经文两句是分开的：太岁带鬼是「祖传旧例」，日辰官并是「口许初心」。旧注和王洪绪都把它们合成一条，只讲太岁、日辰都带鬼的情形，没有分别讲各自的意思。「日下」旧注写作「日下」，王洪绪写作「目下」，是字形相近的两种写法，都译作眼下。
note.en: The verse's two lines are separate: the Tai Sui carrying the ghost is 'an ancestral custom', and Pressure joined to the Day is 'the original intention of a spoken vow'. The old commentary and Wang Hongxu both merge them into one entry and treat only the case of both the Tai Sui and the Day carrying the ghost, without explaining each separately. The old commentary writes 'ri xia' and Wang Hongxu 'mu xia', two close-looking forms, both rendered 'for now'.

zh: 太岁鬼临，乃祖传之旧例；

en: A ghost on the Tai Sui is an old custom handed down from the ancestors;

title: 鬼持世是旧愿未酬、鬼伏世下是有口无心、鬼化妻财是斋修不了、变财空亡是有头无尾

rule.yi: 鬼爻持世，不是祖传的老规矩，而是先前口头许过愿、没有还；卦里没有鬼、世爻下面却伏着本宫的鬼，也是旧欠的愿，是嘴上答应了却没放在心上，所以招来责罚；鬼爻变出妻财，一定是斋戒修行没有做完，或者欠土煞的愿、破了戒；变成的财落空亡，是许了愿却没有戒口，有头没尾。
rule.en: When the Pressure line holds the Self position, it is not an old custom but a spoken vow made earlier and not yet paid; if there is no ghost in the hexagram but the ghost of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line, it too is an old debt, words without the heart in it, and so blame has come; if the Pressure line changes into Wealth, a fast or observance was surely not completed, a debt owed to the earth spirits, or a precept was broken; and if the Wealth it changes into is Void, one made the vow but did not keep the abstinence of the mouth: a head with no tail.

note.yi: 经文「持世则未酬旧愿」，王洪绪引作「持世则来酬旧愿」，「未」和「来」形近，按上下文应是「未」；他的注「有旧愿宜酬」也是这个意思。「心斋」按旧注的解释是斋戒修行，「土杀之欠」按字面译作欠土煞的愿。王洪绪的注只有一句，旧注讲了四种情形。
note.en: Where the verse says 'holding Self, the old vow is not yet paid' (wei chou), Wang Hongxu quotes 'holding Self, the old vow is to be paid' (lai chou); 'wei' and 'lai' look alike and by context 'wei' must be right, and his commentary 'an old vow that ought to be paid' means the same. 'Xinzhai', in the old commentary's explanation, is a fast or observance, and 'a debt owed to the earth-killing' is rendered literally as a debt to the earth spirits. Wang Hongxu's commentary is a single sentence, while the old commentary treats four cases.

yi: 鬼持世，是旧愿没有还；伏着的，是嘴上答应了却不放在心上；

en: A ghost holding the Self position means an old vow has not been paid; if hidden, it is a spoken word without the heart in it;
changing into Wealth, the abstinence of the heart was not completed; if Void, it has a head but no tail.

title: 鬼在宅中住居不稳、官临应上朝向不通：内卦第二爻是宅，动鬼临之宅不安常有病；应爻临鬼宅朝向不利宜改

rule.yi: 鬼在住宅的位置上，住得不安稳；官落在应爻上，房子的朝向不顺。内卦的第二爻是宅：发动的鬼落在这里，住宅不安，常常有病；应爻带着鬼，这座宅子的朝向不利，应该改；旧注还说冲克二爻的爻也是这样。
rule.en: A ghost in the house position means the dwelling is unsettled; Pressure on the Other line means the orientation of the house is blocked. The second line of the inner trigram is the house: if a moving ghost sits there, the dwelling is unsettled and there is often illness; if the Other line carries the ghost, the orientation of the house is unfavourable and should be changed; the old commentary adds that a line that clashes with or controls the second line does likewise.

note.en: The old commentary adds the case of a line that clashes with or controls the second line, which Wang Hongxu lacks. How to judge the household itself the old commentary leaves to the chapter on the household; here it treats only the relation of the ghost to the house.

title: 兑卦金龙干佛像：金鬼在兑宫是佛的善愿，带青龙勾陈是装塑、带螣蛇是图画、化父是描写、否则是经文、化财福是修舍

rule.yi: 金在兑卦里发动，涉及佛像：兑是西方的卦，佛又是金身，所以遇到兑宫的金鬼，神佛那里一定有善愿。带青龙、勾陈，是要装銮塑像；带螣蛇，是想画像；变成父母，是描摹；不是这些，就是经文；变成财或福，是想修建房舍。
rule.en: Metal moving in the Dui trigram concerns a Buddha image: Dui is a trigram of the west and a Buddha has a body of gold, so meeting a Metal ghost in the Dui palace, there is surely a good vow to a god or Buddha. With the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth, it is to mount and mould an image; with the Coiling Snake, to paint a picture; changing into Resource, to copy or delineate; otherwise, scripture; changing into Wealth or Output, to build or repair a hall.

note.yi: 经文「金龙」按旧注是兑宫金鬼带青龙，「干」是涉及、冒犯。王洪绪的注只有一句「金身佛像」，旧注按六神和变出的六亲分了装塑、图画、描写、经文、修舍五种。「舍」在这里指房舍、殿堂，旧注没有再解释。
note.en: By the old commentary, 'gold dragon' in the verse is a Metal ghost in the Dui palace carrying the Azure Dragon, and 'gan' means to concern or to offend. Wang Hongxu's commentary is the one phrase 'a Buddha image with a body of gold', while the old commentary divides by the six spirits and the relation it changes into: mounting and moulding, painting, copying, scripture, and building. 'She' here means a house or hall, and the old commentary does not explain further.

zh: 兑卦金龙干佛像；
yi: 兑卦里金带青龙，涉及佛像；
en: In the Dui trigram, Metal with the Azure Dragon concerns a Buddha image;

zh: 兑西方卦，佛又金身，故遇兑宫金鬼，神佛中必有善愿。
带青龙勾陈，装塑；
带鰧蛇，是欲图画；
化父，是描写；
不然，则是经文。
若化财福，是欲修舍。
yi: 兑是西方的卦，佛又是金身，所以遇到兑宫的金鬼，神佛那里一定有善愿。
带青龙、勾陈，是要装銮塑像；
带螣蛇，是想画像；
变成父母，是描摹；
不是这些，就是经文。
如果变成财或福，是想修建房舍。
en: Dui is a trigram of the west, and a Buddha has a body of gold, so meeting a Metal ghost in the Dui palace, there is surely a good vow to a god or Buddha.
With the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth, it is to mount and mould an image;
with the Coiling Snake, it is to paint a picture;
changing into Resource, it is to copy or delineate;
otherwise, it is scripture.
If it changes into Wealth or Output, it is to build or repair a hall.

zh: 金在兑宫发动，金身佛像；
yi: 金在兑宫发动，是金身的佛像；
en: Metal moving in the Dui palace: a Buddha image with a body of gold;

title: 坎宫木动犯划舟：木在坎宫发动是舟楫之象，必划龙船、上三相公见咎，送之则吉；艮巽卦中水鬼临青龙动及木化水、水化木皆是

rule.yi: 木在坎宫发动，冒犯了划船（龙船）的神：是船和桨的象，一定是划龙船的事，上三相公怪罪，把他们送走就吉利；在艮卦、巽卦里水鬼带青龙发动，以及木变水、水变木，鬼落在水上，也都是这个象。
rule.en: Wood moving in the Kan palace has offended the spirit of the rowed boat: it is the image of a boat and oars, surely a matter of rowing the dragon boat, and the Three Lords Above are displeased; seeing them off brings good fortune. In the Gen or Xun trigram, a Water ghost carrying the Azure Dragon and moving, or Wood changing into Water or Water into Wood, with the ghost on Water, is the same image.

note.yi: 「上三相公」是旧注提到的神，书里没有解释，按字面译作上面的三位相公。王洪绪把「舟楫」写作「舟辑」，字形相近，意思同。这一条和上一条（兑卦金龙）在王洪绪那里是同一段注的前后两句。
note.en: The 'Three Lords Above' are spirits the old commentary mentions but does not explain, and are rendered literally. Wang Hongxu writes 'boat and oars' with a variant character; the meaning is the same. This entry and the previous one (Metal and the Dragon in Dui) are the two halves of one passage in Wang Hongxu.

zh: 坎宫木动犯划舟。
yi: 木在坎宫发动，冒犯了划船的神。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace offends the spirit of the rowed boat.

zh: 木在坎宫发动，舟楫之象。
必划龙船，上三相公见咎。
送之则吉。
若艮巽卦中，水鬼临青龙动，及木化水，水化木，鬼在水上皆是。
yi: 木在坎宫发动，是船和桨的象。
一定是划龙船的事，上三相公怪罪。
把他们送走就吉利。
如果在艮卦、巽卦里，水鬼带青龙发动，以及木变水，水变木，鬼落在水上，都是这个象。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace is the image of a boat and oars.
It is surely a matter of rowing the dragon boat, and the Three Lords Above are displeased.
Seeing them off brings good fortune.
If in the Gen or Xun trigram a Water ghost carries the Azure Dragon and moves, or Wood changes into Water or Water into Wood, with the ghost on Water, all are this image.

zh: 木在坎宫发动，舟辑之象。
yi: 木在坎宫发动，是船桨的象。
en: Wood moving in the Kan palace is the image of a boat and oars.

title: 水土交加在乾宫是三元大帝、火金互动于兑卦为五道伤官：乾宫土化水水化土遇官爻是三官（天地水），兑宫火金互发遇官爻是五道刀剑之神

rule.yi: 水和土交错加在一起，在乾宫就是三元大帝（天官、地官、水官）：乾宫里土变水、水变土，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象；火和金互相发动，在兑卦就是五道伤官（五道是刀剑之神）：在兑宫里互相发动，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
rule.en: Water and Earth mingled together, in the Qian palace, are the Three Primes Great Emperor (the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water): in the Qian palace, Earth changing into Water or Water into Earth and meeting a Pressure line is this image. Fire and Metal moving upon each other, in the Dui trigram, are the Five Paths and the Injuring Officer (the Five Paths are the spirit of blade and sword): moving upon each other in the Dui palace and meeting a Pressure line is this image.

note.yi: 经文和旧注在卜筮大全里写在同一行，中间只隔一个空格；本库按内容拆开。「三元大帝」旧注解作天、地、水三官。旧注和王洪绪都只解释了三官和五道，「伤官」没有再解释。王洪绪引经文时把「在乾宫」「于兑卦」的位置调到了句中，意思一样。
note.en: In the Bushi Daquan the verse and old commentary sit on one line separated by a single space; the library splits them by content. The old commentary explains the 'Three Primes Great Emperor' as the Three Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water. Both commentaries explain only the Three Officials and the Five Paths, and neither explains the 'Injuring Officer'. When Wang Hongxu quotes the verse he moves 'in Qian' and 'in Dui' to the middle of the line; the meaning is the same.

zh: 水土交加，在乾宫则三元大帝；
火金互动，于兑卦为五道伤官。
yi: 水和土交错加在一起，在乾宫就是三元大帝；
火和金互相发动，在兑卦就是五道伤官。
en: Water and Earth mingled together, in the Qian palace, are the Three Primes Great Emperor;
Fire and Metal moving upon each other, in the Dui trigram, are the Five Paths and the Injuring Officer.

hits.text: 水土交加在乾宫，则三元大帝
火金互动于兑卦，为五道伤官
水土交加，在乾宫则三官大帝
火金互动，于兑卦为五道伤官

zh: 三官，天地水三官。
乾宫土化水，水化土，而遇官爻者，是其象。
五道是刀剑之神。
在兑宫互相发，而遇官爻者，是其象。
yi: 三官，就是天、地、水三官。
乾宫里土变水、水变土，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
五道是掌管刀剑的神。
在兑宫里（火和金）互相发动，又遇到官爻的，就是这个象。
en: The Three Officials are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water.
In the Qian palace, Earth changing into Water or Water into Earth, meeting a Pressure line, is this image.
The Five Paths are the spirit in charge of blade and sword.
In the Dui palace, (Fire and Metal) moving upon each other, meeting a Pressure line, is this image.

zh: 三官；
天地水三官，乾宫土水互化遇官爻者是也。
五道乃刀剑之神，在兑宫互相发动而遇官鬼者是也。
yi: 所谓三官；
就是天、地、水三官，乾宫里土和水互相变，又遇到官爻的就是。
五道是刀剑之神，在兑宫里（火和金）互相发动而遇到官鬼的就是。
en: The 'Three Officials';
are the Officials of Heaven, Earth and Water, and this is when in the Qian palace Earth and Water change into each other and meet a Pressure line.
The Five Paths are the spirit of blade and sword, and this is when in the Dui palace (Fire and Metal) move upon each other and meet Pressure.

title: 三空无香火之堂：占病遇第三爻空亡，象是不供香火的厅堂；动空化空似有若无，旺相空亡供器不全

rule.yi: 第三爻落空，就是没有供香火的厅堂：占病时遇到第三爻空亡，他家不供奉香火；动了又落空、变出来也是空，像有又像没有；旺相而落空亡，供奉的器物不齐全。
rule.en: A Void third line means a hall where no incense or fire is offered: in divining illness, when the third line is Void, his family does not offer incense and fire; if it moves into Void or changes into Void, it is as if there were something and as if there were nothing; if strong yet Void, the sacrificial vessels are incomplete.

note.yi: 经文两句「三空无香火之堂，怪动有不祥之祸」，王洪绪的注把两句连成一段，本库按句拆成这一条和下一条。旧注比王洪绪多了动空化空、旺相空亡两种细分。
note.en: The verse has two lines, 'a void third: no hall of incense; a strange line moving: inauspicious misfortune', and Wang Hongxu's commentary runs them into one passage; the library splits them by line into this entry and the next. The old commentary distinguishes two more cases than Wang Hongxu: moving into or changing into Void, and strong yet Void.

zh: 三空无香火之堂；
yi: 第三爻落空，就是没有供香火的厅堂；
en: A Void third line means a hall where no incense or fire is offered;

zh: 凡占病，遇三爻空亡者，其象不供香火之堂。
动空化空，似有若无。
旺相空亡，供器不全。
余见家宅章。
yi: 凡是占病，遇到第三爻空亡的，象是不供香火的厅堂。
动了又落空、变出来也是空，像有又像没有。
旺相而空亡，供奉的器物不齐全。
其余在家宅章里有。
en: In divining illness, when the third line is Void, the image is a hall where no incense or fire is offered.
If it moves into Void or changes into Void, it is as if there were something and as if there were nothing.
If strong yet Void, the sacrificial vessels are incomplete.
The rest is in the chapter on the household.

zh: 三爻空，其家不奉香火。
yi: 第三爻空，他家不供奉香火。
en: If the third line is Void, his family does not offer incense and fire.

title: 怪动有不祥之祸：怪爻依月份取位（旧注：季月初六爻、仲月二五爻、孟月三四爻），动了才成怪；临父母必有怪器、加玄武是盗人之物、螣蛇又动临鬼爻然后可言有怪

rule.yi: 怪动有不吉利的灾祸：怪爻按起卦的月份取，一定要动了才成怪，不动就没有；带父母，一定有怪异的器物；加玄武，是偷来的东西；遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事；螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有怪异。旧注取位是季月落在初爻和六爻，仲月二爻和五爻，孟月三爻和四爻。
rule.en: When the strange line moves there is inauspicious misfortune: the strange line is taken by the month of casting, and it becomes strange only when it moves — if still, there is none. With Resource there is a strange object; with the Dark Tortoise added, stolen goods; whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is a strange matter; and only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one say there is something strange. The old commentary takes the position as the first and sixth lines in the Ji months, the second and fifth in the Zhong months, and the third and fourth in the Meng months.

dispute.yi: 怪爻按月份落在哪几爻：旧注的口诀是季月（辰戌丑未）在初、六爻，仲月（子午卯酉）在二、五爻，孟月（寅申巳亥）在三、四爻；王洪绪写「初六爻是仲月，二五爻是孟月，三四爻是季月」，把三对爻位和三种月份的配法错开了一位（初六配仲、二五配孟、三四配季）。两家对不上，书里没有说哪个是抄错的。
dispute.en: Which lines the strange line falls on by month: the old commentary's rhyme puts the Ji months (Chen, Xu, Chou, Wei) on the first and sixth lines, the Zhong months (Zi, Wu, Mao, You) on the second and fifth, and the Meng months (Yin, Shen, Si, Hai) on the third and fourth; Wang Hongxu writes 'the first and sixth lines are the Zhong months, the second and fifth the Meng months, the third and fourth the Ji months', which shifts the pairing of the three line-pairs and the three kinds of month by one place (first and sixth with Zhong, second and fifth with Meng, third and fourth with Ji). The two do not agree, and the books do not say which is a copying slip.

note.yi: 怪爻的月份口诀只见于旧注。另外旧注末句是「然后可言有怪」，王洪绪写作「然后可言妖怪」，前者说「有怪异」，后者说「有妖怪」，轻重略有不同。「季月」是辰戌丑未月，「仲月」是子午卯酉月，「孟月」是寅申巳亥月。
note.en: The rhyme for the months of the strange line is found only in the old commentary. The old commentary's last sentence is 'only then can one say there is something strange' and Wang Hongxu's 'only then can one speak of a monster'; the first says 'something strange', the second 'a monster', a slight difference of weight. The Ji months are those of Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei, the Zhong months those of Zi, Wu, Mao and You, and the Meng months those of Yin, Shen, Si and Hai.

zh: 怪动有不祥之祸。
yi: 怪爻发动，有不吉利的灾祸。
en: When the strange line moves, there is inauspicious misfortune.

zh: 怪爻季是两头居，初与六爻是。
仲月逢之二五随，孟月只宜三四是。
动爻成怪静无之。
临父母，必有怪器。
加玄武是盗人之物。
凡遇此爻动，虽非鬼爻，必是怪事。
鰧蛇又动临鬼爻，然后可言有怪。
yi: 怪爻在季月落在两头，就是初爻和六爻。
仲月遇到，是二爻、五爻跟着；孟月只在三爻、四爻。
动爻才成怪，不动就没有。
带父母，一定有怪异的器物。
加玄武，是偷来的东西。
凡是遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事。
螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有怪异。
en: In the Ji months the strange line sits at the two ends, the first and sixth lines.
In the Zhong months it is followed by the second and fifth; in the Meng months it is only the third and fourth.
A moving line becomes strange; if still there is none.
With Resource, there is surely a strange object.
With the Dark Tortoise added, it is a thief's stolen goods.
Whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is surely a strange matter.
Only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one say there is something strange.

zh: 怪爻四季月，初六爻是仲月，二五爻是孟月，三四爻是季月。
临父母必有怪器，加玄武是盗人之物，凡遇此爻动，虽非鬼爻，必是怪事。
螣蛇又动临鬼爻，然后可言妖怪。
yi: 怪爻在四季月，初、六爻是仲月，二、五爻是孟月，三、四爻是季月。
带父母一定有怪异的器物，加玄武是偷来的东西，凡是遇到这一爻发动，即使不是鬼爻，也一定是怪事。
螣蛇又发动、落在鬼爻上，然后才可以说有妖怪。
en: The strange line, in the four seasons' months: the first and sixth lines are the Zhong months, the second and fifth lines the Meng months, the third and fourth lines the Ji months.
With Resource there is surely a strange object; with the Dark Tortoise added, stolen goods; whenever this line moves, even if it is not the Pressure line, it is surely a strange matter.
Only when the Coiling Snake also moves and sits on the Pressure line can one speak of a monster.

title: 龙遇文书独发经文可断：占有何鬼神不专看鬼爻，独发之爻亦可推；父母独发是祖宗求祀，临青龙则有善愿经文；本宫鬼爻伏世下在胎养生旺是新死亡人讨求经忏荐度

rule.yi: 青龙遇到父母（文书）、一爻单独发动，可以断是经文：占有什么鬼神，不一定只看鬼爻，单独发动的那一爻也可以推。父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀，带青龙就有善愿和经文；旧注还说，本宫的鬼爻伏在世爻下、又在胎、养、长生、帝旺的位置上，一定有刚死的人在讨要念经拜忏来超度，伏鬼属水的话棺材还暴露着，落空就不是。
rule.en: The Dragon meeting the document line, with a lone line moving, may be judged to mean scripture: in divining what ghost or spirit is involved, one need not rely only on the Pressure line, since a lone moving line can also be worked out. If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice, and with the Azure Dragon there is a good vow and scripture; the old commentary adds that if the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line and stands at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak, a newly dead person is asking for scripture-chanting and rites of repentance to deliver him, and if the hidden ghost is Water the coffin is still exposed, and if it is Void it is not so.

note.yi: 经文说「龙遇文书」，旧注没有解「文书」，按上下文文书是父母爻。旧注多出两层：一层是「不持鬼爻断，独发之爻亦可推」的总原则，一层是本宫鬼爻伏世下、在胎养生旺的新死亡人，王洪绪只留了父母独发这一句。「荐度」是做法事超度亡灵。
note.en: The verse says 'the Dragon meeting the document line', and the old commentary does not gloss 'document'; by context it is the Resource line. The old commentary has two layers Wang Hongxu lacks: the general principle 'not relying on the Pressure line, a lone moving line may also be worked out', and the newly dead person when the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak. Wang Hongxu keeps only Resource moving alone. 'Jiandu' is to perform rites to deliver the spirit of the dead.

zh: 龙遇文书，独发经文可断；
yi: 青龙遇到文书，一爻单独发动，可以断是经文；
en: The Dragon meeting the document line, with a lone line moving, may be judged to mean scripture;

hits.text: 龙遇文书独发，经文可断
龙遇文书，独发经文可断

zh: 凡占有何鬼神，不持鬼爻断，独发之爻亦可推。
如父母独发，祖宗求祀。
临青龙，则有善愿经文。
本宫鬼爻，又伏世下，而在胎养生旺之地者，必有新死亡人，讨求经忏荐度也。
伏鬼属水，棺尚暴露，空则不然。
yi: 凡是占有什么鬼神，不专靠鬼爻来断，单独发动的那一爻也可以推。
比如父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀。
带青龙，就有善愿和经文。
本宫的鬼爻，又伏在世爻下面，而且在胎、养、长生、帝旺的位置上，一定有刚死的人，在讨要念经拜忏来超度。
伏着的鬼属水，棺材还暴露在外；如果落空就不是这样。
en: In divining what ghost or spirit is involved, one need not rely only on the Pressure line to judge; a lone moving line can also be worked out.
If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice.
With the Azure Dragon, there is a good vow and scripture.

If the Pressure line of the home palace is hidden beneath the Self line and stands at Womb, Nurture, Birth or Peak, there is surely a newly dead person asking for scripture-chanting and rites of repentance to deliver him.
If the hidden ghost is Water, the coffin is still exposed; if it is Void, it is not so.

zh: 如父母独发，乃祖宗求祀，临青龙则有善愿经文。
yi: 如果父母爻单独发动，是祖宗要求祭祀，带青龙就有善愿和经文。
en: If Resource alone moves, the ancestors are asking for sacrifice, and with the Azure Dragon there is a good vow and scripture.

title: 蛇逢官鬼属阴梦寐当推：鬼临螣蛇必有虚惊怪异，在阴宫阴象则有梦寐，冲克世爻用爻是梦中所见神祟，螣蛇临鬼动是吊死鬼

rule.yi: 螣蛇遇到官鬼、属阴的，梦里的事该推一推：鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异；如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐；冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中见到的神祟；旧注还说螣蛇带着鬼发动，就是吊死鬼。
rule.en: The Snake meeting Pressure, of the yin kind: dreams should be worked out. A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things; in a yin palace and a yin image there are dreams; one that clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line is surely a spirit seen in a dream; and the old commentary adds that if the Coiling Snake moves with the ghost, it is a hanged ghost.

note.yi: 经文最后一个字，卜筮大全作「梦寐当推」，王洪绪引作「梦寐难当」：一个是「该推算」，一个是「难以承受」，字面不同，书里没有说哪个对。旧注比王洪绪多一句「螣蛇临鬼动，则是吊死鬼」。
note.en: The verse's ending in the Bushi Daquan is 'dreams should be worked out' (dang tui), and Wang Hongxu quotes 'dreams are hard to bear' (nan dang); the wording differs and the books do not say which is right. The old commentary has one more sentence than Wang Hongxu: 'if the Coiling Snake moves on the ghost, it is a hanged ghost'.

zh: 蛇逢官鬼，属阴梦寐当推。
yi: 螣蛇遇到官鬼、属阴的，梦里的事该推一推。
en: The Coiling Snake meeting Pressure, of the yin kind: dreams should be worked out.

hits.text: 蛇逢官鬼，属阴梦寐当推

zh: 鬼临鰧蛇，必有虚惊怪异。
若在阴宫阴象，则有梦寐。
冲克世爻用爻，必梦中所见神崇。
鰧蛇临鬼动，则是吊死鬼。
yi: 鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异。
如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐。
冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中所见的神祟。
螣蛇带着鬼发动，就是吊死鬼。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things.
If it is in a yin palace and a yin image, there are dreams.
If it clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line, it is surely a spirit seen in a dream.
If the Coiling Snake moves with the ghost, it is a hanged ghost.

zh: 鬼临螣蛇，必有虚惊怪异，若在阴宫阴象则有梦寐，冲克世爻用爻，必梦中所见神祟。
yi: 鬼带螣蛇，一定有虚惊怪异；如果在阴宫、阴象，就有梦寐；冲克世爻、用爻的，一定是梦中见到的神祟。
en: A ghost on the Coiling Snake surely brings false alarms and strange things; if it is in a yin palace and a yin image, there are dreams; if it clashes with or controls the Self line or the Subject line, it is surely a spirit seen in a dream.

title: 动入空中值鬼恐失孝思之礼：官爻动空化空，主先亡中有失祀礼，或逢忌日不设祭；在他宫外卦则是眷属中曾有祀礼今取消不设其位

rule.yi: 鬼动了又落入空亡，恐怕丢了孝敬追思的礼数：官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里有丢了祭祀礼数的，或者遇到忌日没有摆祭；如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经有过祭祀的礼，现在却取消了，不设他的牌位；或者曾经送过纸钱纸帛，现在没有了。
rule.en: A ghost that moves into Void: it is feared the rites of filial remembrance have been neglected. If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, it means that among the departed forebears some rites of sacrifice have been lost, or no offering was set out on the anniversary of a death; if it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin there was once a rite of sacrifice which has now been dropped and his place is no longer set, or paper offerings used to be sent and now none is.

note.yi: 「禴」是周礼里的一种春夏之祭。「褚帛」按旧注的用法是烧给亡人的纸钱纸帛，书里没有解释，按字面译。王洪绪没有忌日和纸钱两句；他的「眷中曾会祀礼不设其位」比旧注的「眷属中曾有祀礼，今却除之，不设其位」少了「今却除之」，语意不全，可能是传抄脱字，书里没有说明。
note.en: 'Yue' is a seasonal sacrifice in the Zhou rites, of spring or summer. 'Chubo' in the old commentary's usage is paper money and cloth burned for the dead; the book does not explain it and it is rendered literally. Wang Hongxu lacks the anniversary and paper-offering sentences; his 'among the kin a rite of sacrifice was once held, and his place is not set' lacks the old commentary's 'now dropped' and is incomplete in sense, perhaps a scribal omission, which the book does not explain.

zh: 动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼；
yi: 鬼动了又落入空亡，恐怕丢了孝敬追思的礼数；
en: A ghost that moves into Void: it is feared that the rites of filial remembrance have been neglected;

hits.text: 动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼
动入空中值鬼，恐失孝思之礼

zh: 官爻动空化空，皆主先亡中，有失禴祀，或逢忌日不设祭也。
若在他宫外卦，则是眷属中曾有祀礼，今却除之，不设其位。
或曾馈送褚帛，今无之。
皆有此象。
yi: 官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里，有失了禴祭的，或者遇到忌日没有摆祭。
如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经有过祭祀的礼，现在却取消了，不设他的牌位。
或者曾经送过纸钱纸帛，现在没有了。
都是这样的象。
en: If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, in each case it means that among the departed forebears some have lost the seasonal Yue sacrifice, or that no offering was set out on the anniversary of a death.
If it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin there was once a rite of sacrifice which has now been dropped, and his place is no longer set.
Or paper offerings used to be sent, and now none is.
All have this image.

zh: 官爻动空化空，皆主先亡中有失祀礼。
若在他宫外卦，则是眷中曾会祀礼不设其位。
yi: 官爻发动落空、或变出来空，都主先人亡故的人里有丢了祭祀礼数的。
如果在别的宫、外卦，就是亲属里曾经会过的祭祀礼，不再设他的位置。
en: If the Pressure line moves into Void or changes into Void, in each case it means that among the departed forebears some rites of sacrifice have been neglected.
If it is in another palace or the outer trigram, it is that among the kin a rite of sacrifice was once held, and his place is no longer set.

title: 静居宅上临木家停暴露之棺：木爻官鬼安静地落在二爻，或木鬼伏在父母爻下，其家必停灵柩，举之则安；衰弱的是座席，撤了家宅安泰

rule.yi: 鬼安静地落在宅位（二爻）上又是木，家里停着裸露的棺材：木爻的官鬼安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，这家一定停着灵柩，把它抬走就安宁了；衰弱的话是座席，撤掉它，家宅安泰；旧注说照这样断，万无一失。
rule.en: A still ghost on the house position (the second line), being Wood, means the family has a coffin lying exposed: if a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying in the hall, and once it is carried away there will be peace; if weak, it is a seat or mat, and once it is taken away the household is at peace. The old commentary says that judged this way nothing can go wrong.

note.yi: 「座席」旧注没有解释，按字面译作座位或席子。旧注末句「依此断，万无一失」是注者自己的保证，王洪绪没有，本库照抄注者的话，不替它担保。这一条是鬼神章的最后一条。
note.en: The old commentary does not explain 'zuoxi' (seat and mat), rendered literally as a seat or mat. The old commentary's last sentence, 'judge by this and nothing will go wrong', is the commentator's own guarantee, which Wang Hongxu lacks; the library copies the commentator's words and does not stand surety for them. This is the last entry of the chapter on ghosts and spirits.

zh: 静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺。
yi: 鬼安静地坐在宅位上又是木，家里停着裸露着的棺材。
en: A still ghost sitting on the house position, being Wood, means the family has a coffin lying exposed.

hits.text: 静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺
静居宅上临木，家停暴露之棺

zh: 木爻官鬼，静临二爻，或木鬼伏于父母下，其家必然停柩在堂，举之则安。
衰则座席，起之，家宅安泰。
依此断，万无一失。
yi: 木爻的官鬼，安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，这家一定停着灵柩在堂屋，把它抬走就安宁了。
衰弱的话，就是座席，撤掉它，家宅就安泰。
照这样断，万无一失。
en: If a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying in the hall, and once it is carried away there will be peace.
If weak, it is a mat or seat, and once it is taken away the household will be at peace.
Judge by this and nothing will go wrong.

zh: 木爻官鬼静临二爻，或木鬼伏于父母下，其家必然停柩不安。
yi: 木爻的官鬼安静地落在二爻，或者木鬼伏在父母爻下面，他家一定停着灵柩，不得安宁。
en: If a Wood Pressure line sits still on the second line, or a Wood ghost is hidden beneath the Resource line, the family surely has a coffin lying unburied and is uneasy.

title: 占疾病要慎而详：大端有四——占死生、占病症、占医药、占鬼崇；病何日起、病何处得是疾病的附占（游南子）

rule.yi: 人不幸有了病来占，不可以不谨慎、不周详。大的方面有四件事：占他是死是活，占他是什么病症，占医和药，占有没有鬼崇；至于病是哪一天起的、在哪里得的，是疾病附带要占的事。
rule.en: When a person is unfortunate enough to fall ill and divines about it, one must be careful and thorough. There are four main heads: whether he will live or die, what the illness is, doctors and medicine, and ghostly influences; when the illness began and where it was caught are subsidiary matters of illness.

note.yi: 「病症」在这里是病是什么样的症候，「鬼崇」是鬼神作祟。易隐这一章正是按这四件事排的：二、生死；三、病症；六、医药；七、鬼崇，另有四、病因，五、饮食，八、病起何方，九、病起何年月日。增删卜易的李我平也把来问的事分成吉凶、犯了什么鬼神、病源三类（见 LY.ILL.ZS.39）。
note.en: 'Bingzheng' here is the pattern of symptoms the illness shows, and 'guisui' is ghosts and spirits making trouble. The chapter of the Yi Yin is arranged by just these heads: 2 life and death, 3 symptoms, 6 doctors and medicine, 7 ghostly influences, with 4 the cause of the illness, 5 food and drink, 8 where the illness arose and 9 when it arose in addition. Li Woping in the Zengshan Buyi likewise sorts the matters asked into fortune, which ghost or spirit was offended, and the source of the illness (see LY.ILL.ZS.39).

zh: 游南子曰，夫人不幸有疾而占之，不可不慎而详也。
然大端有四，占其死生，占其病症，占其医药，占其鬼崇而已。
若乃病何日起，病何处得，亦疾病之附占也。
yi: 游南子说：人不幸有了病来占，不可以不谨慎、不周详。
然而大的方面有四件：占他的死活，占他的病症，占他的医药，占有没有鬼崇，仅此而已。
至于病是哪一天起的、在哪里得的，也是疾病的附带占问。
en: Master Younan says: when a person is unfortunate enough to fall ill and divines about it, one cannot but be careful and thorough.
But the main heads are four: divine whether he lives or dies, divine the symptoms, divine the doctors and medicine, and divine the ghostly influences, and that is all.
As for what day the illness began and where it was caught, these too are subsidiary questions of illness.

title: 鬼谷分爻：六爻各配身体部位和一个吉凶名——六爻头脑黄泉、五爻心肺棺椁、四爻脾脏福德、三爻肝肾哭声、二爻腿股吊客、初爻足丧门

rule.yi: 鬼谷把六爻这样分：六爻是头脑，配黄泉；五爻是心肺，配棺椁；四爻是脾脏，配福德；三爻是肝肾，配哭声；二爻是腿和大腿，配吊客；初爻是足，配丧门。
rule.en: Guigu divides the six lines as follows: the sixth line is the head and brain, matched with the Yellow Springs; the fifth is the heart and lungs, with the Coffin; the fourth is the spleen, with Fortune; the third is the liver and kidneys, with Wailing; the second is the legs and thighs, with the Guest of Condolence; the first is the feet, with the Mourning Gate.

note.yi: 表是分两栏排的，书里没有说是从哪一爻排起。按后面「又分宫」一段（初爻是足，二爻股膝，三爻腹腰，四爻胸胃乳，五爻面项手，六爻头脑），头脑在六爻、足在初爻，可知表是从六爻往下排到初爻；右栏的黄泉、棺椁、福德、哭声、吊客、丧门书里没有解释，按字面译。「福德」在这里是这一爻配的名目，不是六亲里的子孙。
note.en: The table is set out in two columns and the book does not say which line it starts from. By the later passage 'again by the division of the lines' (first line the feet, second the thighs and knees, third the belly and waist, fourth the chest, stomach and breasts, fifth the face, neck and hands, sixth the head and brain), the head is on the sixth line and the feet on the first, so the table runs from the sixth line down to the first; the right column — Yellow Springs, Coffin, Fortune, Wailing, Guest of Condolence, Mourning Gate — is not explained in the book and is rendered literally. 'Fortune' (fude) here is the name matched to that line and is not the Output line of the six relations.

zh: 鬼谷分爻
头脑黄泉
心肺棺椁
脾脏福德
肝肾哭声
腿股吊客
足丧门
yi: 鬼谷分爻（表）：
头脑，黄泉；
心肺，棺椁；
脾脏，福德；
肝肾，哭声；
腿股，吊客；
足，丧门。
en: Guigu's division of the lines (table):
head and brain, the Yellow Springs;
heart and lungs, the Coffin;
spleen, Fortune;
liver and kidneys, Wailing;
legs and thighs, the Guest of Condolence;
feet, the Mourning Gate.

title: 占病取用爻：自占以世爻、身爻、命爻为用，代占以应爻为用；占家亲祖妣用官鬼、父兄妻子各以所属；五属不上卦从《黄金策》分爻取用；奴占家主用五爻、占主母用二爻

rule.yi: 占病取用爻：自己占，拿世爻、身爻、命爻做用；替别人占，拿应爻做用。占家里的亲人，祖父祖母用官鬼，父亲、兄弟、妻子、子女各用自己所属的那一类爻；这五类亲属如果不上卦，就按《黄金策》分爻的办法取用。奴仆丁口占家主，拿五爻做用；占主母，拿二爻做用。
rule.en: Taking the Subject line in divining illness: in divining for oneself, the Self line, the Body line and the destiny line are the Subject; in divining for another, the Other line is the Subject. In divining for kin of the household, grandfather and grandmother use the Pressure line, and father, brother, wife and child each use the relation to which they belong; if these five kinds of relative do not appear in the hexagram, take the Subject by the Huangjin Ce's division of the lines. A servant or hired hand divining for the master of the house takes the fifth line as the Subject, and for the mistress the second line.

dispute.yi: 代占取哪一爻：易隐说代占以应爻为用，但占家里的亲人又各用所属的六亲；黄金策的旧注和王洪绪对这一点也不一致，旧注说自占以世为主、代占以应为主，王洪绪说占夫用官、占妻用财、按所占的人取（见 LY.ILL.HJC.33）。增删卜易则按所占的人取用神，不取应爻。
dispute.en: Which line to take in divining for another: the Yi Yin says the Other line is the Subject in divining for another, yet for kin of the household it takes each relation as its own; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu on the Huangjin Ce also disagree on this, the old commentary saying the Self is the master in divining for oneself and the Other in divining for another, and Wang Hongxu taking Pressure for a husband and Wealth for a wife, by the person divined (see LY.ILL.HJC.33). The Zengshan Buyi takes the Subject by the person divined and does not take the Other line.

note.yi: 「五属」是父母、兄弟、妻财、子孙、官鬼这五类六亲；这里说的「黄金策分爻」是黄金策疾病章讲的按所占是谁取六亲的办法。「身爻」指卦身，「命爻」指本命所在的爻。
note.en: The 'five kinds' are the five relations Resource, Peer, Wealth, Output and Pressure; the 'Huangjin Ce division of the lines' is the way the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness takes the relation according to who is divined. 'The Body line' means the hexagram Body and 'the destiny line' the line where the person's natal branch stands.

zh: 自占以世爻身爻命爻为用，代占以应爻为用。
占家亲，祖妣用官鬼，父兄妻子，以各属为用。
如五属不上卦者，则从黄金策分爻取用。
若奴丁占家主，以五爻为用。
占主母，以二爻为用也。
yi: 自己占，拿世爻、身爻、命爻做用；替别人占，拿应爻做用。
占家里的亲人，祖父祖母用官鬼，父亲、兄弟、妻子、子女各用自己所属的那一类爻。
如果这五类亲属不上卦，就按《黄金策》分爻的办法取用。
如果奴仆丁口占家主，拿五爻做用。
占主母，拿二爻做用。
en: In divining for oneself, the Self line, the Body line and the destiny line are the Subject; in divining for another, the Other line is the Subject.
In divining for kin of the household, grandfather and grandmother use the Pressure line, and father, brother, wife and child each use the relation to which they belong.
If these five kinds of relative do not appear in the hexagram, take the Subject by the Huangjin Ce's division of the lines.
If a servant or hired hand divines for the master of the house, the fifth line is the Subject.
For the mistress of the house, the second line is the Subject.

title: 生死·愈：用爻遇龙福月解天医天喜生合即愈；鬼伤用者子孙生旺临值之日、子孙生合用爻之日、鬼被刑害克冲之日愈；用入胎墓者刑冲胎墓之日愈；死绝者生用之日愈；伏藏而元神旺忌神衰者用爻当值之日愈；可救者待鬼衰身旺世生之日愈

rule.yi: 用爻遇到青龙、福德、月解、天医、天喜这些吉神，临在它上面或者生它、合它，病就会好。鬼伤到用爻的，子孙生旺、当值的那天好，子孙来生用爻、合用爻的那天好，鬼被刑、害、克、冲的那天好。用爻入胎、入墓的，刑冲那个胎、墓的日子好；用爻死、绝的，生它的那天好；用爻在『病』位的，它生旺的那天好；用爻伏藏而原神旺、忌神衰的，用爻当值的那天好；用爻的墓遇空、绝遇生、克用的鬼遇克，都可以救，等鬼衰、身旺、世被生的那天好。
rule.en: If the Subject line meets the auspicious spirits Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor or Heavenly Joy, sitting on it or generating or combining with it, he recovers. If the ghost harms the Subject line, he recovers on the day Output is strong and on duty, on the day Output generates or combines with the Subject line, and on the day the ghost is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed. If the Subject line enters Womb or a tomb, he recovers on the day that punishes or clashes the Womb or tomb; if it is in Death or Extinction, on the day that generates it; if it is at Sickness, on the day it is born or strong; if the Subject line is hidden but the Support is strong and the Adversary weak, on the day the Subject line comes on duty; and if its tomb meets Void, its Extinction meets generation, or the ghost that harms it meets control, he can be saved, and recovers on the day the ghost is weak, the Body strong and the Self generated.

note.yi: 「龙福月解天医天喜」是几个吉神：龙是青龙，福是福德，月解、天医、天喜是神煞，书里没有列表。「胎」是十二长生里的胎位。三个断例都在书末的「附断例」里，这里分别挂在它们验证的判断下：解之困（元神独发又化进神，申酉日愈）、革之困（忌神逢绝、官遇长生，戊申日愈）、履之小畜（财遇长生，甲申日愈）。
note.en: 'The Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor and Heavenly Joy' are auspicious spirits: the Dragon is the Azure Dragon, Fortune is Fude, and Month Release, Heavenly Doctor and Heavenly Joy are spirit-stars, which the book does not list. 'Womb' is the Womb stage of the twelve life stages. The three cases are from the 'appended cases' at the end of the section and are hung here under the judgments they bear out: Xie into Kun (the Support moving alone and changing into an Advancing spirit, cured on a Shen or You day), Ge into Kun (the Adversary meeting Extinction and Pressure meeting Birth, cured on the Wushen day), and Lu into Xiaoxu (Wealth meeting Birth, cured on the Jiashen day).

zh: 用爻遇龙福月解天医天喜临持生合者，即愈也。
鬼伤用者，子孙生旺临值之日愈也，子孙生合用爻之日愈也，鬼被刑害克冲之日愈也。
用入胎墓者，刑冲胎墓之日愈也。
用爻死绝者，生用之日愈也。
用爻值病者，生旺之日愈也。
用爻伏藏而元神旺，忌神衰者，用爻临值之日愈也。
用墓逢空，用绝逢生，用鬼逢克者，可救也，待鬼衰身旺世生之日愈也。
yi: 用爻遇到青龙、福德、月解、天医、天喜这些吉神，临在它上面或者生它、合它的，就会好。
鬼爻伤到用爻的，子孙生旺、当值的那天好，子孙来生用爻、合用爻的那天好，鬼被刑、害、克、冲的那天好。
用爻入了胎、墓的，刑冲那个胎、墓的日子好。
用爻死、绝的，生它的那天好。
用爻正处在『病』位的，它生旺的那天好。
用爻伏藏，而原神旺、忌神衰的，用爻当值的那天好。
用爻的墓遇到空，用爻的绝遇到生，伤用爻的鬼遇到克，这些都可以救，等到鬼衰、身旺、世被生的那天好。
en: If the Subject line meets the Dragon, Fortune, Month Release, Heavenly Doctor or Heavenly Joy, sitting on it or generating or combining with it, he recovers at once.

If the ghost harms the Subject line, he recovers on the day Output is strong and on duty, on the day Output generates or combines with the Subject line, and on the day the ghost is punished, harmed, controlled or clashed.
If the Subject line enters Womb or a tomb, he recovers on the day that punishes or clashes the Womb or tomb.
If the Subject line is in Death or Extinction, he recovers on the day that generates it.
If the Subject line is at the stage of Sickness, he recovers on the day it is born or strong.
If the Subject line is hidden but the Support is strong and the Adversary weak, he recovers on the day the Subject line comes on duty.

If the Subject's tomb meets Void, its Extinction meets generation, or the ghost that harms it meets control, he can be saved, and recovers on the day the ghost is weak, the Body strong and the Self generated.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月辛未日，子占父病，得解之困。
本宫子水父母，伏寅木之下，虽云泄气，喜申金，元神独发，又化进神，更得日辰生之，决能生父。
惟不宜土财持世，喜岁月与伏下寅木克之，果于申酉日愈也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月辛未日，儿子占父亲的病，得到解卦变困卦。
本宫的子水父母爻伏在寅木下面，虽然说被泄气，但喜有申金原神独自发动，又变出进神，再得日辰生它，一定能生扶父亲。
只是不适合土财爻持世，好在岁、月和伏在下面的寅木克制它，果然在申酉日好了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Wuyin month, on the Xinwei day, a son divined about his father's illness and obtained Xie changing into Kun (Confinement).

The Zi Water Resource line of the home palace lies hidden beneath Yin Wood and, though drained, is fortunate that Shen Metal, the Support, moves alone and further changes into an Advancing spirit, and is generated by the Day as well: it will surely give life to the father.
Only it is unsuitable that an Earth Wealth line holds the Self position, but the Year, the Month and the Yin Wood hidden beneath control it, and indeed he recovered on a Shen or You day.

zh: 庚寅年癸未月戊戌日，妻占夫病，得革之困。
土用为神，丑土月破，化入辰墓，兄生子而子克官，人皆云凶。
岂知本宫辰土，得寅木动生午火相扶，后至戊申日，忌神逢绝，官遇长生而愈也。
yi: 庚寅年癸未月戊戌日，妻子占丈夫的病，得到革卦变困卦。
土是用神，丑土月破，变出去入了辰墓，兄爻生子孙、子孙克官爻，大家都说凶。
哪知道本宫的辰土得到寅木发动生午火来扶助，后来到戊申日，忌神遇到绝，官爻遇到长生，病就好了。
en: In the Gengyin year, the Guiwei month, on the Wuxu day, a wife divined about her husband's illness and obtained Ge changing into Kun (Confinement).
Earth is the Subject; Chou Earth is in Month-break and changes into the Chen tomb; Peer generates Output and Output controls Pressure; everyone said it was ominous.

But they did not know that Chen Earth of the home palace was helped by Yin Wood moving to generate Wu Fire, and later on the Wushen day the Adversary met Extinction and Pressure met Birth, and he recovered.

zh: 庚寅年甲申月癸酉日，夫占妻病，得履之小畜。
五爻财伏世下，飞上申金生之，三爻兄弟虽动，喜五爻子动，兄乃贪生忘克，而子得生气，生财愈有力矣。
