yi: 李我平说：凡是占药，也有该占的时候，比如医生治疗垂危的病，想用这味药，能起死回生，只怕一有闪失，关系不小。
得到子孙发动的，一定是喜悦，就可以用它，用了必定见效。
或者泛海行船，或者长途旅行，没有地方找医生，有人传来一个奇方，占得子孙发动的，这个方子一定见效。
或者半夜更深，来不及请医生，翻检古方和家里藏的药散，确实对这个病，却不敢擅自用，就不能不占，都拿子孙当用神，只要子孙持世、子孙发动，吃下去马上可以解忧。
在这些占里，子孙不管是金木水火土哪一行，只要旺相或发动，就是喜悦的神，因为用这个方子，见效才喜，不见效，哪里有什么喜？
千万不可又因为金临子孙就用针，火属子孙就用灸，反而弄错。
en: Li Woping says: in divining medicine there are times when one ought to divine, as when a doctor treating a dying patient wants to give a certain medicine that might bring him back from death, and fears only one failure, which would matter greatly.
If Output moves, there is surely joy, and it may be used, and used it will surely be effective.
Or crossing the sea in a boat, or on a long journey with nowhere to find a doctor, someone passes on a rare prescription; if the divination shows Output moving, the prescription will surely work.

Or in the depth of night with no time to call a doctor, one checks old prescriptions and the powders kept at home, which truly fit this illness, but does not dare use them on one's own authority; then one must divine, and in all cases Output is the Subject: if only Output holds the Self line and Output moves, taking it at once relieves the worry.

In all these divinations Output, whatever its phase of metal, wood, water, fire or earth, is the spirit of joy so long as it is strong or moving, for one takes the prescription in order to be glad that it works, and if it does not work, what gladness is there?
One must on no account take Metal on Output to mean the needle, or Fire as Output to mean moxibustion, which only leads to error.

zh: 觉子曰：此卦酉金兄动以生子孙，服此热药而病愈者，若使前贤见之，又以酉金兄爻而为药矣。
yi: 觉子说：这一卦酉金兄弟动来生子孙，服了这热药而病好了，要是让前辈贤人看到，又会把酉金兄弟爻当成药了。
en: Juezi says: in this hexagram You Metal Peer moves to generate Output, and the patient recovered by taking this hot medicine; had the worthies of old seen it, they would again have taken the You Metal Peer line as the medicine.

zh: 余见此卦生疑，近病化六冲，不死之症，却是子孙变鬼，必死之症，不敢断之，再请亲人卜之。
叔占侄病，得“坤为地”
yi: 我看了这一卦心生疑惑：近病变六冲，是不会死的症；可是子孙变鬼，又是必死的症，所以不敢断，请亲人再卜一次。
叔叔占侄子的病，得坤为地卦。
en: Seeing this hexagram I was doubtful: a recent illness changing into Six-Clash is an illness that does not kill, but Output changing into Pressure is one that surely kills; I did not dare judge and asked a relative to divine again.
An uncle divining his nephew's illness got Kun (Earth).

zh: 又得六冲，知之不死矣，问有旧病否？
彼曰：“从无病根，便自山东一路而来，亦无病起。
适间日落之时，忽而满床乱滚，口不能言。”
余曰：既无旧病，余敢保之即愈。
yi: 又得到六冲，知道他不会死了，问有没有旧病？
他说：“从来没有病根，从山东一路回来，也没有生病。
刚才日落的时候，忽然在床上满床乱滚，嘴里说不出话。”
我说：既然没有旧病，我敢保证他马上就好。
en: The hexagram was again Six-Clash, and I knew he would not die, and asked whether he had an old illness.
He said: 'He has never had a root of illness, and coming all the way from Shandong he did not fall ill either.
Just now at sunset he suddenly rolled all over the bed and could not speak.'
I said: since there is no old illness, I dare guarantee that he will recover at once.

zh: 应为病人，世克应爻还不妨，乃是克制病人之病也。
但不宜应爻化回头之克，定是用药有误。
余问东家：药曾吃否？
答曰：“未热。”
问医者曰：“所得何病？
所下何药？”
伊曰：“三伏天途中受暑，不过解暑之凉药耳。”
余私对东家曰：“令郎不死，却得必死之卦，恐此药未必对症，再请复看。”
yi: 应爻是病人，世爻克应爻还不妨碍，那是克制病人的病。
只是不宜应爻变出回头克，那一定是用药有错。
我问主人：药吃了没有？
回答说：“药还没热。”
我问医生：“得的是什么病？
下的是什么药？”
他说：“三伏天路上中了暑，不过是解暑的凉药罢了。”
我私下对主人说：“令郎不会死，却得到必死的卦，恐怕这药未必对症，请再复查一下。”
en: The Other line is the patient, and the Self line controlling the Other line does no harm, for it controls the patient's illness.
But the Other line should not change into a returning control; that would surely be a mistake in the medicine.
I asked the master of the house: has the medicine been taken?
He answered: 'It has not yet been heated.'
I asked the doctor: 'What illness is it?
What medicine have you given?'
He said: 'He took the heat on the road in the dog days, and it is only a cooling medicine to relieve the heat.'
I said privately to the master: 'Your son will not die, yet the hexagram he got is one of certain death; I fear this medicine may not fit the illness; please have him examined again.'

zh: 医者曰：“床上乱滚，不能把脉。”
随以家人问途中何如，家人言曰：“到家热极，移床于此有风之处，再用大冰二块，安于凉床之下，命侄女掌扇。
一觉睡熟，忽然醒来呼唤几声，即不言矣。”
余想：热极之人，卧冰临风，空旷之夫，使姻掌扇，其病可知。
医者亦曰：“适看病已扶入房矣，不知此节事，看来寒药实不可服。”
余曰：竟用附子、肉桂，方可治之。
再命伊父占之：
yi: 医生说：“他在床上乱滚，没法把脉。”
接着我问家里人路上怎么样，家人说：“到家热得厉害，把床移到这个有风的地方，又用两块大冰放在凉床下面，叫侄女摇扇。
他一觉睡得很熟，忽然醒来叫了几声，就不说话了。”
我想：热到极点的人，躺在冰上、对着风，又是空虚之体，还叫姻亲摇扇，他的病就可以知道了。
医生也说：“刚才看病时已经扶进房里了，不知道这一节事，看来寒药实在不能服。”
我说：要用附子、肉桂，才能治他。
再叫他父亲占一次：
en: The doctor said: 'He is rolling about on the bed and I cannot take his pulse.'

Then I asked the household about the journey, and they said: 'He came home extremely hot; we moved the bed to this windy place, put two large blocks of ice under the cool bed and told his niece to fan him.
He fell into a deep sleep, woke suddenly and called out a few times, and then said no more.'
I thought: a man extremely hot, lying on ice in the wind, with an empty body, with an in-law made to fan him, the illness is easy to know.
The doctor also said: 'When I saw him just now he had already been helped into the room, and I did not know about this; it seems cold medicine really must not be taken.'
I said: it must be aconite and cinnamon bark that treat him.
I then had his father divine again:

zh: 壬子日(旬空：寅卯)，占用附子可否？
得“大有之大畜”
yi: 壬子日（旬空：寅、卯），占用附子行不行？
得大有卦变大畜卦。
en: On the Renzi day (void: Yin and Mao), divining whether aconite might be used.
He got Dayou changing into Daxu.

zh: 子孙临日辰，酉金兄动以相生。
服用一剂，保管立愈。
医家先用干姜汤试之，少刻开言，肚疼之甚。
余曰：“何如？
快服此药。”
医家加减调理一夜，次日曰愈。
此人之不死也。
因我出门，子孙发动一卦而断定矣。
厥后连占数卦，合而参之，方敢用大热之剂，起死回生。
不然，一剂凉药，寒上加寒，能于治耶？
yi: 子孙临着日辰，酉金兄弟动来生它。
服一剂，保证马上好。
医生先用干姜汤试着给他，过一会儿他开了口，说肚子疼得厉害。
我说：“怎么样？
快服这药。”
医生加减着调理了一夜，第二天说他好了。
这个人没有死。
是因为我出门时，子孙发动的那一卦就已经断定了。
后来连着占了几卦，合起来参看，才敢用大热的药，起死回生。
不然，一剂凉药，寒上加寒，能治得了吗？
en: Output sits on the Day and You Metal Peer moves to generate it.
One dose taken, and he will surely recover at once.
The doctor first tried dry-ginger soup on him, and after a while he spoke, saying that his belly hurt terribly.
I said: 'How is it?
Take this medicine quickly.'
The doctor adjusted the dose and treated him through the night, and the next day said he was well.
This man did not die.
It was because the hexagram in which Output moved, when I set out, had already settled it.
After that I divined several more hexagrams in a row and studied them together before daring to use very hot medicine, which brought him back from death.
Otherwise, one dose of cool medicine would add cold to cold, and could it treat him?

zh: 一日到一府中，众客告曰：“老先生昨日在后园仆倒，扶起口出狂言，至今不知人事。
适间诸位医者，有曰：不服人参不能提气。
有曰：幸无痰上，若吃人参，痰上则难治矣。”
余曰：“就卜人参吃得否。”
yi: 有一天到一位官府家里，众客人告诉我：“老先生昨天在后花园跌倒，扶起来口出狂话，到现在不省人事。
刚才几位医生，有的说：不服人参不能提气。
有的说：幸好没有痰涌上来，如果吃人参，痰涌上来就难治了。”
我说：“就卜一卜人参吃得吃不得。”
en: One day I came to an official's household, and the guests told me: 'The old gentleman fell down in the back garden yesterday, and when he was helped up he spoke wild words, and until now he has been unconscious.
Just now the doctors said, some of them: without ginseng the qi cannot be lifted.
and some said: luckily no phlegm has risen, and if he takes ginseng and phlegm rises it will be hard to treat.'
I said: 'Let us divine whether ginseng may be taken.'

zh: 寅月丁卯日(旬空：戌亥)，子占父病，人参吃得否？
得“萃之否”
yi: 寅月丁卯日（旬空：戌、亥），儿子占父亲的病，人参吃得吃不得？
得萃卦变否卦。
en: In the Yin month, on a Dingmao day (void: Xu and Hai), a son divining his father's illness, whether ginseng could be taken?
He got Cui changing into Pi.

zh: 占人参，必以子孙为用神，若不通变，只以卦中父动克子而论，不过曰人参不可服也已，病愈与否，弗顾也，余不以此断。
子占父病，父爻为用神，未父化戌父，戌父值旬空，人参可勿用，药亦可不服，明日辰日，冲空即愈。
果于鸡鸣时苏醒，次日不药而愈。
yi: 占人参，一定要拿子孙当用神，如果不会变通，只按卦里父母动来克子孙去论，也不过是说人参不能服罢了，病好不好，不管，我不这样断。
儿子占父亲的病，父爻是用神，未土父母变成戌土父母，戌土父母值旬空，人参可以不用，药也可以不吃，明天辰日，冲空就好。
果然在鸡叫的时候苏醒，第二天不吃药就好了。
en: In divining ginseng the Subject must be Output; if one does not adapt and reasons only from the Resource line moving in the hexagram to control Output, one says no more than that ginseng may not be taken, without regard to whether the illness heals, and I do not judge in this way.

A son divining his father's illness takes the Resource line as the Subject; Wei Earth Resource changes into Xu Earth Resource, and Xu Earth Resource is in Void, so ginseng need not be used and the medicine need not be taken; tomorrow, the Chen day, clashes the Void and he recovers.
Indeed he came to at cockcrow, and the next day recovered without medicine.

zh: 又如一日在席间，忽而东翁口歪眼斜，痰涎长流，余亦在座，其子即问余：“家有牛黄，但不知可服否？”
余命占之。
yi: 又有一天在酒席上，忽然主人口歪眼斜，痰涎直流，我也在座，他的儿子就问我：“家里有牛黄，不知道能不能服？”
我叫他占一卦。
en: Another day, at a banquet, the host's mouth and eyes suddenly twisted and phlegm ran from his mouth; I was at the table, and his son asked me: 'We have bezoar at home, but I do not know whether it may be taken.'
I told him to divine.

zh: 亥月辛酉日(旬空：子丑)，子占父病，服牛黄丸可否？
得“泽天夬”
yi: 亥月辛酉日（旬空：子、丑），儿子占父亲的病，服牛黄丸行不行？
得泽天夬卦。
en: In the Hai month, on a Xinyou day (void: Zi and Chou), a son divining his father's illness, whether the bezoar pill could be taken?
He got Guai (Lake over Heaven).

zh: 余曰：“灌服此丸，可保立愈。”
服之果醒。
盖喜子孙持世也。
或曰：同是子占父药，一卦看父爻，一卦看子孙，其故何也？
余曰：前卦父爻发动，神兆基于动，故以父母断之；
后卦子孙持世值日辰，子孙乃喜悦之神，父病即安，则喜悦矣。
故用子孙也，卦无不灵，在人通变。
yi: 我说：“灌服这颗丸药，可以保证马上好。”
服了果然醒过来。
是因为喜见子孙持世。
有人问：同样是儿子占父亲的药，一卦看父爻，一卦看子孙，是什么缘故？
我说：前一卦父爻发动，神的兆示在于动，所以按父母爻来断；
后一卦子孙持世又值日辰，子孙是喜悦的神，父亲的病马上安了，就喜悦了。
所以用子孙。卦没有不灵验的，在于人会不会变通。
en: I said: 'Give him this pill by pouring it down, and he will surely recover at once.'
He took it and did come to.
It was because Output holding the Self line is what is wanted.
Someone asked: both are a son divining medicine for his father, yet in one hexagram you look at the Resource line and in the other at Output; why?
I said: in the former hexagram the Resource line moves, and the spirit's omen is based on the movement, so I judged by the Resource line;
in the latter hexagram Output holds the Self line and rules the Day, and Output is the spirit of joy; when the father's illness is at once at peace, there is joy.
So I used Output. No hexagram fails to work; it depends on whether one adapts.

title: 子孙持世也要不受克：前面各篇都说子孙持世病即愈，野鹤补一条——必要子孙不受克才行（例：杨梅疮占医人，子孙持世应为医人，但初爻巳火动克申金，巳日添灾）

rule.yi: 前面几篇都说子孙持世，病就马上好，但一定要子孙不受克才行，后来的人不可以不知道。比如有人生了杨梅疮，占这位医生好不好：虽然是子孙持世、应爻是医生，但初爻巳火发动克申金，又有卯木生火，世爻虽旺，巳日一定添灾；他不听，还是请了这位医生，卯日、辰日服药还平安，巳日忽然病症变了，全身疼痛难以忍受。
rule.en: The earlier passages all say that with Output holding the Self line the illness heals at once, but it is so only when Output is not controlled, which later people must know. For example, a man with syphilitic sores divined whether a certain doctor was a good one: though Output held the Self line and the Other line was the doctor, the first line, Si Fire, moved and controlled Shen Metal, with Mao Wood also generating Fire, so that though the Self line was strong there would be added trouble on the Si day; he did not listen and called the doctor, and on the Mao and Chen days the medicine kept him safe, but on the Si day the symptoms suddenly changed and pain all over the body was unbearable.

note.yi: 这一条是对 LY.ILL.ZS.10（子孙持世不药而痊）的补充限制：子孙持世还要看它有没有被克。书中例是占医生，不是占病：子孙持世、应是医人，但初爻巳火动来克申金，野鹤据此断这位医生的药会在巳日添灾。
note.en: This entry is a limiting supplement to LY.ILL.ZS.10 (Output holding the Self line heals without medicine): one must also see whether Output is controlled. The case divines a doctor and not an illness: Output holds the Self line and the Other line is the doctor, but the Si Fire at the first line moves to control Shen Metal, and from this the Old Man judged that this doctor's medicine would bring added trouble on the Si day.

zh: 野鹤曰：前篇俱言子孙持世，其病即愈，然必要子孙不受克方可，后贤不可不知。
yi: 野鹤说：前面几篇都说子孙持世，病就马上好，但一定要子孙不受克才行，后来的贤人不可以不知道。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: the earlier passages all say that with Output holding the Self line the illness heals at once, but it is so only when Output is not controlled; later worthies must not fail to know this.

zh: 又如：有生杨梅疮者，于申月癸卯日(旬空：辰巳)，占医人好否？
得“履之否”
yi: 又如：有人生了杨梅疮，在申月癸卯日（旬空：辰、巳），占这位医生好不好？
得履卦变否卦。
en: Another: a man with syphilitic sores, in the Shen month on a Guimao day (void: Chen and Si), divined whether the doctor was a good one.
He got Lu changing into Pi.

zh: 断曰：此医不可用之。
虽系子孙持世，应为医人，但不宜初爻巳火动克申金，又有卯木生火，世爻虽旺，巳日一定添灾。
不听，竟延此医治之。
卯辰日服药，还保平安，巳日忽然变症，遍身疼痛难当。
病人着急而问余曰：可伤命否？
余曰：世值月建，如何伤命？
速服解药，过此巳午日则止疼矣。
即服解药，至申日，其病如常。
yi: 断语：这个医生不能用。
虽然是子孙持世，应爻是医生，但初爻巳火发动克申金不合适，又有卯木生火，世爻虽然旺，巳日一定添灾。
他不听，还是请这位医生来治。
卯日、辰日服药，还平安，巳日忽然病症变了，全身疼痛难以忍受。
病人着急，问我说：会伤到性命吗？
我说：世爻值月建，怎么会伤命？
赶快服解药，过了巳日、午日就不疼了。
立即服了解药，到申日，他的病像平常一样。
en: Judgment: this doctor must not be used.

Though Output holds the Self line and the Other line is the doctor, it is not fitting that the first line, Si Fire, moves and controls Shen Metal, with Mao Wood also generating Fire; though the Self line is strong, on the Si day there will surely be added trouble.
He did not listen and called this doctor to treat him.
On the Mao and Chen days he took the medicine and was still safe, but on the Si day the symptoms suddenly changed and pain all over the body was unbearable.
The patient was anxious and asked me: will it endanger my life?
I said: the Self line rules the Month; how could it endanger life?
Take the antidote quickly, and once the Si and Wu days are past the pain will stop.
He took the antidote at once, and by the Shen day his illness was as usual.

title: 来人所问决定看什么：问病的吉凶，鬼持世或动是忧神、子孙持世或动是解忧喜悦之神；问病犯何鬼神，看鬼爻五行（金鬼冲犯武神、水鬼得罪河神）；问病源，看鬼爻五行脏腑（火鬼心经、水鬼肾部）——李我平

rule.yi: 官鬼是忧神、子孙是喜悦解忧之神，虽然是古法，用起来很恰当；但也有不把鬼当忧神的，全看来问的人心里想问什么。他问病的吉凶：鬼爻持世、鬼在卦里发动，是忧神；子孙持世、子孙发动，是解忧喜悦的神。他问病是犯了哪路鬼神：卦里出现金鬼，一定冲犯了武神；水鬼，一定得罪了河神这一类。他问病源：卦里出现火鬼，一定属心经；水鬼，一定在肾部。
rule.en: That the Pressure line is the spirit of worry and Output the spirit of joy that relieves worry, though an old method, is very apt in use; but there are cases in which Pressure is not taken as the spirit of worry, and it all depends on what the asker has in mind to ask. If he asks about the fortune of the illness: Pressure holding the Self line or moving in the hexagram is the spirit of worry, and Output holding the Self line or moving is the spirit of joy that relieves worry. If he asks which ghost or spirit the illness offends: a Metal Pressure appearing in the hexagram means he has surely offended a martial god, and a Water Pressure that he has offended the river god and the like. If he asks about the source of the illness: a Fire Pressure appearing in the hexagram surely belongs to the Heart channel, and a Water Pressure surely lies in the Kidney.

note.yi: 李我平在这里把三种看法各归到它回答的问题上：野鹤的「忧神/喜悦神」回答病的吉凶，觉子的五行鬼神（LY.ILL.ZS.23）回答犯了什么，黄金策疾病章开头的五行脏腑（LY.ILL.HJC.02）回答病在哪里。所以野鹤删掉黄金策的首论（LY.ILL.ZS.22），李我平认为不是不对，是问题不同。
note.en: Here Li Woping assigns each of three ways of looking to the question it answers: the Old Man's 'spirit of worry and spirit of joy' answers the fortune of the illness, Juezi's ghosts and spirits by phase (LY.ILL.ZS.23) answers what has been offended, and the organs by phase at the opening of the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness (LY.ILL.HJC.02) answers where the illness lies. So when the Old Man deletes the opening discussion of the Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.ZS.22), Li Woping holds that it is not wrong but answers a different question.

zh: 李我平曰：此论官鬼为忧神，子孙为喜悦解忧之神，虽系古法，然用之甚当，非合鬼神之机，不能幻想至此。
然又有不以鬼作忧神者，全在来人念之所指。
yi: 李我平说：这个论断把官鬼当作忧神，把子孙当作喜悦解忧的神，虽然是古法，用起来却很恰当，不是合了鬼神的机要，想不到这一步。
但是也有不把鬼当忧神的，全在来问的人心里念头指向什么。
en: Li Woping says: this account takes the Pressure line as the spirit of worry and Output as the spirit of joy that relieves worry; though it is an old method, it is very apt in use, and one could not have imagined it without accord with the working of the spirits.
But there are cases in which Pressure is not taken as the spirit of worry, and it all depends on what the asker has in mind.

zh: 彼若问病之凶吉，倘鬼爻持世、鬼动卦中，则为忧神；
子持世、子动卦中，则为解忧喜悦之神。
彼若问病犯是何鬼神，倘卦现金鬼，必冲犯于武神；
水鬼，必获罪于河神之类。
彼若问病源，卦现火鬼，必属心经；
水鬼，必居肾部。
yi: 他如果问病的吉凶，假使鬼爻持世、鬼在卦中发动，那就是忧神；
子孙持世、子孙在卦中发动，就是解忧喜悦的神。
他如果问病是犯了哪路鬼神，假使卦里出现金鬼，一定是冲犯了武神；
水鬼，一定是得罪了河神这一类。
他如果问病源，卦里出现火鬼，一定属心经；
水鬼，一定在肾这一部。
en: If he asks about the fortune of the illness, then if the Pressure line holds the Self line or moves in the hexagram, it is the spirit of worry;
if Output holds the Self line or moves in the hexagram, it is the spirit of joy that relieves worry.
If he asks which ghost or spirit the illness offends, then if a Metal Pressure appears in the hexagram, he has surely offended a martial god;
a Water Pressure means he has surely offended the river god and the like.
If he asks about the source of the illness, then if a Fire Pressure appears in the hexagram it surely belongs to the Heart channel;
a Water Pressure surely lies in the Kidney.

title: 子孙不是针灸之药，火鬼忌热水鬼忌寒是拘泥：子孙旺动则不药自愈，前贤以金生子孙用针、火持子孙用炙是错；诸书说火鬼旺宜大寒药、水鬼旺宜大热药，李我平举土用神、妻占夫二例驳之，说胶柱决之坑陷人命

rule.yi: 子孙旺相又发动的，不吃药就好，并不是教人拿这个子孙当治病的药；前辈贤人常常看到子孙旺动，占病病好、占医医良，就把子孙爻当成治病的药，金生子孙就断用针，火持子孙就断用灸，不知道子孙旺相病自己就好了，哪里用得着针灸，子孙落空被破，针灸又有什么益处。各种书又说火鬼忌热、水鬼忌寒，水鬼在生旺之地要用大热的药，火鬼旺相宜用大寒的药去攻；李我平不知道他们从哪里看出来的：假使用神属土、儿子占父亲的病，父爻临土，火鬼发动是生用爻的元神，怎么能用大寒的药去治元神？妻子占丈夫的病，鬼是用神，丈夫临水鬼，又怎么能用大热的药去攻用神？死板地照大寒大热去断，坑害了不知多少性命。
rule.en: Where Output is strong and moving, one recovers without medicine, and this does not teach us to take that Output as the medicine that treats the illness; the worthies of old often saw Output strong and moving, found that in divining illness the illness healed and in divining a doctor the doctor was good, and so took the Output line as the medicine, judging the needle where Metal generates Output and moxibustion where Fire holds Output, without realising that if Output is strong the illness heals of itself, so what need is there of needle and moxa, and if Output is Void or broken what good would they do. The books also say that a Fire Pressure fears heat and a Water Pressure fears cold, that a Water Pressure in a place of birth or strength must be treated with very hot medicine and a strong Fire Pressure attacked with very cold; Li Woping does not know where they saw this: suppose the Subject is Earth, as when a son divines his father's illness and the Resource line sits on Earth, a moving Fire Pressure is the Support that generates the Subject line, and how could one treat the Support with very cold medicine? When a wife divines her husband's illness, Pressure is the Subject, and if the husband sits on a Water Pressure, how could one attack the Subject with very hot medicine? To judge rigidly by very cold and very hot has sunk who knows how many lives in the pit.

dispute.yi: 用药看什么：黄金策旧注、王洪绪（LY.ILL.HJC.76、HJC.81、HJC.84）按官鬼的五行定寒热（火鬼旺用大寒、水鬼旺用大热），按子孙的五行定针灸（子孙属金用刀针、属火用灸）；李我平、野鹤说这是拘泥：子孙旺动本来就不药而愈，不是针灸之药；火鬼可能是用神的元神，不能拿大寒药去攻；死板照大寒大热去断，是坑人性命。
dispute.en: What to look at in fixing the medicine: the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce and Wang Hongxu (LY.ILL.HJC.76, HJC.81, HJC.84) fix cold or hot by the phase of the Pressure line (a strong Fire Pressure very cold, a strong Water Pressure very hot) and needle or moxa by the phase of Output (Metal Output knife and needle, Fire Output moxa); Li Woping and the Old Man call this rigid: Output strong and moving means recovery without medicine and is not the medicine of needle and moxa, a Fire Pressure may be the Support of the Subject and cannot be attacked with very cold medicine, and to judge rigidly by very cold and very hot sinks lives.

note.yi: 这是整个疾病域里两派分歧最尖锐的一条。李我平末尾说「此书一出，而寒热之药不敢轻用」，是说《增删卜易》出来以后，占卜的人不该再拿五行定寒热。「炙」「灸」在书里写法不一，都指艾灸。「元神」的用法见 LY.ILL.ZS.08。
note.en: This is the sharpest split between the two schools in the whole illness domain. Li Woping's closing 'once this book is out, no one will dare to use cold or hot medicines lightly' means that after the Zengshan Buyi diviners should no longer fix cold and hot by the five phases. 'Zhi' and 'jiu' are written differently in the book and both mean moxibustion. For the use of the 'Support' see LY.ILL.ZS.08. The 'Qian note' at the end of the chapter is a modern addition and is not quoted here.

zh: 子孙旺而动者，不药而愈，非教人以此子孙为治病之药也，往往前贤见此子孙旺动，占病病愈，占医医良，遂以此子孙爻为治病之药。
金生子孙者，断用针；
火持子孙者，断用炙。
殊不知子孙若旺，其病自痊，何用针灸？
子孙若值空破，用针灸而何益？
yi: 子孙旺相又发动的，不吃药就好，并不是教人拿这个子孙当治病的药；往往前辈贤人看到这个子孙旺相发动，占病病好，占医医生高明，就拿这个子孙爻当成治病的药了。
金生子孙的，就断用针；
火持子孙的，就断用灸。
殊不知子孙如果旺相，那病自己就好了，哪里用得着针灸？
子孙如果落空、被破，用针灸又有什么益处？
en: Where Output is strong and moving, one recovers without medicine, and this does not teach us to take that Output as the medicine that treats the illness; the worthies of old often saw Output strong and moving, found that in divining illness the illness healed and in divining a doctor the doctor was good, and so took that Output line as the medicine that treats the illness.
Where Metal generates Output, they judged to use the needle;
where Fire holds Output, to use moxibustion.
They did not realise that if Output is strong the illness heals of itself, so what need is there of needle and moxa?
and if Output is Void or broken, what good would needle and moxa do?

zh: 诸书又皆曰：“火鬼忌热，水鬼忌寒，水鬼若居生旺之地，须大热之药以治之；
火鬼旺者，宜大寒之剂以攻之。”
余不知从何所见。
假使用神属土，及子占父病，父爻临土，若得火鬼发动，乃生用爻之元神也，岂可用大寒之药而治元神耶？
又如妻占夫病，鬼为用神，假便夫临水鬼，又可以大热之药以攻夫爻之用神耶？
每见穷乡僻壤，无处觅医，只谓《周易》乃大圣大贤之书，遵之必灵，而卜者以此大寒大热之药胶柱决之，不知坑陷如许之命，言及发指。
此书一出，而寒热之药不敢轻用，从此泉下无怨鬼矣。
yi: 各种书又都说：“火鬼忌热，水鬼忌寒，水鬼如果在生旺的地方，要用大热的药来治；
火鬼旺相的，宜用大寒的药去攻它。”
我不知道他们是从哪里看出来的。
假使用神属土，比如儿子占父亲的病，父爻临土，如果火鬼发动，那是生用爻的元神，怎么可以用大寒的药去治元神呢？
又如妻子占丈夫的病，鬼是用神，假使丈夫临水鬼，又可以用大热的药去攻丈夫爻的用神吗？
常见穷乡僻壤，没有地方找医生，只当《周易》是大圣大贤的书，照着它办必定灵验，而占卜的人拿这大寒大热的药死板地去决断，不知道坑害了多少条命，说起来令人发指。
这部书一出来，寒热的药就不敢轻易用了，从此黄泉之下没有含冤的鬼了。
en: The books all say again: 'A Fire Pressure fears heat and a Water Pressure fears cold; if a Water Pressure is in a place of birth or strength, it must be treated with very hot medicine;
if a Fire Pressure is strong, attack it with very cold medicine.'
I do not know from where they saw this.

Suppose the Subject is Earth, as when a son divines his father's illness and the Resource line sits on Earth; if a Fire Pressure moves, it is the Support that generates the Subject line, and how could one treat the Support with very cold medicine?
Again, when a wife divines her husband's illness, Pressure is the Subject; suppose the husband sits on a Water Pressure, may one attack the husband line's Subject with very hot medicine?

I have often seen in poor and remote places where there is nowhere to find a doctor, people who think the Zhouyi a book of great sages and worthies that must prove true if followed, and diviners who settle the matter rigidly with these very cold and very hot medicines, not knowing how many lives they have sunk into the pit; it makes one's hair stand on end to speak of it.
Once this book is out, no one will dare to use cold or hot medicines lightly, and from then on there will be no wronged ghosts under the springs.

title: 咸池杀：占婚大忌，主妇人淫乱；寅午戌在卯、巳酉丑在午、申子辰在酉、亥卯未在子

rule.yi: 咸池杀：占婚姻是大忌，主女子淫乱。歌诀按三合局排：寅午戌的兔从卯位出来，巳酉丑的马向南方跑，申子辰的鸡叫乱了人伦，亥卯未的鼠子当头要忌。
rule.en: The Xianchi star: in a marriage divination it is a great taboo and means the woman is licentious. The rhyme goes by the three-harmony frames: for Yin, Wu and Xu the rabbit comes out of Mao; for Si, You and Chou the horse runs south; for Shen, Zi and Chen the rooster crows and disorders human relations; for Hai, Mao and Wei the rat is what must be avoided head-on.

note.yi: 歌诀里的兔、马、鸡、鼠是生肖，依次对着卯、午、酉、子，就是咸池所在的位置；书里没有把地支写出来，这里是照生肖对应的。
note.en: The rabbit, horse, rooster and rat in the rhyme are zodiac animals standing for Mao, Wu, You and Zi in turn, the places of the Xianchi star; the book does not spell out the branches, and they are given by the zodiac.

zh: 占婚大忌，
主妇人淫乱。
yi: 占婚姻，这是大忌，
主女子淫乱。
en: In a marriage divination it is a great taboo,
and it means the woman is licentious.

zh: 寅午戌兔从卯里出，
巳酉丑跃马南方走，
申子辰鸡叫乱人伦，
亥卯未鼠子当头忌。
yi: 寅、午、戌的兔子，从卯位出来，
巳、酉、丑的马，向南方跑，
申、子、辰的鸡叫，乱了人伦，
亥、卯、未的鼠子，当头是要忌的。
en: For Yin, Wu and Xu, the rabbit comes out of Mao;
for Si, You and Chou, the horse leaps and runs to the south;
for Shen, Zi and Chen, the rooster crows and disorders human relations;
for Hai, Mao and Wei, the rat is what is to be avoided head-on.

title: 鳏寡杀：占姻事忌之；春牛不下田、夏龙飞上天、秋羊草枯死、冬犬厌残年

rule.yi: 鳏寡杀：占婚姻的事忌它。歌诀：春天的牛不下田，夏天的龙飞上天，秋天的羊草枯死，冬天的狗厌恶残年。
rule.en: The star of widowers and widows: in marriage matters it is to be avoided. The rhyme: in spring the ox does not go down to the field, in summer the dragon flies up to heaven, in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies, in winter the dog is weary of the dying year.

note.yi: 四句里的牛、龙、羊、犬是生肖，依次对着丑、辰、未、戌，分别是春、夏、秋、冬的鳏寡杀所在；书里没有写出地支。同一首歌诀在《断易天机》里也有，那里注明「婚姻遇发动不久」（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.27）。
note.en: The ox, dragon, goat and dog in the four lines are zodiac animals standing for Chou, Chen, Wei and Xu, the places of this star in spring, summer, autumn and winter; the book does not write out the branches. The same rhyme is in the Duanyi Tianji, where it is glossed 'in marriage, if it moves it does not last' (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.27).

zh: 占姻事忌之。
yi: 占婚姻的事，忌讳它。
en: In marriage matters it is to be avoided.

zh: 春牛不下田，
夏龙飞上天，
秋羊草枯死，
冬犬厌残年。
yi: 春天牛不下田，
夏天龙飞上天，
秋天羊的草枯死，
冬天狗厌恶残年。
en: In spring the ox does not go down to the field,
in summer the dragon flies up to heaven,
in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies,
in winter the dog is weary of the dying year.

title: 孤辰寡宿：婚姻犯之，主无子；亥子丑忌寅戌、寅卯辰忌巳丑、巳午未忌申辰、申酉戌忌亥未

rule.yi: 孤辰寡宿：婚姻犯了它，主没有子女。歌诀：亥子丑忌寅、戌，寅卯辰找巳、丑，巳午未忌申、辰，申酉戌是亥、未来临。
rule.en: The Solitary Star and the Widowhood Star: if a marriage offends them, it means no children. The rhyme: for Hai, Zi and Chou beware Yin and Xu; for Yin, Mao and Chen look to Si and Chou; for Si, Wu and Wei beware Shen and Chen; for Shen, You and Xu, Hai and Wei arrive.

note.yi: 每一句前一个地支按通行的排法是孤辰、后一个是寡宿（亥子丑年孤辰在寅、寡宿在戌，余类推），书里没有写明。「无子」在这里是没有子女的意思，书里没有区分有儿有女。
note.en: In each line, by the usual layout, the first branch is the Solitary Star and the second the Widowhood Star (for Hai, Zi and Chou years the Solitary Star is at Yin and the Widowhood Star at Xu, and so on); the book does not say so. 'No son' here means no offspring, and the book does not tell sons from daughters.

zh: 婚姻犯之，
主无子。
yi: 婚姻犯了它，
主没有子女。
en: If a marriage offends it,
it means no children.

zh: 亥子丑兮忌寅戌，
寅卯辰兮巳丑寻，
巳午未兮申辰忌，
申酉戌兮亥未临。
yi: 亥、子、丑忌寅、戌，
寅、卯、辰找巳、丑，
巳、午、未忌申、辰，
申、酉、戌是亥、未来临。
en: For Hai, Zi and Chou, beware Yin and Xu;
for Yin, Mao and Chen, look to Si and Chou;
for Si, Wu and Wei, beware Shen and Chen;
for Shen, You and Xu, Hai and Wei arrive.

title: 暴败杀：婚姻大忌，男克妇、女伤夫；春猪羊犬、夏蛇鼠龙、秋申酉丑、冬虎马兔

rule.yi: 暴败杀：婚姻是大忌，男的克妻，女的伤夫。歌诀：猪、羊、狗在春天的三个月，蛇、鼠、龙在夏天的月份，申、酉、丑到了秋天一定败，虎、马、兔在冬天要防。
rule.en: The Violent-Ruin star: in marriage it is a great taboo, the man controlling the wife and the woman harming the husband. The rhyme: the pig, goat and dog in the three months of spring; the snake, rat and dragon in the summer months; Shen, You and Chou meeting autumn are sure to fail; the tiger, horse and rabbit are to be guarded against in winter.

note.yi: 歌诀里的生肖依次对着：春三月亥、未、戌，夏三月巳、子、辰，冬三月寅、午、卯；秋三月直接写了申、酉、丑。书里没有把春夏冬的地支写出来。
note.en: The zodiac animals in the rhyme stand for: in the three spring months Hai, Wei and Xu; in the summer months Si, Zi and Chen; in the winter months Yin, Wu and Mao; for the autumn months the branches Shen, You and Chou are written out. The book does not write out the branches for spring, summer and winter.

zh: 婚姻大忌，
男克妇，
女伤夫。
yi: 婚姻是大忌，
男的克妻，
女的伤夫。
en: For marriage it is a great taboo:
the man controls the wife,
the woman harms the husband.

zh: 猪羊犬吠春三月，
蛇鼠龙忧夏月当，
申酉丑逢秋必败，
虎马兔兮冬季防。
yi: 猪、羊、狗吠叫的春天三个月，
蛇、鼠、龙担忧的夏天月份，
申、酉、丑遇到秋天一定败，
虎、马、兔在冬季要防。
en: The pig, goat and dog barking in the three months of spring;
the snake, rat and dragon worrying in the summer months;
Shen, You and Chou meeting autumn are sure to fail;
the tiger, horse and rabbit are to be guarded against in the winter season.

title: 日喝散：甲己逢寅乙庚申，丙辛戊癸向蛇寻，丁壬亥上婚姻忌，一见公私定不成

rule.yi: 日喝散按日干排：甲日、己日在寅，乙日、庚日在申，丙日、辛日、戊日、癸日在巳，丁日、壬日在亥；丁壬日的亥位，婚姻要忌；一见到它，公事私事都一定不成。
rule.en: The Daily Dispersal star goes by the day stem: Jia and Ji days at Yin, Yi and Geng days at Shen, Bing, Xin, Wu and Gui days at Si, Ding and Ren days at Hai; at Hai on Ding and Ren days, marriage is a taboo; once it is seen, public and private matters are sure to fail.

note.yi: 「向蛇寻」的蛇是巳。这一条前面另有「喝散神」，按季节排（春巳夏申秋亥冬寅），讲官事，不讲婚姻，本库没有收。
note.en: The snake in 'look to the snake' is Si. Just before it the book has the seasonal 'Dispersal spirit' (spring Si, summer Shen, autumn Hai, winter Yin), which speaks of official matters and not of marriage and is not included here.

zh: 甲己逢寅乙庚申，
丙辛戊癸向蛇寻，
丁壬亥上婚姻忌，
一见公私定不成。
yi: 甲日、己日逢寅，乙日、庚日逢申，
丙日、辛日、戊日、癸日向巳位找，
丁日、壬日在亥位，婚姻要忌，
一见到它，公事私事一定不成。
en: Jia and Ji meet Yin, Yi and Geng meet Shen;
Bing, Xin, Wu and Gui look to the snake, Si;
Ding and Ren, at Hai, are a taboo for marriage;
once it is seen, public or private matters surely do not succeed.

title: 四刑：寅申巳亥为四刑，所作百事无一成，婚姻官事俱不吉，纵得相生也不宁

rule.yi: 寅、申、巳、亥是四刑：做什么事都没有一件成，婚姻和官事都不吉，即使相生也不安宁（比如寅世、巳应这一类）。
rule.en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments: in doing anything at all nothing is accomplished, marriage and official matters are both unlucky, and even if they generate each other there is no peace (for instance, Self at Yin and Other at Si).

note.yi: 这条和《断易天机》里的四刑是同一首（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.26），用字略有不同：那里是「凡作百事一无成」，这里是「所作百事无一成」；举例也不同，那里是世寅应申，这里是寅世巳应。
note.en: This is the same verse as the four punishments in the Duanyi Tianji (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.26), with a small difference of wording in the second line and a different example: Self at Yin and Other at Shen there, Self at Yin and Other at Si here.

zh: 如寅世巳应之类是也。
yi: 比如寅世、巳应这一类就是。
en: For instance, Self at Yin and Other at Si, and the like.

zh: 寅申巳亥为四刑，
所作百事无一成；
婚姻官事俱不吉，
纵得相生也不宁。
yi: 寅、申、巳、亥是四刑，
所做的百事没有一件成；
婚姻和官事都不吉，
即使得到相生，也不安宁。
en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments;
in what one does, of a hundred things not one is accomplished;
marriage and official matters are both unlucky;
even if they generate each other there is no peace.

title: 神杀断例·天喜与咸池：问喜宜用天喜，消愁宜天解星，大杀不要用，咸池星不要用来问婚

rule.yi: 问喜事，要看天喜星；消愁解忧，要看天解星；大杀不能用；有咸池星的时候不要问婚姻。
rule.en: To ask about a joyful event, look to the Tianxi star; to dispel sorrow, look to the Tianjie star; do not use the Great Killing star; when the Xianchi star is present, do not ask about marriage.

note.yi: 这一句后面还有天医、血忌、往亡、三丘五墓等，都是问病、求雨、出入的口诀，与婚姻无关，没有收。咸池在婚姻里的具体说法见 LY.MARRY.BSQS.01。
note.en: The verse goes on with the Tianyi, Xueji and Wangwang stars, the Three Mounds and Five Tombs and the like, all rhymes on illness, rain-seeking and going out, which have nothing to do with marriage and are not included. What the Xianchi star means in marriage is set out at LY.MARRY.BSQS.01.

zh: 问喜宜天喜，
消愁天解星。
大杀休施用，
咸池莫问婚。
yi: 问喜事，适宜用天喜星，
消愁解忧，要用天解星。
大杀星不要施用，
咸池星不要用来问婚姻。
en: To ask about joy, the Tianxi star is fitting,
to dispel sorrow, use the Tianjie star.
The Great Killing star is not to be used,
and the Xianchi star is not to be used for asking about marriage.

title: 诸爻持世诀：父母持世夫妻相克不和同、到老要求他姓之子；兄弟持世克妻财

rule.yi: 父母爻持世，事情忧虑阻塞，身上带着文书和官鬼，夫妻互相克、不和睦，到老要去求别姓的儿子（过继）。兄弟爻持世，克妻财，官司之忧没了结又来，鬼旺要防口舌，自身强反而损失钱财。
rule.en: With the Resource line holding the Self line, matters are worrying and blocked, one carries documents and Pressure, husband and wife control each other and are not in accord, and in old age one must seek a son of another surname (by adoption). With the Peer line holding the Self line, it controls Wealth, the wife; worry over official matters is not over before more comes; with strong Pressure guard against quarrels; with the Self strong one loses money instead.

note.yi: 这首歌诀有六句，这里只收和夫妻有关的父母持世、兄弟持世两句；同样的诀在《火珠林》（第 945 行）和《周易尚占》（第 477 行）里也有。「用求他姓子」是过继别姓的儿子，即养子。
note.en: The rhyme has more lines; only the two on the Resource and Peer lines holding the Self line, which bear on husband and wife, are included. The same rhyme is in the Huozhulin (line 945) and the Zhouyi Shangzhan (line 477). 'Seeking a son of another surname' means adopting a son of another family.

zh: 父母持世事忧否，
身带文书及官鬼；
夫妻相克不和同，
到老用求他姓子。
yi: 父母爻持世，事情忧虑阻塞，
身上带着文书和官鬼；
夫妻互相克，不和睦，
到老要去求别姓的儿子。
en: With the Resource line holding the Self line, matters are worrying and blocked,
one carries documents and Pressure;
husband and wife control each other and are not in accord,
and in old age one must seek a son of another surname.

zh: 兄弟持世克妻财，
忧官未了事还来；
鬼旺正当防口舌，
身强必定损其财。
yi: 兄弟爻持世，克妻财，
官司的忧虑没了结，事情又来；
鬼旺相，正要防口舌；
自身强，一定损失钱财。
en: With the Peer line holding the Self line, it controls Wealth, the wife;
worry over official matters is not over before more comes;
with strong Pressure, guard against quarrels;
with the Self strong, one will surely lose money.

title: 六亲持世歌：官鬼持世得官，占婚问病俱凶兆；财爻持世，阴爻为妻妾、阳爻为财

rule.yi: 官鬼爻持世，一定得官，文书印信两样都看得见；但占婚姻、问疾病都是凶兆，还会破宅伤财、身不安宁。财爻持世：阴爻是妻妾，阳爻是财，持世持身都合心意；经商种田养蚕收成百倍；占病占产，官鬼是胎。
rule.en: With the Pressure line holding the Self line one is sure to get office, and documents and seals both show; but a divination on marriage or illness is an ill omen, and there will be a broken house, lost money and no ease. With the Wealth line holding the Self line: a yin line is the wife or concubine and a yang line is wealth, and holding the Self or the Body both please the heart; in trade, farming and silkworms the yield is a hundredfold; in divining illness or birth, Pressure is the womb.

dispute.yi: 同样是官鬼持世，这首歌说「占婚问病俱凶兆」，《天玄赋》总论提纲说「官鬼不宜持世，求名婚娶两相宜」（LY.MARRY.TXF.24）。两处都是口诀，没有注，书里不裁断。《增删卜易》按男女分：女占男，官星持世、合世、生世且旺相是良缘（LY.MARRY.ZS.11）。
dispute.en: For the same Pressure line holding Self, this rhyme says 'a divination on marriage or illness is an ill omen', while the opening summary of the Tianxuan Fu says 'Pressure should not hold the Self line, but for seeking office and for marrying both are fitting' (LY.MARRY.TXF.24). Both are bare rhymes and the books do not decide between them. The Zengshan Buyi divides by sex: when a woman divines about a man, a Pressure line that holds, combines with or generates the Self line and is strong makes a good match (LY.MARRY.ZS.11).

note.yi: 这首歌其余几句（父母持世、子孙持世、兄弟持世）讲的是文书、谷财、胎病，与婚姻无关，没有收。同一首歌在《火珠林》（第 948 行）和《周易尚占》（第 477 行）里也有。
note.en: The other lines of the rhyme (on the Resource, Output and Peer lines holding the Self) concern documents, grain and money, and pregnancy and illness, and have nothing to do with marriage and are not included. The same rhyme is in the Huozhulin (line 948) and the Zhouyi Shangzhan (line 477).

zh: 官鬼持世必得官，
文书印信两相看；
占婚问病俱凶兆，
破宅伤财身不安。
yi: 官鬼持世，一定得官，
文书印信两样都看得见；
占婚姻、问疾病都是凶兆，
破宅伤财，身不安宁。
en: Pressure holding the Self line: one is sure to get office,
and documents and seals both show;
but a divination on marriage or illness is an ill omen,
with a broken house, lost money and no ease.

zh: 阴为妻妾阳为财，
持世持身总称怀；
财谷田蚕收百倍，
若占病产鬼为胎。
yi: 阴爻是妻妾，阳爻是财，
持世持身都合心意。
财谷、田地、蚕桑，收成百倍；
如果占病占产，官鬼就是胎。
en: A yin line is the wife or concubine, a yang line is wealth;
holding the Self or the Body both please the heart.
in grain, fields and silkworms the yield is a hundredfold;
if divining illness or birth, Pressure is the womb.

title: 六亲章·妻财：财发动有青龙助因妻致富，临朱雀妻贤慧，犯勾陈妻病，共螣蛇妻拙，同白虎妻性刚，临玄武妻阴暗；两位妻财一妻一妾；妻财合世夫妻顺

rule.yi: 妻财爻发动、有青龙帮助，靠妻子发家致富；财爻临朱雀，妻子贤惠聪明；犯勾陈，妻子有病灾；和螣蛇同位，妻子笨拙；和白虎同行，妻子性子刚烈；临玄武，多有阴暗的事，心思瞒着人，一定不好。两个妻财爻都旺相，是一妻一妾都容貌光彩。卦里如果没有妻财，常独自一人；妻财安静，平安康健。妻财合世爻，夫妻和顺；妻位生身，家道兴旺。
rule.en: With the Wealth line moving and the Azure Dragon helping it, one grows rich through the wife; Wealth on the Vermilion Bird, the wife is worthy and clever; offending Hook Earth, the wife has illness and misfortune; together with the Coiling Snake, the wife is clumsy; going with the White Tiger, the wife's temper is hard; on the Dark Tortoise, much is hidden and dark, and she hides her thoughts from others, surely not good. Two Wealth lines both strong mean one wife and one concubine, both radiant. If the hexagram has no Wealth line one is often alone; Wealth quiet keeps peace and health. Wealth combining with the Self line: husband and wife are in accord; the wife's place generating the Body: the household prospers.

note.yi: 这首歌里「妻财」是财爻，不专指某一个妻子；「两位妻财俱旺相」指卦里有两个财爻。歌的前半（父母、子孙）和后半（官鬼、兄弟）讲别的六亲，没有收。同一首歌在《火珠林》阐奥歌章的六亲章里也有（第 1167 行），个别字不同。
note.en: In this rhyme 'Wealth' is the Wealth line and does not point to a particular wife; 'two Wealth lines' means the hexagram has two Wealth lines. The first part of the rhyme (Resource and Output) and the last (Pressure and Peer) are about other relations and are not included. The same rhyme is in the six-relations chapter of the Chan Ao Ge Zhang in the Huozhulin (line 1167), with a few characters differing.

zh: 妻财发动青龙助，
因妻致富妙难量。
财临朱雀妻贤慧，
妻犯勾陈妻病殃。
螣蛇共位妻应拙，
白虎同行妻性刚。
妻临玄武多阴暗，
心意瞒人必不良。
两位妻财俱旺相，
一妻一妾美容光。
卦若无妻常独自，
妻财安静保安康。
妻财合世夫妻顺，
妻位生身家道昌。
yi: 妻财爻发动，有青龙帮助，
靠妻子发家致富，好处说不尽。
财爻临朱雀，妻子贤惠聪明；
妻财犯了勾陈，妻子有病灾。
和螣蛇同位，妻子应当笨拙；
和白虎同行，妻子性情刚烈。
妻财临玄武，多有阴暗的事，
心思瞒着人，一定不好。
两个妻财爻都旺相，
一妻一妾，容貌都有光彩。
卦里如果没有妻财，常常独自一人；
妻财安静，保平安康健。
妻财爻合世爻，夫妻和顺；
妻位生身，家道兴旺。
en: When the Wealth line moves and the Azure Dragon helps it,
one grows rich through the wife, a blessing beyond measure.
Wealth on the Vermilion Bird: the wife is worthy and clever;
Wealth offending Hook Earth: the wife has illness and misfortune.
together with the Coiling Snake, the wife is clumsy;
going with the White Tiger, the wife's temper is hard.
Wealth on the Dark Tortoise: much that is hidden and dark,
she hides her thoughts from others, surely not good.
Two Wealth lines both strong,
one wife and one concubine, both radiant.
If the hexagram has no Wealth line, one is often alone;
Wealth quiet keeps peace and health.
Wealth combining with the Self line: husband and wife are in accord;
the wife's place generating the Body: the household prospers.

title: 身命章：财临阴位妻交（动）妻妾宜；世、命、应、身相刑相克，不伤自己即伤妻

rule.yi: 财爻落在阴位、又动，妻妾相宜；世、命、应、身彼此又刑又克，不伤到自己就伤到妻子。
rule.en: Wealth on a yin position and moving suits wife and concubine; if the Self, Life, Other and Body punish and control one another, either oneself or one's wife is harmed.

note.yi: 「世为身、应为命」和「内卦为身、外卦为命」是这首歌前面的两种取法，「世命应身」指这几样都算进去。同一首歌在《火珠林》阐奥歌章的身命章里也有（第 1162 行）。
note.en: 'The Self as the Body and the Other as the Life' and 'the inner trigram as the Body and the outer as the Life' are two ways of taking these earlier in the rhyme, and 'Self, Life, Other, Body' means all of them counted. The same rhyme is in the person-and-fate chapter of the Chan Ao Ge Zhang in the Huozhulin (line 1162).

zh: 财临阳位财源广，
阴位妻交妻妾宜。
yi: 财临阳位，财源广；
阴位，妻交，妻妾宜。
en: Wealth on a yang position: the source of wealth is broad;
on a yin position, with the wife line moving, wife and concubine are fitting.

zh: 世命应身刑又克，
不伤自己即伤妻。
yi: 世、命、应、身彼此又刑又克，
不伤自己就伤妻。
en: If the Self, Life, Other and Body punish and control one another,
either oneself or one's wife is harmed.

title: 妻妾财同此：妻、妾和财都看同一个财爻；凡婚姻及求财，皆要此爻旺相有气，不落空亡

rule.yi: 妻、妾和财是同一类，都看财爻。占婚姻和求财，这一爻都要旺相有气，不落空亡。
rule.en: Wife, concubine and wealth are the same kind, all read from the Wealth line. In divining a marriage or seeking wealth alike, this line must be strong and have qi, and must not fall Void.

note.yi: 前一句是「我克者为财」，这一句接着说：妻、妾都跟着财爻。
note.en: The line before it is 'what I control is Wealth', and this one goes on: wife and concubine both follow the Wealth line.

zh: 妻妾财同此。
yi: 妻、妾和财都是这一爻。
en: Wife, concubine and wealth are all this one line.

zh: 凡婚姻及求财，
皆要此卦爻旺相有气，
不落空亡。
yi: 凡是婚姻和求财，
都要这一卦的这一爻旺相有气，
不落空亡。
en: In marriage and in seeking wealth alike,
this line of the hexagram must be strong and have qi,
and must not fall Void.

title: 喜庆视青龙：青龙属木春旺，其神若同子孙发动及持世有气不落空亡，主有婚姻官禄财帛、添进人口之喜

rule.yi: 喜庆的事看青龙。青龙属木，春天旺；它如果和子孙一起发动，或者持世有气、不落空亡，主有婚姻、官禄、财帛，添人进口的喜事。
rule.en: For joyful events look to the Azure Dragon. It belongs to Wood and thrives in spring; if it moves together with Output, or holds Self with qi and does not fall Void, it means the joy of marriage, official salary and wealth, and of people added to the household.

zh: 喜庆视青龙，
yi: 喜庆的事看青龙，
en: For joyful events look to the Azure Dragon,

zh: 属木，
春旺。
其神若同子孙发动，
及持世有气，
不落空亡，
主有婚姻官禄财帛，
添进人口之喜。
yi: 青龙属木，
春天旺。
这个神如果和子孙一起发动，
或者持世有气，
不落空亡，
主有婚姻、官禄、财帛，
添进人口的喜事。
en: It belongs to Wood,
and thrives in spring.
If this spirit moves together with Output,
or holds Self and has qi,
and does not fall Void,
it means marriage, official salary and wealth,
and the joy of adding people to the household.

title: 月建青龙：青龙在内象，月内有婚姻进人口之喜；在外象，求官进职吉

rule.yi: 月建上的青龙：在内象，这个月里有婚姻、添人进口的喜事；在外象，求官、升职吉利。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon of the Month: in the inner image, that month brings the joy of a marriage and of people added to the household; in the outer image, seeking office and promotion is lucky.

note.yi: 这一句前面有一张表，按月排六神（青龙从正月的寅起顺排到十二月的丑），本库没有收表。「内象」「外象」书里没有解释，按字面译。
note.en: Before this line the book has a table laying the six spirits out by month (the Azure Dragon runs from Yin in the first month to Chou in the twelfth), which is not included here. 'Inner image' and 'outer image' are not explained and are translated literally.

zh: 月建青龙在内象，
月内有婚姻进人口之喜。
在外象，
求官进职吉。
yi: 月建上的青龙在内象，
这个月里有婚姻、添人进口的喜事；
如果在外象，
求官、升职吉利。
en: The Azure Dragon of the Month, in the inner image,
brings within that month the joy of a marriage and of people added to the household;
in the outer image,
seeking office and promotion is lucky.

title: 青龙内摇多喜庆：青龙在内三爻动，主家中有婚姻喜庆之事，春寅卯爻为旺相

rule.yi: 青龙在内卦动，多有喜庆：青龙在内三爻上动，主家里有婚姻喜庆的事；春天在寅、卯爻上为旺相。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon moving within brings much celebration: when it moves on one of the inner three lines it means a marriage or other celebration in the household; in spring, on a Yin or Mao line, it is strong.

zh: 青龙内摇多喜庆，
yi: 青龙在内摇动，多有喜庆，
en: The Azure Dragon moving within brings much celebration,

zh: 青龙在内三爻动，
主家中有婚姻喜庆之事。
春寅卯爻为旺相。
yi: 青龙在内三爻上动，
主家里有婚姻喜庆的事。
春天在寅、卯爻上为旺相。
en: The Azure Dragon moving on one of the inner three lines
means a marriage or other celebration in the household.
In spring, on a Yin or Mao line, it is strong.

title: 推占来情：旺相则婚姻官职、休囚则争财退位；内外卦俱旺相者大则求官、次则嫁娶；卦与世爻同克日则必是六畜及婚姻

rule.yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来：先看旺相休囚的气，旺相是婚姻、官职的事，休囚是争财、丢官位的事。注说：春天是艮、震，夏天是巽、离，秋天是坤、兑，冬天是乾、坎；占卜一定要先看八卦的休旺之气，内外卦都旺相的，大的是求官，其次是嫁娶；内外都休囚的，则相反。卦和世爻同克日辰，来问的一定是六畜和婚姻。
rule.en: To know what the diviner has come about, first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped: strong, it is marriage and office; resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place. The note says: spring is Gen and Zhen, summer Xun and Li, autumn Kun and Dui, winter Qian and Kan; a divination must first look at the resting or strong qi of the eight trigrams, and when inner and outer are both strong, the great matter is seeking office and next comes marriage; when inner and outer are both resting or trapped, it is the reverse. If the hexagram and the Self line both control the Day, it must be livestock and marriage.

dispute.yi: 同一首歌诀，《断易天机》作「卦与世爻同与日」（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.30），这里作「卦与世爻同克日」，一字之差：「同与日」是和日辰相同，「同克日」是一起克日辰。
dispute.en: In the same rhyme the Duanyi Tianji reads 'the hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day' (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.30), and this text 'the hexagram and the Self line both control the Day', a one-character difference: 'the same as the Day' means matching the Day and 'both control the Day' means together controlling it.

note.yi: 「休生之卦」的「生」疑是「旺」之误（上下文说的是休旺之气），译文照字面写；「经常有隧」书里没有解释，译作「有常规可循」。
note.en: 'Rest and birth' looks like a slip for 'rest and strength', as the context speaks of resting and strong qi, and is translated as written; 'has a regular tunnel' is not explained and is rendered as having a regular course.

zh: 欲知卜者来何意，
先看旺相休囚气，
旺相婚姻宜官职，
休囚争财官退位。
yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来，
先看旺相休囚的气；
旺相就是婚姻、官职的事，
休囚是争财、丢官位的事。
en: To know what the diviner has come about,
first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped;
strong, it is marriage and office;
resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place.

zh: 春艮震，
夏巽离，
秋坤兑，
冬乾坎。
凡占卜必先看八卦休旺之气者，
盖休生之卦，
乃占卜之提纲也。
故内外俱在旺相者，
大则求官，
次则嫁娶，
出类而知。
凡在公在私，
经常有隧者皆是也。
如内外休囚者，
则反此。
yi: 春天是艮、震，
夏天是巽、离，
秋天是坤、兑，
冬天是乾、坎。
凡是占卜，一定先看八卦休旺的气，
因为休、生的卦，
是占卜的纲领。
所以内外卦都在旺相的，
大的是求官，
其次是嫁娶，
按类推就能知道。
凡是在公在私，
有常规可循的都是这样。
如果内外都休囚，
就与此相反。
en: Spring is Gen and Zhen,
summer is Xun and Li,
autumn is Kun and Dui,
winter is Qian and Kan.
In every divination one must first look at the resting or strong qi of the eight trigrams,
for the trigrams' states of rest and birth
are the guiding thread of divination.
So when inner and outer are both in strength,
the greatest matter is seeking office,
next comes marriage,
and by type one can tell;
whether public or private,
whatever has a regular course is so.
If inner and outer are both resting or trapped,
it is the reverse of this.

zh: 卦与世爻同克日，
必须六畜及婚姻，
yi: 卦和世爻同克日辰，
来问的一定是六畜和婚姻，
en: If the hexagram and the Self line both control the Day,
it must be livestock and marriage,

chapter: 十四、辟《易林补遗》婚姻嫁娶之谬
title: 辟《易林补遗》婚姻嫁娶之谬：用神要按占的人与被占的人是什么关系来取，不能一概以内外卦、世应、财鬼论夫妇

rule.yi: 《易林补遗》一概拿内外卦、世应爻、阴阳财鬼来论夫妇，不管是谁在占、为谁占，这是大谬。王洪绪主张：世爻是我家、应爻是对方家；女人自己占嫁人，以官爻为丈夫，官世相生相合、官阳世阴才叫得地；男人自己占娶妻，以财爻为妻子，财世相生相合、财阴世阳才叫得地；父母尊长为子孙的婚事占，以子孙爻为用神，世上的子孙或阳象是我家的男孩，应上的子孙或阴象是对方的女孩；无冲破而有生合就可配、夫妻和谐，无生合而有冲克就夫妻不睦，休囚或受克就不长寿；为弟弟娶妻、妹妹出嫁占，都以兄弟爻为用神。
rule.en: The Yilin Buyi judges husband and wife by the inner and outer trigrams, the Self and Other lines, and yin, yang, Wealth and Pressure alike, without regard to who divines and for whom; this is a great mistake. Wang Hongxu holds: the Self line is my family and the Other line the other family; when a woman divines for herself about marrying, Pressure is the husband, and only if Pressure and Self generate and combine, with Pressure yang and Self yin, is it called being in place; when a man divines for himself about marrying, Wealth is the wife, and only if Wealth and Self generate and combine, with Wealth yin and Self yang, is it in place; when parents or elders divine the marriage of a child, Output is the Subject, with Output on Self or on a yang image the boy of my family and Output on Other or on a yin image the girl of the other family; with generation and combination and no clash or break they can be matched and are harmonious, with clash and control and no generation or combination they are at odds, and resting or controlled they will not live long; for a younger brother's marriage or a younger sister's, take the Peer line as the Subject.

dispute.yi: 这是王洪绪对《易林补遗》婚姻说法的正面批评（LY.MARRY.YL.05、YL.06、YL.20、YL.21）：《易林补遗》一概按内外卦、世应、财鬼论夫妇，王洪绪要求先分清是谁在占、替谁占，再按这层关系取用神。《增删卜易》也讲代占与自占取用不同（LY.MARRY.ZS.04）。
dispute.en: This is Wang Hongxu's direct attack on the Yilin Buyi's teaching on marriage (LY.MARRY.YL.05, YL.06, YL.20 and YL.21): the Yilin Buyi judges husband and wife throughout by the inner and outer trigrams, Self and Other, and Wealth and Pressure, whereas Wang Hongxu requires first telling who is divining and for whom, and choosing the Subject by that relation. The Zengshan Buyi likewise distinguishes taking the Subject for a proxy from taking it for oneself (LY.MARRY.ZS.04).

note.yi: 张星元即《易林补遗》的作者张世宝（字星元）。「先天之妙旨」指易的本意，书里没有再解释。第三、四、五段是两个卦例，卦图（六爻的排列）不收，只收卦图前后的文字；第二个卦例的前一句在卦图之前。
note.en: Zhang Xingyuan is the author of the Yilin Buyi, Zhang Shibao. 'The fine purport of the primal Way' means the original intent of the Changes and is not explained further. The third to fifth passages belong to two cases, whose hexagram diagrams (the arrangement of the six lines) are not included, only the text before and after the diagrams; the second case's first sentence comes before its diagram.

zh: 婚姻嫁娶，唯《易林补遗》之说最谬，以内外卦世应爻为主，以阴阳财鬼爻为凭，凡男卜女家，内卦为夫外卦为妇；
又以世为夫应为妇，凡女卜男家，外卦为夫内卦为妇，世爻为妇应爻为夫等说，使后学无定见。
假如男家卜婚姻，或遇外卦凶而应爻吉，此婚姻亦好亦不好，竟可配不可配耶？
今人宗之，不问父母叔伯为卜子侄女婿，不问兄弟母舅为卜甥弟女婚，一概以世应论夫妇，官鬼妻财为夫妇，不以用神生克制化之理定其夫妇之吉凶，大失先天之妙旨。
孰知世应财官各有分别。
世爻为我家，应爻为彼家，女人自卜嫁此郎为夫，当以官爻为夫，世为自己，官世相生相合，官阳世阴，此谓之得地。
男人自卜娶此女为妻，当以财为妇，世为自己，财世相生相合，财阴世阳，亦谓之得地。
或父母尊长辈为子孙婚，欲配某家女为媳，以子孙为用神，世上子孙或阳象，子孙皆指我家之男也，应上子孙或阴象，子孙皆指言彼之女也。
无冲破有生合，自然可配，夫妇和谐，无生合有冲克，自然夫妇不睦，或休囚或受克自然不寿。
如父为子婚，世位而受伤者，自然悖逆而刑翁，财爻而受生者，自然孝顺而益。
或为弟娶妹嫁者，皆以兄弟爻为用神也。
yi: 婚姻嫁娶的说法，只有《易林补遗》最荒谬：它以内外卦、世应爻为主，以阴阳、财鬼爻为凭据，凡是男方占女家，内卦是丈夫、外卦是妻子；
又以世爻为丈夫、应爻为妻子，凡是女方占男家，外卦是丈夫、内卦是妻子，世爻是妻子、应爻是丈夫等等，使后来的学者没有定见。
假如男家占婚姻，遇到外卦凶而应爻吉，这桩婚姻既好又不好，到底可配还是不可配呢？
现在的人都宗奉它，不问是父母叔伯替子侄女婿占，不问是兄弟母舅替外甥弟弟女儿的婚事占，一概拿世应论夫妇，拿官鬼妻财当夫妇，不按用神生克制化的道理来定这对夫妇的吉凶，大大失去了先天的妙旨。
谁知道世、应、财、官各有分别。
世爻是我家，应爻是对方家；女人自己占嫁给这个男子，应当以官爻为丈夫，世爻是自己，官世相生相合，官阳世阴，这叫得地。
男人自己占娶这个女子为妻，应当以财爻为妻子，世爻是自己，财世相生相合，财阴世阳，也叫得地。
或者父母、尊长替子孙的婚事占，想给某家的女儿做儿媳，以子孙爻为用神，世爻上的子孙或阳象，子孙都是指我家的男孩，应爻上的子孙或阴象，子孙都是指对方的女孩。
没有冲破、有生合，自然可配，夫妻和谐；没有生合、有冲克，自然夫妻不睦，休囚或者受克，自然不长寿。
如果是父亲替儿子办婚事，世爻上受伤的，自然是媳妇悖逆而刑克公公，财爻受生的，自然孝顺而有益。
或者替弟弟娶妻、妹妹出嫁占，都以兄弟爻为用神。
en: Of the sayings on betrothal and marriage, only that of the Yilin Buyi is the most mistaken: it takes the inner and outer trigrams and the Self and Other lines as the main thing, and yin and yang and the Wealth and Pressure lines as the evidence; whenever a man divines about a woman's family, the inner trigram is the husband and the outer trigram the wife;

and it also takes Self as husband and Other as wife; whenever a woman divines about a man's family, the outer trigram is the husband and the inner trigram the wife, and Self is the wife and Other the husband, and so on, leaving later students with no settled view.
Suppose a man's family divines a marriage and meets an ill outer trigram and a lucky Other line: is the marriage both good and not good, a match that can and cannot be made?

People today follow it: without asking whether parents or uncles are divining for a son, nephew or son-in-law, or brothers or a maternal uncle for a nephew, a younger brother or a daughter's marriage, they judge husband and wife by Self and Other indiscriminately, take Pressure and Wealth as husband and wife, and do not settle the luck of the couple by the principle of the Subject's generation, control, restraint and change, which greatly loses the fine purport of the primal Way.
Who knows that Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure each have their own distinctions.

The Self line is my family and the Other line the other family. When a woman divines for herself about marrying this man, Pressure should be taken as the husband and Self as herself; if Pressure and Self generate and combine, with Pressure yang and Self yin, this is called being in place.

When a man divines for himself about marrying this woman, Wealth should be taken as the wife and Self as himself; if Wealth and Self generate and combine, with Wealth yin and Self yang, this too is called being in place.

Or when parents or elders divine the marriage of a child, wishing to match a girl of some family as a daughter-in-law, take Output as the Subject: Output on Self or on a yang image always means the male of my family, and Output on Other or on a yin image always means the girl of the other family.

With no clash or break and with generation or combination, they can naturally be matched and husband and wife are harmonious; with no generation or combination but clash and control, husband and wife are naturally at odds, and if resting or trapped or controlled, they will naturally not live long.

If a father divines a son's marriage and the line at Self is injured, the bride will naturally be unruly and injure her father-in-law; if the Wealth line is generated, she will naturally be filial and beneficial.
Or for a younger brother's marriage or a younger sister's, always take the Peer line as the Subject.

zh: 曾有午建乙卯日父为女择婿，得否卦安静；
yi: 曾经有一个人，午月乙卯日，父亲替女儿选女婿，得否卦，六爻安静；
en: Once, in the Wu month on a Yi-Mao day, a father chose a husband for his daughter and got the hexagram Pi, with all lines still;

zh: 一人执此卦问予曰：“世阴应阳，官星旺合，卦得六合，日辰持财，财官相生，六爻安静，是必佳偶乎？”
予曰：“若依张星元论，是佳偶也，子孙伏而旬空，是必无子息也；
据予断，子水子孙伏阴爻未土之下，唯恐令爱不寿耳。”
其人不然而去，后成婚不久，此女病故。
yi: 一个人拿着这个卦问我说：「世阴应阳，官星旺而相合，卦得六合，日辰持财，财官相生，六爻安静，这一定是一对佳偶吧？」
我说：「如果照张星元的说法，是佳偶，子孙伏藏而且旬空，必定没有子息；
照我的断法，子水子孙伏在阴爻未土之下，只怕令爱不长寿罢了。」
那个人不以为然就走了，后来成婚不久，这个女子病死了。
en: A man held this hexagram and asked me: 'Self yin and Other yang, the Pressure star strong and combining, the hexagram six-combine, the Day holding Wealth, Wealth and Pressure generating each other, all six lines still: surely a fine match?'
I said: 'By Zhang Xingyuan's theory it is a fine match, but Output is hidden and Void in its ten-day period, so surely there will be no children;
by my judgement, Zi Water Output is hidden under the yin Wei Earth line, and I fear only that your dear daughter will not live long.'
The man did not agree and left; later the marriage was made, and before long the girl died of illness.

zh: 又一人，申月甲午日，父为子择媳得复之噬嗑卦：
yi: 又一个人，申月甲午日，父亲替儿子选媳妇，得复卦变噬嗑卦：
en: Another man, in the Shen month on a Jia-Wu day, a father choosing a daughter-in-law for his son, got the hexagram Fu changing to Shihe:

zh: 予曰：“应爻合成子孙局生世，不但嫁资丰厚，更可享其孝顺之福。
后至巳年完婚，果孝顺贤淑，赠嫁不凡。
若据张星元之说，官为夫，此卦寅木夫星月破，又被金局克，是必克夫，何完婚已二十年，翁姑在堂，夫妇和谐，不唯子多，已近得孙矣！
后学当如是断，庶无弃吉就凶，以至误人婚配也。
yi: 我说：「应爻合成子孙局生世，不但嫁妆丰厚，更能享受她孝顺的福。
后来到巳年完婚，果然孝顺贤淑，陪嫁不凡。
如果照张星元的说法，官爻是丈夫，这个卦寅木夫星月破，又被金局克，必定克夫，可是完婚已经二十年，公婆都在堂上，夫妻和谐，不但儿子多，已经快抱孙子了！
后来的学者应当这样断，才不会舍弃吉的、就着凶的，以致耽误人家的婚配。
en: I said: 'The Other line combines into an Output frame and generates Self, so not only will the dowry be rich, but you will also enjoy the blessing of her filial devotion.
In the Si year the wedding was held, and she was indeed filial, virtuous and gentle, with an outstanding dowry.

By Zhang Xingyuan's theory, Pressure is the husband, and here the Yin Wood husband-star is under a Month-break and controlled by the Metal frame, so it would surely mean harm to the husband; yet twenty years after the wedding the parents-in-law are still in the hall, husband and wife are in harmony, and not only are there many sons, but he is almost at the point of having grandchildren!
Later students should judge in this way, so that they do not abandon the lucky for the unlucky and mislead a marriage.

chapter: 十五、合处逢冲、冲中逢合论
title: 合处逢冲、冲中逢合各有三种：合处逢冲谋虽成而终散、冲中逢合事已散而复成；占婚六合卦而世被日冲、应爻月破，也叫合处逢冲，总不言吉

rule.yi: 合处逢冲有三种：六合卦变成六冲卦；日辰、月建冲爻；动爻变成冲。冲中逢合也有三种，方向相反。合处逢冲，谋划虽然成了最后还是散；冲中逢合，事情已经散了又成。占婚姻时，卦是六合，可是世爻被日辰冲、应爻月破，也是合处逢冲，不说吉；书中例：辰月丁酉日自占婚姻得否卦，当月自己大病，未月世爻和财爻入墓，那个女子病死。
rule.en: There are three kinds of a combination meeting a clash: a six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram; the Day or Month clashing a line; a moving line changing into a clash; and three kinds of a clash meeting a combination, in the opposite direction. With a combination meeting a clash, the plan is made but in the end scatters; with a clash meeting a combination, the matter has scattered and is then made. In a marriage divination, if the hexagram is six-combine but Self is clashed by the Day and the Other line is under a Month-break, that too is a combination meeting a clash and is not called lucky; the case in the book: on a Ding-You day in the Chen month a man divined for himself about a marriage and got Pi; that month he fell gravely ill himself, and in the Wei month, Self and Wealth entering the tomb, the girl died of illness.

note.yi: 这一节讲的三种合处逢冲，《易冒》里的「合冲」（LY.MARRY.YM.25）只是其中第二种（六合的卦被日辰冲害在世应上）。卦例的卦图不收。
note.en: Of the three kinds of a combination meeting a clash set out here, the Yi Mao's 'combination-clash' (LY.MARRY.YM.25) is only the second (a six-combine hexagram whose Self or Other is clashed or harmed by the Day). The case's hexagram diagram is not included.

zh: 合处逢冲有三：凡得六合变六冲，一也；
日月冲爻，二也；
动爻变冲，三也。
冲中逢合亦有三：凡得六冲变六合，一也；
日月合爻，二也；
动爻变合，三也。
合处逢冲，谋虽成而终散；
冲中逢合，事已散而复成。
yi: 合处逢冲有三种：得六合卦变成六冲卦，是第一种；
日辰、月建冲爻，是第二种；
动爻变成冲，是第三种。
冲中逢合也有三种：得六冲卦变成六合卦，是第一种；
日辰、月建合爻，是第二种；
动爻变成合，是第三种。
合处逢冲，谋划虽然成了，最终还是散；
冲中逢合，事情已经散了又成。
en: There are three kinds of a combination meeting a clash: a six-combine hexagram changing into a six-clash hexagram is the first;
the Day or Month clashing a line is the second;
a moving line changing into a clash is the third.
There are also three kinds of a clash meeting a combination: a six-clash hexagram changing into a six-combine hexagram is the first;
the Day or Month combining a line is the second;
a moving line changing into a combination is the third.
With a combination meeting a clash, the plan is made but in the end scatters;
with a clash meeting a combination, the matter has scattered and is then made.

zh: 辰月丁酉日，自占婚姻成否，得否卦：
yi: 辰月丁酉日，自己占婚姻成不成，得否卦：
en: In the Chen month on a Ding-You day, a man divined for himself whether a marriage would be made, and got the hexagram Pi:

zh: 断曰：卦得六合，婚姻最宜，今世被日冲，应爻月破，谓之合处逢冲，总不言吉。
彼曰年庚已经送来，算命又说甚佳，答曰：予屡占屡验，故敢此断。
果于本月自得大病，未月世财入墓，此女病故。
yi: 断语：卦是六合，最宜婚姻，可现在世爻被日辰冲，应爻月破，这叫合处逢冲，总的说来不说吉。
他说年庚已经送来了，算命的又说很好，我回答说：我屡次占屡次应验，所以敢这样断。
果然就在这个月他自己得了大病，未月世爻和财爻入墓，这个女子病死了。
en: Judgement: the hexagram is six-combine and most suitable for a marriage, but now Self is clashed by the Day and the Other line is under a Month-break, which is called a combination meeting a clash, and altogether I would not call it lucky.

He said the birth-dates had already been sent over and the fortune-teller had called them most auspicious; I answered: 'I have divined many times and been proved right many times, so I dare to judge so.'
Indeed, in that very month he fell gravely ill himself, and in the Wei month, with Self and Wealth entering the tomb, the girl died of illness.

title: 何知章·妻：妻有灾（虎临兄弟动伤财）、妻有孕（青龙财临喜神）、有妻妾（内外两财旺相）、损妻房（财爻带鬼落空亡）

rule.yi: 「何知章」是一问一答的口诀，问的是一家人的各样事。其中四问是关于妻子的：妻子有灾，是白虎临着兄弟爻发动，伤克财爻；妻子有孕，是青龙、财爻临着喜神；这家有妻有妾，是内外卦两个财爻都旺相；这家要损妻房（丧妻），是财爻带着官鬼又落空亡。
rule.en: The 'how to know' rhyme is a rhyme of questions and answers on the affairs of a household. Four of its questions concern the wife: the wife has misfortune when the White Tiger sits on a moving Peer line and injures Wealth; the wife has conceived when the Azure Dragon and Wealth arrive with a spirit of joy; the household has a wife and concubines when the two Wealth lines, inside and outside, are both strong; the household will lose its wife when the Wealth line carries Pressure and falls into Void.

note.yi: 「何知章」一共问了三四十件事（父母有病、有没有子孙、讼事、财富、田地、屋宇、坟墓、六畜、口舌、盗贼……），都是家宅的事；这里只收关于妻子的四问，其余与婚姻无关，不收。「损妻房」就是丧妻。《卜筮大全》本第三问作「青龙财临天喜神」，第四问的头一个字作「休」（应是「何」字之误），《卜筮正宗》本作「添喜神」「何」。
note.en: The 'how to know' rhyme asks thirty or forty things (illness of the parents, whether there are children, lawsuits, wealth, land, houses, graves, livestock, quarrels, thieves and more), all about the household; only the four questions about the wife are taken here, and the rest have nothing to do with marriage. 'Loses its wife' means bereavement. The Bushi Daquan text has 'the Azure Dragon and Wealth arrive with the Tianxi spirit' for the second, and 'xiu' for the first word of the fourth question (a slip for 'he'); the Bushi Zhengzong text has 'an added spirit of joy' and 'he'.

zh: 何知人家妻有灾？
虎临兄弟动伤财；
何知人家妻有孕？
青龙财临添喜神；
何知人家有妻妾？
内外两财旺相决；
何知人家损妻房？
财爻带鬼落空亡；
yi: 怎么知道这家的妻子有灾？
白虎临着兄弟爻发动，伤克财爻；
怎么知道这家的妻子有孕？
青龙、财爻临着，再加上喜神；
怎么知道这家有妻有妾？
内外卦两个财爻都旺相，就能断定；
怎么知道这家损了妻房？
财爻带着官鬼，落到空亡。
en: How can one know that the wife of a household has misfortune?
The Tiger on a Peer line, moving, injures Wealth;
How can one know that the wife has conceived?
the Azure Dragon and Wealth arrive with a spirit of joy added;
How can one know that the household has a wife and concubines?
two Wealth lines, inside and outside, both strong, settle it;
How can one know that the household loses its wife?
the Wealth line carries Pressure and falls into Void.

zh: 何知人家妻有灾？
虎临兄弟动伤财。
何知人家妻有孕？
青龙财临天喜神。
何知人家有妻妾？
内外两财旺相决。
休知人家损妻房？
财爻带鬼落空亡。
yi: 怎么知道这家的妻子有灾？
白虎临着兄弟爻发动，伤克财爻。
怎么知道这家的妻子有孕？
青龙、财爻临着天喜这个喜神。
怎么知道这家有妻有妾？
内外卦两个财爻都旺相，就能断定。
（怎么）知道这家损了妻房？
财爻带着官鬼，落到空亡。
en: How can one know that the wife of a household has misfortune?
The Tiger on a Peer line, moving, injures Wealth.
How can one know that the wife has conceived?
The Azure Dragon and Wealth arrive with the Tianxi star, a spirit of joy.
How can one know that the household has a wife and concubines?
Two Wealth lines, inside and outside, both strong, settle it.
How can one know that the household loses its wife?
The Wealth line carries Pressure and falls into Void.

title: 世临阴位女为政，财爻持世赘为姻；二爻冲克破，当家夫妻少恩情（王洪绪注：财爻持世居五爻阴位是入赘成婚，二爻冲克是夫妇各主张，不是赘婚）

rule.yi: 卜筮正宗论家宅六爻的位置时，有两联和夫妻有关。世爻落在阴位（比如五爻是阴爻），家里是妇人当家；但如果是财爻持世在这个位置，是那个男人入赘去成婚，就不是女人主事。二爻如果被冲、被克、被破，当家的夫妻之间少恩爱，王洪绪注：那是夫妇各有各的主张，不是赘婚的说法。
rule.en: In its treatment of the positions of the six lines in a household reading, the Bushi Zhengzong has two couplets touching husband and wife. Self on a yin position (for example the fifth line being a yin line): the woman rules the household; but if it is the Wealth line that holds Self in that place, the man has gone in to marry as a son-in-law, and a woman is not in charge. If the second line is clashed, controlled or broken, the couple who run the household have little affection; Wang Hongxu's note says that then husband and wife each hold their own views, and it is not the reading of a marriage taken in.

note.yi: 这两联是家宅里的六爻分位诗（五爻是一家之主、二爻是宅和主妇）中的两句；这一组的其余各联讲屋宇、田、畜、坟、水等，与婚姻无关，没有收。注里的「主其家内降为政」的「降」字在这里说不通，大概是「妇」的误字，译文按「妇人当家」译。
note.en: These are two lines of the rhyme on the positions of the six lines in a household reading (the fifth line as the head of the house, the second as the dwelling and the mistress); the other couplets in the group, on buildings, land, livestock, graves and water, have nothing to do with marriage and are not taken. The word 'jiang' in the note's 'zhu qi jia nei jiang wei zheng' does not read here and is probably a slip for 'fu' (woman); it is translated as the woman ruling the household.

zh: 世临阴位女为政，财爻持世赘为姻
yi: 世爻落在阴位，女人当家主事；财爻持世，就是入赘成婚。
en: Self on a yin position, the woman runs the household; Wealth holding Self, the marriage is one taken in (zhui).

zh: 如世居五爻，爻是阴位，主其家内降为政主持家事。
财爻持世居此位，其人赘去为婚，又非女人主事也。
yi: 比如世爻在五爻，这一爻是阴位，主这家里的妇人当家，主持家里的事。
财爻持世，又在这个位置，那个男人是去入赘成婚，就不是女人主事了。
en: If Self stands on the fifth line and it is a yin position, the woman in the household rules and manages the family's affairs.
If Wealth holds Self in this place, the man has gone off to marry in as a son-in-law, and it is then not a woman in charge.

zh: 若是二爻冲克破，当家夫妻少恩情
yi: 如果二爻被冲、被克、被破，当家的夫妻之间少恩爱。
en: If the second line is clashed, controlled or broken, the couple who run the household have little affection.

zh: 二爻如逢冲克，主夫妇各主张，又非赘婚之论也。
yi: 二爻如果遇上冲克，主夫妻各有各的主张，那就不是入赘婚的说法了。
en: If the second line meets clash or control, husband and wife each hold their own views, and it is then not a judgment of marrying in.

title: 无鬼无气·占婚：官鬼无形而有用，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动；占婚无鬼婚难成，纵成夫当夭折

rule.yi: 官鬼这一爻没有形体却有用处，卦里不能没有，宜静不宜动；带吉神动也能有福，加凶煞动没有不成祸的。占婚姻而卦中没有官鬼，婚事难成，即使成了，丈夫也会早死。
rule.en: Pressure has no form but has its use; it must not be absent from the hexagram, and should be still and not move; moving with a lucky spirit it can also bring fortune, moving with a fierce star it always brings calamity. In a marriage divination with no Pressure in the hexagram, the marriage is hard to make, and even if it is made the husband will die young.

zh: 鬼者，
无形而有用；
卦中不可无，
宜静不宜动。
带吉神动，
亦能为福；
加凶煞动，
无不为殃。
yi: 鬼这个东西，
看不见形体却有用处；
卦里不能没有，
宜于安静，不宜发动。
带着吉神发动，
也能带来福；
加上凶煞发动，
没有不成为祸殃的。
en: As for Pressure,
it has no form yet has its use;
it must not be absent from the hexagram,
it should be still and not move.
moving with a lucky spirit,
it can also bring fortune;
moving with a fierce star,
it never fails to bring calamity.

zh: 占婚无鬼，
婚难成；
纵成，
夫当夭折。
yi: 占婚姻而卦中没有官鬼，
婚事难成；
即使成了，
丈夫也会早死。
en: In a marriage divination with no Pressure in the hexagram,
the marriage is hard to make;
even if it is made,
the husband will die young.

title: 绝处逢生·占婚：世应绝处逢生，事将解而后成，意先淡而后浓；男女两家贫乏无力得人扶策亦可成

rule.yi: 用爻遇绝，却有一个生它的爻发动来生，又变得有用，叫绝处逢生。占婚姻遇到世爻、应爻绝处逢生：事情快要散的时候又成了，心意先淡后浓；或者可以说男女两家贫乏无力，但得到人扶助，这件事也能成。
rule.en: A line that meets extinction but has a moving line generate it becomes useful again: this is birth in a place of extinction. In a marriage divination, if Self and Other meet birth in a place of extinction, the matter is about to fall apart and then is made, and the intent is at first cool and then warm; or it may be said that the two families are poor and powerless but helped and supported by someone, the matter can still be made.

zh: 且如申日占，卦遇用爻属木，
木见申则绝，木爻无用矣。
此同无也。
若得水爻发动，水长生动来相生，木爻仍复有用。
譬如人当困穷之际，得遇贵人扶持，
必有寒谷回春之象，此乃是绝处逢生也。
yi: 比如在申日占卦，卦里遇到的用爻属木，
木遇到申就绝了，木爻没有用了；
这等于没有。
如果有水爻发动，水在申长生，动来相生，木爻又重新有用了。
就像人在穷困的时候，遇上贵人扶持，
一定有寒谷回春的样子，这就是绝处逢生。
en: Suppose the divination is on a Shen day and the Subject line is Wood:
Wood meets Shen and is cut off, and the Wood line is of no use;
this is the same as having none.
But if a Water line moves, Water being born at Shen and coming to generate it, the Wood line is useful again.
It is like a person at a time of poverty and hardship who meets a noble patron's help:
there is surely the look of spring returning to a cold valley; this is 'meeting life where there was severance'.

zh: 占婚：
遇世应绝处逢生，
事将解而后成，
意先淡而后浓。
或可言男女家贫乏无力，
得人扶策，
其事亦可成。
yi: 占婚姻：
遇到世爻、应爻绝处逢生，
事情将要散而后来成，
心意先淡而后浓。
或者可以说男女两家贫乏无力，
得到人扶助，
这件事也能成。
en: Divining a marriage:
if Self and Other meet birth in a place of extinction,
the matter is about to fall apart and then is made,
and the intent is at first cool and then warm.
It may also be said that the two families are poor and powerless,
but helped and supported by someone,
the matter can still be made.

title: 合处逢冲·占婚：六合的卦被日辰冲，占婚必被人说破、两边相毁，将成而解

rule.yi: 六爻相合的卦，遇到日辰冲世应，叫合处逢冲。占婚姻遇到：一定被人说破，两边互相诋毁，快成的时候又散了。
rule.en: A hexagram whose lines all combine but whose Self or Other line is clashed by the Day is a combination meeting a clash. In a marriage divination, meeting this, the match is sure to be talked to pieces by others, both sides slander each other, and what is about to be made falls apart.

zh: 且如占得雷地豫卦。
世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也。
却在子日占得，
子冲应上午、害世上未，
此乃合处逢冲也。
yi: 比如占到雷地豫卦。
世应相生，六爻相合，吉利没有不顺的，是事事可成的样子。
却是在子日占到的，
子冲应爻上的午、又害世爻上的未，
这就是合处逢冲。
en: Suppose the divination gets the Yu hexagram, Thunder over Earth.
Self and Other generate each other and the six lines combine; all is auspicious and nothing goes against it; it is the look of everything succeeding.
But it is got on a Zi day,
and Zi clashes the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line;
this is 'meeting a clash where there was combination'.

hits.text: 世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也
世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也

zh: 占婚遇之，
必然被人说破，
两边相毁，
当见将成而解。
yi: 占婚姻遇到这种情形，
一定被人说破，
两边互相诋毁，
会看到快成的时候又散了。
en: In a marriage divination, meeting this,
it is sure to be talked to pieces by others,
both sides slander each other,
and what is about to be made falls apart.

title: 随官入墓·占婚：世随鬼入墓，男家贫乏、男财不备；三种入墓不问占何事皆非吉兆

rule.yi: 随官入墓有三种：卦身随鬼入墓、世爻随鬼入墓、本命随鬼入墓；这三种入墓，不管占什么事都不是吉兆。占婚姻遇到世爻随鬼入墓，男方家里贫乏，男方的钱财没有准备好。
rule.en: Following Pressure into the tomb comes in three kinds: the Body, the Self line, or the Life following Pressure into the tomb; whatever the matter divined, none of the three is a lucky sign. In a marriage divination, if Self follows Pressure into the tomb, the man's family is poor and the man's wealth is not ready.

zh: 随官入墓，其目有三：
有身随鬼入墓，
有世随鬼入墓，
有命随鬼入墓。
yi: 随官入墓，分作三种：
有卦身跟着鬼入墓，
有世爻跟着鬼入墓，
有本命跟着鬼入墓。
en: 'Following Pressure into the tomb' has three kinds:
the Body following Pressure into the tomb,
the Self following Pressure into the tomb,
and the natal line following Pressure into the tomb.

zh: 以上三墓，
不问占何事，
皆非吉兆。
yi: 以上三种入墓，
不管占什么事，
都不是吉兆。
en: Of these three tombs,
whatever is being divined,
none is an auspicious sign.

zh: 占婚，
遇世随鬼入墓，
男家贫乏，
男财不备。
yi: 占婚姻，
如果世爻随官鬼入墓，
男方家里贫乏，
男方的钱财没有准备好。
en: In a marriage divination,
if Self follows Pressure into the tomb,
the man's family is poor,
and the man's wealth is not ready.

title: 逢冲暗动·占婚：吉则暗中有人网维、凶则暗中有人破说

rule.yi: 六爻安静的卦，被日辰冲而动，叫暗动；暗动有吉有凶，各有各的用处，不可一概而论。占婚姻遇到暗动：吉的话暗中有人维系撮合；凶的话暗中有人说破。
rule.en: In a hexagram whose six lines are still, a line stirred by the Day's clash is a hidden movement; hidden movement brings good or ill, each with its own use, and cannot be judged all the same. In a marriage divination, meeting hidden movement, if lucky someone quietly holds the match together; if unlucky someone quietly talks it apart.

zh: 且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动。
若日辰相冲，名曰暗动。
暗动者，有吉有凶，
各有所用焉，不可一概而论。
yi: 六爻都安静的时候，不遇到冲就不动。
如果被日辰冲到，叫作暗动。
暗动有吉有凶，
各有各的用处，不能一概而论。
en: When the six lines are all quiet, without a clash they do not move.
If the Day clashes a line, it is called a hidden movement.
A hidden movement may be auspicious or ominous,
each with its own use, and not to be judged all alike.

凶的话，暗中有人说破。

if lucky, someone quietly holds the match together;
if unlucky, someone quietly talks it apart.

title: 助鬼伤身·占婚：鬼克世而妻财动来生助，纵成其妇也不贤不孝公姑、搬唆夫主、割户分门、不和兄弟

rule.yi: 生助官鬼的只有妻财，不宜发动，动了就把弱的鬼变成旺鬼。卦中鬼爻克身世，妻财再动来生助，凶更重；没有财，凶有限；两个财都动，大凶。占婚姻遇到：世爻是男家，官鬼是丈夫，鬼克世是自己克自家，本来就不好；再遇财爻发动、生助鬼爻，即使成了，那个妻子也一定不贤、不孝敬公婆、挑唆丈夫、分家另过、不和兄弟。
rule.en: The only line that generates and supports Pressure is Wealth, and it should not move, for moving turns a weak ghost into a strong one. When the Pressure line in a hexagram controls the Body or Self and Wealth also moves to generate and support it, the ill is all the worse; with no Wealth the ill is limited; with two Wealth lines both moving the calamity is very great. In a marriage divination: Self is the man's family and Pressure is the husband, so Pressure controlling Self is a house controlling itself, which is not fine to begin with; if Wealth then moves and generates and supports Pressure, even if the match is made the wife will surely be unworthy, unfilial to her parents-in-law, egg her husband on, split the household and be at odds with his brothers.

zh: 生助官鬼者，不过妻财也。
不宜发动，
动则衰鬼变成旺鬼。
旺鬼遇之，其势愈凶。
yi: 能生助官鬼的，只有妻财。
它不宜发动，
一动，衰弱的鬼就变成旺鬼。
旺鬼再遇到它，来势更凶。
en: The only line that can generate and help Pressure is Wealth.
It should not move,
for once it moves a weak Pressure becomes a strong one.
A strong Pressure meeting it grows more fierce.

if there is no Wealth,
the ill is limited;
if there are two Wealth lines and both move,
the calamity is very great.

even if the match is made,
the wife will surely be unworthy and unfilial to her parents-in-law,

split the household and set up a separate door,
and be at odds with his brothers.

title: 父母用·占婚：父母爻为主婚人，空则必无主者及无聘礼

rule.yi: 父母爻是生我的，能吉能凶，各有各的用处：遇财就伤自身，遇鬼反而增光；发动就克伤子孙、生扶兄弟。占婚姻，父母爻是主婚人：空亡了，就一定没有人主婚，也没有聘礼。
rule.en: The Resource line is what generates me and can bring good or ill, each with its own use: meeting Wealth it harms its own body, meeting Pressure it grows in radiance; moving, it controls and harms Output and supports Peer. In a marriage divination the Resource line is the presider at the wedding; when it is Void there is surely no presider and no betrothal gifts.

note.yi: 「为主婚人空」原书没有标点，这里读作「为主婚人，空则……」。
note.en: The book has no punctuation in 'is the presider, Void', and it is read here as 'the presider; when Void, ...'.

zh: 父母者，
生我者谓之。
父母也，
能为凶，
能为吉，
各有所用。
遇财则有伤本体，
逢鬼则增长光辉。
发动则克伤子孙，
生扶兄弟。
审其动静衰旺，
各有所宜。
yi: 父母这一爻，
是生我的。
父母这一爻，
能带来凶险，
能带来吉利，
各有各的用处。
遇到财就伤到自身，
遇到鬼就增长光辉。
发动就克伤子孙，
生扶兄弟。
要审察它的动静衰旺，
各有各适宜的情形。
en: The Resource line
is what generates me.
The Resource line
can bring ill,
can bring good,
each with its own use.
Meeting Wealth it harms its own body,
meeting Pressure it grows in radiance.
Moving, it controls and harms Output
and supports Peer.
Examine whether it is still or moving, weak or strong;
each has what suits it.

zh: 占婚：
为主婚人空，
则必无主者及无聘礼。
yi: 占婚姻：
父母爻是主婚人，落空的话，
就一定没有人主婚，也没有聘礼。
en: Divining a marriage:
the Resource line is the presider at the wedding, and if it is Void,
there is surely no presider and no betrothal gifts.

title: 兄弟用·占婚：兄弟为费财、诡诈、虚妄；大象可成发动不过破财，不可成则临世发动他日伤妻，间爻动则媒人诡诈

rule.yi: 兄弟爻是与我五行相同的，不能带来福，也不至于大凶，不过是破败、克剥、阻滞之神；怕官鬼发动来制它，喜欢父母兴旺让它有依靠；发动就伤克妻财、扶持子孙。占婚姻，兄弟爻是耗费钱财、诡诈、虚妄：大象能成的，发动不过是破财；不能成的，兄弟临世发动，日后必伤妻；在间爻上发动，一定是媒人诡诈虚妄。
rule.en: Peer is what shares my element; it cannot bring fortune and cannot bring great ill, being nothing but the spirit of ruin, plunder and obstruction; it fears Pressure moving to hold it in check and is glad when Resource thrives and gives it support; moving, it injures and controls Wealth and supports Output. In a marriage divination Peer means expense, trickery and falsehood: if the overall image allows the match, its moving is no more than a loss of money; if it cannot be made, Peer moving on Self surely means the wife will be harmed some day, and moving on a between line means the go-between is tricky and false.

zh: 比和者为兄弟。
大抵不能为福，
亦不能为大凶，
无非破败、克剥、阻滞之神也。
怕逢官鬼发动，
则受制；
喜遇父母兴隆，
则有依。
发动则伤克妻财、扶持福德。
yi: 与我五行相同的是兄弟。
大体上不能带来福，
也不能带来大凶，
不过是破败、克剥、阻滞的神。
怕遇到官鬼发动，
就受到制约；
喜欢遇到父母兴旺，
就有依靠。
发动就伤克妻财、扶持福德。
en: What shares my element is Peer.
In general it cannot bring fortune,
nor can it bring great ill;
it is nothing but the spirit of ruin, plunder and obstruction.
It fears Pressure moving,
and is then held in check;
it is glad to meet a thriving Resource line,
and then has something to lean on.
Moving, it injures and controls Wealth and supports Output.

title: 子孙用·占婚：子孙为子息，卦中无子必无儿，但不宜动，动则异日伤夫

rule.yi: 我所生的是子孙爻，是卦中最吉的神：遇到它没有不好的，背离它就没法带来福；卦里没有父母爻它就不受克，有兄弟爻它就有依靠；发动就生财、克伤官鬼。占婚姻，子孙爻代表子息：卦中没有子孙，一定没有儿子；但不宜发动，动了日后要伤夫。
rule.en: What I generate is the Output line, the most auspicious spirit in a hexagram: meeting it, all is fair, and whatever turns its back on it cannot bring fortune; with no Resource line in the hexagram it is not controlled, and with Peer among the lines it has support; moving, it generates Wealth and controls and harms Pressure. In a marriage divination the Output line stands for children: if there is no Output in the hexagram there will surely be no son; but it should not move, for moving it will harm the husband some day.

zh: 凡我所生为子孙。
是卦中至吉之神，
逢之者无不为佳，
背之者莫能为福。
卦无父母则无克，
爻有兄弟则有依。
动则生财，
克伤官鬼。
yi: 凡是我所生的是子孙爻。
它是卦中最吉的神，
遇到它没有不好的，
背离它的没法带来福。
卦里没有父母爻就不受克，
爻里有兄弟就有依靠。
发动就生财，
克伤官鬼。
en: What I generate is Output.
It is the most auspicious spirit in a hexagram:
meeting it, all is fair,
and whatever turns its back on it cannot bring fortune.
With no Resource line in the hexagram it is not controlled,
with Peer among the lines it has support.
Moving, it generates Wealth
and controls and harms Pressure.

zh: 占婚姻：

卦中无子，
必无儿。
但不宜动，
动则异日伤夫。
yi: 占卜婚姻时：
子孙爻代表子息。
卦中没有子孙，
一定没有儿子。
但不宜发动，
发动了日后要伤夫。
en: Divining a marriage:
the Output line stands for children.
If there is no Output in the hexagram,
there will surely be no son.
But it should not move:
moving, it will harm the husband some day.

title: 妻财用·占婚：财为妇，旺相临青龙吉星必女貌端正，不宜动，动则伤克公姑

rule.yi: 妻财是我所克的，诸事遇到都吉，只有占父母和文书时不宜见到它；遇兄弟受损，遇子孙更好，遇官鬼会泄我的气；动静都吉。占婚姻，妻财代表妻子：旺相、临青龙等吉星，女子相貌一定端正；不宜发动，动了就伤克公婆。
rule.en: Wealth is what I control, and in every matter meeting it is lucky, except that it is not welcome when divining for parents or documents; meeting Peer it suffers, meeting Output it is better still, meeting Pressure it drains my qi; still or moving, it is lucky. In a marriage divination Wealth stands for the wife: strong and on the Azure Dragon or another lucky star, the woman's looks are surely upright; it should not move, for moving it injures and controls the parents-in-law.

zh: 妻财者，我克者谓之妻财也。
诸事逢之，无不为吉。
惟占父母及文书，不宜见之。
值兄弟则有损，
遇福德则愈佳，
逢官鬼则泄我之气也。
动静皆吉。
yi: 妻财，就是我克的那个六亲。
各种事遇到它，没有不吉的；
只有占父母和文书时，不宜见到它；
遇到兄弟就有损，
遇到福德就更好，
遇到官鬼就泄我的气。
动也吉，静也吉。
en: Wealth is the relation that I control.
In all matters, meeting it is always auspicious;
only when divining about Resource, that is parents and documents, is it unwelcome;
meeting Peer it suffers loss,
meeting Output it is better still,
meeting Pressure it drains my qi.
Moving or still, it is auspicious.

title: 官鬼用·妻占夫：官鬼凶多福少，怕子孙、靠妻财，卦中不可无，宜静不宜动；妻占夫以官鬼为用爻，旺相带青龙者聪明俊雅

rule.yi: 官鬼是克我的，大体上凶多福少，怕子孙、靠妻财，发动就伤克兄弟、生扶父母；卦中虽凶却不能没有，宜静不宜动。妻子占丈夫，官鬼是用爻：旺相带青龙的，一定是聪明俊雅的人；加贵人一定有职事，不然也是官宦人家的子弟；在胎、养、沐浴的爻上，如今虽是小官，日后必贵；最宜持世，或者临阳象，都叫得地。
rule.en: Pressure is what controls me; in general it brings more ill than fortune, fears Output and relies on Wealth; moving, it injures and controls Peer and supports Resource; though ill in a hexagram it must not be missing, and should be still and not move. When a wife divines a husband, Pressure is the Subject line: strong and carrying the Azure Dragon, he is surely an intelligent, handsome and refined man; with the Noble added he surely has a position, and otherwise he is at least a son of an official family; on a line at the Womb, Nurture or Bathing stage, though now a minor official he will surely be eminent some day; it is best holding Self or on a yang image, and either is called being in place.

note.yi: 「胎、养、沐浴」是十二长生里的三个阶段，书里没有另外解释。
note.en: The Womb, Nurture and Bathing stages are three of the twelve life stages, which the book does not explain further.

zh: 官鬼者，克我者为官鬼也。
大抵为凶处多，
为福处少。
所畏者福德，
所恃者妻财。
动则伤克兄弟，
生扶父母。
