yi: 官鬼爻是克我的。
大体上凶的地方多，
福的地方少。
它怕的是子孙，
它靠的是妻财。
发动就伤克兄弟，
生扶父母。
然而卦中虽然凶，
却不能没有，
但宜静不宜动。
en: Pressure is what controls me.
In general it means more ill
and less fortune.
What it fears is Output;
what it relies on is Wealth.
Moving, it injures and controls Peer
and supports Resource.
Yet though it is ill in a hexagram,
it must not be missing,
but it should be still and not move.

zh: 妻占夫：
为用爻。
yi: 妻子占丈夫：
官鬼是用爻。
en: A wife divining a husband:
it is the Subject line.

zh: 旺相带青龙者，
必聪明俊雅之人。
加贵人必有勾当，
不然亦是宦家子弟。
若在胎养沐浴爻上，
今虽末仕，
他日必贵。
最宜持世，
或临阳象，
皆名得地。
yi: 旺相带青龙的，
一定是聪明俊雅的人。
加贵人一定有职事，
不然也是官宦人家的子弟。
如果在胎、养、沐浴的爻上，
如今虽然只是小官，
日后一定显贵。
最宜持世，
或者临阳象，
都叫得地。
en: Strong and carrying the Azure Dragon,
he is surely an intelligent, handsome and refined man.
With the Noble added he surely has a position;
otherwise he is at least a son of an official family.
If it is on a line at the Womb, Nurture or Bathing stage,
though now he is only a minor official,
some day he will surely be eminent.
It is best holding Self,
or on a yang image;
either is called being in place.

title: 父母用变·婚姻：父母爻发动克子孙，婚姻子息应难得

rule.yi: 父母爻一发动就克子孙：病人无药、沉昏；婚姻和子息都难得；买卖劳心，利不存。
rule.en: When the Resource line moves it controls Output: a sick person has no medicine and sinks into stupor; marriage and offspring are hard to get; in trade, effort is spent and profit does not stay.

note.yi: 这一句只有「婚姻子息应难得」说到婚姻，前后是病和买卖。
note.en: Only 'marriage and offspring are hard to get' speaks of marriage; the clauses around it are about illness and trade.

zh: 父动当头克子孙，
病人无药主沉昏；
婚姻子息应难得，
买卖劳心利不存。
yi: 父母爻发动，当头克子孙，
病人没有药可用，昏沉不醒；
婚姻、子嗣难得；
做买卖，劳心费力，没有利。
en: Resource moving and squarely controlling Output:
the sick have no medicine and sink into stupor;
marriage and offspring are hard to get;
in trade one wears out the mind and no profit remains.

title: 子孙用变·婚姻：子孙发动伤官鬼，婚姻喜美是姻缘

rule.yi: 子孙爻发动伤克官鬼：占病求医身体就痊愈；行人、买卖身体安康；婚姻喜庆美满，是好姻缘。
rule.en: When the Output line moves it injures and controls Pressure: in illness and seeking a doctor the body recovers; travelers and trade are in good health; a marriage is happy and fair, a good match.

note.yi: 子孙发动克官鬼，对占婚的女方是伤夫（见 LY.MARRY.TXF.07、LY.MARRY.DYTJ.09），这里说的却是「婚姻喜美」，是这首歌诀的口径。
note.en: Output moving to control Pressure is, for a woman divining a marriage, harm to the husband (see LY.MARRY.TXF.07 and LY.MARRY.DYTJ.09), yet this rhyme says 'a marriage is happy and fair'; that is the rhyme's own line.

zh: 子孙发动伤官鬼，
占病求医身便痊；
行人买卖身康泰，
婚姻喜美是姻缘。
yi: 子孙发动，伤克官鬼，
占病求医，身体就痊愈；
出门的人和做买卖的人，平安康泰；
婚姻喜庆美满，是好姻缘。
en: Output moving and harming Pressure:
in divining illness and seeking a doctor, the body is cured;
the traveller and the trader are safe and well;
a marriage is happy and fair, a good match.

title: 妻财用变·婚姻：财爻发动，亲姻如意乐无虞；财化财则妇主灾

rule.yi: 妻财爻发动克文书：考试求官都是虚的；买卖、结交官府的财吉利；婚姻亲事如意，快乐无忧。财化财，妇人有灾。
rule.en: When the Wealth line moves it controls documents: exams and seeking office come to nothing; trade and dealing with officials bring luck in money; marriage and family ties go as wished, glad and free of worry. Wealth changing into Wealth, the woman meets calamity.

zh: 财爻发动克文书，
应举求官总是虚；
买卖交官财吉利，
亲姻如意乐无虞。
yi: 财爻发动，克父母文书，
应试求官，总是落空；
做买卖、结交官府，对财有利；
婚姻亲事如意，快乐无忧。
en: The Wealth line moving and controlling the document line:
sitting exams and seeking office always come to nothing;
trading and dealing with officials favour the money;
marriages and family ties go as wished, glad and free of worry.

zh: 财化财兮妇主灾；
yi: 财化成财，妇人有灾；
en: Wealth changing into Wealth, the woman meets calamity;

title: 兄弟用变·婚姻：兄弟交重克了财，买婢求妻事不谐

rule.yi: 兄弟爻交重克了财：病人难愈、灾未离；考试雷同是大忌；官非、暗贼耗钱财；若带吉神有助，出路的行人还没来，做买卖折本；买婢女、求妻，事情不和谐。
rule.en: When the Peer line moves and controls Wealth: a sick person is hard to cure and the calamity has not left; in exams sameness with others is a great taboo; lawsuits and hidden thieves drain money. If it carries a lucky spirit and helps, a traveler on the road has not yet come, trade loses its capital, and buying a maid or seeking a wife does not go smoothly.

note.yi: 这一首里只有最后一句说到婚姻（买婢、求妻）。
note.en: In this rhyme only the last clause speaks of marriage (buying a maid, seeking a wife).

zh: 兄弟交重克了财，
病人难愈未离灾；
应举雷同为大忌，
官非阴贼耗钱财。
若带吉神为有助，
出路行人尚未来；
货物经商消折本，
买婢求妻事不谐。
yi: 兄弟发动，克了财，
病人难好，灾还没有走；
应考遇到雷同，是大忌；
官司和暗中的盗贼，耗损钱财。
如果带着吉神，就有帮助；
出门在外的人还没有回来；
货物、经商，亏了本；
买婢女、求妻，事不和谐。
en: Peer moving and controlling Wealth:
the sick are hard to cure and the calamity has not left;
in an exam, meeting the same rivals is a great taboo;
lawsuits and secret thieves waste money.
if it carries an auspicious spirit, there is help;
the traveller on the road has not yet come home;
goods and trade lose capital;
buying a maid or seeking a wife does not go smoothly.

title: 官鬼用变·婚姻：官鬼发动克兄弟，婚姻未就生滞疑

rule.yi: 官鬼爻发动克兄弟：婚姻还没成，生出停滞和疑虑；病困门庭，祸祟来到。
rule.en: When the Pressure line moves it controls Peer: a marriage not yet made meets delay and doubt; illness troubles the household and haunting misfortune comes.

note.yi: 《易冒》《海底眼》等书里官鬼是婚姻的用爻，这首诗却说官鬼发动主婚姻停滞，要和 LY.MARRY.HZL.22 一起看。
note.en: In the Yi Mao and other books Pressure is the Subject for marriage, whereas this rhyme says Pressure moving means marriage delay; read it together with LY.MARRY.HZL.22.

zh: 官鬼发动克兄弟，
婚姻未就生滞疑；
yi: 官鬼发动，克兄弟，
婚姻还没成，生出停滞和疑虑；
en: Pressure moving and controlling Peer:
a marriage not yet made meets delay and doubt;

title: 世应当中隔爻：两间爻发动则所求多阻隔，有气事分明而慢慢方得；兄弟动脱诈口舌、官鬼动人事乖隔；占婚姻间爻为媒

rule.yi: 世应当中的两个间爻发动，所求的事多有阻隔；间爻有气，事情就分明，但要慢慢才得。兄弟动是脱诈口舌，官鬼动是人事乖隔。占婚姻，间爻是媒人；占生产，是接生婆；占事，是阻隔；占种田，是农人；占宅，是邻里。
rule.en: When the two between lines in the middle of Self and Other move, what is sought meets many obstructions; if they have qi the matter is clear, but it is obtained only slowly. Peer moving means evasion, deceit and quarrels; Pressure moving means people and affairs at odds and cut off. In marriage a between line is the go-between; in childbirth the midwife; in an affair, obstruction; in farming, the farmer; for a house, the neighbors.

zh: 世应当中两间爻，
发动所求多阻隔，
假若有气事分明，
必定慢慢方始得。
yi: 世应当中的两个间爻，
发动了所求的事多有阻隔；
如果有气，事情就分明，
但一定要慢慢才得到。
en: The two between lines in the middle of Self and Other,
when they move, what is sought meets many obstructions;
if they have qi, the matter is clear,
but it is obtained only slowly.

zh: 兄弟动主脱诈口舌，
官鬼动主人事乖隔。
占婚姻为媒，
占生产为接生婆，
占事为隔阻，
占种田为农人，
占宅为邻里。
yi: 兄弟动，主脱诈口舌；
官鬼动，主人事乖隔。
占婚姻，间爻是媒人；
占生产，是接生婆；
占事，是阻隔；
占种田，是农人；
占宅，是邻里。
en: Peer moving means evasion, deceit and quarrels;
Pressure moving means people and affairs at odds and cut off.
In marriage a between line is the go-between;
in childbirth the midwife;
in an affair, obstruction;
in farming, the farmer;
for a house, the neighbors.

title: 六爻俱静类：卦遇六爻安静须看用与日辰，日辰克用及冲刑宜谨慎，世应临用神及原神则昌盛；娶妻买妾用爻宜静、有气为先

rule.yi: 六爻全都安静的卦，要看用神和日辰：日辰克用神或者冲刑它，事情要谨慎；再推究世应，忌神千万不要加临，世应临用神和原神，做事一定昌盛。娶妻买妾、屋宅坟田、住庵谒人、失物理冤这些事，用爻宜静，有气为先。
rule.en: When all six lines of a hexagram are still, look at the Subject and the Day: if the Day controls, clashes with or punishes the Subject, the matter calls for caution; then examine Self and Other: the Adversary must on no account come upon them, and if Self and Other sit on the Subject and the Support spirit, the undertaking will certainly flourish. For taking a wife or buying a concubine, houses and graves, living in a hermitage or calling on people, lost property and righting a wrong, the Subject line should be still and having qi comes first.

note.yi: 第一段末尾原书有一个「（1）」，是指向今人注释的编号，不在译文里。「元辰」译作 Support spirit，即原神。
note.en: The book has a '(1)' at the end of the first passage, a number pointing to a modern note, which is left out of the translation. 'Yuan chen' is rendered as the Support spirit, the same as the original spirit.

zh: 卦遇六爻安静，
须看用与日辰，
日辰克用及冲刑，
其事宜当谨慎。
更把世应推究，
忌神切莫加临，
世应临用及元辰，
做事断然昌盛
yi: 卦遇到六爻安静，
要看用神和日辰；
日辰克用神，或者冲、刑它，
事情要谨慎。
再推究世应：
忌神千万不要加临，
世应临用神和原神，
做事一定昌盛
en: When a hexagram has all six lines still,
look at the Subject and the Day;
if the Day controls the Subject, or clashes with or punishes it,
the matter calls for caution.
Go on to examine Self and Other:
the Adversary must on no account come upon them;
if Self and Other sit on the Subject and the Support spirit,
the undertaking will certainly flourish

zh: 娶妻买妾，
屋宅坟田，
住庵谒人，
失物理冤，
用爻宜静，
有气为先。
yi: 娶妻买妾，
屋宅坟田，
住庵谒人，
失物理冤，
用爻宜静，
有气最要紧。
en: taking a wife or buying a concubine,
houses and graves and fields,
living in a hermitage, calling on people,
lost property, righting a wrong,
the Subject line should be still,
and having qi comes first.

title: 妻财独发：损书伤父，若乘旺相则婚姻可成

rule.yi: 妻财爻独自发动，会损文书、伤父母；如果乘旺相，婚姻可以成。
rule.en: When Wealth moves alone it harms documents and injures the parent; if it rides on strength, the marriage can be made.

zh: 妻财独发，
损书伤父；
若乘旺相，
婚姻可成。
yi: 妻财爻独自发动，
会损害文书、伤害父母；
如果乘着旺相，
婚姻可以成。
en: Wealth moving alone
harms documents and injures the parent;
if it rides a thriving state,
the marriage can be made.

title: 占公私用事：官用取官、私用取财；占婚问夫看官爻，占婚姻事看财爻

rule.yi: 官用取官，私用取财。占病（鬼祟）、占失（看贼）、求官事、官司词讼、占婚姻问丈夫，这些都看官爻；占买卖、家事、奴婢事、求财事、婚姻事，这些都看财爻。
rule.en: For an official matter take Pressure, for a private matter take Wealth. Illness (haunting), loss (look for the thief), seeking office, lawsuits, and marriage when asking after the husband: all of these look at the Pressure line; trade, household affairs, servant matters, seeking wealth and marriage matters: all of these look at the Wealth line.

note.yi: 「占婚问夫」是女方占丈夫；「占婚姻事」没有写明男女，按上下文是一般的婚事，看财爻。
note.en: 'Marriage when asking after the husband' is a woman divining a husband; 'marriage matters' does not say man or woman and, from the context, is marriage in general, judged by the Wealth line.

zh: 阴阳男女，次第推排；
官用取官，
私用取财。
yi: 阴阳男女，依次推排；
公家的事，用官爻；
私人的事，用财。
en: Yin and yang, man and woman, are laid out in order;
for public matters, take the Pressure line;
for private matters, take Wealth.

zh: 占病鬼祟，
占失看贼，
占求官事，
占官词讼，
占婚问夫，
以上皆看官爻。
占买卖财，
占家事，
占奴婢事，
占求财事，
占婚姻事，
以上皆看财爻。
yi: 占病看鬼祟，
占失物看盗贼，
求官的事，
官司词讼，
占婚姻问丈夫，
以上都看官爻。
占买卖，看财，
家里的事，
奴婢的事，
求财的事，
婚姻的事，
以上这些都看财爻。
en: illness: look at haunting spirits,
loss: look for the thief,
seeking office,
official lawsuits,
marriage when asking after the husband,
all look to the Pressure line.
trade, look at Wealth,
household affairs,
servant matters,
seeking wealth,
marriage matters,
in all of these look at the Wealth line.

title: 期日章·婚姻：婚姻本宫内外旺，或然月卦用为仪

rule.yi: 期日章说婚姻的应期：本宫内外卦旺的时候，或者以月卦为准。
rule.en: The chapter on days of fulfilment says of the timing of a marriage: when the home palace is strong, inner and outer, or else take the month hexagram as the standard.

note.yi: 这一句原书后面另有今人的「注释」逐句解释，本库不引。「仪」按上下文是准则。
note.en: In the book this line is followed by a modern gloss, which this library does not quote. 'Yi' is read from the context as a standard or measure.

zh: 婚姻本宫内外旺，
或然月卦用为仪，
yi: 婚姻的应期，本宫的内卦外卦旺相的时候，
或者用月卦来做准则。
en: For marriage, when the home palace is strong, inner and outer,
or else take the month hexagram as the standard.

title: 明六神诀·青龙：属木属阳，持世及交重者为财喜、为婚姻、为孕育、为姻亲，附于六爻无有不吉

rule.yi: 青龙属木、属阳，春天旺，亥月长生，卯月最旺，在未、申墓绝。它持世或发动，主财喜、婚姻、孕育、姻亲；附在哪一爻上都吉而亨通。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon belongs to Wood and is yang; it thrives in spring, is born at Hai, peaks at Mao, and is in the tomb and extinct at Wei and Shen. If it holds Self or moves, it means joy over wealth, marriage, pregnancy and in-law relations; attached to any of the six lines it is lucky and smooth.

zh: 青龙属木。
震旺巽相。
旺于春，
生于亥，
旺于卯，
墓绝于未申，
属阳。
其神若持世及交重者，
为财喜，
为婚姻，
为孕育，
为姻亲。
附于六爻无有不吉而亨者也。
yi: 青龙属木。
震旺，巽相。
春天最旺盛，
亥月长生，
卯月最旺，
在未、申墓绝，
属于阳。
这个神如果持世或者发动，
主财运喜庆，
主婚姻之事，
主怀孕生育，
主姻亲往来。
附在六爻上，没有不吉利而亨通的。
en: The Azure Dragon belongs to Wood.
Zhen thrives and Xun is strong.
It thrives in spring,
is born at Hai,
peaks at Mao,
and is in the tomb and extinct at Wei and Shen;
it is yang.
If this spirit holds Self or moves,
it means joy over wealth,
marriage,
pregnancy,
and in-law relations.
Attached to any of the six lines, there is none that is not lucky and smooth.

title: 六神彖象歌·青龙入木：值旺来生世、不值空亡尽可为，求婚须得财须有

rule.yi: 青龙落在木爻上，旺相、来生世爻、不落空亡，做什么都可以；求婚要有财爻；占行人一定回来。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon on a Wood line, strong and coming to generate Self and not meeting Void, all may be done; to seek a marriage Wealth must be present; asking after a traveler, he will surely return.

zh: 入木值旺来生世，
不值空亡尽可为，
求婚须得财须有，
占问行人定主归。
yi: 青龙入木，遇到旺相、来生世爻，
不遇到空亡，什么都可以做；
求婚要有财爻；
占行人，一定是会回来。
en: The Azure Dragon entering Wood, finding strength and coming to generate Self,
not meeting Void, all may be done;
to seek a marriage, Wealth must be present;
asking after a traveler, he will surely return.

title: 何知章·青龙：青龙进钱财，住宅婚姻进口来

rule.yi: 青龙进钱财，住宅和婚姻都会进人口来；出入求财大有所获，造作添修也没有灾。
rule.en: The Azure Dragon brings in money; for a house and for a marriage, people are added to the household; going in and out seeking wealth, one will gain greatly, and building or repairs bring no calamity.

note.yi: 「进口」是添人口：住宅添人口，婚姻娶进新人。
note.en: 'Bringing in mouths' means adding people to the household: for a house, more members; for a marriage, a new member brought in.

zh: 青龙进钱财，
住宅婚姻进口来，
出入求财当大获，
造作添修不入灾。
yi: 青龙主进钱财，
住宅、婚姻，人口物件都进来；
出门入门求财，该有大收获；
建造修缮不遇灾。
en: The Azure Dragon brings in money;
for house and marriage, people and goods come in;
going out and coming in to seek wealth, there should be a great haul;
building and repairs meet no calamity.

title: 神煞表·天月德、青龙：喜庆婚姻，求财合吉；公私吉庆，婚姻财吉

rule.yi: 神煞表按月排：天月德按月依次是丁、坤、壬、辛、乾、甲、癸、艮、丙、乙、巽、庚，主喜庆婚姻，求财也合吉；青龙按月依次是寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑，主公私吉庆，婚姻和财都吉。
rule.en: The table of spirit stars is laid out by month. The Heavenly-Month Virtue runs month by month as Ding, Kun, Ren, Xin, Qian, Jia, Gui, Gen, Bing, Yi, Xun, Geng, and means joyful events and marriage, and suits seeking wealth; the Azure Dragon runs month by month as Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou, and means good fortune in public and private matters, with marriage and wealth both lucky.

note.yi: 这两行是一张表里的两行，表头是「神煞 月令 一 二 三 …… 十二 说明」，十二个字依次对着正月到十二月；表格里的空白原文已压掉。
note.en: These two rows come from one table whose header reads 'spirit star, month, one, two, three, ... twelve, explanation', the twelve entries standing for the first to the twelfth month; the blank spaces of the table are squeezed out of the original text.

zh: 天月德丁坤壬辛乾甲癸艮丙乙巽庚喜庆婚姻，
求财合吉。
yi: 天月德（按月依次是丁、坤、壬、辛、乾、甲、癸、艮、丙、乙、巽、庚），喜庆婚姻，
求财也合吉。
en: Heavenly-Month Virtue (month by month: Ding, Kun, Ren, Xin, Qian, Jia, Gui, Gen, Bing, Yi, Xun, Geng): joyful events and marriage,
and it suits seeking wealth.

zh: 青龙寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥子丑公私吉庆，
婚姻财吉。
yi: 青龙（按月依次是寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑），公私吉庆，
婚姻和财都吉。
en: Azure Dragon (month by month: Yin, Mao, Chen, Si, Wu, Wei, Shen, You, Xu, Hai, Zi, Chou): good fortune in public and private matters,
marriage and wealth both lucky.

hits.text: 青龙寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥子丑
青龙寅卯辰巳午未申酉戌亥子丑

title: 四刑：寅申巳亥为四刑，凡作百事一无成，婚姻官事俱不吉，纵得相生也不宁

rule.yi: 寅、申、巳、亥是四刑：做什么事都不成，婚姻和官事都不吉，即使相生也不安宁（比如世爻寅、应爻申）。
rule.en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments: in doing anything at all nothing is accomplished, marriage and official matters are both unlucky, and even if they generate each other there is no peace (for example, Self at Yin and Other at Shen).

zh: 寅申巳亥为四刑，
凡作百事一无成，
婚姻官事俱不吉，
纵得相生也不宁。
yi: 寅、申、巳、亥是四刑，
做什么事都一件也不成；
婚姻和官事都不吉，
即使得到相生，也不安宁。
en: Yin, Shen, Si and Hai are the four punishments;
in doing anything at all, nothing is accomplished;
marriage and official matters are both unlucky;
even if they generate each other there is no peace.

zh: 如世寅应申是也。
yi: 比如世爻是寅、应爻是申就是这样。
en: For example, Self at Yin and Other at Shen.

title: 鳏寡杀：春牛不下田、夏龙飞上天、秋羊草枯死、冬犬厌残年，婚姻遇发动不久

rule.yi: 鳏寡杀的口诀：春天的牛不下田，夏天的龙飞上天，秋天的羊草枯死，冬天的狗厌恶残年。婚姻遇到它发动，长久不了。
rule.en: The rhyme of the widower-and-widow star: in spring the ox does not go down to the field, in summer the dragon flies up to heaven, in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies, in winter the dog is weary of the dying year. In marriage, if it meets this star moving, it does not last.

note.yi: 四句口诀里的牛、龙、羊、犬是生肖，依次对着丑、辰、未、戌四个地支，分别是春、夏、秋、冬的鳏寡杀所在；地支对应是照生肖说的，书里这里没有写出来。
note.en: The ox, dragon, goat and dog in the four-line rhyme are zodiac animals standing for the branches Chou, Chen, Wei and Xu, the places of the widower-and-widow star in spring, summer, autumn and winter respectively; the book does not spell out the branches here, and they are given by the zodiac.

zh: 春牛不下田，
夏龙飞上天，
秋羊草枯死，
冬犬厌残年。
婚姻遇发动不久也。
yi: 春天牛不下田，
夏天龙飞上天，
秋天羊的草枯死，
冬天狗厌恶残年。
婚姻遇到它发动，长久不了。
en: In spring the ox does not go down to the field,
in summer the dragon flies up to heaven,
in autumn the goat's grass withers and dies,
in winter the dog is weary of the dying year.
In marriage, if it meets this star moving, it does not last.

title: 世应相克类：婚姻有疑逃者近

rule.yi: 世应相克的卦，断语是：宅墓高低，生孩子难；病多反复，出行艰难；婚姻有疑虑，逃跑的人就在近处；诉讼拖延，被牵连羁留。
rule.en: For a hexagram in which Self and Other control each other the verse says: with houses and graves high or low, childbirth is hard; illness advances and retreats and travel is hard; a marriage has doubts and the runaway is near; a lawsuit drags on and means being bound and held.

note.yi: 这首诗在「世应相克」这个小标题下面。「逃者近」按字面译：逃跑的人在近处。
note.en: This verse stands under the small heading 'Self and Other control each other'. 'The runaway is near' is translated literally.

zh: 宅墓高低产子难，
病多进退往行艰，
婚姻有疑逃者近，
讼词留连主系关。
yi: 宅墓高低产子难，
病多进退往行艰，
婚姻有疑逃者近，
讼词留连主系关。
en: House and grave high or low, childbirth is hard;
illness advances and retreats, going and travelling are hard;
a marriage has doubts and the runaway is near;
a lawsuit drags on and means being bound and held.

title: 总断门：占婚嫌财死，占产看阴阳

rule.yi: 占婚姻，忌财爻死绝；占生产，看阴阳。
rule.en: In a marriage divination, Wealth dead is disliked; in childbirth, look at yin and yang.

note.yi: 这一句后面原书有今人的注释，本库不引；「死」指财爻在十二长生里死、墓、绝一类无力的位置。
note.en: In the book this verse is followed by a modern gloss, which this library does not quote. 'Dead' means the Wealth line in the death, tomb or extinction stage of the twelve life stages, or a similar powerless place.

zh: 占婚嫌财死，
占产看阴阳。
yi: 占婚姻，嫌财爻死；
占生产，看阴阳。
en: For a marriage divination, Wealth dead is disliked;
for childbirth, look at yin and yang.

title: 占来意：旺相则来问婚姻官职，休囚则是争财官退位；卦与世爻同与日则必是六畜及婚姻

rule.yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来：先看旺相休囚，旺相是婚姻、官职的事，休囚是争财、丢官的事。卦、世爻和日辰相同的话，来问的一定是六畜和婚姻。
rule.en: To know what the diviner has come about, first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped: strong, it is marriage and office; resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place. If the hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day, it must be livestock and marriage.

note.yi: 第一段末尾原书有一个「（1）」，是指向今人注释的编号，不在译文里。「卦与世爻同与日」的意思书里没有解释，译文照字面写。
note.en: The book has a '(1)' at the end of the first passage, a number pointing to a modern note, which is left out of the translation. 'The hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day' is not explained and is translated literally.

zh: 欲知卜者来何意，
先看旺相休囚气，
旺相婚姻宜官职，
休囚争财官退位
yi: 要知道占卜的人为什么事来，
先看旺相休囚的气；
旺相就是婚姻、官职的事，
休囚就是争财、丢官位的事
en: To know what the diviner has come about,
first look at whether the qi is strong, resting or trapped;
strong, it is marriage and office;
resting or trapped, it is quarrels over money and an official losing his place

zh: 卦与世爻同与日，
必须六畜及婚姻，
yi: 卦和世爻与日辰相同，
来问的一定是六畜和婚姻，
en: If the hexagram and the Self line are the same as the Day,
it must be livestock and marriage,

title: 占行人·咸池临玄武恐逢觅水之欢：用爻加咸池玄武则行人有外情牵惹不归，二星动合应爻或用爻是觅水之欢，青龙动合世应必娶妾

rule.yi: 占在外的人（行人）：咸池星临在玄武上，恐怕他会遇上寻欢的事。小注展开说：用爻如果加上咸池、玄武，行人在外有别的情爱牵住，不回来；咸池、玄武发动，去合应爻或用爻，是在外寻欢；青龙发动去合世爻和应爻，他一定会娶妾。
rule.en: Divining a traveller: if the Xianchi star sits on the Dark Tortoise, he may meet a dalliance. The note goes on: if the Subject line has the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise added, the traveller has an outside affair holding him and does not return; if the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise move and combine with the Other line or the Subject line, it is a dalliance; if the Azure Dragon moves and combines with Self and Other, he will surely take a concubine.

note.yi: 「觅水之欢」的「水」指咸池：咸池又叫桃花，是水星，主男女私情，「觅水之欢」是在外面找私情的欢会。这一段是占出门在外的人（行人），不是占本地的婚姻；这里收的是它里面和男女私情、娶妾有关的三句，前面讲梦的话和别的行人断法没有收。「用爻」这里是行人本人所在的爻。
note.en: 'Seeking the pleasure of water' refers to the Xianchi star: Xianchi, also called the peach blossom, is a water star and rules illicit love between man and woman, and 'seeking the pleasure of water' is going outside for a liaison. This passage divines a traveller away from home and not a marriage at home; what is taken here are the three sentences in it that concern illicit love and taking a concubine, and the words before them about dreams and the other rules for judging travellers are not taken. The 'Subject line' here is the line that stands for the traveller himself.

zh: 咸池若临玄武，
恐逢觅水之欢。
yi: 咸池星如果临在玄武上，
恐怕会遇上寻欢作乐的事。
en: If the Xianchi star sits on the Dark Tortoise,
he may meet with the pleasures of seeking the water (a dalliance).

zh: 用爻若加咸池、玄武，行人主有外情牵惹，不归。
咸池、玄武动合应爻或用爻，觅水之欢。
或青龙动合世应，必娶妾。
yi: 用爻如果加上咸池、玄武，行人在外有别的情爱牵住，不回来。
咸池、玄武发动去合应爻或用爻，是寻欢之事。
或者青龙发动去合世爻和应爻，一定娶妾。
en: If the Subject line has the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise added, the traveller has an outside affair holding him and does not return.
If the Xianchi star and the Dark Tortoise move and combine with the Other line or the Subject line, it is the pleasure of seeking the water.
Or if the Azure Dragon moves and combines with Self and Other, he will surely take a concubine.

title: 娶妻先向财中觅，嫁夫可类鬼爻推：旺相得时成合配，休囚刑害不相宜；兄旺克妻妻不就，子旺伤夫夫有疑；八纯动者主离别，五世游魂损小儿

rule.yi: 娶妻先看财爻，嫁夫也照样看鬼爻。旺相得时就能配成，休囚或被刑害就不合适。兄弟爻旺克妻，妻子成不了；子孙爻旺伤夫，丈夫有疑。八纯卦动主离别，五世卦、游魂卦损害小孩。眉批的意思相同：财、鬼旺相成合，休囚不宜，兄旺克妻，子动伤夫。
rule.en: To take a wife look first at the Wealth line; to marry a husband, look likewise at the Pressure line. If it is strong and in season the match is made; if resting, trapped, punished or harmed it is unsuitable. A strong Peer line controls the wife and she cannot be had; a strong Output line harms the husband and he is in doubt. A pure eight-palace hexagram that moves means parting; a fifth-generation or Wandering Soul hexagram harms the children. The marginal comment says the same: Wealth and Pressure strong, they combine; resting or trapped, unsuitable; a strong Peer line controls the wife; Output moving harms the husband.

zh: 娶妻先向财中觅，嫁夫可类鬼爻推，
旺相得时成合配，休囚刑害不相宜。
兄旺克妻妻不就，子旺伤夫夫有疑，
八纯动者主离别，五世游魂损小儿。
yi: 娶妻先在财爻里找，嫁夫可以照样在鬼爻里推；
旺相得时就能配成，休囚、遭刑害就不合适。
兄弟爻旺克妻，妻子成不了；子孙爻旺伤夫，丈夫有疑；
八纯卦动主离别，五世卦、游魂卦损害小孩。
en: To take a wife look first in the Wealth line; to marry a husband, reckon likewise in the Pressure line;
if it is strong and in season the match is made; if resting, trapped, punished or harmed it is unsuitable.
a strong Peer line controls the wife and she cannot be had; a strong Output line harms the husband and he is in doubt;
a pure eight-palace hexagram that moves means parting; a fifth-generation or Wandering Soul hexagram harms the children.

hits.text: 八纯动者生离别，五世游魂损小儿
八纯动者生离别，五世游魂损小儿

zh: 妻财鬼爻，旺相成合，休囚不宜，兄旺克妻。
子动伤夫，八纯离别，五世游魂，必损小儿。
yi: 妻财、鬼爻，旺相就成合，休囚就不宜，兄弟爻旺就克妻。
子孙爻动伤夫，八纯卦离别，五世、游魂卦，必定损伤小孩。
en: Wealth and Pressure: strong, they combine and succeed; resting or trapped, unsuitable; a strong Peer line controls the wife.
Output moving harms the husband; a pure eight-palace hexagram means parting; a fifth-generation or Wandering Soul hexagram surely harms the children.

title: 占妻看财宜动，占夫有鬼宜静

rule.yi: 占妻子看财爻，宜动；占丈夫要有鬼爻，宜静。
rule.en: To divine a wife look at the Wealth line, which should move; to divine a husband the Pressure line must be present and should be still.

dispute.yi: 占妻看财爻：《海底眼》说宜动；《火珠林》说「占妻看财爻，宜静」（LY.MARRY.HZL.04）；《易林补遗》也说要静。占夫看鬼爻，两家都说宜静。这一处是《海底眼》独异，也可能是转录之误，书里无从核对。
dispute.en: For divining a wife by the Wealth line, the Haidi Yan says it should move; the Huozhulin says 'for a wife look at the Wealth line, which should be still' (LY.MARRY.HZL.04); the Yilin Buyi also asks for stillness. For a husband by the Pressure line both say it should be still. Here the Haidi Yan stands alone; it may be a transcription slip, and there is nothing in the books to check it against.

zh: 占妻看财宜动，占夫有鬼宜静。
yi: 占妻子看财爻，宜动；占丈夫要有鬼爻，宜静。
en: To divine a wife look at the Wealth line, which should move; to divine a husband the Pressure line must be present and should be still.

title: 阳宫端正、阴宫丑陋，落在飞神上应头面，卦无子孙不喜悦

rule.yi: 阳宫的人端正，阴宫的人丑陋；落在飞神上，只应在头面；落在飞神……不应在四肢。卦里没有子孙爻，不喜悦。
rule.en: A yang palace means upright looks, a yin palace ugly ones: on the flying spirit it answers only in the head and face; on the flying spirit... it does not answer in the limbs. A hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

note.yi: 「在飞止应头面，在飞不应四肢」两个「在飞」不同义，读不通。《火珠林》同一句作「在飞上应头面四肢，在飞下应拙不稳」（LY.MARRY.HZL.04），这里的第二个「在飞」像是漏了「下」字；译文照原文译，括号里注明。
note.en: The two 'on the flying spirit' in 'on the flying spirit it answers only in the head and face; on the flying spirit it does not answer in the limbs' cannot both mean the same, and the sentence does not read through. The Huozhulin has the same sentence as 'on the flying spirit it answers in the head, face and limbs, and under it, in clumsiness' (LY.MARRY.HZL.04), so the second 'on the flying spirit' looks as if the word 'below' has dropped out; it is translated as written, with the doubt marked in brackets.

zh: 阳宫端正，阴宫丑陋，在飞止应头面，在飞不应四肢，卦无子孙不喜悦。
yi: 阳宫端正，阴宫丑陋，落在飞神上只应在头面，落在飞神（下）不应在四肢，卦里没有子孙爻，不喜悦。
en: A yang palace is upright, a yin palace ugly; on the flying spirit it answers only in the head and face, on the flying spirit (below) it does not answer in the limbs; a hexagram without an Output line is not a happy one.

title: 男占得震主再婚，女占得坎主再嫁

rule.yi: 男子占得震卦，主再婚；女子占得坎卦，主再嫁。
rule.en: A man who gets Zhen will marry again; a woman who gets Kan will marry again.

note.yi: 《火珠林》同一句是「男占得震巽主再婚，女占得坎离主再嫁」，这里各少一个卦名。
note.en: The Huozhulin has 'a man who gets Zhen or Xun... a woman who gets Kan or Li...', one trigram name more on each side.

zh: 男占得震主再婚，女占得坎主再嫁。
yi: 男子占，得震卦，主再婚；女子占，得坎卦，主再嫁。
en: A man who gets the hexagram Zhen will marry again; a woman who gets Kan will marry again.

hits.text: 男占得震巽主再婚；女占得坎离主再嫁

title: 妻在间爻女有亲为主婚、夫在间爻男有亲为主婚，得时旺相则成，出现忌日冲月破；世动男不肯、应动女生疑；用神发动成也分离；父伤损长亲，间动阻隔或媒人作鬼

rule.yi: 妻子（财爻）在间爻上，女方有亲人做主婚人；丈夫（鬼爻）在间爻上，男方有亲人做主婚人。得时旺相就能成；用神出现时，忌日冲、月破。世爻动，男方不肯；应爻动，女方起疑。用神发动，即使成了也见分离。父母爻受伤，损害长辈；间爻动，有阻隔；或者媒人又化作鬼爻。
rule.en: If the wife (the Wealth line) is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage; if the husband (the Pressure line) is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides. If it is in season and strong it can be made; when the Subject appears, it fears a clash from the Day and a Month-break. If the Self line moves the man will not agree; if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful. If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation. If the Resource line is harmed the elders are injured; a moving between line means obstruction; or the go-between turns into Pressure again.

note.yi: 「妻在同爻」「夫在同爻」的「同爻」多半是「间爻」之误（《火珠林》同一句作「妻在间爻」，LY.MARRY.HZL.05），译文按「间爻」译。这一节和《火珠林》「占婚姻」里的几句几乎相同，词句略有出入。
note.en: 'Same line' in 'the wife on the same line' and 'the husband on the same line' is most likely a slip for 'between line' (the Huozhulin has 'the wife on a between line', LY.MARRY.HZL.05) and is translated so. This passage is almost the same as several sentences in the Huozhulin's 'divining marriage', with small differences of wording.

zh: 妻在同爻女有亲为主婚，夫在同爻男有亲为主婚。
若得时旺相，则有成。
如出现，忌日冲月破。
世动男不肯，应动女生疑。
用神发动，成也见分离。
父伤损长亲，间动阻隔，或媒人又作鬼。
yi: 妻子在间爻上，女方有亲人做主婚人；丈夫在间爻上，男方有亲人做主婚人。
如果得时旺相，就能成。
如果用神出现，忌讳日冲、月破。
世爻动，男方不肯；应爻动，女方起疑。
用神发动，即使成了也见分离。
父母爻受伤，损害长辈；间爻动，有阻隔；或者媒人又化作鬼爻。
en: If the wife is on a between line, a relative of the woman's side presides at the marriage; if the husband is on a between line, a relative of the man's side presides.
If it is in season and strong, it can be made.
If the Subject appears, it fears a clash from the Day and a Month-break.
If the Self line moves the man will not agree; if the Other line moves the woman grows doubtful.
If the Subject moves, even if made it ends in separation.
If the Resource line is harmed the elders are injured; a moving between line means obstruction; or the go-between turns into Pressure again.

hits.text: 妻在间爻，女有亲为主婚；夫在间爻、男有亲为主婚
世动，男不肯，应动，女生疑
用神如发动，成也见分离

title: 六亲爻动断婚姻：父动子息难得，子动喜笑成姻缘（旺动伤夫），财动如意，兄动求妻难谐，官动婚姻未就生疑滞

rule.yi: 《海底眼》的「六亲爻动」一节，给每一种六亲爻发动列了一首诗，每首诗里有一句是断婚姻的：父母爻动，婚姻和子息都难得（子孙变成父母，被克）；子孙爻动，婚姻喜悦是一段好姻缘（但小注说：旺而动，伤丈夫）；妻财爻动，婚姻称心如意；兄弟爻动，求娶妻子难以和谐；官鬼爻动，婚姻还没有成，生出疑虑阻滞。每首诗的其余各句讲病、官司、买卖、行人，这里不收。
rule.en: The Haidi Yan's section on 'the relatives moving' gives each relative a poem, and each poem has one line for marriage: Resource moving, marriage and children are hard to get (Output changes into Resource and is controlled); Output moving, marriage is glad and a fated match (but the small note says: strong and moving, it harms the husband); Wealth moving, marriage is as wished; Peer moving, seeking a wife is hard to bring to harmony; Pressure moving, the marriage is not yet made and doubt and hindrance arise. The other lines of each poem speak of illness, lawsuits, trade and travellers and are not included here.

dispute.yi: 这五句和同一本书别处的说法有出入。第一，子孙爻动：这里说「喜笑是姻缘」，而本书婚姻章（LY.MARRY.HDY.01）说「子旺伤夫夫有疑」，小注「旺动伤夫」把两边并在一起，没有再往下分；第二，妻财爻动：这里说「如意」，本书别处说占妻看财要静（LY.MARRY.HDY.07），《火珠林》也说妻财独发「必克翁姑」（LY.MARRY.HZL.27）。书里没有把这几处说圆。
dispute.en: These five lines do not all agree with the rest of the same book. First, for Output moving, this says 'glad and a fated match', while the marriage chapter of this book (LY.MARRY.HDY.01) says 'a strong Output line harms the husband and he is in doubt'; the small note 'strong and moving harms the husband' sets the two side by side and goes no further. Second, for Wealth moving, this says 'as wished', while elsewhere in the book the Subject line for taking a wife should be still (LY.MARRY.HDY.07), and the Huozhulin says a Wealth line moving alone 'must harm the parents-in-law' (LY.MARRY.HZL.27). The book does not reconcile them.

note.yi: 每一首里括号里的小注是书里自己的夹注，和正文写在一起，所以引文里带着它们。兄弟爻动那一首的头一句是「兄弟同人克了财」（兄动克财，小注说「同」是同类），它是「求妻买婢事难谐」的缘由，但中间隔着病、应举两句，没有一起收。这一组诗在别的书里也有，字句略有出入：《断易天机》（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.12 至 DYTJ.16）、《卜筮大全》第 3147 行起、《卜筮正宗》第 254 行起、《易隐》第 50 行起、《火珠林》第 1008 行起。《海底眼》这一本的独异之处是给每一句都加了小注，并且兄弟爻动那一首里有「求妻买婢事难谐」一句，《火珠林》的同一首里没有。
note.en: The bracketed small notes in each poem are the book's own interlinear notes, written together with the text, so they are carried in the quotations. The first line of the Peer poem is 'a Peer moving controls Wealth' (the note says 'same' means the same kind), which is the reason for 'seeking a wife or buying a maid is hard to harmonize'; but two lines on illness and examinations lie between them, and they are not taken together. The same set of poems appears in other books with small differences: the Duanyi Tianji (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.12 to DYTJ.16), the Bushi Daquan from line 3147, the Bushi Zhengzong from line 254, the Yi Yin from line 50 and the Huozhulin from line 1008. What is peculiar to the Haidi Yan is that it adds a small note to every line, and that its Peer poem has the line 'seeking a wife or buying a maid is hard to bring to harmony', which the Huozhulin's poem does not have.

zh: 婚姻子息应难得（子变父克），
yi: 婚姻和子息应该难得（小注：子孙变出父母，被父母克）。
en: Marriage and children should be hard to get (annotation: Output changes into Resource and is controlled).

zh: 婚姻喜笑是姻缘（旺动伤夫）。
yi: 婚姻喜悦欢笑，是一段好姻缘（小注：旺而动，伤丈夫）。
en: Marriage is glad and laughing, a fated match (annotation: strong and moving, it harms the husband).

zh: 婚姻如意乐无虞（财为妻主）。
yi: 婚姻称心如意，欢乐没有忧虑（小注：财爻是妻子的主爻）。
en: Marriage is as wished, joyful and free of worry (annotation: the Wealth line is the master of the wife).

zh: 求妻买婢事难谐（同上断之）。
yi: 求娶妻子、买婢女，事情难以和谐（小注：照上面一样断）。
en: Seeking a wife or buying a maid, the matter is hard to bring to harmony (annotation: judge it as above).

zh: 官鬼从来克兄弟（鬼动克兄），
婚姻未就生疑滞（鬼动狐疑），
yi: 官鬼爻一向克兄弟爻（小注：鬼动克兄），
婚姻还没有成，生出疑虑阻滞（小注：鬼动就狐疑不决）。
en: The Pressure line has always controlled the Peer line (annotation: Pressure moving controls Peer),
the marriage is not yet made and doubt and hindrance arise (annotation: Pressure moving means doubt and hesitation).

title: 娶妻买婢，用爻宜静，有气为先

rule.yi: 娶妻、买婢女这一类事（同一排里还有买房宅坟田、住庵、拜见人、寻失物、申冤），用爻宜静，以有气（旺相有力）为先。这一排之后的「取索借债、读书请客、生产求归、脱货赎解、官员待次、散事解灾」眉批也标「宜静」；再后面「改易叙职、告欲干求、脱诈失约、行人远信、出行迁移」则标「宜动」。
rule.en: For taking a wife or buying a maid (in the same row: houses, tombs and fields, staying in a hermitage, calling on someone, looking for lost goods, righting a wrong) the Subject line should be still, and having breath comes first. The marginal comment marks the row after it too ('claims and loans, reading, inviting guests, childbirth, releasing goods, an official awaiting a post, dispersing trouble') as 'should be still'; the row after that ('changing posts, petitioning, cheating and broken promises, letters from travellers, journeys and moves') is marked 'should move'.

dispute.yi: 同一本书前面说占妻要看财爻「宜动」（LY.MARRY.HDY.02），这里又说娶妻用爻「宜静」，两处相反，书里没有解释。《火珠林》（LY.MARRY.HZL.04）和《易林补遗》（LY.MARRY.YL.19）都说占妻看财要静。
dispute.en: Earlier the same book says that for divining a wife the Wealth line 'should move' (LY.MARRY.HDY.02), and here that the Subject line for taking a wife 'should be still'; the two are opposite and the book does not explain. The Huozhulin (LY.MARRY.HZL.04) and the Yilin Buyi (LY.MARRY.YL.19) both say that in divining a wife the Wealth line should be still.

note.yi: 这一排的头一句「娶妻买婢」是婚姻在这份「用爻宜静」名单里的位置。原文这一行紧接着还有两排：「取索借债……散事解灾」后面括着眉批「宜静」，「改易叙职……出行迁移」后面括着眉批「宜动」，婚姻不在第二排里。眉批「宜静」在原文里放在第二排的后面，读法是它管着前面两排，这里照此读；书里没有再多说。《断易天机》（LY.MARRY.DYTJ.18）有同一句，作「娶妻买妾，用爻宜静，有气为先」，只差「婢」和「妾」一个字。
note.en: The first phrase of this row, 'taking a wife and buying a maid', is where marriage stands in this list of matters where the Subject line should be still. In the original two more rows follow: 'claims and loans ... dispersing trouble' is followed by the marginal comment 'should be still', and 'changing posts ... journeys and moves' by 'should move'; marriage is not in the second. The comment 'should be still' comes after the second row in the original, and it is read here as governing the two rows before it; the book says nothing more. The Duanyi Tianji (LY.MARRY.DYTJ.18) has the same line as 'taking a wife or a concubine, the Subject line should be still, and having breath comes first', differing only in 'concubine' for 'maid'.

zh: 娶妻买婢，
屋宅坟田，
住庵谒人，
失物理冤。
用爻宜静，
有气为先，
yi: 娶妻、买婢女，
房屋宅子、坟地田地，
住到庵里、拜见人，
找失物、申冤：
用爻宜静，
有气（旺相有力）为先。
en: Taking a wife, buying a maid,
houses and dwellings, tombs and fields,
staying in a hermitage, calling on someone,
looking for lost goods, righting a wrong:
the Subject line should be still,
and having breath (being strong and in season) comes first.

title: 辰日合酉、午合未、亥日寅爻六合神：用神旺相长生皆可顺，财鬼婚姻便结亲

rule.yi: 日辰和用神爻六合（辰日合酉、午合未、亥日合寅），用神又旺相或长生，事情都顺；占婚姻时，妻财和官鬼爻遇上这样的六合，婚事就结成。
rule.en: When the Day six-combines the Subject line (a Chen day combines You, Wu combines Wei, a Hai day combines Yin), and the Subject is strong or in its birth state, things all go smoothly; in a marriage divination, when the Wealth and Pressure lines meet such a six-combine, the match is made.

note.yi: 「辰日合酉、午合未、亥日寅爻」是举例：辰酉合、午未合、亥寅合。「财鬼」是妻财和官鬼，占婚姻时的两个用神，男占看财、女占看鬼。原文后面括着一条眉批「凶神即凶陈」，前后读不通，没有收。
note.en: 'A Chen day combines You, Wu combines Wei, a Hai day the Yin line' are examples: Chen-You, Wu-Wei and Hai-Yin are the branch combinations. 'Wealth and Pressure' are the two Subject lines for a marriage, Wealth for a man's divination and Pressure for a woman's. A marginal comment follows in brackets, 'the malign spirit is the malign array', which does not read through with what precedes it and is left out.

zh: 辰日合酉午合未，
亥日寅爻六合神，
旺相长生皆可顺，
财鬼婚姻便结亲
yi: 辰日合酉，午合未，
亥日和寅爻是六合的神；
旺相、长生都可以顺，
妻财、官鬼（占）婚姻，就结成亲。
en: A Chen day combines You, Wu combines Wei,
and a Hai day and the Yin line are the six-combine spirits;
strong and in season, or in the birth state, all can go smoothly,
and for Wealth and Pressure in a marriage, the match is made.

title: 世应当中两间爻，发动则所求多阻隔：间为中人不可动，兄动脱诈口舌，鬼动见祸，占婚姻为某人诡谲

rule.yi: 世爻和应爻中间的两个间爻，代表中间人（占婚姻就是媒人），不可发动，动了就有阻隔：兄弟爻动，主诈骗、口舌；官鬼爻动，主人事上受阻隔、见祸；占婚姻，就是某个人在使诈。
rule.en: The two between lines between Self and Other stand for the go-betweens (in a marriage, the matchmakers) and must not move; moving, they bring hindrance to what is sought: a Peer line moving means cheating and quarrels, a Pressure line moving means people and affairs are cut off and misfortune shows; in a marriage divination it is some person acting deceitfully.

note.yi: 第 482 行的诗里，「假饶有无事分明，又见切切方始得」两句意思不清（大概是说事情看着有没有都分明了，还要再切切实实地看到才算得），没有收，只收头两句和小注。第 484 行接着往下列「占生产为老娘，占事为阻隔……」，是别的事里间爻各指什么人，不属婚姻，没有收。
note.en: In the poem at line 482 the two lines 'even if there is or is not, and the matter is clear, it is only obtained when it is seen again earnestly' are unclear (perhaps: even if the matter seems clear either way, it counts as got only when seen again in earnest) and are left out; only the first two lines and the small note are taken. Line 484 goes on to say who the between lines are in other matters ('in childbirth the midwife, in affairs a hinderer ...'), which is not about marriage and is not taken.

zh: 世应当中两间爻，发动所求多阻隔，
yi: 世爻和应爻当中的两个间爻，发动，所求的事多有阻隔。
en: The two between lines lying between Self and Other, if they move, what is sought meets many hindrances.

title: 六亲持世断夫妻：父母持世夫妻不同床、老来终求他姓之子；兄弟持世克妻财

rule.yi: 《海底眼》的「六亲持世」诗里，和夫妻有关的两句：父母爻持世，夫妻不合、不同床（书里写的是「相合」，疑是「相克」之误），到老终究要过继别姓的儿子（小注：父母必克子孙）；兄弟爻持世，克妻财（小注：兄弟必克财）。
rule.en: Two lines of the Haidi Yan's poem on 'the relatives on Self' touch husband and wife: with the Resource line on Self, husband and wife do not share a bed (the book writes 'combine', probably a slip for 'control'), and in the end one must seek a son of another surname (annotation: Resource must control Output); with the Peer line on Self, Wealth is controlled (annotation: Peer must control Wealth).

note.yi: 「相合不同床」读不通：相合而不同床，自相矛盾。《卜筮全书》的「诸爻持世诀」同一句作「夫妻相克不和同、到老要求他姓之子」（LY.MARRY.BSQS.08），这里的「相合」「到者」像是「相克」「到老」抄错了，《火珠林》所附歌诀第 945 行也作「夫妻相克不和同，到老用求他姓子」。译文照原文译，括号里注出。第 336 行后面三句讲官司、口舌、损财，不属婚姻，没有收。
note.en: 'Combine yet do not share a bed' is self-contradictory. The Bushi Quanshu's poem on the lines holding Self has the same line as 'husband and wife control each other and do not agree, in old age one must seek a son of another surname' (LY.MARRY.BSQS.08); 'combine' and 'at the last' here look like miscopies of 'control' and 'in old age'. The verse appended to the Huozhulin, at line 945, also reads 'husband and wife control each other and do not agree, in old age one must seek a son of another surname'. The translation follows the text as written, with the doubt marked in brackets. The three lines after line 336 speak of lawsuits, quarrels and loss of money, not marriage, and are not taken.

zh: 父母持世身忧苦（父主难宰），
身带文书及官鬼（父赖官生），
夫妻相合不同床（夫妇不宜），
到者终求他姓子（父必克子）。
yi: 父母爻持世，自身忧愁辛苦（小注：父母主难以主持），
自身带着文书和官鬼（小注：父母靠官鬼生），
夫妻相合却不同床（小注：夫妇不相宜），
到者（疑为「到老」）终究要求别姓的儿子（小注：父母必克子）。
en: With Resource on Self one is anxious and toiling (annotation: Resource is hard to manage),
carrying documents and Pressure (annotation: Resource depends on Pressure to be generated),
husband and wife 'combine' yet do not share a bed (annotation: husband and wife are not suited),
at the last (probably 'in old age') one must in the end seek a son of another surname (annotation: Resource must control Output).

zh: 兄弟持世克妻财（兄必克财），
yi: 兄弟爻持世，克妻财（小注：兄弟必克财），
en: With a Peer line on Self, Wealth is controlled (annotation: Peer must control Wealth),

title: 结婚买婢成诸事，卦无财子闹重重：用爻出现为有、不现为无

rule.yi: 结婚、买婢女这一类求成的事，卦里没有妻财和子孙，就是困难重重。眉批说明什么叫「无」：用爻在卦里出现叫「有」，用爻不现叫「无」。
rule.en: For marriage, buying a maid and other matters one wants to bring about, if the hexagram has no Wealth or Output line, trouble comes on trouble. The marginal comment explains 'no': the Subject line appearing in the hexagram is 'present', not appearing is 'absent'.

note.yi: 这一首诗前两句是「五行忧者先忧否，无鬼忧官喜落空」，讲的是忧事和官讼，没有收。「财子」是妻财和子孙：妻财是妻，子孙是福神，结婚时两个都要有。「无」按眉批的定义是不出现在卦里（比如伏在别爻之下），不是旺衰的衰。
note.en: The first two lines of this poem, 'in the five elements the worried one worries first about denial; without Pressure he worries about the officials, and is glad if it is Void', speak of worries and lawsuits and are not taken. 'Wealth and Output' are the Wealth line, the wife, and the Output line, the line of fortune; a marriage needs both. 'Absent' by the marginal comment's definition means not appearing in the hexagram (for example hidden beneath another line), and is not the 'weak' of strong and weak.

zh: 结婚买婢成诸事，
卦无财子闹重重。
yi: 结婚、买婢女，成办这些事，
卦里没有妻财、子孙，就闹得重重叠叠。
en: For marriage and buying a maid, bringing such matters about,
if the hexagram has no Wealth or Output, trouble comes on trouble.

zh: 用爻出现谓之有，
用爻不现谓之无。
yi: 用爻在卦里出现，叫做「有」；
用爻不出现，叫做「无」。
en: The Subject line appearing is called 'present';
the Subject line not appearing is called 'absent'.

title: 欲谐伉俪，必定阴阳：阳奇阴偶，世阳应阴、鬼阳财阴、内阳外阴，阴阳相得成夫妇之道

rule.yi: 夫妻要和谐，先看阴阳配不配：世属阳、应属阴，鬼（官）属阳、财属阴，内卦属阳、外卦属阴；各得其位，才是夫妇之道，日后有利。男家占，宜世阳应阴；女家占，宜世阴应阳。
rule.en: For a couple to be harmonious, first see whether yin and yang match: the Self is yang and the Other yin, Pressure is yang and Wealth yin, the inner trigram is yang and the outer yin; each in its place is the way of husband and wife, and later days will be favourable. When the man's family divines, the Self should be yang and the Other yin; when the woman's family divines, the Self should be yin and the Other yang.

note.yi: 「朱陈」指朱陈村，旧时两姓世代联姻的说法；「宓羲」即伏羲；「月老」即月下老人。这几句是章首的引语，不是判断。
note.en: 'Zhu and Chen' refers to the village of Zhu-Chen, proverbial for two families who intermarried through generations; 'Mi Xi' is Fu Xi; 'Yue Lao' is the Old Man under the Moon. These opening lines are a preface, not a judgement.

zh: 男女合婚，契于前定；
朱陈缔结，分在夙成。
然非月老，焉知夫妇于当时；
不有宓羲，岂识吉凶于今日！
欲谐伉俪，必定阴阳。
yi: 男女配成婚姻，是前世就定好的；
朱陈两家结亲，缘分早就注定。
但如果不是月下老人，怎么会在当时就知道谁是夫妻；
没有伏羲，怎么会在今天知道吉凶！
想要夫妻和谐，必须先定阴阳。
en: A man and woman joined in marriage: it was fixed beforehand;
the Zhu and Chen families were bound as in-laws, their lot made long before.
But without the Old Man under the Moon, how could one know at the time who would be husband and wife;
and without Fu Xi, how could one know good or ill today!
To harmonise a couple, first settle yin and yang.

zh: 阳奇阴偶，配合成婚。
世属阳，应属阴；
鬼属阳，财属阴；

yi: 阳是奇数，阴是偶数，配合起来成了婚姻。

鬼属阳，财属阴；
内卦属阳，外卦属阴。
阴阳相得，才成夫妇之道。
日后必然大利。
en: Yang is odd and yin is even; matched together they make a marriage.
The Self belongs to yang and the Other to yin;
Pressure belongs to yang and Wealth to yin;
the inner trigram belongs to yang and the outer to yin.
When yin and yang suit each other, that is the way of husband and wife.
In the days to come it will surely be greatly favourable.

zh: 阳奇阴偶，配合成婚。
如男家卜，宜世属阳应属阴，用神阴阳得位；
女家卜，宜世阴应阳。
yi: 阳是奇数，阴是偶数，配合起来成了婚姻。
如果男家占，宜于世属阳、应属阴，用神的阴阳各得其位；
女家占，宜于世阴、应阳。
en: Yang is odd and yin is even; matched together they make a marriage.
If the man's family divines, it is fitting that the Self be yang and the Other yin, with the Subject's yin and yang each in its place;
if the woman's family divines, the Self should be yin and the Other yang.

title: 阴阳交错，难期琴瑟之和鸣：世阴应阳、鬼阴财阳、内阴外阳，成婚后夫妻反目

rule.yi: 阴阳交错是指世阴应阳、鬼阴财阳、内阴外阳，这是反象；成婚后，丈夫欺凌妻子、妻子欺侮丈夫，整天吵架，不得和顺；如果变出的财、鬼不空，主象又安静，也还可用。
rule.en: Yin and yang crossed means the Self yin and the Other yang, Pressure yin and Wealth yang, the inner trigram yin and the outer yang; this is an inverted image, and after the marriage the husband bullies the wife and the wife slights the husband, quarrelling all day and never in harmony; if the changed Wealth and Pressure are not Void and the principal image is quiet, it can still be used.

note.yi: 「主象」书里没有解释，这里译作「主象」（最主要的那一个象）。
note.en: The book does not gloss 'the principal image'; it is translated as the main image of the hexagram.

zh: 阴阳交错，难期琴瑟之和鸣；
yi: 阴阳交错，难以指望夫妻琴瑟和鸣；
en: With yin and yang crossed, one can hardly hope for lute and zither to sound in concert;

zh: 如男卜女，遇世阴应阳，世阴财阳者，是阴阳交错，后主夫妻欺凌，终朝反目。
yi: 比如男子占女子，遇到世阴应阳、世阴财阳的，就是阴阳交错，以后夫妻互相欺凌，整天吵架。
en: For instance, when a man divines about a woman and gets the Self yin with the Other yang, or the Self yin with Wealth yang, yin and yang are crossed, and later the couple bully each other and quarrel all day.

title: 内外互摇，定见家庭之挠括：婚姻卦宜安静；财动不和公婆，鬼动不和妯娌，父动不和子侄，兄动不和夫妻

rule.yi: 占婚姻，卦宜安静，安静则家庭和睦、没有争斗；如果财动，和公婆不和；鬼动，和妯娌不和；父动，和子侄不和；兄动，夫妻不和；再加月建、日辰，不但不和，还有克制。
rule.en: In divining marriage the hexagram should be quiet, and when quiet the household is at peace without strife; if Wealth moves, discord with the parents-in-law; Pressure moving, with the brothers' wives; Resource moving, with the children and nephews; Peer moving, between husband and wife; with the Month or Day added there is not only discord but also control.

note.yi: 兄动一句，旧注作「不和夫妻」，王洪绪作「不和妻妾」，字面不同。
note.en: On Peer moving, the old commentary reads 'discord between husband and wife' and Wang Hongxu 'discord with wife and concubines'; the wording differs.

zh: 内外互摇，定见家庭之挠括。
yi: 内外互相摇动，一定会看到家庭里的纷扰。
en: With inner and outer moving upon each other, the household will surely see turmoil.

zh: 占婚，卦宜安静。
安静家庭雍睦，必无争斗事。
若财动，则不和翁姑；
鬼动，则不和妯娌；
父动，则不和子侄；
兄动，则不和夫妻。
动加月建日辰，不唯不和，更有克制。
yi: 占婚姻，卦宜安静。
安静，家庭就和睦，一定没有争斗的事。
如果财动，就和公婆不和；
鬼动，就和妯娌不和；
父动，就和子侄不和；
兄动，就夫妻不和。
动爻再加月建、日辰，不但不和，还有克制。
en: In divining marriage the hexagram should be quiet.
If quiet, the household is at peace and there will be no strife.
If Wealth moves, there is discord with the parents-in-law;
if Pressure moves, with the brothers' wives;
if Resource moves, with the children and nephews;
if Peer moves, between husband and wife.
If the moving line is reinforced by the Month or Day, there is not only discord but also control.

zh: 占婚姻卦宜安静，安静则家庭雍睦无争。
若财动则不和公姑，鬼动则不和妯娌，父动则不和子侄，兄动则不和妻妾。
加月建日辰，不唯不和，更有刑克。
yi: 占婚姻，卦宜安静；安静，家庭就和睦、没有争执。
如果财动，和公婆不和；鬼动，和妯娌不和；父动，和子侄不和；兄动，和妻妾不和。
再加月建、日辰，不但不和，还有刑克。
en: In divining marriage the hexagram should be quiet; when quiet the household is at peace and without quarrel.
If Wealth moves, discord with the parents-in-law; Pressure moving, with the brothers' wives; Resource moving, with the children and nephews; Peer moving, with the wife and concubines.
With the Month or Day added, there is not only discord but also punishment and control.

title: 六合则易而且吉，六冲则难而又凶

rule.yi: 六合卦一阴一阳配合成象，世应相生、财官相合，容易成而且吉；六冲卦不是纯阴就是纯阳，像两个女人同住、两个男人并处，志向合不来，难成，成了也不利。
rule.en: A Six-Combine hexagram is one yin matched with one yang, with the Self and Other generating each other and Wealth and Pressure combining, and is easy to bring about and auspicious; a Six-Clash hexagram is pure yin or pure yang, like two women living together or two men side by side whose aims cannot agree, hard to bring about, and unfavourable even if it succeeds.

zh: 六合则易而且吉；
yi: 六合，就容易而且吉；
en: Six-Combine is easy and auspicious;

zh: 六合卦，一阴一阳，配合成象。
世应相生，财官相合。
占者得之，必主易成而又吉。
yi: 六合卦是一阴一阳，配合起来成象。
世和应相生，财和官相合。
占卦的人得到它，一定容易成而且吉。
en: A Six-Combine hexagram is one yin and one yang, matched to form an image.
The Self and Other generate each other, and Wealth and Pressure combine.
One who divines and gets it will find it easy to bring about, and auspicious as well.

zh: 六冲则难而又凶。
yi: 六冲，就困难而且凶。
en: Six-Clash is hard and ominous.

zh: 六冲卦，非纯阴则纯阳也。
其象犹二女同居，两男并处，志必不合。
占者得之，必主难成，纵成亦不利。
yi: 六冲卦，不是纯阴就是纯阳。
它的象好比两个女人同住、两个男人并处，志向一定合不来。
占卦的人得到它，一定难成，就是成了也不利。
en: A Six-Clash hexagram is either pure yin or pure yang.
Its image is like two women living together or two men side by side, whose aims cannot agree.
One who divines and gets it will find it hard to bring about, and even if it succeeds it is not favourable.

zh: 六合之卦，一阴一阳配合成象，世应相生，六爻相合，占主得之，必主成而又吉。
六冲卦非纯阳则纯阴也，其象尤二女同居，两男并处，志必不合，占者得之，必主难成，纵成亦不利。
yi: 六合的卦，一阴一阳配合成象，世应相生，六爻相合，占的人得到，必然成而且吉。
六冲卦不是纯阳就是纯阴，象是两个女人同住、两个男人并处，志向一定合不来，占的人得到，必然难成，就是成了也不利。
en: A Six-Combine hexagram is one yin matched with one yang; the Self and Other generate each other and the six lines combine; one who gets it will succeed, and auspiciously.

A Six-Clash hexagram is pure yang or pure yin, like two women together or two men side by side, whose aims cannot agree; one who gets it will find it hard to bring about, and even if it succeeds it is not favourable.

title: 阴而阳阳而阴，偏利牵丝之举：世官宜阳反阴、应财宜阴反阳，娶妇多不利，惟入赘吉

rule.yi: 世和官本宜阳却变成阴，应和财本宜阴却变成阳，这样的卦，占娶妻多半不利，只有入赘（男子嫁入女家）才吉。
rule.en: When the Self and Pressure, which should be yang, turn out yin, and the Other and Wealth, which should be yin, turn out yang, then in divining the taking of a wife it is mostly unfavourable, and only marrying into the bride's family is auspicious.

note.yi: 「牵丝」字面是牵红线成亲；旧注和王洪绪的解释都落在「惟入赘则吉」上，本库照此。
note.en: 'Drawing the thread' literally means drawing the red thread of a match; both the old commentary and Wang Hongxu resolve it into 'only marrying into the bride's family is auspicious', and this library follows that.

zh: 阴而阳阳而阴，偏利牵丝之举；
yi: 阴变阳、阳变阴，偏偏利于「牵丝」的事；
en: Yin turning to yang and yang to yin favour only the 'drawing of the thread';

zh: 世与官，宜阳反阴；
应与财，宜阴反阳。
占娶妇多不利。
惟入赘则吉。
yi: 世和官，本宜阳，却反成了阴；
应和财，本宜阴，却反成了阳。
占娶妻，大多不利。
只有入赘就吉。
en: The Self and Pressure should be yang but have become yin;
the Other and Wealth should be yin but have become yang.
In divining the taking of a wife it is mostly unfavourable.
Only marrying into the bride's family is auspicious.

zh: 世与用宜阳反阴，应与财宜阴反阳，占娶妻多为不利，唯入赘最吉。
yi: 世和用神本宜阳却反成阴，应和财本宜阴却反成阳，占娶妻多半不利，只有入赘最吉。
en: The Self and the Subject should be yang but are yin, and the Other and Wealth should be yin but are yang; in divining the taking of a wife it is mostly unfavourable, and only marrying into the bride's family is best.

title: 世合应应合世，终成种玉之缘：世应相合是两愿之象，易成而后吉

rule.yi: 世和应相合、应和世相合，是男女两家都愿意的象，容易成，以后也吉利。
rule.en: The Self and Other combining with each other is the image of both families willing; it is easy to bring about and auspicious later as well.

note.yi: 「种玉之缘」用杨伯雍种玉得妻的典故，指婚姻。
note.en: 'The match that plants jade' alludes to the story of Yang Boyong, who planted jade and won a wife, and stands for a marriage.

zh: 世合应应合世，终成种玉之缘。
yi: 世和应相合，应和世相合，终究能成种玉般的姻缘。
en: The Self combines with the Other and the Other with the Self: in the end a match that plants jade is made.

zh: 世为男家，应为女家。
若得相合，是两愿之象，必主易成，后亦吉利。
yi: 世是男家，应是女家。
如果得到相合，是两家都愿意的象，一定容易成，以后也吉利。
en: The Self is the man's family and the Other the woman's.
If they combine, that is the image of both willing; it will surely be easy to bring about, and auspicious later.

zh: 男家卜，世为男家，应女家，若得相合是两愿之象，必主易成，后亦吉利。
yi: 男家占，世是男家，应是女家，如果得到相合，是两家都愿意的象，一定容易成，以后也吉利。
en: When the man's family divines, the Self is the man's family and the Other the woman's; if they combine, that is the image of both willing, surely easy to bring about and auspicious later.

title: 欲求庚帖，不宜应动应空；若论聘仪，不可世临螣蛇、兄弟

rule.yi: 求庚帖（女方的八字帖），要应爻安静不空、又生合世爻，才一定应允；应爻发动、空亡或冲克世爻，都主不答应。论聘礼，世爻见螣蛇、兄弟，主男家吝啬、礼不多；应爻见它们，主女家妆奁淡薄；旺相发动，也是克妻的兆头。
rule.en: To obtain the horoscope card (the woman's family's eight-character card), the Other line must be quiet, not Void, and must generate or combine with the Self, and then consent is sure; the Other moving, falling Void, or clashing with or controlling the Self all mean refusal. As to betrothal gifts, the Coiling Snake or Peer on the Self line means the man's family is stingy and the gifts few; on the Other line, the woman's dowry is meagre; thriving and moving, it is also a sign of harm to the wife.

note.yi: 「庚帖」是写着生辰八字的帖子，订婚时两家互换；「聘仪」是聘礼。
note.en: 'Geng tie' is the card bearing the birth-hour characters that the two families exchange at betrothal; 'pin yi' is the betrothal gift.

zh: 欲求庚帖，岂宜应动应空；
yi: 想求庚帖，怎么宜应动、应空；
en: To ask for the horoscope card, how can the Other moving or Void be fitting;

hits.text: 欲求庚帖，不宜应动应空

zh: 欲求庚帖，须得应爻安静不空，而又生合世爻者，必然允诺，亦易成。
若应爻发动，或空亡，或冲克世爻，皆主不允，事亦难成，或去亦不遇。
yi: 想求庚帖，须应爻安静不空，而又生合世爻的，才一定应允，也容易成。
如果应爻发动，或空亡，或冲克世爻，都主不答应，事情也难成，或者去了也遇不到人。
en: To obtain the horoscope card, the Other line must be quiet and not Void and must generate or combine with the Self; then consent is sure and it is easy to bring about.
If the Other line moves, falls Void, or clashes with or controls the Self, in every case consent is refused and the matter is hard to bring about, or one goes and does not even meet the person.

zh: 若论聘仪，安可世蛇世弟。
yi: 说到聘礼，怎么可以世上见螣蛇、兄弟。
en: As for betrothal gifts, how can the Self carry the Coiling Snake or Peer.

zh: 螣蛇兄弟，世爻临之，主男家悭吝，礼必不多；
应爻临之，主女家妆奁淡薄。
临旺发动，亦克妻之兆也。
yi: 螣蛇、兄弟，世爻临着，主男家吝啬，礼一定不多；
应爻临着，主女家的妆奁淡薄。
临旺相、发动，也是克妻的兆头。
en: The Coiling Snake or Peer on the Self line means the man's family is stingy and the gifts will not be many;
on the Other line, the woman's family's dowry is meagre.
Thriving and moving, it is also a sign of harm to the wife.

zh: 欲求庚帖，须得应爻安静生合世爻者，必然允许；
若应爻发动，或空或冲，皆主不允。
世临蛇弟，主男家悭吝，礼必不多；
应爻临之，主女家妆淡薄。
如旺动主克妻也。
yi: 想求庚帖，须应爻安静、生合世爻的，才一定应允；
如果应爻发动，或空，或冲，都主不答应。
世上见螣蛇、兄弟，主男家吝啬，礼一定不多；
应爻见它们，主女家妆奁淡薄。
如果旺相发动，主克妻。
en: To obtain the horoscope card, the Other line must be quiet and generate or combine with the Self, and then consent is sure;
if the Other line moves, falls Void or is clashed, in every case consent is refused.
The Coiling Snake or Peer on the Self means the man's family is stingy and the gifts will not be many;
on the Other line, the woman's dowry is meagre.
If thriving and moving, it means harm to the wife.

title: 应生世，悦服成亲；世克应，用强劫娶

rule.yi: 应爻生合世爻，是女家贪图男家，容易成；世刑克应爻，男家不会早来求；世旺应衰，是倚仗富有欺负贫弱、用强抢娶。世上见鬼和螣蛇、财爻旺相、青龙得地，多半是看上了女子的姿色，想设谋娶她；世上见玄武、兄弟，是因为缺钱还债，想谋娶这个女子。
rule.en: The Other line generating or combining with the Self means the woman's family covets the man's and it is easy to bring about; the Self punishing or controlling the Other means the man's family would not have come early to ask; the Self thriving and the Other weak is relying on wealth to bully the poor and taking her by force. With the Self carrying Pressure and the Coiling Snake, Wealth thriving and the Azure Dragon well placed, it is probably because the girl is good-looking and someone means to scheme to marry her; with the Self carrying the Dark Tortoise or Peer, it is because the family lacks money to repay a debt and wants to take the girl in.

zh: 应生世，悦服成亲；
世克应，用强劫娶。
yi: 应生世，(女方)心悦诚服地成亲；
世克应，(男方)倚强抢娶。
en: The Other generating the Self: marriage with willing hearts;
the Self controlling the Other: taking a bride by force.

zh: 应爻生合世爻，主女家贪男家之象，必易成。
不然，是女家先来求亲也。
若世刑克应爻，男家必不早来求其女。
世旺应衰，乃恃富欺贫，用强劫娶也。
若世临鬼及螣蛇，而财爻得时旺相，青龙得地者；
必因其女有姿色，而欲设谋以娶之也。
世临玄武兄弟，必因其家乏财偿债，欲谋纳其女也。
应动或旺，以旺动断。
yi: 应爻生合世爻，主女家贪图男家，一定容易成。
不然，就是女家先来求亲。
如果世刑克应爻，男家一定不会早来求这个女子。
世旺应衰，是倚仗富有欺负贫弱，用强力抢娶。
如果世上见鬼和螣蛇，而财爻得时旺相，青龙得地的；
一定是因为那女子有姿色，而想设计谋娶她。
世上见玄武、兄弟，一定是因为他家缺钱还债，想谋娶这个女子。
应爻发动或旺相，就以旺相发动来断。
en: The Other line generating or combining with the Self means the woman's family covets the man's, and it will surely be easy.
Otherwise, it is the woman's family who came first to ask for the match.
If the Self punishes or controls the Other, the man's family surely would not have come early to ask for this girl.
The Self thriving and the Other weak is relying on wealth to bully the poor, taking her by force.
If the Self carries Pressure and the Coiling Snake while the Wealth line is thriving in season and the Azure Dragon is well placed;
it must be because the girl is good-looking and someone wants to scheme to marry her.
With the Self carrying the Dark Tortoise or Peer, it must be because his family lacks the money to repay a debt and wants to plot to take the girl in.
If the Other moves or thrives, judge by the thriving, moving line.

zh: 应爻生合世爻，主女家贪求其男，则易成；
若世爻生合应爻，主男家贪求其女。
如旺世克衰应，乃恃富欺贫，用强劫娶也。
yi: 应爻生合世爻，主女家贪求那个男子，就容易成；
如果世爻生合应爻，主男家贪求那个女子。
如果旺相的世克衰弱的应，是倚仗富有欺贫，用强抢娶。
en: The Other line generating or combining with the Self means the woman's family covets the man, and it is easy to bring about;
if the Self line generates or combines with the Other, the man's family covets the woman.
If a thriving Self controls a weak Other, it is relying on wealth to bully the poor and taking her by force.

title: 如日合而世应比和，因人成事：世生应男求女、应生世女求男；日辰合爻定谁赞成；间爻动合是媒人

rule.yi: 世生应，是男方求女方；应生世，是女方求男方；相合也一样。世应比和，是两家互相成全。想知是谁赞成，看日辰合到哪一爻；间爻发动、与日辰相合，就是媒人。
rule.en: The Self generating the Other means the man is seeking the woman; the Other generating the Self means the woman is seeking the man; combining is the same. The Self and Other in harmony means the two families are helping each other. To know who approves, see which line the Day combines with; a between line that moves and combines with the Day is the go-between.

zh: 如日合而世应比和，因人成事；
yi: 如果日辰相合、世应比和，是靠别人促成的事；
en: If the Day combines and the Self and Other are in harmony, the matter is made through another person;

hits.text: 如日合而世应比和，因人成事
如日合而世应比和，因人成事

zh: 凡遇世生应，是男求女；
应生世，是女求男；
相合亦然。
若世应比和，乃是两家相成其事。
要知何人赞成，以日辰合爻定之。
间动辰合，则是媒人也。
yi: 凡遇世生应，是男方求女方；
应生世，是女方求男方；
相合也是一样。
如果世应比和，是两家互相成全这件事。
想知道是谁赞成，用日辰合到哪一爻来定。
间爻发动、与日辰相合，就是媒人。
en: When the Self generates the Other, the man is seeking the woman;
when the Other generates the Self, the woman is seeking the man;
combining is the same.
If the Self and Other are in harmony, the two families are helping each other bring it about.
To know who approves, decide by which line the Day combines with.
A moving between line that combines with the Day is the go-between.

zh: 世应比合，得日辰合世应者，或间爻动来合世应者，是赖媒人之力也。
yi: 世应比合，又有日辰合世应，或者间爻发动来合世应的，是靠媒人的力量。
en: With the Self and Other in harmony, and the Day combining with the Self and Other, or a moving between line combining with them, it depends on the go-between's efforts.

title: 若父动而子孙墓绝，为嗣求婚：父旺动、子孙墓绝，子息少；大人占，是无子而娶

rule.yi: 占婚遇到父爻旺相发动，子孙墓绝，日后子息一定少；如果占的是长辈（大人）的婚姻，有这种象，是因为没有儿子而再娶；父爻持身、持世的也一样。
rule.en: In divining marriage, if the Resource line is thriving and moving and Output is in the tomb or cut off, children later will surely be few; if it is an elder's marriage that is divined, this image means he is marrying because he has no son; Resource holding the Body or the Self is the same.

zh: 若父动而子孙墓绝，为嗣求婚。
yi: 如果父母爻发动而子孙墓绝，是为了子嗣而求婚。
en: If Resource moves and Output falls into the tomb or is cut off, the marriage is sought for the sake of an heir.

hits.text: 若父动而子孙墓绝，为嗣求婚
若父动而子孙墓绝，为嗣求婚

zh: 占婚，遇父旺动，子孙若墓绝，异日子息必少。
若卜大人婚姻，有此象，乃为无子而娶也。
父持身世者亦然。
yi: 占婚姻，遇到父爻旺相发动，子孙如果墓绝，日后子息一定少。
如果占的是长辈的婚姻，有这种象，是因为没有儿子而娶。
父爻持身、持世的也一样。
en: In divining marriage, if Resource is thriving and moving and Output is in the tomb or cut off, children later will surely be few.
If it is an elder's marriage that is divined, this image means he is marrying because he has no son.
Resource holding the Body or the Self is the same.

zh: 若因无子而娶，遇父旺动或子孙墓绝，主无子息，父持身世者亦然。
yi: 如果是因为没有儿子而娶，遇到父爻旺相发动，或者子孙墓绝，主没有子息；父爻持身、持世的也是这样。
en: If one marries for lack of a son, meeting Resource thriving and moving, or Output in the tomb, means there will be no offspring; Resource holding the Body or the Self is the same.

title: 财官动合，先私而后公：财官两爻动合，先通后娶；临玄武眉目传情未通；财与旁爻合，与他人有情

rule.yi: 以官为丈夫、财为妻子；两爻都动而相合，一定是先私通后成婚；遇冲克，外人已经知道；临玄武，只是眉来眼去、还没有通情意；本人自占，财和世爻动而相合，也是这样；财爻与旁爻相合，是与别人有情；财遇合多、又化出子孙，一定是妓家出身，因为化子孙有从良的象。
rule.en: Take Pressure as the husband and Wealth as the wife; if both lines move and combine, they were surely intimate in secret before they married; if a clash or control meets them, outsiders already know; on the Dark Tortoise, it is only glances and looks and feelings have not yet been exchanged; when one divines for oneself, Wealth and the Self line moving and combining is the same; if the Wealth line combines with another line, she has feelings for someone else; Wealth meeting many combinations and turning into Output means she is surely from a brothel, since turning into Output carries the image of leaving that life to marry.

note.yi: 旧注把「财官」读作男女两方（官为夫，财为妇）；这一条只对男占女、女占男这一类占法成立，用神照占者身份定，见 HJC.45。
note.en: The old commentary reads 'Wealth and Pressure' as the two parties (Pressure the husband, Wealth the wife); this holds only for the ordinary man-divining-woman or woman-divining-man question, and the Subject is fixed by who divines, as HJC.45 says.

zh: 财官动合，先私而后公；
yi: 财官两爻动而相合，先是私通、后是公开成婚；
en: Wealth and Pressure moving and combining: first in secret, then openly married;

zh: 凡婚。
以官为夫，财为妇。
两爻俱动相合，必是先通后娶。
若遇冲克，外人已知。
若临玄武，则眼去眉来，未通情意。
本人自占，而财与世爻动合者，亦然。
财爻若与旁爻作合，与他人有情。
财遇合多，而化出子孙，必是妓家。
盖化子有从良之象也。
yi: 凡是婚姻，
以官为丈夫，以财为妻子。
两爻都动而相合，一定是先私通、后成婚。
如果遇到冲克，外人已经知道了。
如果临玄武，只是眉来眼去，还没有通情意。
本人自己占，而财和世爻动而相合的，也是这样。
财爻如果与旁边的爻相合，是与别人有情。
财遇到相合多的，又化出子孙，一定是妓家。
因为化出子孙有从良的象。
en: In any marriage,
take Pressure as the husband and Wealth as the wife.
If both lines move and combine, they were surely intimate in secret first and married after.
If a clash or control meets them, outsiders already know.
If it sits on the Dark Tortoise, it is only glances and looks, and feelings have not yet been exchanged.
When the person divines for himself and Wealth and the Self line move and combine, it is the same.
If the Wealth line combines with another line, she has feelings for someone else.
If Wealth meets many combinations and turns into Output, she is surely from a brothel.
since turning into Output carries the image of leaving that life to marry.

zh: 夫占以财为妇，世与动合，是必先通而后娶，财与世爻动合亦然。
财爻动与旁爻合，与他人有情，财遇合多亦然。
yi: 男子占，以财为妻子，世和它动而相合，一定是先私通后娶，财和世爻动而相合也是这样。
财爻动而与旁边的爻相合，是与别人有情，财遇到相合多的也是这样。
en: A man divining takes Wealth as the wife; if the Self combines with it by moving, they were intimate in secret before marrying, and the same if Wealth and the Self line combine by moving.
If the Wealth line moves and combines with another line, she has feelings for someone else, and the same if Wealth meets many combinations.

title: 世应化空，始成而终悔：世动生合应、应动生合世皆易成，怕变入空亡；日辰动爻扶助则悔而可成

rule.yi: 世动生合应爻，男家愿成；应动生合世爻，女家愿嫁；都是容易成的象；只怕变入空亡，一定有退悔的意思；如果有日辰、动爻扶助，虽悔也可成。
rule.en: The Self moving to generate or combine with the Other means the man's family is willing; the Other moving to generate or combine with the Self means the woman's family is willing to give her; both are images of easy success; only turning into Void is feared, which means a wish to withdraw and regret; if the Day or a moving line supports it, it can still succeed despite regret.

zh: 世应化空，始成而终悔。
yi: 世应变成空亡，开始成了，最终反悔。
en: The Self and Other turning into Void: it succeeds at first and ends in regret.

zh: 世动，生合应爻，男家愿成其婚；
应动，生合世爻，妇家愿妻其女；
皆易成之象。
但怕变入空亡，必有退悔之意。
若得日辰动爻扶助，虽悔，亦可成也。
yi: 世动，生合应爻，男家愿意成这门亲事；
应动，生合世爻，女家愿意把女儿嫁给他；
都是容易成的象。
但怕变入空亡，一定有退悔的意思。
如果有日辰、动爻扶助，即使反悔，也可以成。
en: If the Self moves and generates or combines with the Other, the man's family is willing to make the match;
if the Other moves and generates or combines with the Self, the woman's family is willing to give her daughter;
both are images of easy success.
But if it turns into Void, there will surely be a wish to withdraw and regret.
If the Day or a moving line supports it, then even with regret it can still succeed.

zh: 世动生合应爻，男家愿成，应动生合世爻，女家愿嫁，皆易成之象，但怕变入空空亡，必有退悔之意也。
yi: 世动生合应爻，男家愿意成；应动生合世爻，女家愿意嫁；都是容易成的象，只怕变入空亡，一定有退悔的意思。
en: The Self moving to generate or combine with the Other, the man's family is willing; the Other moving to generate or combine with the Self, the woman's family is willing to marry her off; both are images of easy success, only turning into Void is feared, which means a wish to withdraw and regret.

title: 六合而动象刑伤，必多破阻；世冲而日辰扶助，当有吹嘘：动爻日辰冲克则有人破阻、生合则有人吹嘘

rule.yi: 世应相生相合本是吉兆，但遇动爻、日辰冲克，两边必有人说坏话，事难成；世应相冲相克本不吉，但遇动爻、日辰生合，两边必有人说好话，也可成；想知道是谁，按五类推，比如父母爻是叔伯尊长一类，外宫、他卦上的是外人。
rule.en: The Self and Other generating and combining is by nature an auspicious sign, but if a moving line or the Day clashes or controls it, there will be people on both sides speaking against it and the matter is hard to bring about; the Self and Other clashing or controlling each other is by nature not auspicious, but if a moving line or the Day generates or combines with them, there will be people on both sides speaking well of it and it can succeed; to know who they are, judge by the five kinds: the Resource line is the uncles and elders, and lines in the outer palace or another trigram are outsiders.

zh: 六合而动象刑伤，必多破阻；
世冲而日辰扶助，当有吹嘘。
yi: 六合而又有动爻刑伤它，一定多有破坏阻隔；
世冲而有日辰扶助，就会有人吹嘘（说好话）。
en: A Six-Combine hexagram with a moving line punishing or harming it is sure to meet many breakages and obstacles;
the Self clashed but supported by the Day will have someone speaking up for it.

zh: 世爻与应生合，本主吉兆；
若遇动爻日辰冲克，必两边有破说，其事难成。
世应冲克，本非吉兆；
若遇动爻日辰生合，两边必有吹嘘，亦可成。
要知吹嘘破阻之人，依五类推之。
如父母，为叔伯尊长类。
外宫他卦，以外人言。
yi: 世爻与应爻相生相合，本来主吉兆；
如果遇到动爻、日辰冲克，一定两边有人拆台说坏话，这件事难成。
世应相冲相克，本来不是吉兆；
如果遇到动爻、日辰生合，两边必有人吹嘘，也可以成。
想知道吹嘘的人、破阻的人是谁，依五类来推。
比如父母爻，是叔伯尊长一类。
外宫、他卦上的，指外人。
en: The Self line and the Other line generating and combining is by nature an auspicious sign;
if a moving line or the Day clashes or controls it, there will surely be people on both sides speaking against it, and the matter is hard to bring about.
The Self and Other clashing or controlling each other is by nature not auspicious;
if a moving line or the Day generates or combines with them, there will surely be people on both sides speaking well of it, and it can succeed.
To know who is speaking up or obstructing, judge by the five kinds.
For example, the Resource line is the uncles, aunts and elders.
Those on the outer palace or another trigram mean outsiders.

zh: 世应逢生主吉，若遇动爻日辰冲克，两边必有阻隔难成。
世应冲克本凶，若遇动爻日辰生合两边，必有吹嘘可成。
要知吹嘘破破阻之人，依五类推之，如父母为伯叔尊长类；
外宫他卦以外人而言。
yi: 世应逢生主吉，如果遇到动爻、日辰冲克，两边必有阻隔难成。
世应冲克本来凶，如果遇到动爻、日辰生合两边，必有人吹嘘，可以成。
想知道吹嘘、破阻的人，依五类来推，比如父母爻是伯叔尊长一类；
外宫、他卦上的，指外人。
en: The Self and Other meeting generation is auspicious, but if a moving line or the Day clashes or controls them, there will be obstruction on both sides and it is hard to bring about.

The Self and Other clashing or controlling each other is by nature ominous, but if a moving line or the Day generates or combines with both sides, there will be people speaking well of it and it can succeed.
To know who speaks well of it or obstructs it, judge by the five kinds; for example the Resource line is the uncles and elders;
those on the outer palace or another trigram mean outsiders.

title: 鬼克飞爻，果信绿窗之难嫁；官合财位，方知绮席之易婚：女占男，鬼刑克世、应克世皆不成；官生合世或合财、应生合世则易成

rule.yi: 女方占男方，最不宜鬼爻刑克世爻，也不宜应爻克世，都主不成，男家不愿结婚；如果他有制约、我有扶助、大象又吉，也可成，但他家终究无意；若得官爻生合世爻，或合财爻，或应爻生合世爻，才主容易成。
rule.en: When the woman's side divines about the man, the most unfavourable thing is a Pressure line punishing or controlling the Self line, and also the Other line controlling the Self; both mean it will not succeed and the man's family is unwilling; if he is restrained, I am supported and the overall image is auspicious, it can still succeed, though his family in the end has no intention; if Pressure generates or combines with the Self line, or combines with the Wealth line, or the Other generates or combines with the Self, then it is easy to bring about.

dispute.yi: 王洪绪引的经文与《卜筮全书》不同：他写作「鬼克世爻」「用合身位」，全书作「鬼克飞爻」「官合财位」；王洪绪的注按用神（谁占看谁）讲，旧注按女占男讲。
dispute.en: Wang Hongxu's text of the verse differs from the Bushi Quanshu's: he writes 'Pressure controlling the Self line' and 'the Subject combining with the Body place', where the Quanshu has 'the flying line' and 'the Wealth place'; his note speaks by the Subject (whoever is the object of the question), and the old commentary by a woman divining about a man.

zh: 鬼克飞爻，果信绿窗之难嫁；
官合财位，方知绮席之易婚。
yi: 鬼克飞爻（世爻），果然相信闺中女子难嫁；
官爻合财位，才知道绮席上的婚事容易成。
en: Pressure controlling the flying line: one really believes the girl behind the green window is hard to marry off;
Pressure combining with the Wealth place: only then does one know the match at the fine banquet is easy to make.

zh: 飞爻即世爻。
大凡女占男，最不宜鬼爻刑克世爻，亦不宜应爻克世，皆主不成。
盖女占男，以世为女家，应为男家，故也。
如遇此象，主男家不愿为婚，所以难嫁。
若他有制，我有扶，而大象又吉，亦可成。
然其家终是无意于我也。
若得官生合世爻，或合财爻，或应爻生合世，方主易成。
yi: 飞爻就是世爻。
大凡女方占男方，最不宜鬼爻刑克世爻，也不宜应爻克世，都主不成。
因为女方占男方，以世为女家、应为男家的缘故。
遇到这种象，主男家不愿意结婚，所以难嫁。
如果他有制约，我有扶助，而大象又吉，也可以成。
然而他家终究对我们没有意思。
如果得官爻生合世爻，或者合财爻，或者应爻生合世爻，才主容易成。
en: The flying line is the Self line.

In general, when the woman's side divines about the man, what is most unfavourable is a Pressure line punishing or controlling the Self line, and also the Other line controlling the Self, both meaning it will not succeed.
This is because, in a woman's divining about a man, the Self is the woman's family and the Other the man's.
When this image appears, the man's family is unwilling to marry, hence she is hard to marry off.
If he is restrained and I am supported and the overall image is auspicious, it can still succeed.
But his family in the end has no intention toward me.
If Pressure generates or combines with the Self line, or combines with the Wealth line, or the Other generates or combines with the Self, then it is easy to bring about.

zh: 如鬼煞克世，不独不愿为婚，更防祸殃。
如用神用合世位，不但易成，后必恩爱。
yi: 如果鬼煞克世，不但不愿结婚，还要防灾祸。
如果用神生合世位，不但容易成，以后一定恩爱。
en: If a baleful Pressure controls the Self, not only is there unwillingness to marry but also calamity is to be guarded against.
If the Subject generates or combines with the Self place, it is not only easy to bring about but later there will surely be affection.

title: 财鬼如无刑害，夫妻定主和谐

rule.yi: 财、鬼受刑冲克害，夫妻必然不和睦；没有这种象，才能如鱼得水，到老和谐。
rule.en: Wealth and Pressure punished, clashed, controlled or harmed means the couple will surely not be at peace; without this image they are like fish in water and are in harmony into old age.

zh: 财鬼如无刑害，夫妻定主和谐；
yi: 财、鬼如果没有刑害，夫妻一定和谐；
en: If Wealth and Pressure suffer no punishment or harm, the couple will surely be in harmony;

title: 文书若动当权，子嗣必然萧索：父母旺动克子孙；子孙旬空反可得子，不空受伤则无子息

rule.yi: 父母爻当权发动，子孙躲在空亡里，是事情还没定；如果子孙不空，而是死绝无气，就被父母克，日后一定克子，没有子息。
rule.en: If the Resource line holds power and moves while Output hides in the Void, the matter is not yet settled; if Output is not Void but dead, cut off and without qi, it is controlled by Resource, and later the children will surely be harmed, leaving no offspring.

zh: 文书若动当权，子嗣必然萧索。
yi: 文书爻如果发动当权，子嗣一定稀少冷落。
en: If the document line moves and holds power, offspring will surely be few and lonely.

en: If the Resource line holds power and moves while Output hides in a Void place, the matter is not yet settled.
If it is not Void but dead, cut off and without qi, it is controlled by Resource, and later the children will surely be harmed.

zh: 父母旺动，子孙旬空反可得子，至子孙出空之年亦难免克；
若不空现受其伤，主无子息。
yi: 父母爻旺相发动，子孙旬空反而可以得子，到子孙出空的那一年也难免被克；
如果不空、现身而受伤，主没有子息。
en: With Resource thriving and moving, Output in the ten-day Void can on the contrary have a child, though in the year Output leaves the Void it will still inevitably be controlled;
if it is not Void but shows and is harmed, there will be no offspring.

title: 若在一宫，当有通家之好；若加三合，曾叨会面之亲：世应生合比和、财鬼同宫是亲上亲；带三合则曾见过面

rule.yi: 世应相生相合或比和，财、鬼又在同一宫，是亲上加亲；不带三合，虽是亲戚也不相识；带三合，一定是见过面的。
rule.en: The Self and Other generating, combining or in harmony, with Wealth and Pressure also in one palace, is kin upon kin; without a three-harmony frame they are relatives who do not know each other, and with one they have surely met.

note.yi: 「本宫至亲，他宫外亲」等分法见 HJC.34。
note.en: The division into 'nearest kin of the home palace' and 'outside kin of another palace' is in HJC.34.

zh: 若在一宫，当有通家之好；
若加三合，曾叨会面之亲。
yi: 如果在同一宫，该有世交的情谊；
如果再加三合，是曾经见过面的亲戚。
en: If they are in one palace, there should be a friendship between families;
if a three-harmony frame is added, they are relatives who have met.

en: The Self and Other generating, combining or in harmony, with Wealth and Pressure also in one palace, is kin upon kin.

with a three-harmony frame they have surely met.

en: The Self and Other generating, combining or in harmony, with Wealth and Pressure also in one palace, is kin upon kin.
Without a three-harmony frame, though kin they have not made acquaintance; with one, they have surely met.

title: 如逢财鬼空亡，乃婚姻之大忌；苟遇阴阳得位，实天命之所关：男占女用财、女占男用鬼，用神无损害为要，空亡不可执法推

rule.yi: 财、鬼两爻是占婚姻的用神，逢空亡本不吉，但不可死守：男占女以财为主，鬼空不妨；女占男以鬼为主，财空不妨；要紧的是用神没有损害。财鬼空亡而干支相合、世应相生、阴阳得位，是真姻缘，只是半辈子同床、不能白头到老，那是天命，不是刑克；逢冲遇克叫避空，反而不用担心。长辈占子侄、兄占弟，就看子孙爻、兄弟爻，不能一律用财官。
rule.en: The Wealth and Pressure lines are the Subject in a marriage divination and Void on them is by nature unlucky, but it must not be followed rigidly: when a man divines about a woman Wealth is the main thing and Pressure Void does no harm; when a woman divines about a man Pressure is the main thing and Wealth Void does no harm; what matters is that the Subject is undamaged. If Wealth and Pressure are Void but the stems and branches combine, the Self and Other generate each other and yin and yang are in their places, it is a real marriage bond, only that they share a pillow for half a lifetime and do not grow old together, which is decreed by Heaven and not the work of punishment or control; meeting a clash or control is called escaping the Void and there is on the contrary nothing to fear. When elders divine for a son or nephew, or an elder brother for a younger, look at the Output line or the Peer line, and do not always use Wealth and Pressure.

note.yi: 「衾枕虚设」是名义夫妻、聚少离多的意思；「避空」的说法见 HJC.03（求财）。「财空妻失，鬼空夫亡」是《天玄赋》的话，旧注和王洪绪都说不可死守。
note.en: 'An empty bed' means a couple in name only who are often apart. 'Escaping the Void' is discussed at the wealth entry HJC.03. 'Wealth Void, the wife is lost; Pressure Void, the husband dies' is from the Tianxuan Fu, and both the old commentary and Wang Hongxu say it must not be followed rigidly.

zh: 如逢财鬼空亡，乃婚姻之大忌；
苟遇阴阳得位，实天命之所关。
yi: 如果遇到财、鬼空亡，是婚姻的大忌；
如果遇到阴阳得位，实在是天命所关。
en: Meeting Void on Wealth and Pressure is a great taboo for marriage;
meeting yin and yang in their places is truly a matter of the decree of Heaven.

若值空亡，必不吉利。
《天玄赋》曰：财空妻失，鬼空夫亡。
然不可执法推。

要在用神无损害耳。
若财鬼空亡，而干支相合，世应相生，阴阳得位者，此实姻缘；
不过半世衾枕，不能偕老；
非夫妻刑克，故也。
乃天命所在耳。
逢冲遇克谓避空，反不虑。
但主其一生该虚设衾枕，或半生在外仕宦工商之类。
yi: 财、鬼两爻，是占婚姻的用神。
如果遇到空亡，必定不吉利。
《天玄赋》说：财空妻失，鬼空夫亡。
然而不可死守这个办法去推。
因为男占女，以财为主，鬼空不妨；
女子占男子，以鬼为主，财空也无妨。
要紧的是用神没有损害罢了。
如果财、鬼空亡，而干支相合，世应相生，阴阳得位，这是实实在在的姻缘；
只不过半辈子同床共枕，不能白头到老；
并不是夫妻刑克的缘故，
是天命所在罢了。
逢冲遇克叫避空，反而不用忧虑。
只是主他一生该有虚设的衾枕，或者半辈子在外做官、经商之类。
en: The Wealth and Pressure lines are the Subject in divining marriage.
If they meet Void, it is surely unlucky.
The Tianxuan Fu says: Wealth Void, the wife is lost; Pressure Void, the husband dies.
But one must not judge by this rule rigidly.
For a man divining about a woman takes Wealth as the main thing, and Pressure being Void does no harm;
a woman divining about a man takes Pressure as the main thing, and Wealth being Void does no harm.
What matters is only that the Subject is not damaged.
If Wealth and Pressure are Void but the stems and branches combine, the Self and Other generate each other and yin and yang are in their places, this is a real marriage bond;
only that they share a pillow for half a lifetime and cannot grow old together;
and not because husband and wife punish or harm each other,
but simply where Heaven's decree lies.
Meeting a clash or control is called escaping the Void, and on the contrary there is nothing to worry about.
It only means his life is fated to have an empty bed, or that for half his life he is away from home in office or trade.

zh: 夫卜女以财爻，女卜夫以鬼爻，为卜婚姻之用神也，若值空亡，必不吉利，然不可执法推。
财空妻失，鬼空夫亡，盖男占女以财为主，鬼空不妨，女占男以鬼为主，财空不妨。
如父母伯叔卜子侄女婚姻，必看子孙爻何如；
若兄占弟婚，必看兄弟，爻遇吉则吉，逢凶则凶。
当从用神断，不可一概而言之也。
yi: 男子占女子用财爻，女子占男子用鬼爻，是占婚姻的用神，如果遇到空亡，必定不吉利，然而不可死守这个办法去推。
财空妻失，鬼空夫亡，是说男占女以财为主，鬼空不妨，女占男以鬼为主，财空不妨。
如果父母、伯叔占子侄的婚姻，必须看子孙爻怎么样；
如果哥哥占弟弟的婚姻，必须看兄弟爻，爻遇吉就吉，遇凶就凶。
应当按用神来断，不可一概而论。
en: A man divining about a woman uses the Wealth line and a woman divining about a man uses the Pressure line as the Subject of a marriage divination; if it meets Void it is surely unlucky, but one must not judge by this rule rigidly.

'Wealth Void, the wife is lost; Pressure Void, the husband dies' means that a man divining about a woman takes Wealth as the main thing and Pressure Void does no harm, and a woman divining about a man takes Pressure as the main thing and Wealth Void does no harm.
If parents (the Resource) or uncles divine the marriage of a son, daughter or nephew, they must look at how the Output line stands;
if an elder brother divines a younger brother's marriage he must look at the Peer line: meeting good it is good, meeting ill it is ill.
Judge by the Subject and do not speak of all cases alike.

title: 应财世鬼，终须夫唱妇随；应鬼世财，不免夫权妻夺：世持鬼应持财是阴阳得位，反之夫权被夺，惟赘婿反吉

rule.yi: 世持鬼、应持财，是阴阳得位，丈夫掌男权、妻子守妇道，夫唱妇随；应持鬼、世持财，是阴阳失位，丈夫的权被妻子夺去，只有入赘的女婿反而吉。
rule.en: The Self holding Pressure and the Other holding Wealth is yin and yang in their places, with the husband holding the man's authority and the wife keeping to her place, he leading and she following; the Other holding Pressure and the Self holding Wealth is yin and yang out of place, with the husband's authority seized by the wife, and only a son-in-law who marries into the wife's family finds it favourable.

zh: 应财世鬼，终须夫唱妇随；
应鬼世财，不免夫权妻夺。
yi: 应持财、世持鬼，终究会夫唱妇随；
应持鬼、世持财，免不了丈夫的权被妻子夺去。
en: With the Other holding Wealth and the Self holding Pressure, in the end the husband leads and the wife follows;
with the Other holding Pressure and the Self holding Wealth, the husband's authority will inevitably be seized by the wife.

zh: 世持鬼，应持财，此乃阴阳得位之象。

定能夫唱于前，妇随于后。
若应持鬼，世持财，此同阴阳失位之象。
必然夫权妻夺，牝鸡晨鸣；
惟赘婿反吉。
yi: 世持鬼，应持财，这是阴阳得位的象。
必然丈夫掌男人的权，妻子守妇道；
一定能丈夫在前倡导，妻子在后跟随。
如果应持鬼，世持财，这同是阴阳失位的象。
必然丈夫的权被妻子夺去，如同母鸡打鸣；
只有入赘的女婿反而吉。
en: The Self holding Pressure and the Other holding Wealth is the image of yin and yang in their places.
The husband will surely hold the man's authority and the wife keep to a wife's way;
he will surely lead in front and she follow behind.
If the Other holds Pressure and the Self holds Wealth, this is likewise the image of yin and yang out of place.
The husband's authority will surely be seized by the wife, like a hen crowing at dawn;
only a son-in-law who marries into the wife's family finds it on the contrary favourable.

zh: 世持鬼应持财，如男自占是阴阳得位之象，必然夫秉男权，妻操妇道，能夫唱于前，妇随于后。
若应持鬼世持财，是阴阳失位也，必然夫权妻夺，唯赘婿反吉。
yi: 世持鬼、应持财，如果是男子自己占，是阴阳得位的象，必然丈夫掌男权，妻子守妇道，能够夫唱于前，妇随于后。
如果应持鬼、世持财，是阴阳失位，必然丈夫的权被妻子夺去，只有入赘的女婿反而吉。
en: The Self holding Pressure and the Other holding Wealth, when a man divines for himself, is the image of yin and yang in their places: the husband will hold the man's authority and the wife keep to a wife's way, he leading in front and she following behind.

If the Other holds Pressure and the Self holds Wealth, yin and yang are out of place, and the husband's authority will surely be seized by the wife; only a son-in-law who marries into her family finds it favourable.

title: 妯娌不和，只为官爻发动；翁姑不睦，定因妻位交重：官动克兄弟则妯娌不和，财动克父母则公婆不睦

rule.yi: 占婚以兄弟为妯娌、父母为公婆；官动克兄弟，妯娌之间不利；财动克父母，公婆不和睦；如果旺相而没有制约，或父爻衰弱抵挡不住，双亲就有刑克。觉子反驳：财旺时同样克父母，不必等到动才说。
rule.en: In divining marriage Peer stands for the brothers' wives and Resource for the parents-in-law; Pressure moving controls Peer and is unfavourable among the brothers' wives; Wealth moving controls Resource and the parents-in-law are at odds; if it is thriving with no restraint, or Resource is weak and cannot resist, the parents suffer punishment and control. Juezi objects that a thriving Wealth harms Resource just the same, and one need not wait for it to move.

dispute.yi: 《黄金策》旧注和王洪绪都说「财动克父母」；觉子（《增删卜易》）认为伤父母的是财旺，不必等到动，前人只说动是为了避免被驳；他的办法是先占财官旺不旺，得吉卦后再单占妨不妨克父母。
dispute.en: The old commentary and Wang Hongxu both say 'Wealth moving controls Resource'; Juezi (Zengshan Buyi) holds that what harms the parents is Wealth being thriving, with no need to wait for it to move, and that the ancients spoke of moving only to avoid being challenged; his method is to divine first whether Wealth and Pressure are thriving and, having got a good hexagram, to divine separately whether the parents will be harmed.

zh: 妯娌不和，只为官爻发动；
翁姑不睦，定因妻位交重。

公婆不睦，一定是因为妻位（财爻）交重。
en: The brothers' wives are at odds only because the Pressure line moves;
the parents-in-law are at odds surely because the wife's place, the Wealth line, is doubled.
