If a Pressure line moves in the hexagram it controls Peer;
among the brothers' wives it is surely unfavourable.
If a Wealth line moves it controls Resource;
it surely means the parents-in-law are at odds.
If it is thriving and not harmed or controlled, the matter will go back and forth;
if the Resource line is weak and cannot resist, the parents suffer punishment and control.

zh: 夫占婚以兄为妯娌，父为翁姑。
卦有官动则克兄弟，主妯娌不和，有财动则克父母，主公姑不睦。
若旺而无制，父爻衰弱不能敌，与亲有刑克也矣。
yi: 丈夫占婚，以兄弟为妯娌，以父母为公婆。
卦里有官爻发动就克兄弟，主妯娌不和；有财爻发动就克父母，主公婆不睦。
如果旺相而没有制约，父爻衰弱抵挡不住，双亲就有刑克。
en: In a husband's divination of marriage, Peer stands for the brothers' wives and Resource for the parents-in-law.
A moving Pressure line controls Peer and means the brothers' wives are at odds; a moving Wealth line controls Resource and means the parents-in-law are at odds.
If it is thriving without restraint, and the Resource line is weak and cannot resist, the parents suffer punishment and control.

zh: 或曰：《黄金策》云：翁姑不睦，皆因妻位交重；
《海底眼》云：财动丧双亲；
《易冒》亦云：妻财动，父母参商。
俱以财动则伤克父母，未说旺也。
余曰：动则能伤父母，旺则不能伤乎？
假令春天占卦，财爻属木，谓之女命旺而可取，但父母爻定然属土，如此当权得令之财爻，有不克休囚之父母爻者乎？
何必曰动？
殊不知昔人言动而不言旺者，正虑后人驳议，故讳言其旺，不得已而言动也，岂知亦被看破耶？
yi: 有人说：《黄金策》讲：公婆不睦，都是因为妻位交重；
《海底眼》讲：财动，丧双亲；
《易冒》也讲：妻财动，父母不和。
都是说财动就伤克父母，没有说旺。
我说：动就能伤父母，旺就不能伤吗？
假如春天占卦，财爻属木，叫作女命旺而可取，但父母爻一定属土，这样当权得令的财爻，有不克衰弱的父母爻的吗？
何必说动？
殊不知前人说动而不说旺，正是担心后人驳议，所以不肯说它旺，不得已才说动，哪知也被看破了呢？
en: Someone says: the Huangjin Ce says the parents-in-law are at odds always because the wife's place is doubled;
the Haidi Yan says that Wealth moving means the loss of both parents;
the Yi Mao also says that Wealth moving means Resource, the parents, disagree.
all say that Wealth moving harms and controls Resource, the parents, and none says thriving.
I say: if moving can harm Resource, the parents, can thriving not harm them?

Suppose the divination is in spring and the Wealth line is Wood, called a woman whose fate is strong and worth taking; but the Resource line is surely Earth, and can a Wealth line thus holding power and in season fail to control a weak Resource line?
Why say only moving?

Little do people know that the ancients said moving and not thriving precisely for fear of later objections, and avoided saying thriving and said moving because they had to; who would have thought this too would be seen through?

title: 父合财爻，异日有新台之行；世临妻位，他时无就养之心：财父二爻带玄武动合，有翁淫子媳之事；财临世身，妇不善事公婆

rule.yi: 占婚遇到财、父两爻，世带玄武，动而相合的，日后有公公与儿媳私通的事；如果财临世身，那个妇人一定不善于侍奉公婆。
rule.en: In divining marriage, when the Wealth and Resource lines with the Self carrying the Dark Tortoise move and combine, there will later be an affair between the father-in-law and his son's wife; if Wealth sits on the Self or the Body, the woman will surely not serve her parents-in-law well.

note.yi: 「新台」出自《诗经·邶风·新台》，讲卫宣公在河上筑新台，夺了儿子的新娘；旧注把它直接解作「翁淫子媳」。
note.en: 'The New Terrace' is from the Book of Odes (Bei Feng, 'Xin Tai'), about Duke Xuan of Wei building a new terrace on the river and seizing his son's bride; the old commentary reads it directly as a father-in-law's affair with his son's wife.

zh: 父合财爻，异日有新台之行；
世临妻位，他时无就养之心。
yi: 父爻合财爻，日后有像「新台」那样的丑行；
世临妻位，将来没有就养（奉养公婆）的心。
en: The Resource line combining with the Wealth line: later there will be conduct like that of the New Terrace;
the Self sitting on the wife's place: in time she will have no heart to support her parents-in-law.

title: 空鬼伏财，必是望门之寡妇；动财值虎，定然带服之婆娘：财伏空鬼之下，其女先曾受聘、未婚夫死；加白虎动，是已嫁夫亡带孝

rule.yi: 卦里有官、财两爻，而财爻伏在空亡的鬼爻下，那个女子先前受过聘，未婚夫死了，俗称望门寡；再加白虎发动来克，就是嫁了以后丈夫死、带着孝服的；如果伏在不空的鬼下，是有丈夫的妇人，被日辰、动爻提起而刑克世爻，日后要防争讼。
rule.en: If the hexagram has both Pressure and Wealth lines and the Wealth line is hidden under a Void Pressure line, the woman was once betrothed and her fiancé died, commonly called a widow at the door; with the White Tiger moving and controlling as well, she married and her husband died and she wears mourning; if she is hidden under a Pressure line that is not Void, she is a woman with a husband, and if the Day or a moving line raises her and it punishes or controls the Self line, guard later against a lawsuit.

note.yi: 第三个「伏」的方向，旧注写「若伏鬼不空」（财伏在鬼下，鬼不空），王洪绪写「鬼伏财下不空」（鬼伏在财下），字面相反；两处都是说有夫之妇，本库照原文。
note.en: On the third case, the old commentary writes 'if hidden under Pressure that is not Void' (Wealth under Pressure) and Wang Hongxu 'Pressure hidden under Wealth, not Void' (Pressure under Wealth); the wording is opposite, though both mean a married woman, and the original is kept.

zh: 空鬼伏财，必是望门之寡妇；
动财值虎，定然带服之婆娘。
yi: 空鬼伏着财，一定是「望门寡」；
财动而值白虎，一定是带着孝服的妇人。
en: Void Pressure with Wealth hidden under it: surely a widow before the wedding;
Wealth moving and on the White Tiger: surely a woman wearing mourning.

the woman was once betrothed and her fiancé died, commonly called a widow at the door;
if the White Tiger is added, moving to control, she married and her husband died and she surely wears mourning;

if she is hidden under a Pressure line that is not Void, she is surely a woman with a husband, and if the Day or a moving line raises her and it punishes or controls the Self line, guard later against a lawsuit.

zh: 卦中财爻伏于空鬼之下，其女先曾受聘，未婚夫死，俗谓之望门寡。
若加白虎发动，则已嫁而夫死带孝。
若鬼伏财下不空者，必是有夫妇女。
如被日辰动爻提起刑克世爻者，后防争讼。
yi: 卦中财爻伏在空亡的鬼下，那个女子先前受过聘，未婚夫死了，俗称望门寡。
如果再加白虎发动，就是已经嫁了、丈夫死了，带着孝服。
如果鬼伏在财下而鬼不空，一定是有丈夫的妇女。
如果被日辰、动爻提起，刑克世爻，日后要防争讼。
en: If the Wealth line is hidden under a Void Pressure line, the woman was once betrothed and her fiancé died, commonly called a widow at the door.
If the White Tiger is added and moves, she married and her husband died and she wears mourning.
If Pressure is hidden under Wealth and is not Void, she is surely a woman with a husband.
If the Day or a moving line raises her and it punishes or controls the Self line, guard later against a lawsuit.

title: 世应俱空，难遂百年之连理：世空自己不想成，应空对方不想成

rule.yi: 世空，是自己不想成；强行成了，终究不如意；应空，是对方不想成；成了以后两家一定不来往。
rule.en: The Self Void means one does not wish it oneself, and if forced through it never turns out as wished; the Other Void means the other side does not wish it, and if it comes about the two families will surely not visit each other afterwards.

en: With the Self and Other both Void, it is hard to achieve a lifelong union as wished.

title: 财官叠见，重为一度之新人：男占女卦有两财、女占男卦有两鬼，是再娶再嫁

rule.yi: 男占女，卦里有两个财；女占男，卦里有两个鬼；一定是再娶再嫁。两个财都没有损伤，一正一偏；一个旺一个空，前妻已死；两鬼发动，有两家争娶；一旺一空，前夫已死；鬼伏财下，男方家里有妻；财伏鬼下，女方有夫；鬼不空而被动爻日辰冲克妻财，是生离改嫁；世克鬼而动爻日辰生合妻财，是逐婿嫁女。
rule.en: A man divining about a woman with two Wealth lines in the hexagram, or a woman divining about a man with two Pressure lines, means a remarriage; two Wealth lines both unharmed are one principal and one secondary; one thriving and one Void means the former wife has died; two Pressure lines moving means two families contending to marry her; one thriving and one Void, the former husband has died; Pressure hidden under Wealth means the man has a wife at home; Wealth hidden under Pressure means the woman has a husband; Pressure not Void while a moving line or the Day clashes with or controls Wealth means a living separation and remarriage; the Self controlling Pressure while a moving line or the Day generates or combines with Wealth means driving out the son-in-law and marrying off the daughter.

note.yi: 这一条的前提是「男占女看财、女占男看鬼」；另一方向的伏（鬼伏财下、财伏鬼下），旧注和王洪绪的说法正好相反：旧注是鬼伏财下男有妻、财伏鬼下女有夫，王洪绪是财伏鬼下男有妻、鬼伏财下女有夫。
note.en: The premise is 'a man divining about a woman looks to Wealth, a woman divining about a man looks to Pressure'. On the direction of hiding, the old commentary and Wang Hongxu are opposite: the old commentary says Pressure hidden under Wealth means the man has a wife and Wealth hidden under Pressure means the woman has a husband, while Wang Hongxu says Wealth hidden under Pressure means the man has a wife and Pressure hidden under Wealth means the woman has a husband.

zh: 财官叠见，重为一度之新人。
yi: 财、官两爻重叠出现，是再做一次新人。
en: Wealth and Pressure appearing twice over: to be a new bride or groom a second time.

Two Pressure lines moving mean two families contending to marry her;
Wealth hidden under Pressure means the man surely has a wife at home;
Pressure hidden under Wealth means the woman surely has a husband.
Pressure not Void while a moving line or the Day clashes with or controls Wealth surely means a living separation and remarriage.

title: 夫若才能，官位占长生之地；妻如丑拙，财爻落墓库之乡：男女性情容貌看财鬼二爻，月令旺身肥、日时旺貌美

rule.yi: 想知男女的性情容貌，看财、鬼两爻：月令旺身体胖，日时旺相貌美；月令衰身体瘦，日时衰相貌丑；月令旺而日时衰，身胖貌不扬；月令衰而日时旺，身瘦貌美；衰而有扶，丑却有才能；旺而入墓，虽美而愚拙；只看性情，男看鬼，女看财。
rule.en: To know the temperament and looks of the man or woman, look at the Wealth and Pressure lines: thriving in the month means a stout body, thriving on the day and hour means good looks; weak in the month means a thin body, weak on the day and hour means plain looks; thriving in the month but weak on the day and hour, a stout body and unremarkable looks; weak in the month but thriving on the day and hour, a thin body and handsome looks; weak but supported, plain but capable; thriving but entering the tomb, handsome but dull; for temperament alone, look at Pressure for a man and Wealth for a woman.

note.yi: 王洪绪在下一条（HJC.26）里说旺衰不能按四季论。本条「月令旺、日时旺」是旧注的说法；王洪绪另加了六神与五行的取象。
note.en: Wang Hongxu says in the next entry (HJC.26) that thriving and weakness must not be judged by the four seasons. The 'month and day-hour' scheme here is the old commentary's; Wang Hongxu adds his own images from the six spirits and five phases.

zh: 夫若才能，官位占长生之地；

en: A husband who is capable has his official place in the ground of Long Life;
a wife who is plain and clumsy has her Wealth line fallen in the region of the tomb.

thriving on the day and hour, the looks are handsome.
Weak in the month, the body is thin;
weak on the day and hour, the looks are plain.

weak in the month but thriving on the day and hour: a thin body and handsome looks.
Weak but supported: plain but capable;
thriving but entering the tomb: handsome but dull.
For temperament alone, judge a man by Pressure and a woman by Wealth.

zh: 要知男妇情性容貌，财鬼二爻取之，旺者身肥，衰者瘦弱。

如青龙属木金，貌美。
衰而有扶，丑有才能；
旺而入墓，美偏愚拙。
yi: 想知道男女的性情容貌，取财、鬼两爻，旺的身体胖，衰的身体瘦弱。
如果是虎、蛇、勾陈、玄武属土火的，相貌丑；

en: To know the temperament and looks of the man or woman, take the Wealth and Pressure lines: a thriving line means a stout body, a weak one a thin and frail body.
If it is the Tiger, the Snake, Hook Earth or the Dark Tortoise and belongs to Earth or Fire, the looks are plain;
if it is the Azure Dragon and belongs to Wood or Metal, the looks are handsome.
Weak but supported: plain but capable;
thriving but entering the tomb: handsome but dull.

title: 命旺则荣华可拟，时衰则发达难期：本命爻生旺有气则荣华，休囚死绝则无发达；本命爻所临六亲六神各主一种性好

rule.yi: 本命爻生旺有气，日后有荣华；休囚死绝，没有发达的日子。财旺命衰，妻子相貌虽美命却平常；鬼衰命旺，丈夫虽愚蠢衣食丰足。命临父母好技艺，加青龙好诗书，临兄好赌博、爱花钱、不好学，临官喜迎官府，临财福善于持家。王洪绪反对拿四季论旺衰，主张看本命爻是否临财福、青龙、贵人，或得日辰动爻生扶。
rule.en: When the natal line is born or thriving and has qi, glory lies ahead; when it is weak, dead or cut off, there is no rise. With Wealth thriving and the natal line weak, the wife is handsome but her fate is ordinary; with Pressure weak and the natal line thriving, the husband is dull but well fed and clothed. The natal line on Resource means a liking for skills, with the Azure Dragon added for poetry and books, on Peer for gambling, spending and no love of study, on Pressure a welcome to officials, on Wealth or Output a good housekeeper. Wang Hongxu objects to judging thriving and weakness by the four seasons and looks instead at whether the natal line sits on Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon or a noble, or is generated and supported by the Day or a moving line.

dispute.yi: 旺衰怎么论：旧注按月令、日时（四季）；王洪绪明说古法按四季论旺衰是错的，改看本命爻临什么六亲六神、有没有日辰动爻生扶；两家在这一条上直接不同。
dispute.en: How to judge thriving and weakness: the old commentary goes by the month and by the day and hour (the seasons); Wang Hongxu says outright that the old method of judging by the four seasons is wrong, and looks instead at what relation and spirit the natal line sits on and whether the Day or a moving line supports it; the two differ directly here.

zh: 命旺则荣华可拟，时衰则发达难期。
yi: 本命旺，就可以期望荣华；时令衰，就难以期望发达。
en: With a thriving natal line one may look for glory; with a weak season it is hard to look for a rise.

en: Life-fate is each one's natal line.
Born or thriving and with qi, there will surely be days of glory;
weak, dead or cut off, there will surely be no days of rising.
If Wealth thrives and the natal line is weak, the wife is handsome but her fate is ordinary;
if Pressure is weak and the natal line thriving, the husband is dull but well fed and clothed.
The natal line on Resource means surely a liking for skills;
with the Azure Dragon added, a liking for poetry and books.
On Peer, a liking for gambling, spending and no love of study.
On Pressure, a liking for welcoming officials.

Judge by whether it shows or not, and by generation and control among the five phases and by the movement of the six spirits.

zh: 命者，即求卜人之本命爻是也。

学者宜以类推。
yi: 命，就是求卜人的本命爻。
旺衰两个字，古法按四季来论，是错的。
如果木命的人挑春秋占卜，就一定发达吗？
难道富贵贫贱是由人自己挑的吗？
我屡次验过的，是本命爻临财福、青龙、贵人等吉星，或者遇到日辰、动爻生扶拱合的，荣华就有日子；
如果命临兄、鬼、白虎等凶神，或者遇到日辰、动爻刑冲克害的，发达就没有指望。
命临父母主好技艺，如果加青龙主好诗书，临兄弟则爱赌好贱，临财福必善持家，临官鬼带凶神主疾病官刑，不加凶神则是公门人役，带贵人则贵。
学的人应当类推。
en: Life-fate is the natal line of the person seeking the divination.
The old method judged thriving and weakness by the four seasons, which is wrong.
If a person of Wood fate chose spring or autumn to divine, would he surely rise?
Could wealth, rank, poverty and lowliness be chosen by oneself?

What I have often verified is that when the natal line sits on Wealth, Output, the Azure Dragon, a noble or other auspicious stars, or meets the Day or a moving line generating, supporting or embracing it, glory has its day;
if the natal line sits on Peer, Pressure, the White Tiger or other ominous spirits, or meets the Day or a moving line punishing, clashing, controlling or harming it, there is no hope of rising.

The natal line on Resource means a liking for skills, with the Azure Dragon a liking for poetry and rites, on Peer a love of gambling and cheapness, on Wealth or Output surely a good housekeeper, on Pressure with ominous spirits illness and official punishment, without ominous spirits a runner in a government office, and with a noble, high rank.
Learners should reason by analogy.

title: 财化财，一举两得；鬼化鬼，四复三番：财化财有赠嫁，财化子有带来的幼子；鬼化鬼凡事反复

rule.yi: 占婚遇财化财，一定有仆人陪嫁（赠嫁）；财化子，有小孩带来（带幼聘）；化子逢空虽来不长寿；化财遇冲以后会走失；退神逢冲，以后背夫改嫁或回娘家。鬼化鬼，不论进退神，凡事反复不定，占婚一定不容易，即使可成也迟滞，女家多有变化，缓急全听对方。
rule.en: In a marriage divination, Wealth changing into Wealth surely means servants come with the bride as a gift; Wealth changing into Output means a small child is brought along, called a betrothal with a child; changing into Output and meeting Void, the child comes but will not live long; changing into Wealth and meeting a clash, she will later run away; changing into a retreating spirit and meeting a clash, she will later leave her husband and remarry, or go back to her family. Pressure changing into Pressure, whether advancing or retreating, means everything is reversed and unsettled, and the marriage surely will not be easy, and even if it can succeed it is delayed; the woman's family will change its mind often, and easy or hard, slow or quick, all is at its pleasure.

note.yi: 经文「鬼化鬼，四复三番」在旧注本写作「四复三番」，这里译作「四次反复三次重来」。「带幼聘」「有他名」都是旧时的说法，指新娘带着幼子改嫁。
note.en: The verse's 'four repeats, three reversals' is translated as repeated reversals. 'A betrothal with a child' and 'having another's name' are old expressions for a bride who brings a young child from a previous marriage.

zh: 财化财，一举两得；
yi: 财爻化出财爻，一举得到两份；
en: Wealth changing into Wealth: two gains in one stroke;

zh: 占婚遇财化财，必有僮仆同来，谓赠嫁。
财化子，则有小儿带来，谓之带幼聘。

zh: 先观卦象之阴阳，则男女可决；
yi: 先看卦象的阴阳，就可以断定媒人是男是女；
en: First look at the yin and yang of the hexagram and one can decide whether the go-between is a man or a woman;

hits.text: 先观卦象阴阳，则男女可决
先观卦象之阴阳，则男女可决

zh: 阳男媒，阴女媒。
或问：间爻有二，当以何爻为主？
以衰旺动静取之。
又问：衰爻动，旺爻静，则如何？
则动者是也。
又问：两爻皆旺或皆衰，又将何以定之？
以冲动者定之。
若又无冲，以生合扶起者定之。
或一旺一空，以不空者定之。
又不遇空，则以长生决法定之。
务归于一，则不杂乱。
yi: 阳是男媒，阴是女媒。
有人问：间爻有两个，应当以哪一爻为主？
用衰旺、动静来取。
又问：衰的爻动、旺的爻静，怎么办？
那么动的就是。
又问：两个爻都旺或者都衰，又用什么来定？
用被冲而动的来定。
如果又没有冲，用被生合扶起的来定。
或者一旺一空，用不空的来定。
又不遇空，就用长生的办法来定。
务必归到一个，就不杂乱。
en: Yang is a male go-between and yin a female one.
Someone asks: there are two between lines, which should be taken as the main one?
Take it by strength and movement.
Again he asks: what if the weak line moves and the thriving one is still?
Then the moving one is it.
Again: if both lines thrive or both are weak, what decides?
Decide by the one clashed into movement.
If there is no clash either, decide by the one raised by generation or combination.
Or if one thrives and one is Void, decide by the one that is not Void.
If neither is Void, decide by the Long Life method.
Always come down to one, and then it is not confused.

zh: 阳男媒，阴女媒，以衰动旺静取之是也。
yi: 阳是男媒，阴是女媒，按衰的动、旺的静来取。
en: Yang is a male go-between and yin a female one, chosen by taking the weak that moves and the thriving that is still.

title: 次看卦爻之动静，则老幼堪推：交重二爻为老年人，单拆二爻为少年人；胎养长生少年、临官帝旺中年、墓绝老年

rule.yi: 交、重（老阴老阳）为老年人，单、拆（少阳少阴）为少年人；胎、养、长生是少年，临官、帝旺是中年，墓、绝是老年；墓化旺，是老年人先来说；阴化阳，是女人先来说；这爻动空化空而自冲另一爻，是原来的媒人有事推辞，别人来做媒。
rule.en: The doubled and crossed marks (old yin and old yang) mean an old person and the single and broken marks (young yang and young yin) a young one; Womb, Nurture and Long Life mean youth, Official and Emperor's Prime middle age, Tomb and Cut-off old age; Tomb changing to thriving means an old person spoke first; yin changing to yang means a woman spoke first; if this line moves, is Void and turns Void and itself clashes another line, the original go-between has an excuse to decline and someone else acts as go-between.

zh: 次看卦爻之动静，则老幼堪推。
yi: 再看卦爻的动静，就可以推断媒人是老是少。
en: Then look at the movement of the lines and one can judge whether the go-between is old or young.

hits.text: 次看卦爻之动静，则老幼堪推

zh: 交重二爻为老年人，单拆二爻为少年人。
或胎养长生为少年，临官帝旺为中年，墓绝是老年人为媒也。
若墓化旺，是老年人先来说；
阴化阳，是女人先来说。
若此爻动空化空，而自冲动彼一爻，主原媒有故推却，而他人为媒也。
yi: 交、重两种爻（老阴老阳）是老年人，单、拆两种爻（少阳少阴）是少年人。
或者胎、养、长生是少年，临官、帝旺是中年，墓、绝是老年人做媒。
如果墓化旺，是老年人先来说；
阴化阳，是女人先来说；
如果这一爻动、空、化空，而自己冲动另一爻，主原来的媒人有事推辞，而别人来做媒。
en: The crossed and doubled lines, old yin and old yang, mean an old person, and the single and broken lines, young yang and young yin, a young one.
Or Womb, Nurture and Long Life mean youth, Official and Emperor's Prime middle age, and Tomb and Cut-off an old go-between.
If Tomb changes into thriving, an old person spoke first;
yin changing into yang, a woman spoke first;
if this line moves, is Void and turns Void, and itself clashes another line, the original go-between has an excuse to decline and someone else acts as go-between.

zh: 交重二爻或衰弱者是老年人，单拆二爻或旺相者是少年人。
yi: 交重两种爻或者衰弱的是老年人，单拆两种爻或者旺相的是少年人。
en: The crossed and doubled lines, or a weak one, mean an old person, and the single and broken lines, or a thriving one, a young person.

title: 论贫富，当究身命；决美恶，可验性情：问妇看财爻、问夫看鬼爻、问男家看世爻、问女家看应爻；应旺财衰，女家富而女貌不扬

rule.yi: 要看男女的贫富美恶：问妇看财爻，问夫的身看鬼爻，问男家看世爻，问女家看应爻；应旺而财衰，是女家虽富，女子相貌不出众；维持和拆台的旁人，用刑冲生合的爻来推。
rule.en: To judge the wealth, poverty, looks and character of the man or woman: to ask about the bride look at the Wealth line, about the bridegroom look at the Pressure line, about the man's family the Self line, about the woman's family the Other line; the Other thriving and Wealth weak means the woman's family is rich but her looks are unremarkable; the bystanders who support or wreck it are judged by the lines that punish, clash, generate or combine.

note.yi: 看男家女家的爻，旧注和王洪绪不同：旧注是问男家看世、问女家看应；王洪绪是问对方的家一律看应。
note.en: For looking at the families the old commentary and Wang Hongxu differ: the old commentary looks at the Self for the man's family and the Other for the woman's; Wang Hongxu looks at the Other for whichever is the other party's family.

zh: 论贫富，当究身命；
决美恶，可验性情。
yi: 论贫富，应当追究身命；
断美恶，可以验证性情。
en: To judge wealth and poverty, look into the Body and the natal line;
to decide good looks and plainness, verify the temperament.

zh: 人生美恶贫富，两章尽之矣。
然非特可观媒妁而已。
若问妇，看财爻；
问夫身，看鬼爻；
问男家，看世爻；
问女家，看应爻。
若应旺财衰，可言女家虽富，女貌不扬，余类推。
至于维持破说之旁人，可以刑冲生合之爻推之。
yi: 人的美恶贫富，这两章（身命章、性情）已经说尽了。
然而不只是可以观察媒人而已。
如果问新妇，看财爻；
问丈夫本人，看鬼爻；
问男家，看世爻；
问女家，看应爻。
如果应旺财衰，可以说女家虽然富，女子相貌不出众，其余类推。
至于从旁维持、拆台的人，可以用刑冲生合的爻来推。
en: Human beauty, plainness, wealth and poverty are exhausted in those two chapters.
But they are useful for more than observing the go-between.
To ask about the bride, look at the Wealth line;
about the bridegroom himself, the Pressure line;
about the man's family, the Self line;
about the woman's family, the Other line.
If the Other thrives and Wealth is weak, one can say the woman's family is rich but her looks are unremarkable, and the rest by analogy.
As for those on the side who support or wreck it, judge by the lines that punish, clash, generate or combine.

zh: 男问妇看财爻，女问夫看鬼爻，女问男家、男问女家皆看应爻。
若应旺财衰，女家虽富，女貌不扬。
余类推。
yi: 男子问妻子看财爻，女子问丈夫看鬼爻，女子问男家、男子问女家都看应爻。
如果应旺财衰，女家虽然富有，女子相貌不出众。
其余类推。
en: A man asking about a wife looks at the Wealth line, a woman asking about a husband the Pressure line, and a woman asking about the man's family or a man about the woman's, the Other line.
If the Other thrives and Wealth is weak, the woman's family though rich has a daughter of unremarkable looks.
The rest by analogy.

title: 雀值兄临，惯在其中得利：间爻遇螣蛇、朱雀、兄弟，其人伶牙俐齿，惯以做媒获利，旺相必奸诈

rule.yi: 间爻遇到螣蛇、朱雀和兄弟的，那人一定伶牙俐齿，一向靠做媒获利，旺相就一定奸诈。
rule.en: A between line that meets the Coiling Snake, the Vermilion Bird or Peer marks a person with a ready tongue who has always profited from matchmaking, and if thriving, one who is surely crafty.

zh: 雀值兄临，惯在其中得利；
yi: 朱雀、兄弟临在（间爻）上，惯于从中获利。
en: With the Vermilion Bird or Peer on it, one habitually profits from the middle.

zh: 间爻如值螣蛇朱雀，及兄弟者，其人必俐齿伶牙，素以媒妁获利者。
兴旺必奸诈。
yi: 间爻如果遇到螣蛇、朱雀，以及兄弟的，那个人一定伶牙俐齿，一向靠做媒获利。
旺相就必定奸诈。
en: If the between line meets the Coiling Snake, the Vermilion Bird or Peer, the person surely has a ready tongue and has always profited from matchmaking.
If thriving, surely crafty.

zh: 间爻如值螣蛇、朱雀及兄弟者，其人惯赖媒妁获利。
yi: 间爻如果遇到螣蛇、朱雀以及兄弟的，那个人惯于靠做媒获利。
en: If the between line meets the Coiling Snake, the Vermilion Bird or Peer, the person is used to profiting from matchmaking.

title: 世冲应合，浼他出以为媒：间爻安静被世应冲动或生扶合起，其人无心作伐，是一边央他去说

rule.yi: 间爻安静，被应、世两爻冲动，或者被生扶合起，或被日辰冲并起来的，那个人无心做媒，一定是一边请他去说；间爻自己发动的，不要这样断。
rule.en: A quiet between line clashed into motion by the Other and the Self, or raised by generation, support or combination, or by a clash from the Day, belongs to a person who has no mind to act as go-between and has certainly been asked by one side to speak; a between line that moves of itself is not to be judged this way.

zh: 世冲应合，浼他出以为媒。

yi: 间爻安静，被应、世两爻冲动，或者被生扶合起，以及被日辰冲并起来的，那个人无心做媒，一定是一边央求他去说。

en: A between line that is quiet and is clashed into motion by the Other and Self lines, or raised by generation, support or combination, or by a clash from the Day, belongs to a person who has no mind to act as go-between and has certainly been asked by one side to speak.
A between line that moves of itself is not to be judged this way.

zh: 间爻安静被世应冲合起，及日辰冲并起者，其人无心作伐，必央他说合也。
间爻自动者勿如此断。
yi: 间爻安静，被世、应冲合起来，以及被日辰冲并起来的，那个人无心做媒，一定是请他去说合。

en: A quiet between line raised by clash or combination from the Self and Other, or by a clash from the Day, belongs to a person who has no mind to act as go-between and has certainly been asked to speak.
A between line that moves of itself is not to be judged this way.

title: 两兄同发，定多月老以争盟；二间俱空，必无通好以为礼：两间俱动必有两媒；间爻安静俱空则无媒；空动而化兄鬼是媒欲谢礼作梗

rule.yi: 两个间爻都动，一定有两个媒人，临兄弟或兄化兄、动出两个鬼，主有争着做媒的，要看空亡衰旺、有制无制，才知道谁掌权；间爻安静又都空亡，一定没有媒人来通好；空动而化出兄鬼，是媒人想要谢礼而作梗不来，不是没有媒人。
rule.en: Two between lines both moving means two go-betweens, and if they sit on Peer, or Peer changes into Peer, or two Pressure lines move out, they compete to be go-between, and one must see Void, thriving or weakness, and whether there is restraint to know which holds the power; between lines that are quiet and both Void mean no go-between comes to bring the two sides together; between lines that are Void and moving and change into Peer or Pressure mean the go-between wants his thank-you gift and is holding back, not that there is no go-between.

zh: 两兄同发，定多月老以争盟；
二间俱空，必无通好以为礼。
yi: 两个兄爻一起发动，一定有很多月老争着做媒；
两个间爻都空，一定没有人来通好、送礼。
en: Two Peer lines moving together mean many go-betweens contending to make the match;
two between lines both Void mean no one comes to bring the two sides together with a gift.

zh: 两间俱动，必有两媒。
临兄，或兄化兄，或动出两鬼，主有争竞为媒。
须看空亡衰旺，及有制无制，可知那个执权。
若间爻安静，俱在空亡，必无媒人通好。
若空动而化出兄鬼，或临兄鬼空动者，乃是媒欲谢礼作鬼不来，非无媒也。
yi: 两个间爻都动，一定有两个媒人。
临兄弟，或者兄弟化兄弟，或者动出两个鬼，主有争着做媒的。
要看空亡、衰旺，以及有制无制，可以知道哪个掌权。
如果间爻安静，又都在空亡，一定没有媒人来通好。
如果空、动而化出兄、鬼，或者临兄、鬼而空动的，是媒人想要谢礼，故意作梗不来，不是没有媒人。
en: Two between lines both moving mean two go-betweens.
On Peer, or Peer changing into Peer, or two Pressure lines moving out, they compete to be go-between.
One must see Void, thriving or weakness, and whether there is restraint, to know which holds the power.
If the between lines are quiet and both in Void, no go-between comes to bring the two sides together.

If they are Void and moving and change into Peer or Pressure, or sit on Peer or Pressure while Void and moving, the go-between wants his thank-you gift and is holding back on purpose, not that there is no go-between.

zh: 两间俱动，必有两媒，须看衰旺及有制无制，可知哪个执权。
yi: 两个间爻都动，一定有两个媒人，要看衰旺以及有制无制，可以知道哪个掌权。
en: Two between lines both moving mean two go-betweens, and one must look at strength and weakness and whether there is restraint to know which holds the power.

title: 世应不和，仗冰言而通好：世应相冲相克难成，得间爻生合解救，靠媒人两边说合可成

rule.yi: 世应相冲相克，本来难成亲，如果得间爻生合来解救，终归要靠媒人两边说合来通好，事也可以成；解救的办法，比如应动克世，间爻合住应爻、生扶世爻，其余类推。
rule.en: The Self and Other clashing or controlling each other makes the match hard, but if a between line rescues them by generating or combining, in the end the go-betweens must speak to both sides to bring them together, and then it can succeed; the way of rescue is, for example, when the Other moves to control the Self, a between line combines with the Other and generates the Self, and the rest by analogy.

zh: 世应不和，仗冰言而通好；

en: The Self and Other clashing or controlling each other, if a between line moves to generate or combine with the Self and Other, it can succeed only by relying on the go-between speaking to both sides.

title: 间爻受克，总绮语亦无从：欲托媒说合，须应爻生合间爻；间爻被应冲克，甜言也不听

rule.yi: 想请媒人说合求亲，必须应爻生合间爻，媒人的话才容易入耳、被听信；如果间爻反被应爻冲克，即使甜言蜜语，对方也不听从。
rule.en: To ask a go-between to arrange a match, the Other line must generate or combine with the between line, and then his words go in easily and are believed; if the between line is instead clashed or controlled by the Other, even honeyed words are not heeded.

title: 财官冲克，反招就里愆尤：间爻被日辰动爻刑冲克害，媒人被两家埋怨；世爻冲克男家怨、应爻冲克女家怨

en: With Wealth and Pressure clashing or controlling, resentment from within is instead drawn down.

应爻冲克，女方家里有怨言。
或者世来生合，而财爻冲克，男家虽然吉，日后女家一定怨。
财、官都冲克，夫妻双方都有怨。
en: If the between line is punished, clashed, controlled or harmed by the Day or a moving line, the go-between is surely resented by both families.
The Self line clashing or controlling, the man's family resents;
the Other line clashing or controlling, the woman's family resents.
Or if the Self generates or combines while the Wealth line clashes or controls, the man's family is fine but later the woman's family will surely resent.
If Wealth and Pressure both clash or control, both husband and wife resent.

en: If the between line is clashed or controlled by the Day, a moving line, or Wealth and Pressure, the go-between is surely blamed by both families; the Self line clashing means the man's family resents and the Other line clashing means the woman's family resents.

title: 世应生扶，必得其中厚惠：世应日辰带财福青龙生合间爻，媒人必得两家酬谢；带兄鬼螣蛇玄武只是巧言虚礼

rule.en: When the Self and Other or the Day carry Wealth, Output or the Azure Dragon and generate or combine with the between line, the go-between surely receives thanks from both families, more if thriving and less if weak; if what generates or combines carries Peer, Pressure, the Coiling Snake or the Dark Tortoise, it is no more than fine words and empty courtesy without real benefit; changing out into Wealth or Output that generates or combines is also auspicious; a man looks at the Self line and a woman at the Other line; the Self and Other both generating or combining means both families give; the Self thriving means more from the man's family and the Other thriving more from the woman's.

the Other thriving, the woman's family gives more.

title: 一卦吉凶，细察精微委曲：此章只论男卜女婚、女卜男姻；择婿择媳嫁妹娶嫂，要按用神断，不可一概以官为夫、财为妇

rule.yi: 一卦的吉凶，要细察其中精微曲折；夫妇百年，才知道到底能否团圆。王洪绪特别说：这一章只是讲男子占女方婚事、女子占男方姻缘；今天的术士不辨清楚，凡择婿、择媳、嫁妹、娶嫂，都不按用神断，一概以官为夫、财为妇，大大误人；应当按用神的吉凶来推断，不可一概只论财官。
rule.en: The good and ill of a hexagram is to be examined for its fine and winding detail; only over a lifetime as husband and wife does one know whether they come together in the end. Wang Hongxu adds especially: this chapter speaks only of a man divining about a bride or a woman divining about a bridegroom; today's practitioners, not seeing the distinction, for choosing a son-in-law or daughter-in-law, marrying off a younger sister or taking a brother's wife, do not judge by the Subject but always take Pressure as the husband and Wealth as the wife, which misleads people greatly; one should judge by the good or ill of the Subject and never speak of Wealth and Pressure alike in every case.

dispute.yi: 这一章的财官各指谁：旧注一路按「官为夫、财为妇」讲（见 HJC.11、HJC.24）；王洪绪在章末明说这是「男卜女婚、女卜男姻」的意思，别人代占、兄占弟婚之类要按用神断，不可一概；觉子（《增删卜易》）也说男家占女以财为用、女家占男以官为用，不拘父母亲朋代占都同。
dispute.en: Whom Wealth and Pressure stand for in this chapter: the old commentary throughout speaks by 'Pressure the husband, Wealth the wife' (see HJC.11, HJC.24); Wang Hongxu says at the chapter's end that this is what applies when a man divines about a bride or a woman about a bridegroom, and that divinations made on another's behalf or by an elder brother for a younger must be judged by the Subject and not all alike; Juezi (Zengshan Buyi) also says that the man's family divining about the woman takes Wealth as the Subject and the woman's family divining about the man takes Pressure, the same whether parents or relatives divine on their behalf.

zh: 一卦吉凶，细察精微委曲；

yi: 一卦的吉凶，要细细察看其中精微曲折；
百年夫妇，才知道到底能不能团圆。
en: The good and ill of a hexagram is to be examined for its fine and winding detail;
only over a lifetime as husband and wife does one know whether they come together in the end.

况且这一章里有一句说：「妯娌不合，只为官爻发动；翁姑不睦，定因妻位交重」，这两句就可以为证。
学的人应当按用神的吉凶来推断，不可一概只论财官。
en: This chapter speaks only of a man divining about a bride or a woman divining about a bridegroom; the practitioners of today, not seeing the distinction, for choosing a son-in-law or daughter-in-law, marrying off a younger sister or taking a brother's wife, do not judge by the Subject and always take Pressure as the husband and Wealth as the wife, which misleads people greatly.

Moreover the chapter itself says, 'the brothers' wives are at odds only because the Pressure line moves; the parents-in-law are at odds surely because the wife's place is doubled', and these two lines can serve as proof.
Learners should judge by the good or ill of the Subject and never speak of Wealth and Pressure alike in every case.

title: 妻夺夫权，妻有能家之兆：妻命临夫身五爻之上与夫相生相合是内助能家，妻克夫爻则妻凌夫或破夫家

rule.en: If the wife's Life line sits above the husband's Body line on the fifth line and generates and combines with the husband, it is a sign of a helpmate who can run the household; if the wife's line controls the husband's line, the wife overbears her husband or ruins his family.

rule.en: If the husband's Body or Life line sits on the wife's Emolument place (for a wife born in a Jia-Zi year, her Emolument is at Yin), strong and in season and also meeting the Food spirit, the husband eats off the wife's emolument, living on his wife; if it meets the Owl spirit, the Goat Blade, or Void, ghost, waste and ruin stars, then though he eats the wife's emolument it is of no use.

note.en: 'Emolument', the 'Food spirit' and the 'Owl spirit' are terms of the Ziping birth-chart art, which the book does not explain; here the birth stems and branches of husband and wife are set into the hexagram.

if they generate and combine, it means she can be respectful and dutiful and do her part as a daughter-in-law.

title: 吉连沐浴，败而不成：吉神、用爻化入沐浴（败神）则败而不成；占婚姻最忌，男择婚得财爻化沐浴兼生则败门风、兼克则因奸杀身

rule.yi: 吉神、用爻和喜爻化入沐浴（也叫败神），败而不成。占婚姻最忌它：男人择婚，财爻化成沐浴又带生的，必定败坏门风；带克的，会因为奸情丧命。各种占也一样：世爻化入沐浴，带生的因贪色败坏名声，带克的因奸情丧命，有救的从险里逃生。所以说吉神不可以化沐浴。
rule.en: A lucky spirit, the Subject line or a welcome line that changes into Bathing, also called the spirit of ruin, is ruined and does not succeed. In a marriage divination it is most to be avoided: when a man chooses a marriage and the Wealth line changes into Bathing with generation, it will surely ruin the family name; with control, he will lose his life over adultery. It is the same in all divinations: if the Self line changes into Bathing, with generation one ruins one's name through lust, with control one loses one's life through adultery, and with rescue one escapes from danger. Hence a lucky spirit must not change into Bathing.

note.yi: 旧注本（卜筮大全）里这一联后面有一个作者自己的卦例，本库没有收；「沐浴」是十二长生里的一位，「败神」「沐浴煞」是它的别名。
note.en: In the old commentary text (Bushi Daquan) this couplet is followed by a case of the author's own, which is not included here; 'Bathing' is one of the twelve life stages, and 'spirit of ruin' and 'Bathing star' are other names for it.

zh: 吉连沐浴，败而不成。
yi: 吉神连着沐浴，败了就不成。
en: A lucky spirit joined to Bathing is ruined and does not succeed.

zh: 沐浴，其名败神，又称沐浴煞，乃无廉无耻之神，其性淫败，然而有轻重之分别。
即如金败于午，败中兼克；
寅木败于子，败中兼生；
卯木败于子，败中兼刑；
水败于酉，败中兼生；
土败于酉，败中兼泄气；
火败于卯，败中兼生。
唯占婚姻最宜忌之。
倘夫择婚姻，得财爻而化沐浴兼生者，必败门风，兼克者，因奸杀身。
即如诸占，倘世爻化之，生者因色坏名，克者因奸丧身，有救者险里逃生。
故曰吉神不可化沐浴也。
yi: 沐浴，名叫败神，又叫沐浴煞，是无廉耻的神，它的性子淫败，不过有轻重的分别。
比如金败在午，败中带克；
寅木败在子，败中带生；
卯木败在子，败中带刑；
水败在酉，败中带生；
土败在酉，败中带泄气；
火败在卯，败中带生。
只有占婚姻最应该忌它。
如果男人择婚姻，得到财爻化成沐浴又带生的，必定败坏门风，带克的，因为奸情丧命。
就像各种占一样，如果世爻化成它，带生的因为贪色败坏名声，带克的因为奸情丧命，有救的从险里逃生。
所以说吉神不可以化沐浴。
en: Bathing is called the spirit of ruin, also the Bathing star: a spirit without integrity or shame, licentious and ruinous by nature, though there are lighter and heavier cases.
For example, Metal is ruined at Wu, where the ruin also brings control;
Yin Wood is ruined at Zi, where the ruin brings generation;
Mao Wood is ruined at Zi, where the ruin brings punishment;
Water is ruined at You, where the ruin brings generation;
Earth is ruined at You, where the ruin brings a draining of qi;
Fire is ruined at Mao, where the ruin brings generation.
Only in divining a marriage is it most to be avoided.
If a man chooses a marriage and gets a Wealth line that changes into Bathing with generation, it will surely ruin the family name; with control, he will lose his life over adultery.

As in all divinations, if the Self line changes into it, with generation one ruins one's name through lust, with control one loses one's life through adultery, and with rescue one escapes from danger.
Hence it is said that a lucky spirit must not change into Bathing.

title: 世应相生夫唱妇随、悔贞相克琴瑟不调：世是一身之本、应为百岁之妻；世为贞、应为悔，相生相合则和顺，相冲相克则不谐

rule.yi: 世爻是自己一身的根本，应爻是相伴百年的妻子。世应相生相合，一定夫唱妇随（汉朝鲍宣娶桓少君）；世（贞）应（悔）相冲相克，一定夫妻不谐（唐朝郭暧招升平公主）。
rule.en: The Self line is the root of one's whole person and the Other line is the wife of a hundred years. Self and Other generating and combining means husband leads and wife follows (like Bao Xuan of Han and Lady Huan Shaojun); Self (Zhen) and Other (Hui) clashing and controlling means the couple is out of tune (like Guo Ai of Tang and Princess Shengping).

note.yi: 「悔贞」在这里指世应两爻：注说「世为贞、应为悔」，不是内卦外卦。鲍宣、桓少君是汉朝的一对贫贱夫妻，妻子不要陪嫁、随夫过朴素日子；郭暧是唐代宗的女婿，和妻子升平公主吵过架。卜筮大全写「郭暖」，卜筮正宗写「郭曦」，人名是郭暧，译文按卜筮大全。这一句在卜筮全书里紧挨着「世是一生之本、应为百岁之妻」，那句的出处是这里的旧注（见 LY.MARRY.ZS.04）。
note.en: 'Hui and Zhen' here means the Self and Other lines: the commentary says 'the Self line is Zhen and the Other line is Hui', not the inner and outer trigrams. Bao Xuan and Huan Shaojun were a poor Han couple, the wife giving up her dowry to live simply with her husband; Guo Ai was a son-in-law of Emperor Daizong of Tang who quarrelled with his wife Princess Shengping. The Quanshu writes 'Guo Nuan' and the Zhengzong 'Guo Xi'; the name is Guo Ai, and the translation follows the Quanshu. The line 'the Self line is the root of a life, the Other line the wife of a hundred years' quoted at LY.MARRY.ZS.04 comes from the old commentary here.

zh: 世应相生，汉鲍宣娶桓氏少君为妇；
yi: 世爻和应爻相生，就像汉朝的鲍宣娶了桓氏少君做妻子；
en: The Self and Other lines generating each other: like Bao Xuan of Han taking Lady Huan Shaojun as his wife;

hits.text: 世应相生，汉鲍宣娶桓氏少君为妇
世应相生，汉鲍宣娶桓氏少君为妇

zh: 世是一身之本，应为百岁之妻。
若见相生相合，必然夫唱妇随。
yi: 世爻是一身的根本，应爻是相伴百年的妻子。
如果看到相生相合，一定是夫唱妇随。
en: The Self line is the root of one's whole person; the Other line is the wife of a hundred years.
If they generate and combine with each other, husband leads and wife follows, surely.

zh: 悔贞相克，唐郭暖招升平公主为妻。
yi: 悔卦贞卦相克，就像唐朝的郭暖招了升平公主做妻子。
en: Hui and Zhen controlling each other: like Guo Nuan (Guo Ai) of Tang who married Princess Shengping.

hits.text: 悔贞相克，唐郭曦招升平公主为妻
悔贞相克，唐郭暧尚升平公主为妻

zh: 世为贞，应为悔。
若见相冲相克，必然琴瑟不调。
yi: 世爻是贞，应爻是悔。
如果看到相冲相克，一定是夫妻不和谐。
en: The Self line is Zhen and the Other line is Hui.
If they clash and control each other, husband and wife are surely out of tune, like a zither and a lute not in tune.

zh: 世是一生之本，应为百岁之妻子，若见生合，必然夫唱妇随，若见冲克，必然琴瑟不调。
yi: 世爻是一生的根本，应爻是百年相伴的妻子，如果看到相生相合，一定夫唱妇随；如果看到相冲相克，一定夫妻不和谐。
en: The Self line is the root of a whole life and the Other line is the wife of a hundred years; if they generate and combine, husband leads and wife follows, surely; if they clash and control, the couple is surely out of tune.

title: 箕踞鼓盆歌，世伤应位：世持白虎螣蛇、乘旺发动，刑害应爻，应又临无气之地，必主克妻

rule.yi: 世爻带着白虎或螣蛇，乘旺相发动，去刑害应爻，应爻又落在没有气的地方，一定克妻，就像庄周的妻子死了，他还箕踞着敲盆唱歌。
rule.en: The Self line carrying the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, moving on strength and punishing and harming the Other line, while the Other line sits in a place without qi, means the wife is surely harmed, like Zhuang Zhou, who sat sprawled drumming on a basin and singing when his wife died.

note.yi: 卜筮正宗把「箕踞」写成「僦居」，是同一句的异文。庄子妻死鼓盆而歌，是《庄子·至乐》里的故事，这里只借它指「妻死」。卜筮正宗的注比卜筮全书多了一个条件：世爻还得是兄弟爻（「临兄弟」）。
note.en: The Zhengzong writes 'jiu ju' where the Quanshu has 'ji ju' (sitting sprawled), a variant of the same line. Zhuangzi drumming on a basin and singing at his wife's death is the story in the Zhuangzi, 'Perfect Joy', and is used here only to stand for the wife's death. The Zhengzong's note adds one condition the Quanshu lacks: the Self line must also be a Peer line.

zh: 箕踞鼓盆歌，世伤应位；
yi: 箕踞着敲盆唱歌，是世爻伤了应爻的位置；
en: Sitting sprawled, drumming on a basin and singing: the Self line harms the Other line's place;

zh: 世持虎蛇，乘旺发动，刑害应爻，应又临无气之地，必主克妻。
如春秋时，庄周妻死，犹箕踞鼓盆而歌。
yi: 世爻带白虎、螣蛇，乘旺发动，刑害应爻，应爻又落在没有气的地方，一定克妻。
就像春秋时庄周的妻子死了，他还箕踞着敲着盆唱歌。
en: The Self line carrying the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, moving on strength, punishing and harming the Other line, while the Other line sits in a place without qi: the wife is surely harmed.
As when, in the Spring and Autumn period, Zhuang Zhou's wife died and he still sat sprawled, drumming on a basin and singing.

zh: 世持虎蛇临兄弟，乘旺发动，刑害应爻，应爻临无气之地，必主克妻，如春秋时庄子，妻死鼓盆而歌。
yi: 世爻带白虎、螣蛇，又是兄弟爻，乘旺发动，刑害应爻，应爻落在没有气的地方，一定克妻，就像春秋时的庄子，妻子死了敲着盆唱歌。
en: The Self line carrying the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake and being a Peer line, moving on strength, punishing and harming the Other line, while the Other line sits in a place without qi: the wife is surely harmed, like Zhuangzi in the Spring and Autumn period, who drummed on a basin and sang when his wife died.

title: 河东狮子吼，应制世爻：应爻克制世爻是牝鸡晨鸣之象，其人凡事听妻子的

rule.yi: 应爻克制世爻，是母鸡打鸣的样子，这个人凡事听妻子的，就像宋朝陈季常怕老婆的「河东狮子吼」。
rule.en: The Other line controlling and holding down the Self line is the image of the hen crowing at dawn: the man goes by his wife's word in everything, like Chen Jichang of Song and the 'lion of Hedong roars'.

note.yi: 「牝鸡晨鸣」出自《尚书·牧誓》「牝鸡无晨」，指妻子当家作主。「河东狮吼」是苏东坡取笑朋友陈季常怕老婆的诗句，后来成了怕老婆的代称。卜筮大全「狮子吼」，卜筮正宗「狮吼」，字数不同，意思一样。
note.en: 'The hen crowing at dawn' comes from the Book of Documents, 'Oath at Mu', 'the hen does not herald the dawn', and means a wife who rules the house. 'The lion of Hedong roars' is Su Dongpo's teasing of his friend Chen Jichang for fearing his wife, and became a byword for a henpecked husband. The Quanshu has 'lion roars' and the Zhengzong 'lion roar', which differ in length but not in meaning.

zh: 河东狮子吼，应制世爻。
yi: 河东狮子吼叫，是应爻制住了世爻。
en: The lion of Hedong roars: the Other line holds the Self line down.

zh: 应爻克制世爻，乃是牝鸡晨鸣之象，其人必凭妻言语。
如宋陈季常河东狮子吼，东坡所戏言也。
yi: 应爻克制世爻，是母鸡在早晨打鸣的样子，这个人一定凭着妻子的话行事。
就像宋朝陈季常「河东狮子吼」的故事，那是东坡开的玩笑话。
en: The Other line controlling and holding down the Self line is the image of the hen crowing at dawn: the man surely goes by his wife's word.
As with Chen Jichang of Song and the 'lion of Hedong roars', which Dongpo said in jest.

zh: 应爻克冲世爻，其人凭妻言语，如宋陈季常河东狮子吼之事也。
yi: 应爻克冲世爻，这个人凭着妻子的话行事，就像宋朝陈季常「河东狮子吼」那件事。
en: The Other line controlling and clashing the Self line: the man goes by his wife's word, like the affair of Chen Jichang of Song and the 'lion of Hedong roars'.

title: 世值凶而应克，愿听鸡鸣：世爻自带刑害兄官虎蛇等凶神，反喜应爻来克世，去我之病，主有贤妻

rule.yi: 世爻自己带着刑害、兄弟、官鬼、白虎、螣蛇这些凶神，应爻来克它，反而是对方来救我的过失、去我的毛病，不是伤我，主有贤惠的妻子（像齐国国君得到贤妃日夜规劝）。和上一条对照：世爻本来没事而被应爻克制，是怕老婆；世爻自己带凶而被应爻克制，是有人纠正我。
rule.en: If the Self line itself carries punishment, harm and ill spirits such as Peer, Pressure, the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, and the Other line comes to control it, then the other party is coming to save me from my faults and cure my ailment and is not hurting me; it means a virtuous wife (as the ruler of Qi was warned day and night by a virtuous consort). Compare the previous entry: a Self line that is sound but held down by the Other line means a henpecked husband; a Self line that itself carries ill and is held down by the Other line means someone is correcting me.

dispute.yi: 同一个应克世：上一条（LY.MARRY.HJC.71）把它断成怕老婆，这一条断成有贤妻。分界在世爻自己：世爻本身平安而被应克，是被妻子压住；世爻本身带凶而被应克，是被妻子救回来。
dispute.en: The same Other line controlling Self is judged a henpecked husband in the previous entry (LY.MARRY.HJC.71) and a virtuous wife here. The dividing line is the Self line itself: a sound Self line held down by the Other line is pressed under the wife; a Self line that itself carries ill and is controlled by the Other line is rescued by the wife.

note.yi: 卜筮大全写「愿听鸡鸣」，卜筮正宗写「顾听鸡鸣」；注里的国君，卜筮大全是齐哀公，卜筮正宗是齐襄公。《诗经·齐风·鸡鸣》的小序说的是哀公，译文照各书原样。「鸡鸣」是妻子在天亮前催丈夫起来理事的诗。
note.en: The Quanshu writes 'glad to hear the cock-crow' and the Zhengzong 'willing to listen to the cock-crow'; the ruler in the note is Duke Ai of Qi in the Quanshu and Duke Xiang of Qi in the Zhengzong. The preface to 'Cock-crow' in the Odes (Qi Feng) speaks of Duke Ai; each book is translated as written. 'Cock-crow' is the poem of a wife urging her husband to rise before dawn and attend to affairs.

zh: 世值凶而应克，愿听鸡鸣；
yi: 世爻遇到凶神而应爻来克它，倒愿意听那鸡鸣的规劝；
en: The Self line meeting an ill spirit while the Other line controls it: one is glad to hear the cock-crow warning;

hits.text: 世值凶而应克，顾听鸡鸣
世值凶而应克，愿听鸡鸣

zh: 若应虽来克世，而世爻自带刑害，及兄官虎蛇等凶神者，则是彼来救我之失，去我之病，非有所伤于我。
主其人必有贤妻。
如齐哀公荒怠慢政，得陈贤妃，有夙夜警戒相成之道。
故诗有鸡鸣篇。
yi: 如果应爻虽然来克世爻，但世爻自己带着刑害，以及兄弟、官鬼、白虎、螣蛇这些凶神，那是对方来救我的过失、去我的毛病，并没有伤害我。
主这个人一定有贤惠的妻子。
就像齐哀公荒废懈怠政事，得到陈国的贤妃，有日夜警戒、彼此成全的规矩。
所以《诗经》里有《鸡鸣》这一篇。
en: If the Other line does come to control the Self line, but the Self line itself carries punishment and harm and ill spirits such as Peer, Pressure, the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, then the other party is coming to save me from my faults and cure my ailment, and does me no harm.
It means the man surely has a virtuous wife.
As Duke Ai of Qi, dissolute and slack in government, obtained the virtuous consort of Chen, who kept the way of warning him day and night and helping him toward success.
So the Book of Odes has the poem 'Cock-crow'.

zh: 倘世爻自带兄官虎蛇等凶神者，反喜应来克世，谓之克我之凶，去我之病，主有贤妻，如齐襄公荒怠慢政，得陈贤妃，有夙夜警戒相成之道，故诗有《鸡鸣篇》。
yi: 倘若世爻自己带着兄弟、官鬼、白虎、螣蛇这些凶神，反而喜欢应爻来克世爻，这叫做克我的凶、去我的病，主有贤妻，就像齐襄公荒废懈怠政事，得到陈国的贤妃，有日夜警戒、彼此成全的规矩，所以《诗经》里有《鸡鸣》篇。
en: If the Self line itself carries ill spirits such as Peer, Pressure, the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake, one is glad that the Other line comes to control it; this is called a control of me that removes my ill and cures my ailment, and it means a virtuous wife, as Duke Xiang of Qi, dissolute and slack in government, obtained the virtuous consort of Chen, who kept the way of warning him day and night and helping him toward success, and so the Odes have the poem 'Cock-crow'.

title: 兄兴六位张瞻丧偶于中年：兄弟爻动克妻财，动在六爻主中年丧妻；财动初爻则早年克父母

rule.yi: 兄弟爻动就克妻财，如果动在六爻上，中年一定像张瞻那样丧妻。同一对句的上半句说财爻动伤父母，动在初爻就是早年受克（像李密生下六个月父亲就去世）。
rule.en: A Peer line moving controls Wealth, the wife; if it moves on the sixth line, in middle age a wife is surely lost, as with Zhang Zhan. The first half of the couplet says that Wealth moving harms the parents, and on the first line the harm comes in early years (as when Li Mi's father died when he was six months old).

note.yi: 初爻代表早年，六爻代表中年以后，这是三限里「一爻管五年」的排法（见黄金策同章）。卜筮正宗把经文写成「财动克亲于早岁，兄衰丧偶于中年」（「兄兴」作「兄衰」），注文与卜筮大全一致。
note.en: The first line stands for early years and the sixth for what follows middle age, following the scheme of the three periods in which each line governs five years (see the same chapter of the Huangjin Ce). The Zhengzong gives the verse as 'Wealth moving harms the parents in early years, a Peer line weak loses a spouse in middle age' ('flourishing' becomes 'weak'), with a note matching the Quanshu.

zh: 财动初爻，令伯克亲于早年；
yi: 财爻动在初爻，像令伯（李密）那样，早年就克了双亲；
en: Wealth moving on the first line: like Lingbo (Li Mi), the parents are harmed in early years;

hits.text: 财动初爻，令伯克亲于早

zh: 财动，则伤父母。
如在初爻，则早年见克。
如李密生孩六月，其父即丧。
yi: 财爻动，就伤到父母（父母爻）。
如果在初爻，就在早年受克。
就像李密才生下六个月，他的父亲就去世了。
en: Wealth moving harms the parents, the Resource line.
If it is on the first line, the harm comes in early years.
As when Li Mi was six months old and his father died.

zh: 兄兴六位，张瞻丧偶于中年。
yi: 兄弟爻在六爻上兴旺发动，像张瞻那样，中年丧偶。
en: A Peer line flourishing on the sixth line: like Zhang Zhan, a spouse is lost in middle age.

hits.text: 兄兴六位，张瞻丧偶于中年

zh: 兄动，则克妻财。
如居六位，中年必如张瞻之克妻也。
yi: 兄弟爻动，就克妻财。
如果在六爻上，中年一定像张瞻那样克妻。
en: A Peer line moving controls Wealth, the wife.
If it is on the sixth line, in middle age the wife is surely harmed, as with Zhang Zhan.

zh: 财动伤父母，兄动则克妻财。
yi: 财爻动伤父母，兄弟爻动就克妻财。
en: Wealth moving harms the parents, the Resource line; a Peer line moving controls Wealth, the wife.

zh: 青龙乃喜悦慈善之神，子孙又清吉之神。
若财临青龙，化子，或子临青龙动来生助者，必主其妇慈祥恺悌，淑善贤德。
如孟母也。
yi: 青龙是喜悦慈善的神，子孙又是清吉的神。
如果财爻临青龙、化出子孙，或者子孙临青龙、动来生助，一定主这个妇人慈祥和乐、淑善贤德。
就像孟母。
en: The Azure Dragon is a spirit of joy and kindness, and Output is a clean and lucky spirit.
If the Wealth line sits on the Azure Dragon and changes into Output, or Output sits on the Azure Dragon and moves to generate and support it, the woman is surely gentle, kind, good and virtuous.
Like Mencius' mother.

zh: 青龙主仁慈，子孙主清正，若财临青龙化子，或子临青龙生财，其妇自慈祥恺悌，贤德如孟母也。
yi: 青龙主仁慈，子孙主清正，如果财爻临青龙化子孙，或者子孙临青龙生财，这个妇人自然慈祥和乐，贤德像孟母。
en: The Azure Dragon stands for benevolence and Output for uprightness; if the Wealth line sits on the Azure Dragon and changes into Output, or Output sits on the Azure Dragon and generates Wealth, the woman is naturally gentle and kind, her virtue like Mencius' mother's.

title: 逢龙而化败兄，蔡琰聪明而失节：财遇青龙本主聪明，但不宜化出兄爻及败爻，皆主不贞洁；化出刑爻、病爻、害爻及玄武同临亦然

rule.yi: 财爻遇到青龙，本来主聪明，但是不宜化出兄弟爻，也不宜化出败爻（沐浴之类），那样都主不贞洁，还兼不长寿。化出刑爻、病爻、害爻，以及玄武同临的，也是这样。像蔡琰，文章冠绝一时，却在胡人那里失了节。
rule.en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means cleverness in itself, but it should not change out into a Peer line or into a ruined stage such as the Bath; either means she is not chaste, and short-lived besides. The same for changing out into a punishing, sick or harming line, and for the Dark Tortoise sitting with it. Like Cai Yan, whose writing surpassed all others of her time and who lost her chastity among the barbarians.

note.yi: 「败」指十二长生里衰败的几位，卜筮正宗举的是沐浴。蔡琰（文姬）是蔡邕的女儿，被匈奴掳去，嫁给匈奴左贤王，后来被曹操赎回。
note.en: 'Ruined' means the falling stages of the twelve life stages, of which the Zhengzong names the Bath. Cai Yan (Wenji) was the daughter of Cai Yong; she was carried off by the Xiongnu and married to a Xiongnu prince, and was later ransomed by Cao Cao.

en: Meeting the Azure Dragon yet changing into a ruined Peer line: like Cai Yan of Han, clever but losing her chastity;

en: Wealth meeting the Azure Dragon means cleverness in itself, but if it changes out into a Peer line or the Bath stage, she is not chaste and short-lived besides, like Cai Yan, whose writing was without equal and who lost her chastity among the barbarians.

title: 化子而生身世，鲁伯姬贤德无疵：财动化出子孙、生合世身，必有懿德；占妇人身命以财爻为主，不以应世作其身

rule.yi: 财爻动、化出子孙，生合世爻和卦身的，这个妇人一定有美德，言行都好，没有可挑剔的，像鲁国的伯姬。凡是占（妇人）的身命，要以财爻为主，不能拿应爻、世爻当作她本人。
rule.en: If the Wealth line moves, changes out into Output and generates or combines with the Self line and the Body, the woman surely has fine virtue, good in word and deed and beyond reproach, like Bo Ji of Lu. In divining a (woman's) person, take the Wealth line as the main sign; the Other and Self lines are not to be taken as the person.

note.yi: 鲁国的伯姬是鲁宣公的女儿、嫁给宋共公，《春秋》记她宋国宫中失火时守礼不肯夜出，被烧死；书里说她是「鲁庄公夫人」，与史书不合，译文照书。
note.en: Bo Ji of Lu was a daughter of Duke Xuan of Lu, married to Duke Gong of Song; the Spring and Autumn Annals record that when fire broke out in the Song palace she kept to propriety and would not leave in the night, and was burned to death. The book calls her the wife of Duke Zhuang of Lu, which does not agree with the histories, and the translation follows the book.

zh: 化子而生身世，鲁伯姬贤德无疵。

en: Changing into Output that generates the Self and Body: virtue like Bo Ji of Lu, without a flaw.

title: 合而遇空，窦二女不辱于盗贼：他爻动来合、或咸池玄武动来克合，若财爻落空避之，是彼欲淫我而我不愿，宁死不受辱

rule.en: If another line moves to combine with it in the hexagram, or the Xianchi star or the Dark Tortoise moves to control the combination, it is not a good sign in itself; but if the Wealth line falls into Void and avoids it, it is the picture of the other wanting to defile me and my being unwilling, like the two daughters of the Dou family at Fengtian in Tang, seized by bandits, who leapt off a cliff rather than be shamed.

title: 静而冲动，卓文君投奔于相如：咸池玄武刑害等杀临持财爻，休囚不动或落空亡则无事，被日辰动爻冲动则夜奔

rule.en: If ill stars such as the Xianchi star, the Dark Tortoise, punishment and harm sit on the Wealth line, then if it is resting and still or falls into Void it is probably safe; but if the Day or a moving line clashes and stirs it, she is like Zhuo Wenjun, whom Sima Xiangru stirred with the zither: her heart moves, and she cannot but elope to Xiangru by night, and later sell wine at the counter.

note.yi: 卓文君是卓王孙的女儿，新寡，听司马相如弹琴，夜里私奔与他成亲，后来在临邛开酒店，自己站柜卖酒。
note.en: Zhuo Wenjun was Zhuo Wangsun's daughter, newly widowed; hearing Sima Xiangru play the zither she eloped with him by night and married him, and later they kept a wine shop at Linqiong where she herself stood at the counter.

zh: 静而冲动，卓文君投奔于相如。

zh: 咸池玄武持财，若衰空不动者无碍，若日辰动爻冲之，如相如以琴挑动，卓文君夜奔相如，后当炉卖酒。

title: 福引刑爻发动，卫共姜作誓于柏舟：子孙带刑旺动必克夫；但子孙是贞洁之神，财不值凶者主守节

rule.yi: 子孙带刑、旺相发动，一定克丈夫；但子孙是贞洁的神，遇到这样的爻而财爻不逢凶的，主守节（守寡不改嫁），像卫国的共姜作《柏舟》诗，以死自誓。
rule.en: Output carrying punishment and moving on strength surely harms the husband; but Output is a spirit of chastity, and if with such a line the Wealth line does not meet ill, it means keeping faith (a widow not remarrying), like Gong Jiang of Wei, who wrote the poem 'Cypress Boat' and swore by death.

note.yi: 《诗经·鄘风·柏舟》据《毛诗序》是卫世子共伯的妻子共姜在丈夫早死后、拒绝父母要她改嫁而作。「福」指子孙爻。
note.en: According to the Mao Preface, the 'Cypress Boat' of the Odes (Yong Feng) was written by Gong Jiang, wife of the Wei crown prince Gong Bo, after her husband's early death, when she refused her parents' wish that she marry again. 'Fortune' here means the Output line.

en: Output strong and moving means harm to the husband, but Output is a spirit of chastity and means keeping faith, like Gong Jiang of Wei, who wrote the poem 'Cypress Boat' and swore by death.

title: 身遭化鬼克刑，班婕妤感伤乎秋扇：卦中官与身世相生合，又化官来克制身世及财爻，先亲爱后弃绝

rule.yi: 卦里本来有官鬼，和世爻、卦身相生相合，又化出官鬼来克制世爻、卦身和财爻。断法是动爻为开始，变爻为结局，主先亲爱、后疏绝，像汉朝的班婕妤对汉武帝，起初宠爱，后来疏远；所以看到秋天的扇子而感伤作词，寄托她凄楚的心情。
rule.en: If the hexagram has Pressure from the start, generating and combining with the Self line and the Body, and then changes into Pressure that controls the Self, the Body and the Wealth line, then, since the moving line is the start and the changed line the end, it shows close affection first and rejection after, like Ban Jieyu of Han and the emperor, favored at first and later cast off; hence she wrote a poem in sorrow at seeing the autumn fan, giving voice to her bitter feelings.

note.yi: 班婕妤是汉成帝的妃子，失宠后作《怨歌行》，以秋天被收起的团扇自比。卜筮大全说「汉武帝」，卜筮正宗说「汉成帝」，史实是成帝；译文各照原书。
note.en: Ban Jieyu was a consort of Emperor Cheng of Han; after losing favor she wrote the 'Song of Resentment', likening herself to a round fan put away in autumn. The Quanshu says 'Emperor Wu of Han' and the Zhengzong 'Emperor Cheng of Han'; the emperor in history is Cheng, and each translation follows its own book.

zh: 身遭化鬼克刑，班婕妤感伤乎秋扇。
yi: 卦身遭遇化出官鬼来克制刑伤，班婕妤看着秋天的扇子感伤；
en: The Body meeting a change into Pressure that controls and punishes it: Ban Jieyu grieved at the autumn fan;

hits.text: 身遭化鬼克刑，班婕好感伤于秋扇
身遭化鬼克刑，班婕妤感伤乎秋扇

zh: 卦中原有官，与身世相生合，又化官，却来克制身世，及财爻。
占法以动爻为始，变爻为终。

占法是以动爻为开始，变爻为结局。
主先亲爱、后弃绝的样子。
就像汉朝班婕妤对汉武帝，起初亲爱，后来疏远断绝。
所以看见秋天的扇子而感伤作词，寄托她凄楚的心情。

The method is to take the moving line as the start and the changed line as the end.
It shows close affection first and rejection after.
Like Ban Jieyu of Han with the emperor Wu, close at first and later estranged and cut off.
So seeing the autumn fan she grieved and wrote a poem, giving voice to her bitter feelings.

zh: 如卦象六合而世爻化官鬼刑克，以动爻为始，以变爻为终，如汉班姬于成帝始亲爱后疏远，所以见秋扇而感伤，作词以寓其凄楚之意。
yi: 比如卦象六合，而世爻化出官鬼刑克，以动爻为开始，以变爻为结局，像汉朝班婕妤对汉成帝，起初亲爱、后来疏远，所以看见秋天的扇子感伤，作词寄托她凄楚的心意。
en: For example a hexagram of Six-combine in which the Self line changes into a punishing, controlling Pressure line: taking the moving line as the start and the changed line as the end, it is like Ban Jieyu of Han with the emperor Cheng, close at first and later estranged, so that seeing the autumn fan she grieved and wrote a poem giving voice to her bitter feelings.

title: 二鬼争权水父冲，钱玉莲逢汝权于江浒：二鬼发动都来生合财爻，又遇水父来冲，财爻落空避之，主两夫争权、父母逼勒，而己有守节之操

rule.yi: 卦里如果有两个官鬼都发动，都来生合财爻，又遇到属水的父母爻来刑冲克害，财爻落在空亡里避开的，一定是两个男人争夺她、父母逼迫她的样子；而她自己有守节的节操，所以躲进空亡。像孙汝权对钱玉莲。
rule.en: If two Pressure lines in the hexagram both move and both generate and combine with the Wealth line, and a Resource line of Water comes to punish, clash and control it, with the Wealth line falling into Void to avoid it, it is the picture of two men contending for her and her parents forcing her; she herself holds to her chastity and so hides in Void. Like Sun Ruquan and Qian Yulian.

note.yi: 钱玉莲、孙汝权出自《荆钗记》：钱玉莲嫁王十朋，孙汝权是想夺她的富家子，后来她被逼改嫁、投江。这里只用它说两男争一女、女子守节的情形。
note.en: Qian Yulian and Sun Ruquan are from the play Jingchai Ji: Qian Yulian married Wang Shipeng, and Sun Ruquan was the rich young man who wanted to take her; she was later pressed to marry again and threw herself into the river. It is used here only for two men contending over one woman and the woman keeping faith.

title: 六爻竞合阴财动，秦弱兰遇陶谷于邮亭：男带合聪明俊秀，女带合浇浮淫佚；六合卦而财爻属阴，不动犹可，动则淫滥无耻

rule.yi: 男子卦带合，聪明俊秀；女子卦带合，轻浮淫乱。要是六合卦而财爻又属阴，不动还算可以，一动就淫滥无耻，像秦弱兰在驿亭遇到陶学士。（卜筮正宗补充：财爻和世爻相合的，不能这样断；女人自己占卦，世爻就是她自己，发动去合别的爻也这样断。）
rule.en: A man's hexagram with combination is clever and handsome; a woman's with combination is frivolous and lewd. If the hexagram is a Six-combine and the Wealth line is yin, then still it is passable, but moving it is dissolute and shameless, like Qin Ruolan meeting Scholar Tao at the post pavilion. (The Zhengzong adds: where the Wealth line combines with the Self line one must not judge so; when a woman divines for herself the Self line is herself, and moving to combine with another line is judged the same.)

note.yi: 陶谷是宋初出使南唐的使臣，自命端方，南唐派官妓秦弱兰扮作驿卒之女，在驿亭里勾住了他。「邮亭」就是驿亭。
note.en: Tao Gu was an envoy of early Song to the Southern Tang who prided himself on his uprightness; the Southern Tang sent the courtesan Qin Ruolan, disguised as a courier's daughter, and she caught him at the post pavilion. 'Youting' is the post pavilion.

title: 鬼弱而未获生扶，朱淑贞良人愚蠢：女人身命以鬼为夫星，不宜空亡、不宜动、不宜衰弱；衰弱无生扶又带勾陈螣蛇，夫愚蒙不正

rule.yi: 看女人的身命，以官鬼为夫星。夫星不宜空亡，空亡就难做丈夫；又不宜发动，发动就为难兄弟（克伤兄弟爻）；也不宜衰弱，弱就招来不成器的丈夫、发不了福。要是衰弱又得不到一点生扶合助，还带勾陈、螣蛇这些凶神，一定像朱淑真的丈夫，愚昧不正、人又矮小，所以她才有断肠的诗。
rule.en: In reading a woman's person, Pressure is the husband star. It should not be Void, for Void makes it hard for him to be a husband; it should not move, for moving is hard on the brothers (Pressure controls the Peer line); and it should not be weak, for weak brings a worthless husband who cannot bring fortune. If it is weak with no support or help at all and carries Hook Earth, the Coiling Snake or another ill spirit, the husband is surely like Zhu Shuzhen's: stupid, improper and stunted, and that is why she wrote her heartbroken poems.

note.yi: 朱淑真是南宋女词人，嫁给不相称的丈夫，郁郁而终，诗集叫《断肠集》。卜筮大全作「朱淑贞」「侏儒」。「动则难为兄弟」按官鬼克兄弟爻来读（官鬼发动伤克兄弟，见 LY.MARRY.DYTJ.11）。这一条是「女占夫」的一般规则，和婚姻章里女占男的说法可以合着读（LY.MARRY.HJC.22）。
note.en: Zhu Shuzhen was a Southern Song woman poet married to an ill-matched husband who died unhappy; her collection is called 'Heartbroken Poems'. The Quanshu writes 'Zhu Shuzhen' and 'dwarf'. 'Moving makes it hard on the brothers' is read as Pressure controlling the Peer line (a moving Pressure line injures the Peer line, LY.MARRY.DYTJ.11). This is the general rule for a woman divining about a husband and can be read together with what the marriage chapter says of a woman divining about a man (LY.MARRY.HJC.22).

title: 官强而又连龙福，吴孟子夫主贤明：鬼爻旺相更逢青龙福德、禄马贵人，主有贵显贤明之夫；衰而逢助亦有贤明之夫

rule.yi: 官鬼爻旺相，又碰上青龙、福德、禄马、贵人这些吉神，一定有显贵贤明的丈夫，像吴孟子嫁给鲁昭公；官鬼衰弱但得到生扶，也有贤明的丈夫。
rule.en: If the Pressure line is strong and also meets lucky spirits such as the Azure Dragon, Output, the Emolument and Horse stars and the Noble, she surely has an eminent, wise husband, like Wu Mengzi who married Duke Zhao of Lu; if Pressure is weak but supported, she also has a wise husband.

note.yi: 吴孟子是鲁昭公的夫人，吴国人，姓姬，因同姓不婚才不称「吴姬」而称「孟子」。卜筮正宗的「临量」疑是「临旺」之误，译文按「强」并照旺相解。
note.en: Wu Mengzi was the wife of Duke Zhao of Lu, from the state of Wu; she was of the Ji surname, and because marriage within a surname was avoided she was called 'Mengzi' and not 'Wu Ji'. The Zhengzong's 'lin liang' looks like a slip for 'lin wang' (sitting on strength), and is taken as 'strong'.

title: 子死妻空，绝俗离尘之辈：占身以福为子、财为妻，二爻临死墓绝空之地是刑妻丧子之兆，小儿见之出家，僧道见之反吉

rule.yi: 占身命，子孙爻是儿子，财爻是妻子。这两个爻如果落在死、墓、绝、空的地方，是刑妻丧子的征兆。小孩子见到这种卦，一定超脱世俗、出家；僧人道士见到反而是吉兆，没有世俗的牵累。
rule.en: In divining one's person, the Output line is the son and the Wealth line the wife. If these two lines fall into Death, Tomb, Extinction or Void, it is the sign of a wife punished and a son lost. A child meeting this will surely leave the world and become a monk or nun; a monk or Taoist meeting it finds it lucky, with no worldly ties to hold him.
