a marriage was divined and Dui changing into Jie was obtained;
the hexagram, though a Six-clash,
had the Day and Month combining Self and Other,
and it changed into a Six-combine;
it was judged contrary at the start and fulfilled at the end,
and afterwards the two families did come together.

title: 助鬼伤身而占身命：认祸为福、比匪为良，因财丧身、贪色亡命，妻妾不贤而归夫咎

rule.yi: 助鬼伤身（世爻被鬼克，而鬼又在日辰上长生，是自己引来祸害）的格局，占身命时：把祸当成福，把匪类当成好人；为钱财送了性命，贪恋女色丢了命；妻妾不贤，过错却归到丈夫身上；奴仆放肆忤逆，连累主人遭殃。注文的理由是：财是利，鬼是害，天下的害都藏在利里面。
rule.en: With the pattern of 'helping Pressure to harm Self' (the Self line is controlled by Pressure while Pressure is in its birth state on the Day, so the person draws the harm on himself), in a reading of life and fate: he takes harm for fortune and wrong company for good; he loses his body for wealth and his life through lust; his wife and concubines are unworthy and yet the blame comes back to the husband; his servants are unruly and bring disaster on the master. The note gives the reason: Wealth is profit, Pressure is harm, and all the harms under heaven lie hidden in profit.

note.yi: 「助鬼伤身」的定义在这一章开头（LY.MARRY.YM.02 引过第 614 行）。这一句是替问自己命的人断的，其中讲夫妻的只有「妻妾不贤而归夫咎」一句；同一章第 620 行讲「娶妇则主妇不贤」，也在 LY.MARRY.YM.02 里。「比匪」出自《易·比》「比之匪人」，是亲近了不该亲近的人。
note.en: The definition of 'helping Pressure to harm Self' is at the head of this chapter (line 614, quoted in LY.MARRY.YM.02). This sentence judges for a person asking about his own fate, and only 'his wife and concubines are unworthy and the blame comes back to the husband' concerns husband and wife; line 620 of the same chapter, 'for taking a wife it means the wife is unworthy', is also in LY.MARRY.YM.02. 'Wrong company' is from the Book of Changes, Bi, 'befriending the wrong people', getting close to people one should not.

zh: 占身命者认祸为福，
比匪为良，
因财丧身，
贪色亡命，
妻妾不贤而归夫咎，
奴仆肆逆而累主殃。
yi: 占身命的人，把祸当成福，
把匪类当成好人，
因为钱财送了性命，
贪恋女色丢了命；
妻妾不贤，过错却归到丈夫身上，
奴仆放肆忤逆，连累主人遭殃。
en: One who divines his own fate takes harm for fortune,
takes wrong company for good company,
loses his body for the sake of wealth,
and ruins his life through lust;
his wife and concubines are unworthy, yet the blame comes back to the husband,
his servants are unruly and rebellious and bring disaster on the master.

zh: 以财为利，
以鬼为害，
天下之害皆伏于利，
理固然也。
yi: 把财当成利，
把鬼当成害，
天下的害都藏在利里面，
道理本来就是这样。
en: Taking Wealth as profit
and Pressure as harm,
all the harms under heaven lie hidden in profit;
that is simply the way it is.

title: 问妻而忌财陷，不能拿世空去断

rule.yi: 为自己问「道」，怕的是六冲；问妻子，怕的是妻财陷落；这两种问法，都不能拿世爻落空去断。
rule.en: In asking about the Way the taboo is the six-clash; in asking about a wife the taboo is a sunken Wealth line; in neither is a Void Self line to be made the ground of judgment.

note.yi: 这一句紧跟在「问富贵先看世象生旺，世空无成」之后，是转折：富贵要世爻旺，问道和问妻却不能因为世空就断坏。「财陷」书里在这里没有定义。
note.en: This sentence follows straight after 'in asking about wealth and rank look first at whether the Self line is strong, and a Void Self means nothing is achieved', and turns from it: wealth and rank need a strong Self, but in asking about the Way or a wife one cannot judge it bad merely because Self is Void. The book does not define 'sunken' here.

zh: 且问道而忌六冲，
问妻而忌财陷，
皆不可以世空也。
yi: 而且问「道」，忌讳六冲，
问妻子，忌讳妻财陷落，
这些都不能拿世爻落空去断。
en: Moreover, in asking about the Way the taboo is the six-clash,
in asking about a wife the taboo is a sunken Wealth line,
and in none of these is a Void Self line to be made the ground of judgment.

title: 防害以鬼为端：以婚姻淫乐而兆殃者，青龙之鬼发也

rule.yi: 戒防章里总说防祸害以官鬼为开端：因为言语音信出祸的，是朱雀临着的官鬼发动；因为婚姻、淫乐而预兆祸殃的，是青龙临着的官鬼发动。
rule.en: The chapter on precautions says that in guarding against harm Pressure is where to begin: where harm comes through words and messages, it is the Pressure line on the Vermilion Bird moving; where disaster is foretold through marriage and lustful pleasure, it is the Pressure line on the Azure Dragon moving.

note.yi: 这一句在戒防章开头，讲各种祸害由哪个六神临着的官鬼发动来。它把「婚姻」和「淫乐」放在一起，说的是因婚姻和淫乐的事出祸，不是说婚姻本身是祸；紧接着的一句讲勾陈、螣蛇、玄武、白虎各主什么祸，不属婚姻，没有收。
note.en: This sentence stands at the head of the chapter on precautions and tells which six-spirit's Pressure line, moving, brings which kind of harm. It puts 'marriage' and 'lustful pleasure' together and speaks of harm coming through matters of marriage and pleasure, not of marriage itself as a harm; the sentence that follows, on what harm the Hook Earth, Coiling Snake, Dark Tortoise and White Tiger each bring, is not about marriage and is not taken.

zh: 概言防害，
以鬼为端。
以言语音信而产祸者，
朱雀之鬼发也；
以婚姻淫乐而兆殃者，
青龙之鬼发也；
yi: 总的说来，防祸害，
以官鬼为开端。
因为言语音信而出祸事的，
是朱雀临着的官鬼发动；
因为婚姻、淫乐而预兆祸殃的，
是青龙临着的官鬼发动；
en: In general, in guarding against harm,
Pressure is where to begin.
Where harm comes through words and messages,
it is the Pressure line on the Vermilion Bird moving;
where disaster is foretold through marriage and lustful pleasure,
it is the Pressure line on the Azure Dragon moving;

title: 筮室家用妻财、仆妾同焉；丈夫用官，良朋用应，不可错审

rule.yi: 身命章里列各种人用什么爻：占家室（妻子）用妻财爻，仆人、妾也是一样；丈夫用官鬼爻，好朋友用应爻，不可以看错了。
rule.en: The chapter on life and fate lists which line stands for whom: divining the household (the wife) uses the Wealth line, and servants and concubines are the same; a husband uses the Pressure line, a good friend the Other line, and one must not judge it wrongly.

note.yi: 中间隔着的一句「筮手足而用于弟兄，宗娣同焉」讲兄弟姐妹，与婚姻无关，没有收。这里的「丈夫用官」和婚姻章开头的规矩（LY.MARRY.YM.01）是一回事，只是在这里多了一句「仆妾同焉」：仆人和妾也看妻财爻。
note.en: The sentence in between, 'divining brothers and sisters uses the Peer line, clan kin the same', concerns siblings and not marriage, and is not taken. 'A husband uses Pressure' here is the same rule as at the head of the marriage chapter (LY.MARRY.YM.01); what this adds is 'servants and concubines the same': servants and concubines are also read from the Wealth line.

zh: 筮室家而用于妻财，
仆妾同焉；
yi: 占家室（妻子）用妻财爻，
仆人、妾也是一样；
en: Divining the household (the wife) uses the Wealth line,
and servants and concubines are the same;

zh: 丈夫用官，
良朋用应，
而不可错审也。
yi: 丈夫用官鬼爻，
好朋友用应爻，
不可以看错了。
en: for a husband use the Pressure line,
for a good friend use the Other line,
and one must not judge it wrongly.

title: 婚姻是人道之始，占之不可不慎：先占门第、德行、性情容貌、子嗣，再占入门吉凶、聘奁厚薄，然后占成否；无媒不成，媒也要占

rule.yi: 婚姻是做人的头一件大事，占它不能不慎重。求婚总是男方先开口，所以挑妻子的这一占尤其要慎重。占的次序：先占门第、德行、性情容貌、有没有子嗣，再占入门以后的吉凶、聘礼和嫁妆的厚薄，然后才占成不成；没有媒人就得不到，所以媒人（月老）也要占。鬼谷的分爻法把爻对到：祖宗、父母、外氏、婿、妇、媒妁、自身。
rule.en: Marriage is the first business of human life, and its divination must not be undertaken carelessly. It is always the man's side that seeks first, so the divination for choosing a wife calls for still more care. The order of divining: first her family standing, virtue, nature and looks, and whether there will be children; then the good or ill of her entering the house and the richness of the betrothal gifts and dowry; only then whether the marriage will be made. Without a go-between it cannot be had, so the go-between (the Old Man under the Moon) must be divined too. Guiguzi's division of the lines assigns them to: ancestors, parents, the mother's family, the son-in-law, the wife, the go-between and oneself.

note.yi: 「鬼谷分爻」下面只列了七个名目（祖宗、父母、外氏、婿、妇、媒妁、自身），没有说各对哪一爻，七个名目也多于六个爻；译文照录名单，没有替它排位。
note.en: Under 'Guiguzi's division of the lines' the text lists only seven names, without saying which line each belongs to, and seven names outnumber the six lines; the list is translated as it stands without assigning positions.

zh: 游南子曰，婚姻人道之始事，是不可不慎其占也。
然婚姻之求，必先于男，故择妇之占，尤当慎之。
占其门第，占其德行，占其性情容貌，及子嗣之有无。
入门之吉凶，聘奁之厚薄，而后占其婚姻之成否也。
然而匪媒不得，则月老亦不可以不占也。
yi: 游南子说：婚姻是人道的开头一件事，所以占它不能不谨慎。
但求婚总是男方先开口，所以挑选妻子这一占，更要慎重。
要占她的门第，占她的德行，占她的性情容貌，以及有没有子嗣。
再占入门以后的吉凶、聘礼和嫁妆的厚薄，然后才占婚姻成不成。
但是没有媒人就得不到，所以月老（媒人）也不能不占。
en: Master Younan says: marriage is the first business of human life, so its divination must not be undertaken carelessly.
But it is always the man's side that seeks first, so the divination for choosing a wife calls for still more care.
Divine her family standing, her virtue, her nature and looks, and whether there will be children.
Then divine the good or ill of her entering the house and the richness of the betrothal gifts and dowry, and only then divine whether the marriage will be made.
But without a go-between it cannot be had, so the Old Man under the Moon, the go-between, must also be divined.

zh: 鬼谷分爻祖宗父母外氏婿妇媒妁自身
yi: 鬼谷分爻：祖宗、父母、外氏、婿、妇、媒妁、自身。
en: Guiguzi's division of the lines: ancestors, parents, the mother's family, the son-in-law, the wife, the go-between, oneself.

title: 门第：内卦世爻旺男家富，外卦应爻旺女家富；应临贵马德合不空破克伤者贵；应财衰而外卦旺富止虚名，应财旺而外卦衰家窘而女有德色

rule.yi: 内卦的世爻旺，男方家里富；外卦的应爻旺，女方家里富。应爻带贵人、驿马、德神和合，又不空、不破、不受克伤的，显贵；月建旺、日辰衰的，近几年在走下坡。应爻、财爻衰而外卦旺，富只是虚名；应爻、财爻旺而外卦衰，家里窘迫，但女儿有德有容色。富贵贫贱另见身命占，德行性情容貌另见妻妾一类，这里不重复。
rule.en: With the Self line in the inner trigram strong, the man's family is rich; with the Other line in the outer trigram strong, the woman's family is rich. If the Other line carries the Nobleman, the Post Horse, Virtue and a combination, and is not Void, broken, controlled or harmed, the family is eminent; strong in the Month but weak in the Day, it has declined in recent years. With the Other and Wealth lines weak but the outer trigram strong, the wealth is only a name; with the Other and Wealth lines strong but the outer trigram weak, the family is straitened but the daughter has virtue and beauty. Wealth, rank, poverty and lowliness are treated in the divination of one's person and fate, and virtue, nature and looks in the section on wives and concubines, so they are not repeated here.

zh: 内卦世爻旺，男家富。
外卦应爻旺，女家富。
应临贵马德合，不空破克伤者贵。
逢月旺日衰者，近年退也。
应爻财爻衰，而外卦旺，富止虚名。
应爻财爻旺，而外卦衰，家窘而女有德色也。
凡富贵贫贱，俱见身命占。
德行性情容貌，俱见妻妾类中，故不复赘。
yi: 内卦世爻旺，男方家里富。
外卦应爻旺，女方家里富。
应爻带贵人、驿马、德神，又相合，不空、不破、不受克伤的，显贵。
逢月建旺、日辰衰的，近几年在走下坡。
应爻、财爻衰，而外卦旺，富只是虚名。
应爻、财爻旺，而外卦衰，家里窘迫但女儿有德行、有容色。
凡是富贵贫贱，都见身命占。
德行、性情、容貌，都见妻妾一类的章节里，所以这里不再重复。
en: With the Self line in the inner trigram strong, the man's family is rich.
With the Other line in the outer trigram strong, the woman's family is rich.
With the Other line carrying the Nobleman, the Post Horse and Virtue, and in combination, and not Void, broken, controlled or harmed, the family is eminent.
If it is strong in the Month but weak in the Day, the family has declined in recent years.
With the Other and Wealth lines weak but the outer trigram strong, the wealth is only a name.
With the Other and Wealth lines strong but the outer trigram weak, the family is straitened but the daughter has virtue and beauty.
Wealth, rank, poverty and lowliness are all found in the divination of one's person and fate.
Virtue, nature and looks are all found in the section on wives and concubines, so they are not repeated here.

title: 子息：卦无子孙、子孙空绝破、财带孤寡天狗杀动、卦纯阳纯阴俱主无子；子孙胎爻两备有子；子化鬼头胎难招（水一火二木三金四土五）；子之多少以一水二火三木四金五土推

rule.yi: 没有子孙爻，或子孙爻逢空、绝、破，或财爻带孤寡、天狗煞而动，或卦是纯阳、纯阴，都主不生育、没有儿子。子孙爻和胎爻两样齐备的，有儿子；子孙变鬼，或胎爻临在父母爻上，有儿子也难留住；有胎爻没有子孙爻，怀了孕养不成；有子孙爻没有胎爻，是庶出或过继来的。子孙在阳爻多男，在阴爻多女。水的子孙变鬼，头胎难留；火的，二胎；木的，三胎；金的，四胎；土的，五胎。孩子的多少，按一水、二火、三木、四金、五土的数推：旺相加倍，休囚照数，囚死减半。
rule.en: With no Output line, or the Output line meeting Void, extinction or break, or the Wealth line carrying the Solitary and Widowhood stars and the Heavenly Hound star and moving, or a hexagram of pure yang or pure yin: all mean no childbearing and no son. Where both the Output line and the Womb line are present there is a son; if Output changes into Pressure, or the Womb line is on the Resource line, there is a son but he is hard to keep; with a Womb line but no Output line there is conception but no child is raised; with an Output line but no Womb line the son is a concubine's child or adopted. Output on a yang line means mostly boys, on a yin line mostly girls. A Water Output line changing into Pressure: the first child is hard to keep; Fire, the second; Wood, the third; Metal, the fourth; Earth, the fifth. The number of children is reckoned by one for Water, two for Fire, three for Wood, four for Metal, five for Earth: doubled if strong, as it stands if resting, halved if trapped or dead.

note.yi: 「庶出暝蛉」的「暝蛉」是「螟蛉」（过继的孩子）的写法；「有子难招」的「招」译作「留住」是取上下文。
note.en: 'Ming ling' in 'a concubine's child or adopted' is a variant writing of 'mingling', an adopted child; 'hard to secure' is rendered 'hard to keep' from the context.

zh: 卦无子孙，与子孙逢空绝破，财爻带孤寡，天狗杀动，或卦值纯阳纯阴者，俱主不生育而无子也。
子孙胎爻两备者，有子。
子化鬼，与胎爻临父者，有子难招。
有胎无子者，孕而不育。
有子无胎者，庶出暝蛉。
子值阳多男，值阴多女。
水子化鬼，头胎难招。
火子化鬼，二胎难招。
木子化鬼，三胎难招。
金子化鬼，四胎难招。
土子化鬼，五胎难招。
子之多少，以一水二火三木四金五土推之。
旺相加倍，休如数，囚死减半。
yi: 卦里没有子孙爻，或者子孙爻逢空、绝、破，财爻带孤辰寡宿、天狗煞而动，或者卦是纯阳、纯阴，都主不生育、没有儿子。
子孙爻和胎爻两样齐备的，有儿子。
子孙变成鬼爻，或者胎爻临在父母爻上的，有儿子也难以留住。
有胎爻没有子孙爻的，怀了孕却养不成。
有子孙爻没有胎爻的，是庶出或过继来的孩子。
子孙爻在阳爻上多男，在阴爻上多女。
水的子孙爻变成鬼爻，头胎难留。
火的子孙爻变成鬼爻，二胎难留。
木的子孙爻变成鬼爻，三胎难留。
金的子孙爻变成鬼爻，四胎难留。
土的子孙爻变成鬼爻，五胎难留。
孩子的多少，按一水、二火、三木、四金、五土的数来推。
旺相加倍，休囚照数，囚死减半。
en: If the hexagram has no Output line, or the Output line meets Void, extinction or break, or the Wealth line carries the Solitary and Widowhood stars and the Heavenly Hound star and moves, or the hexagram is pure yang or pure yin, all mean no childbearing and no son.
Where both the Output line and the Womb line are present, there is a son.
Output changing into Pressure, or the Womb line on the Resource line: there is a son, but he is hard to keep.
With a Womb line but no Output line, there is conception but no child is raised.
With an Output line but no Womb line, the son is a concubine's child or adopted.
The Output line on a yang line means mostly boys, on a yin line mostly girls.
A Water Output line changing into Pressure: the first child is hard to keep.
A Fire Output line changing into Pressure: the second child is hard to keep.
A Wood Output line changing into Pressure: the third child is hard to keep.
A Metal Output line changing into Pressure: the fourth child is hard to keep.
An Earth Output line changing into Pressure: the fifth child is hard to keep.
The number of children is reckoned by one for Water, two for Fire, three for Wood, four for Metal, five for Earth.
If strong, double it; if resting, take the number as it stands; if trapped or dead, halve it.

title: 入门：财空绝伤妻、鬼空绝伤夫；财遇刑刃劫杀妻灾、鬼遇则夫厄；财化鬼破妻带病、官化鬼破夫带疾；财动公姑不协，父动卑幼不睦，兄动妻灾，子动夫灾，鬼动妯娌姑嫂不和

rule.yi: 入门以后的吉凶：财爻空、绝，伤妻子；鬼爻空、绝，伤丈夫。财爻遇刑、刃、劫杀，妻子有灾；鬼爻遇刑、刃、劫杀，丈夫有厄。财爻变鬼或破，妻子带病；官爻变鬼或破，丈夫带病。财爻动，公婆不和；父母爻动，晚辈幼辈不睦；兄弟爻动妻子有灾，子孙爻动丈夫有灾；鬼爻动，妯娌姑嫂不和（丑未相冲也是这样）。
rule.en: The good or ill after she enters the house: Wealth Void or extinguished harms the wife; Pressure Void or extinguished harms the husband. Wealth meeting the punishment, blade and robbery stars brings the wife calamity; Pressure meeting them brings the husband distress. Wealth changing into Pressure or a break: the wife carries an illness; Pressure changing into Pressure or a break: the husband carries an illness. When Wealth moves the parents-in-law are at odds; when Resource moves the juniors do not get along; when a Peer line moves the wife has calamity, when Output moves the husband has calamity; when Pressure moves the sisters-in-law are at odds (a Chou-Wei clash is the same).

zh: 财空绝者伤妻，鬼空绝者伤夫。
财遇刑刃劫杀者妻灾，鬼遇刑刃劫杀者夫厄。
财化鬼破者，妻带病。
官化鬼破者，夫带疾。
财动，则公姑不协。
父动则卑幼不睦。
兄动妻灾，子动夫灾。
鬼动则妯娌姑嫂不和。
(丑未相冲亦然)。
yi: 财爻空、绝的伤妻子，鬼爻空、绝的伤丈夫。
财爻遇刑、羊刃、劫杀的，妻子有灾；鬼爻遇刑、羊刃、劫杀的，丈夫有厄。
财爻变成鬼爻或破的，妻子带病。
官爻变成鬼爻或破的，丈夫带病。
财爻动，公婆不和。
父母爻动，晚辈幼辈不和睦。
兄弟爻动妻子有灾，子孙爻动丈夫有灾。
鬼爻动，妯娌、姑嫂不和。
（丑未相冲也是这样）。
en: Wealth Void or extinguished harms the wife; Pressure Void or extinguished harms the husband.
Wealth meeting the punishment, the Goat Blade and the Robbery star brings the wife calamity; Pressure meeting them brings the husband distress.
Wealth changing into Pressure or a break: the wife carries an illness.
Pressure changing into Pressure or a break: the husband carries an illness.
When Wealth moves, the parents-in-law are at odds.
When Resource moves, the juniors do not get along.
When a Peer line moves the wife has calamity; when Output moves the husband has calamity.
When Pressure moves, the sisters-in-law are at odds.
(A Chou-Wei clash is the same.)

title: 子（福）带龙喜德贵持世动妻夺夫权；子持世旺静妻嫌夫、旺动夫遭伤；财持世旺动克公姑；兄持世旺静夫嫌妻、旺动妻遭伤；两鬼旺相而财被刑冲克害必生离改嫁；世应财鬼带刑刃鳏寡杀动夫妻不久

rule.yi: 子孙爻带青龙、喜神、德神、贵人，持世而动，妻子夺丈夫的权；子孙持世，旺而静，妻子必定嫌丈夫；旺而动，丈夫必定遭伤。财爻持世，旺而动，克公婆；兄弟爻持世，旺而静，丈夫嫌妻子；旺而动，妻子遭伤。两个鬼爻旺相，而月建、日辰和动爻刑冲克害财爻的，一定生离改嫁。世应财鬼带刑、刃、鳏寡煞而动，夫妻不长久。
rule.en: The Output line carrying the Azure Dragon, the Joy star, Virtue and the Nobleman, holding the Self line and moving: the wife seizes the husband's authority; Output on the Self line, strong and still: the wife surely dislikes her husband; strong and moving: the husband is surely harmed. The Wealth line on the Self line, strong and moving, harms the parents-in-law; a Peer line on the Self line, strong and still: the husband dislikes his wife; strong and moving: the wife is harmed. Two Pressure lines, strong, while the Month, Day and moving lines punish, clash, control or harm the Wealth line: surely parting alive and remarriage. The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines carrying the punishment, blade and Widower-Widow stars and moving: the couple will not last.

zh: 子带龙喜德贵持世动，妻夺夫权。
子世旺静，妻必嫌夫。
子世旺动，夫必遭伤。
财世旺动者克公姑，兄世旺静者，夫嫌妻。
兄世旺动者，妻遭伤也。
两鬼旺相，而月日与动爻刑冲克害财爻者，必生离改嫁也。
世应财鬼带刑刃鳏寡杀动，夫妻不久。
yi: 子孙爻带青龙、喜神、德神、贵人，持世而动，妻子夺丈夫的权。
子孙爻持世，旺而静，妻子必定嫌丈夫。
子孙爻持世，旺而动，丈夫必定遭伤。
财爻持世，旺而动的，克公婆；兄弟爻持世，旺而静的，丈夫嫌妻子。
兄弟爻持世，旺而动的，妻子遭伤。
两个鬼爻旺相，而月建、日辰和动爻刑冲克害财爻的，一定生离改嫁。
世应财鬼带刑、羊刃、鳏寡煞而动，夫妻不长久。
en: The Output line carrying the Azure Dragon, the Joy star, Virtue and the Nobleman, holding the Self line and moving: the wife seizes the husband's authority.
The Output line on the Self line, strong and still: the wife surely dislikes her husband.
The Output line on the Self line, strong and moving: the husband is surely harmed.
The Wealth line on the Self line, strong and moving, harms the parents-in-law; a Peer line on the Self line, strong and still: the husband dislikes his wife.
A Peer line on the Self line, strong and moving: the wife is harmed.
Two Pressure lines, strong, while the Month, Day and moving lines punish, clash, control or harm the Wealth line: surely parting alive and remarriage.
The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines carrying the punishment, blade and Widower-Widow stars and moving: the couple will not last.

title: 世应生合而财官空绝半世夫妻；合而又生偕老，冲而又克生离；前卦冲变合初乖后睦，合化冲先睦后睽；生合而被日辰动爻冲克因入门不睦；冲克而日辰动爻类合局得人劝复和；阳鬼阴财一卦旺静亲上成亲

rule.yi: 世应相生相合，但财爻、官爻空、绝，只做半辈子夫妻。合中又有生的，白头偕老；冲中又有克的，生离。本卦冲而变卦合，起初不合、后来和睦；本卦合而变冲，先和睦、后乖离。世应财鬼相生相合，但被日辰、动爻冲克，因入了门反而不和睦；世应财鬼冲克，而日辰和动爻合成局面的，得人劝解又和好。阳的鬼爻、阴的财爻，其中一个卦旺而静的，一定是亲上加亲，举案齐眉、白头偕老。
rule.en: The Self and Other lines generating and combining, but Wealth and Pressure Void or extinguished: husband and wife for half a lifetime. A combination with a generation as well: they grow old together; a clash with a control as well: parting alive. A hexagram of clash changing into combination: at odds at first, in harmony later; a hexagram of combination changing into a clash: harmony first, estrangement later. The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generating and combining but clashed and controlled by the Day and moving lines: discord arises because of her entering the house; the same lines clashing and controlling, but the Day and moving lines forming something like a combination frame: with someone's mediation they are reconciled. A yang Pressure line and a yin Wealth line, with one trigram strong and still: surely a match within the family, with mutual respect to the end of their days.

note.yi: 最后一句的「借老」是「偕老」的转录之误；引用原字，译文按「偕老」译。「类合局」的意思原文没有解释，译作「合成局面一类的」。
note.en: 'Jie lao' in the last sentence is a transcription slip for 'xie lao' (grow old together); the character is quoted as it stands and translated accordingly. 'Lei he ju' is not explained and is rendered as 'forming something like a combination frame'.

zh: 世应生合，而财官空绝，半世夫妻。
合而又生者，偕老。
冲而又克者，生离。
前卦冲而变合，初乖后睦。
前卦合而化冲，先睦后睽。
世应财鬼生合，而被日辰动爻冲克，因入门而不睦。
世应财鬼冲克，而日辰与动爻类合局者，得人劝而复和。
阳鬼阴财其一卦旺静者，必亲上成亲，齐眉借老也。
yi: 世应相生相合，但财爻、官爻空、绝，只做半辈子夫妻。
合中又有生的，白头偕老。
冲中又有克的，生离。
本卦冲而变卦合，起初不合、后来和睦。
本卦合而变冲，先和睦、后乖离。
世应财鬼相生相合，但被日辰、动爻冲克，因入了门反而不和睦。
世应财鬼冲克，而日辰和动爻合成局面的，得到人劝解又和好。
阳的鬼爻、阴的财爻，其中一个卦旺而静的，一定是亲上加亲，举案齐眉、白头偕老。
en: The Self and Other lines generating and combining, but Wealth and Pressure Void or extinguished: husband and wife for half a lifetime.
A combination with a generation as well: they grow old together.
A clash with a control as well: parting alive.
A hexagram of clash changing into combination: at odds at first, in harmony later.
A hexagram of combination changing into a clash: harmony first, estrangement later.
The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generating and combining but clashed and controlled by the Day and moving lines: discord arises because of her entering the house.
The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines clashing and controlling, but the Day and moving lines forming something like a combination frame: with someone's mediation they are reconciled.
A yang Pressure line and a yin Wealth line, with one trigram strong and still: surely a match within the family, with mutual respect to the end of their days.

title: 动爻冲克父则尊长不全，冲克财则分离耗财帛奴婢无力，冲克子则无子，冲克兄则姑嫂妯娌兄弟不睦，冲克鬼则不利丈夫

rule.yi: 动爻冲克父母爻，尊长不齐全；冲克财爻，分离、耗财物，奴婢不得力；冲克子孙爻，没有子，有也不多；冲克兄弟爻，姑嫂、妯娌、兄弟不和睦；冲克鬼爻，不利于丈夫。
rule.en: A moving line clashing with and controlling the Resource line: the elders are not all present; Wealth: separation, loss of money and servants of no help; Output: no son, or not many if there are any; a Peer line: the sisters-in-law and brothers are at odds; Pressure: bad for the husband.

zh: 动爻冲克父，尊长不全也。
动爻冲克财，主分离耗财帛，奴婢无力也。
动爻冲克子，主无子，有亦不多也。
动爻冲克兄，姑嫂妯娌兄弟不睦也。
动爻冲克鬼，不利丈夫也。
yi: 动爻冲克父母爻，尊长不齐全。
动爻冲克财爻，主分离、耗财物，奴婢不得力。
动爻冲克子孙爻，主没有子，有也不多。
动爻冲克兄弟爻，姑嫂、妯娌、兄弟不和睦。
动爻冲克鬼爻，不利于丈夫。
en: A moving line clashing with and controlling the Resource line: the elders are not all present.
A moving line clashing with and controlling Wealth: separation, loss of money, and servants who are of no help.
A moving line clashing with and controlling Output: no son, or not many if there are any.
A moving line clashing with and controlling a Peer line: the sisters-in-law and the brothers (Peer) are at odds.
A moving line clashing with and controlling Pressure: bad for the husband.

title: 鬼动化财者女不妨夫必再嫁，财动化鬼者男不妨妻必再婚；卜娶遇两财者停妻再娶，卜嫁逢两鬼者抛夫改嫁；官鬼动者夫朝东暮西

rule.yi: 鬼爻动而变成财爻的，女子不妨害丈夫，但必定再嫁；财爻动而变成鬼爻的，男子不妨害妻子，但必定再婚。占娶妻遇到两个财爻的，停了妻再娶；占出嫁逢到两个鬼爻的，抛开丈夫改嫁。官鬼爻动的，丈夫一定朝东暮西，不定。
rule.en: Pressure moving and changing into Wealth: the woman does not harm her husband but will surely marry again; Wealth moving and changing into Pressure: the man does not harm his wife but will surely marry again. Divining a marriage and meeting two Wealth lines: he sets aside his wife and marries again; divining a bride's marriage and meeting two Pressure lines: she leaves her husband and remarries. When Pressure moves, the husband is surely changeable, east in the morning and west at night.

zh: 鬼动化财者，女不妨夫必再嫁。
财动化鬼者，男不妨妻必再婚。
卜娶而遇两财者，停妻再娶。
卜嫁而逢两鬼者，抛夫改嫁。
官鬼动者，夫必朝东而暮西也。
yi: 鬼爻动化成财爻的，女子不妨害丈夫，但必定再嫁。
财爻动化成鬼爻的，男子不妨害妻子，但必定再婚。
占娶妻而遇到两个财爻的，停了妻再娶。
占出嫁而逢到两个鬼爻的，抛开丈夫改嫁。
官鬼爻动的，丈夫一定朝东暮西。
en: Pressure moving and changing into Wealth: the woman does not harm her husband but will surely marry again.
Wealth moving and changing into Pressure: the man does not harm his wife but will surely marry again.
Divining a marriage and meeting two Wealth lines: he sets aside his wife and marries again.
Divining a bride's marriage and meeting two Pressure lines: she leaves her husband and remarries.
When Pressure moves, the husband is surely changeable, east in the morning and west at night.

zh: 己丑年丁卯月甲戌旬戊寅日，女占姻，得剥之观。
本宫寅财，伏巳火鬼干，又居应上，乃有夫之妇。
寅巳相刑，必夫妻不睦，而欲改嫁也。
又本宫寅财，与午鬼相生合，决是与人私通，而欲嫁之也。
但世上申兄动冲寅财，必有人破其妇。
世上傍爻，子孙动冲午鬼，必有人破其夫。
况午鬼伏墓戌土之下，世应相冲刑克，必不成也。
yi: 己丑年丁卯月甲戌旬戊寅日，一位女子占婚事，得剥卦变观卦。
本宫的寅木财爻，下面伏着巳火鬼爻，又在应爻上，是有丈夫的妇人。
寅和巳相刑，一定夫妻不和睦，想要改嫁。
又本宫的寅木财爻和午火官鬼相生相合，一定是和别人私通，想嫁给他。
但是世爻上的申金兄弟爻动来冲寅木财爻，一定有人来破坏这位妇人的事。
世爻旁边的爻，子孙爻动来冲午火官鬼，一定有人来破坏她的丈夫。
何况午火官鬼又伏在戌土墓下，世爻应爻相冲相刑相克，一定不成。
en: In the Jichou year, Dingmao month, Jiaxu ten-day cycle, on a Wuyin day, a woman divined a marriage and got Bo changing into Guan.
The Yin-wood Wealth line of the home palace has the Si-fire Pressure hidden beneath it, and it also sits on the Other line: she is a wife who already has a husband.
Yin and Si punish each other, so husband and wife are surely not in accord, and she wishes to marry again.
Again, the home palace's Yin-wood Wealth line generates and combines with the Wu-fire Pressure, so she is surely having an illicit affair with another man and wishes to marry him.
But the Shen-metal Peer line on Self moves and clashes the Yin-wood Wealth, so someone will surely spoil this woman's plan.
A side line of Self, an Output line, moves and clashes the Wu-fire Pressure, so someone will surely spoil the man's side.
Moreover the Wu-fire Pressure is hidden beneath the Xu-earth, its tomb, and Self and Other clash, punish and control each other: it will surely not be made.

title: 游魂主离别、八纯主反目；咸恒节泰和谐、睽革解离乖忤；女得坎离再嫁、男得震巽重婚；坤化坎男破体、乾化离女非真；夫阳壮伤妻、妇阴强欺夫；蒙不有其躬、渐夫征不复

rule.yi: 游魂卦主离别，八纯卦主反目。咸、恒、节、泰的和谐，睽、革、解、离的乖违。女子得坎、离的再嫁，男子得震、巽的重婚。坤变坎，男子破体；乾变离，女子不真。丈夫阳气壮盛就伤妻子，妻子阴气强就欺丈夫。蒙卦是「不有其躬」，渐卦是「夫征不复」。
rule.en: A Wandering Soul hexagram means separation, and a pure eight-palace hexagram falling out. Xian, Heng, Jie and Tai are harmonious; Kui, Ge, Xie and Li are discordant. A woman who gets Kan or Li marries again; a man who gets Zhen or Xun marries again. Kun changing into Kan: the man's body is broken; Qian changing into Li: the woman is not genuine. A husband with strong yang harms his wife; a wife with strong yin overrides her husband. Meng is 'not to have a body'; Jian is 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return'.

note.yi: 这几句是按卦名和八卦断的口诀，和《火珠林》婚姻章的一段几乎逐句相同（见 LY.MARRY.HZL.11、HZL.15、HZL.24），《增删卜易》觉子反对拿卦名断婚（LY.MARRY.ZS.14）。
note.en: These lines judge by hexagram and trigram names and are almost sentence for sentence the same as a passage in the Huozhulin's marriage chapter (see LY.MARRY.HZL.11, HZL.15 and HZL.24); Juezi of the Zengshan Buyi objects to judging marriage by hexagram names (LY.MARRY.ZS.14).

zh: 游魂，主离别。
八纯，主反目。
咸恒节泰者和谐。
睽革解离者乖忤。
女得坎离者再嫁，男得震巽者重婚。
坤化坎者，男破体。
乾化离者，女非真。
夫阳壮而伤妻，妇阴强而欺夫。
蒙则不有其躬，渐则夫征不复。
yi: 游魂卦，主离别。
八纯卦，主反目。
咸、恒、节、泰的和谐。
睽、革、解、离的乖违。
女子得坎、离的再嫁，男子得震、巽的重婚。
坤变坎的，男子破体。
乾变离的，女子不真。
丈夫阳气壮盛就伤妻子，妻子阴气强就欺丈夫。
蒙卦就是「不有其躬」，渐卦就是「夫征不复」。
en: A Wandering Soul hexagram means separation.
A pure eight-palace hexagram means falling out.
Xian, Heng, Jie and Tai are harmonious.
Kui, Ge, Xie and Li are discordant.
A woman who gets Kan or Li marries again; a man who gets Zhen or Xun marries again.
Kun changing into Kan: the man's body is broken.
Qian changing into Li: the woman is not genuine.
A husband with strong yang harms his wife; a wife with strong yin overrides her husband.
Meng is 'not to have a body'; Jian is 'the husband goes on the expedition and does not return'.

title: 内卦乾坤受伤舅姑不睦、坎艮震受伤丈夫叔伯不睦、巽离兑受伤姑嫂妯娌不睦；外卦乾坤生内舅姑悦、坎艮震生内丈夫叔伯悦、巽离兑生内姑嫂妯娌悦

rule.yi: 内卦的乾、坤受伤，公婆不和睦；坎、艮、震受伤，丈夫和叔伯不和睦；巽、离、兑受伤，姑嫂、妯娌不和睦。外卦的乾、坤来生内卦，公婆喜悦；坎、艮、震生内卦，丈夫和叔伯喜悦；巽、离、兑生内卦，姑嫂、妯娌喜悦。（挑选女婿的占法见身命占。）
rule.en: If Qian or Kun in the inner trigram is harmed, the parents-in-law are at odds; if Kan, Gen or Zhen is harmed, the husband and his uncles and brothers are at odds; if Xun, Li or Dui is harmed, the sisters-in-law are at odds. If Qian or Kun in the outer trigram generates the inner, the parents-in-law are pleased; if Kan, Gen or Zhen generates it, the husband and his uncles and brothers are pleased; if Xun, Li or Dui generates it, the sisters-in-law are pleased. (Choosing a son-in-law is found in the divination of one's person and fate.)

zh: 内卦乾坤受伤，舅姑不睦。
坎艮震受伤，丈夫叔伯不睦。
巽离兑受伤，姑嫂妯娌不睦。
外卦乾坤生内，舅姑悦也。
坎艮震生内，丈夫叔伯悦也。
巽离兑生内，姑嫂妯娌悦也。
(择婿见身命占)。
yi: 内卦乾、坤受伤，公婆不和睦。
坎、艮、震受伤，丈夫和叔伯不和睦。
巽、离、兑受伤，姑嫂、妯娌不和睦。
外卦乾、坤来生内卦，公婆喜悦。
外卦坎、艮、震生内卦，丈夫和叔伯喜悦。
外卦巽、离、兑生内卦，姑嫂、妯娌喜悦。
（挑选女婿的占法见身命占。）
en: If Qian or Kun in the inner trigram is harmed, the parents-in-law are at odds.
If Kan, Gen or Zhen is harmed, the husband and his uncles and brothers are at odds.
If Xun, Li or Dui is harmed, the sisters-in-law are at odds.
If Qian or Kun in the outer trigram generates the inner, the parents-in-law are pleased.
If Kan, Gen or Zhen in the outer trigram generates the inner, the husband and his uncles and brothers are pleased.
If Xun, Li or Dui in the outer trigram generates the inner, the sisters-in-law are pleased.
(Choosing a son-in-law is found in the divination of one's person and fate.)

title: 聘礼：卦无父者无雁币或无婚书；财旺币厚财衰币薄，无财或财化空绝无币礼；金财聘金厚、木财果核盛、火财缎疋多、水财珠玉鱼酒丰、土财以田产代；未财旺羊肥、亥财旺猪硕

rule.yi: 卦里没有父母爻，没有雁币（聘礼），或者没有婚书。财爻旺聘礼厚，财爻衰聘礼薄；没有财爻，或财爻化成空、绝，就没有聘礼。金的财爻生合应爻，聘金丰厚；木的，果品多；火的，缎匹多；水的，珠玉鱼酒丰盛；土的，用田产代替聘礼。未的财爻旺，羊肥；亥的财爻旺，猪大。
rule.en: A hexagram without a Resource line has no goose-and-silk betrothal gift, or no marriage contract. Strong Wealth means rich gifts, weak Wealth slight ones; with no Wealth line, or Wealth changing into Void or extinction, there are no gifts. A Metal Wealth line generating or combining with the Other line: the betrothal money is generous; Wood: fruits and nuts in plenty; Fire: many bolts of satin; Water: pearls, jade, fish and wine in abundance; Earth: land and property take the place of gifts. A strong Wei Wealth line: fat sheep; a strong Hai Wealth line: big pigs.

zh: 卦无父者，无雁币，或无婚书也。
财旺币厚，财衰币薄。
无财，及财化空绝，无币礼也。
金财生合应，聘金厚。
木财生合应，果核盛。
火财生合应，缎疋多。
水财生合应，珠玉鱼酒丰。
土财生合应，以田产代币。
未财旺，则羊肥。
亥财旺，则猪硕。
yi: 卦里没有父母爻的，没有雁币（聘礼），或者没有婚书。
财爻旺聘礼厚，财爻衰聘礼薄。
没有财爻，以及财爻化成空、绝，就没有聘礼。
金的财爻生合应爻，聘金丰厚。
木的财爻生合应爻，果品干果多。
火的财爻生合应爻，缎匹多。
水的财爻生合应爻，珠玉鱼酒丰盛。
土的财爻生合应爻，用田产代替聘礼。
未的财爻旺，羊肥。
亥的财爻旺，猪大。
en: A hexagram without a Resource line has no goose-and-silk betrothal gift, or no marriage contract.
Strong Wealth means rich gifts; weak Wealth means slight gifts.
With no Wealth line, or Wealth changing into Void or extinction, there are no betrothal gifts.
A Metal Wealth line generating or combining with the Other line: the betrothal money is generous.
A Wood Wealth line doing so: fruits and nuts in plenty.
A Fire Wealth line doing so: many bolts of satin.
A Water Wealth line doing so: pearls, jade, fish and wine in abundance.
An Earth Wealth line doing so: land and property take the place of gifts.
A strong Wei Wealth line: the sheep are fat.
A strong Hai Wealth line: the pigs are big.

title: 嫁妆：龙财旺相奁具精巧、虎财旺相奁具粗恶、财衰奁薄、无财或化空绝无奁；金财生合世多宝玉五金器、木多木器、火多锦绣绫罗、土多奁产、水多珍珠布帛衣饰；应财伏财有媵婢，应财化子有仆从

rule.yi: 带青龙的财爻旺相，嫁妆器具精巧；带白虎的财爻旺相，嫁妆器具粗劣；财爻衰，嫁妆薄；卦里没有财爻，或财爻化成空、绝，没有嫁妆。金的财爻生合世爻，多宝玉和金属器物；木的，多木器；火的，多锦绣绫罗；土的，多田产；水的，多珍珠、布帛、衣饰。应爻上的财爻（或伏着的财爻），有陪嫁的婢女；应爻上的财爻化成子孙，有仆从。
rule.en: The Wealth line with the Azure Dragon, strong: the dowry furnishings are fine and skilful; with the White Tiger, strong: coarse and poor; weak Wealth means a slight dowry; with no Wealth line, or Wealth changing into Void or extinction, there is no dowry. A Metal Wealth line generating or combining with the Self line: many jewels, jade and metal wares; Wood: many wooden articles; Fire: much brocade, embroidery, damask and silk; Earth: much dowry property; Water: many pearls, cloth, silks and clothing. Wealth on the Other line, or a hidden Wealth line: there are accompanying maids; Wealth on the Other line changing into Output: there are attendants.

note.yi: 「应财伏财」四个字语法很省，译文读作「应爻上的财爻、伏着的财爻」两种情形；别的读法也说得通。
note.en: The four characters 'Other-line Wealth, hidden Wealth' are elliptical; they are read as two cases, Wealth on the Other line and a hidden Wealth line; other readings are possible.

zh: 龙财旺相，奁具精巧。
虎财旺相，奁具粗恶。
财衰则奁薄。
卦无财，或财化空绝，无奁也。
金财生合世，多宝玉五金器。
木财生合世，多木器。
火财生合世，多锦绣绫罗。
土财生合世，多奁产。
水财生合世，多珍珠布帛衣饰。
应财伏财，有媵婢也。
应财化子，有仆从也。
yi: 带青龙的财爻旺相，嫁妆器具精巧。
带白虎的财爻旺相，嫁妆器具粗劣。
财爻衰，嫁妆就薄。
卦里没有财爻，或者财爻化成空、绝，没有嫁妆。
金的财爻生合世爻，多宝玉和金属器物。
木的财爻生合世爻，多木器。
火的财爻生合世爻，多锦绣绫罗。
土的财爻生合世爻，多嫁妆田产。
水的财爻生合世爻，多珍珠、布帛、衣饰。
应爻上的财爻、伏着的财爻，有陪嫁的婢女。
应爻上的财爻化成子孙，有仆从。
en: The Wealth line with the Azure Dragon, strong: the dowry furnishings are fine and skilful.
The Wealth line with the White Tiger, strong: the dowry furnishings are coarse and poor.
Weak Wealth means a slight dowry.
With no Wealth line, or Wealth changing into Void or extinction, there is no dowry.
A Metal Wealth line generating or combining with the Self line: many jewels, jade and metal wares.
A Wood Wealth line doing so: many wooden articles.
A Fire Wealth line doing so: much brocade, embroidery, damask and silk.
An Earth Wealth line doing so: much dowry property.
A Water Wealth line doing so: many pearls, cloth, silks and clothing.
Wealth on the Other line, or a hidden Wealth line: there are accompanying maids.
Wealth on the Other line changing into Output: there are attendants.

title: 世应财鬼生合比和者成；阴世女家许配、阳应男子求婚；世生应男求女、应生世女求男；世克应强娶；世应父母动合亲家杯酒而成，世应子孙动合割襟而成；官化父男家尊长成合，财化父女家尊长成合；世与财爻生合女家亲人成合，世与鬼爻生合男家亲人成合

rule.yi: 世、应、财、鬼相生、相合、比和的，成。世爻属阴，是女家许配；应爻属阳，是男方求婚。世爻生应爻，是男方求女方；应爻生世爻，是女方求男方。世爻克应爻，是用强力抢娶；世、应、日辰三样全合，是靠别人成事。世应与动的父母爻相合，两家亲家一杯酒就成了；世应与动的子孙爻相合，是两边的男女靠割襟之约成的。官鬼化成父母，男方的尊长促成；财爻化成父母，女方的尊长促成。世爻与财爻相生相合，女方的亲人促成；世爻与鬼爻相生相合，男方的亲人促成。
rule.en: Where the Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generate, combine or are in accord, it is made. With the Self line yin, the woman's family gives her in betrothal; with the Other line yang, the man's side is asking for the marriage. The Self line generating the Other: the man seeks the woman; the Other generating the Self: the woman seeks the man. The Self controlling the Other: taking her by force; the Self, Other and Day all combining: the matter is made through others. The Self and Other combining with a moving Resource line: the two in-law families settle it over a cup of wine; with a moving Output line: the boy and girl are betrothed by the lapel-cutting pact. Pressure changing into Resource: the man's elders bring it about; Wealth changing into Resource: the woman's elders bring it about. The Self line generating or combining with Wealth: the woman's relatives bring it about; with Pressure: the man's relatives bring it about.

note.yi: 「割襟」是旧时两家为尚未成年的儿女订婚的一种约定（割下各自的一片衣襟为信）；这是按通行说法译，原文没有解释。
note.en: 'Lapel-cutting' is an old way for two families to betroth their young children (each cutting a piece of its garment as a token); it is translated by this common understanding, and the original does not explain it.

zh: 世应财鬼生合比和者，成也。
阴世，女家许配。
阳应男子求婚。
世生应，男求女。
应生世，女求男。
世克应用强劫娶，世应日辰三全合，因人成事。
世应父母动合，两亲家杯酒而成。
世应子孙动合，两男女割襟而成。
官化父，男家尊长成合。
财化父，女家尊长成合。
世与财爻生合，女家亲人成合。
世与鬼爻生合，男家亲人成合。
yi: 世、应、财、鬼相生、相合、比和的，成。
世爻属阴，是女家许配。
应爻属阳，是男方求婚。
世爻生应爻，是男方求女方。
应爻生世爻，是女方求男方。
世爻克应爻，是用强力抢娶；世、应、日辰三样全合，是靠别人成事。
世应与动的父母爻相合，两家亲家一杯酒就成了。
世应与动的子孙爻相合，是两边的男女靠割襟之约成的。
官鬼化成父母，男方的尊长促成。
财爻化成父母，女方的尊长促成。
世爻与财爻相生相合，女方的亲人促成。
世爻与鬼爻相生相合，男方的亲人促成。
en: Where the Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generate, combine or are in accord, it is made.
With the Self line yin, the woman's family gives her in betrothal.
With the Other line yang, the man's side is asking for the marriage.
The Self line generating the Other: the man seeks the woman.
The Other line generating the Self: the woman seeks the man.
The Self controlling the Other: taking her by force; the Self, Other and Day all combining: the matter is made through others.
The Self and Other combining with a moving Resource line: the two in-law families settle it over a cup of wine.
The Self and Other combining with a moving Output line: the boy and girl are betrothed by the lapel-cutting pact.
Pressure changing into Resource: the man's elders bring it about.
Wealth changing into Resource: the woman's elders bring it about.
The Self line generating or combining with the Wealth line: the woman's relatives bring it about.
The Self line generating or combining with the Pressure line: the man's relatives bring it about.

zh: 己丑年丙子月甲寅旬戊午日，男占婚，得困之解。
世应生合，本宜成就，却被酉兄动冲卯财，化出申兄，又刑冲克世上寅财，必被人破也。
yi: 己丑年丙子月甲寅旬戊午日，一位男子占婚事，得困卦变解卦。
世爻应爻相生相合，本来该成，却被酉金兄弟爻动来冲卯木财爻，化出申金兄弟，又刑冲克世爻上的寅木财爻，一定被人破坏。
en: In the Jichou year, Bingzi month, Jiayin ten-day cycle, on a Wuwu day, a man divined a marriage and got Kun changing into Xie.

Self and Other generate and combine, so it should have succeeded, but the You-metal Peer line moves and clashes the Mao-wood Wealth, changes out a Shen-metal Peer, and punishes, clashes and controls the Yin-wood Wealth on Self; it will surely be spoiled by someone.

title: 卦六合者成、六冲者不成；前卦合变冲成后复退、冲化合退后复成；六冲或世应动被日辰合住欲退不得；世应财鬼冲克而日辰动爻生合不成而得人赞成、生合而日辰动爻冲克成而被破；虽生合而临死墓绝胎被刑冲克害，在世鬼则男家不允、在应财则女家不允

rule.yi: 卦是六合的成，卦是六冲的不成。本卦合而变冲，成了以后又退；本卦冲而化合，退了以后又成。卦是六冲，或世应动，而被日辰合住的，想退也退不成。世应财鬼互相冲克，逢日辰、动爻来生合的，不成，但得到别人赞助；世应财鬼相生相合，逢日辰、动爻冲克的，成了又被破坏。世应财鬼虽然相生相合，但临着死、墓、绝、胎，被刑冲克害，或者动而化成死、墓、绝、胎而遭刑冲克害的：落在世爻、鬼爻上，男家不答应；落在应爻、财爻上，女家不答应。
rule.en: A hexagram of Six-combine is made; a hexagram of Six-clash is not. The original hexagram combining and changing into a clash: made, then withdrawn again; clashing and changing into a combination: withdrawn, then made again. A Six-clash hexagram, or the Self and Other moving, held by a combination with the Day: one wants to withdraw and cannot. The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines clashing and controlling, meeting generation or combination from the Day or a moving line: it is not made, yet someone approves and helps it along; generating and combining, meeting a clash or control from the Day or a moving line: made, then broken up. Though the Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generate and combine, if they sit on the death, tomb, extinction or womb stages and are punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, or move and change into those stages and are so harmed: if it is on the Self line or the Pressure line, the man's family does not agree; if it is on the Other line or the Wealth line, the woman's family does not agree.

dispute.yi: 「冲变合」：这里说「前卦冲而化合，退后复成」（先退后成）；《易林补遗》说未配之前得冲中化合「决不相谐」（LY.MARRY.YL.15），《增删卜易》说「六冲变六合者尤吉，求婚者目下不允，久必成之」（LY.MARRY.ZS.13）。《易隐》和《增删卜易》一致：不是不成，是先退后成。
dispute.en: For a clash changing into a combination this text says 'withdrawn, then made again'; the Yilin Buyi says that before the match is made it 'surely will not be harmonious' (LY.MARRY.YL.15), and the Zengshan Buyi that 'a Six-clash changing into a Six-combine is better still: for one seeking a marriage, although refused for now, it will be made in time' (LY.MARRY.ZS.13). The Yi Yin agrees with the Zengshan Buyi: not that it fails, but that it is withdrawn first and made afterwards.

zh: 卦六合者成，卦六冲者不成。
前卦合而变冲，成后复退。
前卦冲而化合，退后复成。
卦六冲或世应动，而被日辰合住者，欲退而不得。
世应财鬼冲克，逢日辰动爻生合者不成，而得人赞成。
世应财鬼生合，逢日辰动爻冲克者，成而被破。
世应财鬼虽相生合，或临死墓绝胎，被刑冲克害，或动化死墓绝胎，刑冲克害者，在世爻鬼爻，则男家不允。
在应爻财爻，主女家不允。
yi: 卦是六合的成，卦是六冲的不成。
本卦合而变冲，成了以后又退。
本卦冲而化合，退了以后又成。
卦是六冲，或者世应动，而被日辰合住的，想退也退不成。
世应财鬼互相冲克，逢日辰、动爻来生合的，不成，但得到别人赞助。
世应财鬼相生相合，逢日辰、动爻冲克的，成了又被破坏。
世应财鬼虽然相生相合，但临着死、墓、绝、胎，被刑冲克害，或者动而化成死、墓、绝、胎而遭刑冲克害的，落在世爻、鬼爻上，就是男家不答应；
落在应爻、财爻上，主女家不答应。
en: A hexagram of Six-combine is made; a hexagram of Six-clash is not.
The original hexagram combining and changing into a clash: made, then withdrawn again.
The original hexagram clashing and changing into a combination: withdrawn, then made again.
A Six-clash hexagram, or the Self and Other moving, held by a combination with the Day: one wants to withdraw and cannot.
The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines clashing and controlling, meeting generation or combination from the Day or a moving line: it is not made, yet someone approves and helps it along.
The Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generating and combining, meeting a clash or control from the Day or a moving line: made, then broken up.

Though the Self, Other, Wealth and Pressure lines generate and combine, if they sit on the death, tomb, extinction or womb stages and are punished, clashed, controlled or harmed, or move and change into those stages and are so harmed: if it is on the Self line or the Pressure line, the man's family does not agree;
if it is on the Other line or the Wealth line, the woman's family does not agree.

zh: 庚寅年戊寅月甲寅旬癸亥日，男占婚，得复之颐。
六爻酉子动化寅官与亥财合，月日又值财官世应又合，两家俱肯，婚大吉也。
但五爻亥财自刑，妇性峭刻，貌美，面尖微黑，初爻单，则足小也。
yi: 庚寅年戊寅月甲寅旬癸亥日，一位男子占婚事，得复卦变颐卦。
六爻里酉金、子水动，化出寅木官鬼，和亥水财爻相合，月、日又是财爻官爻，世爻应爻又相合，两家都肯，婚事大吉。
但是第五爻的亥水财爻自刑，妻子性情峭刻，容貌美，脸尖微黑；初爻是单爻（阳爻），脚就小。
en: In the Gengyin year, Wuyin month, Jiayin ten-day cycle, on a Guihai day, a man divined a marriage and got Fu changing into Yi.

Among the six lines the You and Zi lines move and change into the Yin-wood Pressure, which combines with the Hai-water Wealth; the Month and Day are again Wealth and Pressure, and Self and Other also combine: both families are willing, and the marriage is greatly lucky.

But the Hai-water Wealth on the fifth line punishes itself, so the wife is sharp and harsh in temper, pretty, with a pointed and slightly dark face; the first line is a single (yang) line, so her feet are small.

title: 父化官男家尊长阻隔、父化财女家尊长阻隔；父空无主婚苟合成；父克世应父母阻；兄冲世应兄弟阻；兄加杀动必争竞；鬼化鬼男家反覆；兄化兄见阻方成；两父齐兴主婚非一；财官动合先奸后娶；二官并动两家求娶；两鬼克应女许二家

rule.yi: 父母爻化成官鬼，男方的尊长阻隔；父母爻化成财爻，女方的尊长阻隔。父母爻空，没有主婚的人，只能苟且成合。父母爻克世应，父母阻挠；兄弟爻冲世应，兄弟阻挠；兄弟爻加煞而动，一定争斗。鬼爻化鬼爻，男家反复不定；兄弟爻化兄弟爻，遇到阻碍才能成。两个父母爻一起发动，主婚的不止一人。财官动而相合，先私通后娶（自刑的应验）。两个官爻一起动，两家来求娶；两个鬼爻克应爻，女方许给了两家。
rule.en: Resource changing into Pressure: the man's elders obstruct; Resource changing into Wealth: the woman's elders obstruct. With the Resource line Void there is no one to preside at the wedding, and the union is made irregularly. The Resource line controlling the Self and Other lines: the parents obstruct; a Peer line clashing the Self and Other: the brothers obstruct; a Peer line with a baleful star and moving: quarrels are certain. Pressure changing into Pressure: the man's family goes back and forth; a Peer line changing into a Peer line: made only after meeting obstruction. Two Resource lines moving together: more than one person presides at the wedding. Wealth and Pressure moving and combining: illicit relations first, marriage after (it proves true where there is self-punishment). Two Pressure lines moving together: two families ask for the bride; two Pressure lines controlling the Other line: the woman is promised to two families.

zh: 父化官，男家尊长阻隔。
父化财，女家尊长阻隔。
父空无主婚之人，苟合成也。
父克世应，父母阻。
兄冲世应，兄弟阻。
兄加杀动，必争竞。
鬼化鬼，男家反覆。
兄化兄，见阻方成。
两父齐兴，主婚非一。
财官动合，先奸后娶。
(自刑者验)。
二官并动，两家求娶。
两鬼克应，女许二家。
yi: 父母爻化成官鬼，男方的尊长阻隔。
父母爻化成财爻，女方的尊长阻隔。
父母爻空，没有主婚的人，只能苟且成合。
父母爻克世应，父母阻挠。
兄弟爻冲世应，兄弟阻挠。
兄弟爻加煞而动，一定争斗。
鬼爻化成鬼爻，男家反复不定。
兄弟爻化成兄弟爻，遇到阻碍才能成。
两个父母爻一起发动，主婚的不止一个人。
财爻、官爻动而相合，先私通后娶。
（自刑的应验。）
两个官爻一起动，两家来求娶。
两个鬼爻克应爻，女方许给了两家。
en: Resource changing into Pressure: the man's elders obstruct.
Resource changing into Wealth: the woman's elders obstruct.
With the Resource line Void there is no one to preside at the wedding, and the union is made irregularly.
The Resource line controlling the Self and Other lines: the parents (Resource) obstruct.
A Peer line clashing the Self and Other lines: the brothers (Peer) obstruct.
A Peer line with a baleful star and moving: there will surely be quarrels.
Pressure changing into Pressure: the man's family goes back and forth.
A Peer line changing into a Peer line: made only after meeting obstruction.
Two Resource lines moving together: more than one person presides at the wedding.
Wealth and Pressure moving and combining: illicit relations first, marriage after.
(It proves true where there is self-punishment.)
Two Pressure lines moving together: two families ask for the bride.
Two Pressure lines controlling the Other line: the woman is promised to two families.

zh: 己丑年丙子月甲子旬丁卯日，男占婚，得睽之归妹。
本宫子水财，正值月建，离卦无气，而财爻有气，家虽贫而貌则美。
但性急贪淫，色黑而面圆耳。
奈财伏兄下，世应化爻俱兄，克财者多，决有人互相把持。
应又冲世，化爻又冲应，本宫父母真空，是无主婚之人，故不成也。
细看财官同居外卦，惟西北方亲上做亲者，是其姻缘也。
yi: 己丑年丙子月甲子旬丁卯日，一位男子占婚事，得睽卦变归妹卦。
本宫的子水财爻，正好是月建，在离卦里没有气，但财爻自己有气，她家虽然贫穷而容貌却美。
只是性子急躁贪淫，肤色黑而脸圆。
可惜财爻伏在兄弟爻下，世爻、应爻、变爻都是兄弟，克财的多，一定有人互相把持。
应爻又冲世爻，变爻又冲应爻，本宫的父母爻真空，是没有主婚人，所以不成。
仔细看财爻官爻同在外卦，只有西北方面亲上加亲的婚事，才是他的姻缘。
en: In the Jichou year, Bingzi month, Jiazi ten-day cycle, on a Dingmao day, a man divined a marriage and got Kui changing into Guimei.
The Zi-water Wealth line of the home palace is exactly the Month branch; in the Li trigram it has no qi, yet the Wealth line itself has qi: her family is poor though her looks are fair.
But she is hasty and lustful, dark in colour with a round face.
Unfortunately Wealth is hidden beneath a Peer line, and Self, Other and the changed lines are all Peer lines, so many control Wealth and surely some people hold each other back.
Other again clashes Self and the changed line clashes Other, and the Resource line of the home palace is truly Void, so there is no one to preside over the match; therefore it is not made.
Looking closely, Wealth and Pressure both stand in the outer trigram; only a match in the north-west, a marriage between kin, would be his fate.

title: 卦纯阳纯阴者不成；龙动生世应者成，虎动克世应者不成；蛇动克牵缠不允，雀动克口舌非常，武动克者阴人破，勾动克者小人挠

rule.yi: 卦是纯阳、纯阴的，不成。青龙动而生世应的成，白虎动而克世应的不成；螣蛇动而克，牵缠不答应；朱雀动而克，口舌非常；玄武动而克，女人来破坏；勾陈动而克，小人来阻挠。
rule.en: A hexagram of pure yang or pure yin is not made. The Azure Dragon moving and generating the Self and Other lines: made; the White Tiger moving and controlling them: not made. The Coiling Snake moving and controlling: entanglement and no agreement; the Vermilion Bird: extraordinary quarrels; the Dark Tortoise: a woman wrecks it; Hook Earth: petty people obstruct.

zh: 卦值纯阳纯阴者不成。
龙动生世应者成，虎动克世应者不成。
蛇动克，牵缠不允。
雀动克，口舌非常。
武动克者，阴人破。
勾动克者，小人挠。
yi: 卦是纯阳或纯阴的，不成。
青龙动而生世应的成，白虎动而克世应的不成。
螣蛇动而克，牵缠不答应。
朱雀动而克，口舌非常。
玄武动而克的，女人来破坏。
勾陈动而克的，小人来阻挠。
en: A hexagram of pure yang or pure yin is not made.
The Azure Dragon moving and generating the Self and Other lines: made; the White Tiger moving and controlling them: not made.
The Coiling Snake moving and controlling: entanglement and no agreement.
The Vermilion Bird moving and controlling: extraordinary quarrels.
The Dark Tortoise moving and controlling: a woman (a yin person) wrecks it.
Hook Earth moving and controlling: petty people obstruct.

title: 世临外卦财爻动、身世命爻合应财，或命爻鬼爻伏墓应财下，俱主入赘；鬼居应财居世，或世鬼属阴应财属阳，非入赘则夫妇相凌

rule.yi: 世爻临在外卦、财爻动，身爻、世爻、命爻去合应爻上的财，或者命爻、鬼爻伏在墓中、藏在应爻财之下的，都主入赘。鬼爻在应爻、财爻在世爻，或者世爻的鬼属阴、应爻的财属阳的，不是入赘，一定夫妻互相欺凌。
rule.en: The Self line in the outer trigram with Wealth moving, and the Body, Self or fate line going to combine with the Wealth on the Other line, or the fate or Pressure line hidden in a tomb beneath the Other line's Wealth: all mean marrying into the wife's family. Pressure on the Other line and Wealth on the Self line, or the Self line's Pressure yin and the Other line's Wealth yang: if it is not a marriage into the wife's family, husband and wife will surely bully each other.

note.yi: 第一句读起来很绕（身、世、命三个爻与应财、伏墓的几种关系），译文照字面，没有替它理顺；最后一句的「蜚入赘」，「蜚」是「非」的转录之误，译作「不是入赘」。
note.en: The first sentence is convoluted (several relations of the Body, Self and fate lines to the Other line's Wealth and to a hidden tomb) and is translated literally without straightening it out; 'fei ru zhui' in the last sentence has 'fei' (a kind of insect) for 'fei' (not), and is translated as 'if it is not marrying in'.

zh: 又世临外卦财爻动，身世命爻去合应财或命爻鬼爻伏墓应财之下者，俱主入赘。
鬼居应财居世，与世鬼属阴，应财属阳者，蜚入赘，必夫妇相凌也。
yi: 又，世爻临在外卦，财爻动，身爻、世爻、命爻去合应爻上的财，或者命爻、鬼爻伏在墓中、藏在应爻财之下的，都主入赘。
鬼爻在应爻、财爻在世爻，或者世爻的鬼属阴、应爻的财属阳的，不是入赘，一定夫妻互相欺凌。
en: Again: the Self line in the outer trigram with Wealth moving, and the Body, Self or fate line going to combine with the Wealth on the Other line, or the fate or Pressure line hidden in a tomb beneath the Other line's Wealth: all mean marrying into the wife's family.

Pressure on the Other line and Wealth on the Self line, or the Self line's Pressure yin and the Other line's Wealth yang: if it is not a marriage into the wife's family, husband and wife will surely bully each other.

title: 媒约：以间爻为用；世生合间男家之亲、应生合间女家之亲、世应俱生合间两家皆亲；间阳男媒间阴女媒；衰墓老媒生旺少媒；间阴化阳女人先说；间空化空更人为媒；间兄两动二人争媒；蛇武兄动冰人诡诈；朱雀旺空媒多诳语

rule.yi: 以间爻为用神。世爻生合间爻，是男家的亲戚；应爻生合间爻，是女家的亲戚；世应都生合间爻，两家都是亲戚。间爻属阳是男媒人，属阴是女媒人；衰、入墓是老媒人，生旺是年轻的媒人。间爻属阴变阳，是女人先开口；间爻空又化空，换人做媒；间爻和兄弟爻都动，两个人争着做媒。螣蛇、玄武、兄弟爻动，媒人诡诈；朱雀旺相或空，媒人多说谎话。
rule.en: Take the between lines as the Subject. The Self line generating or combining with a between line: a relative of the man's family; the Other line doing so: a relative of the woman's family; the Self and Other both doing so: a relative of both. A yang between line is a male go-between, a yin one a female go-between; weak or in a tomb, an old go-between; in birth or strength, a young one. A yin between line changing into yang: a woman speaks first; a between line Void and changing into Void: another person becomes the go-between; the between line and a Peer line both moving: two people compete to be the go-between. The Coiling Snake and Dark Tortoise with a moving Peer line: the go-between is crafty and deceitful; the Vermilion Bird strong or Void: he tells many lies.

zh: 以间爻为用。
世生合间，男家之亲，应生合间，女家之亲。
世应俱生合间，两家皆亲。
间阳男媒，间阴女媒。
衰墓，老媒。
生旺少媒。
间阴化阳，女人先说。
间空化空，更人为媒。
间兄两动，二人争媒。
蛇武兄动，冰人诡诈。
朱雀旺空，媒多诳语。
yi: 以间爻为用神。
世爻生合间爻，是男家的亲戚；应爻生合间爻，是女家的亲戚。
世应都生合间爻，两家都是亲戚。
间爻属阳是男媒人，间爻属阴是女媒人。
衰、入墓的，是老媒人。
生旺的，是年轻的媒人。
间爻属阴变阳，是女人先开口。
间爻空又化空，换了人做媒。
间爻和兄弟爻都动，两个人争着做媒。
螣蛇、玄武、兄弟爻动，媒人诡诈。
朱雀旺相或空，媒人多说谎话。
en: Take the between lines as the Subject.
The Self line generating or combining with a between line: a relative of the man's family; the Other line doing so: a relative of the woman's family.
The Self and Other both generating or combining with the between line: a relative of both families.
A yang between line is a male go-between; a yin between line is a female go-between.
Weak or in a tomb: an old go-between.
In birth or strength: a young go-between.
A yin between line changing into yang: a woman speaks first.
A between line Void and changing into Void: another person becomes the go-between.
The between line and a Peer line both moving: two people compete to be the go-between.
The Coiling Snake and Dark Tortoise with a moving Peer line: the go-between is crafty and deceitful.
The Vermilion Bird strong or Void: the go-between tells many lies.

title: 白虎间动媒来损害、龙喜间摇赖其吹嘘、勾陈间动多阻隔；间临贵马仕宦为媒；二间俱空必无月老；间生合世应善调停、间刑冲克害世应心怀欺骗；世应冲克间两家相怨；日辰动爻带虎雀刑冲克害间者群口交谪

rule.yi: 白虎带的间爻动，媒人带来损害；青龙、喜神带的间爻动，靠他撮合；勾陈带的间爻动，必多阻隔。间爻临贵人、驿马，是做官的人做媒。两个间爻都空，一定没有媒人。间爻生合世应，善于调停；间爻刑冲克害世应，心里怀着欺骗。世应冲克间爻，两家互相埋怨。日辰、动爻带白虎、朱雀，刑冲克害间爻的，众口交相指责。
rule.en: The White Tiger with a moving between line: the go-between brings harm; the Azure Dragon and Joy star with a moving between line: one depends on his boosting; Hook Earth with a moving between line: many obstructions. The between line on the Nobleman and Post Horse: an official is the go-between. Both between lines Void: there is surely no go-between. The between line generating or combining with the Self and Other lines: skilled at mediating; punishing, clashing, controlling or harming them: he harbors deceit. The Self and Other lines clashing with and controlling the between line: the two families resent each other. The Day or a moving line carrying the White Tiger and Vermilion Bird and punishing, clashing, controlling or harming the between line: everyone blames him in chorus.

zh: 白虎间动，媒来损害。
龙喜间摇，赖其吹嘘。
勾陈间动，必多阻隔。
间临贵马，仕宦为媒。
二间俱空，必无月老。
间生合世应，善于调停。
间刑冲克害世应，心怀欺骗。
世应冲克间，两家相怨。
日辰动爻带虎雀刑冲克害间者，群口交谪也。
yi: 白虎带的间爻动，媒人带来损害。
青龙、喜神带的间爻摇动，靠他吹捧撮合。
勾陈带的间爻动，必定多阻隔。
间爻临贵人、驿马，是做官的人做媒。
两个间爻都空，一定没有媒人。
间爻生合世应，善于调停。
间爻刑冲克害世应，心里怀着欺骗。
世应冲克间爻，两家互相埋怨。
日辰、动爻带白虎、朱雀，刑冲克害间爻的，众口交相指责。
en: The White Tiger with a moving between line: the go-between brings harm.
The Azure Dragon and Joy star with a moving between line: one depends on his boosting.
Hook Earth with a moving between line: many obstructions.
The between line on the Nobleman and Post Horse: an official is the go-between.
Both between lines Void: there is surely no go-between.
The between line generating or combining with the Self and Other lines: skilled at mediating.
The between line punishing, clashing, controlling or harming the Self and Other lines: he harbors deceit.
The Self and Other lines clashing with and controlling the between line: the two families resent each other.
The Day or a moving line carrying the White Tiger and Vermilion Bird and punishing, clashing, controlling or harming the between line: everyone blames him in chorus.

title: 欲知过聘下定之月，以月卦临直为期；单占媒人贤奸，以应爻为用

rule.yi: 想知道过聘、下定在哪个月，就以「月卦」临值的时候为期。只占媒人是贤是奸，就以应爻为用神。
rule.en: To know the month of the betrothal exchange and the fixing of the engagement, take the time when the 'month hexagram' is in charge. To divine alone whether the go-between is worthy or crafty, take the Other line as the Subject.

note.yi: 「月卦临直为期」里的「月卦」是什么，原文没有解释（可能是按月排的卦或月建），译文照字面，没有替书选一种读法。
note.en: What the 'month hexagram' in 'take the time when the month hexagram is in charge' is, is not explained (perhaps a hexagram assigned to each month, or the Month branch); it is translated literally without choosing a reading for the book.

zh: 欲知过聘下定之月，则以月卦临直为期也。
又单占媒人贤奸者，则以应爻为用也。
yi: 想知道过聘、下定的月份，就以月卦临值为期。
又，单独占媒人是贤是奸的，就以应爻为用神。
en: To know the month of the betrothal exchange and the fixing of the engagement, take the time when the month hexagram is in charge as the date.
Again, to divine alone whether the go-between is worthy or crafty, take the Other line as the Subject.

title: 断妻妾：以本宫内卦出现的妻财为主，不现看伏神、再不现取飞宫；世克之爻为妻、妻克之爻为妾（自占以应爻为正妻）；阳宫阳爻旺相带吉神者貌丽行洁善主中馈，阴宫阴爻衰墓带刑刃亡劫者丑陋无能夭折

rule.yi: 认妻妾：以本宫内卦上出现的妻财爻为主；不出现，看内卦的伏神；再不出现、又没有伏神，就取飞宫来论。世爻所克的爻是妻，妻爻所克的爻是妾；自己占的，也可以把应爻当正妻，应爻所克的爻当妾。财爻临阳宫阳爻、旺相又带吉神的，一定相貌秀丽、品行贞洁，善于持家；临阴宫阴爻、衰弱入墓又带刑、刃、亡神、劫煞的，一定丑陋无能而且短命。
rule.en: Identifying wives and concubines: take the Wealth line that appears in the inner trigram of the home palace as the main one; if it does not appear, look at the hidden spirit of the inner trigram; if it neither appears nor is hidden, reckon from the flying palace. The line controlled by the Self line is the wife, and the line controlled by the wife's line is the concubine; in a divination for oneself one may also take the Other line as the principal wife and the line it controls as the concubine. Wealth on a yang palace and yang line, strong and with auspicious spirits: she is surely beautiful and chaste in conduct and good at running the house; on a yin palace and yin line, weak, in a tomb and with the punishment, blade, Loss and Robbery stars: she is surely ugly and incapable, and dies young.

note.yi: 「中馈」指家中的饮食，「善主中馈」译作「善于持家」。「亡劫」是亡神、劫煞的合称。
note.en: 'Zhong kui' means the household meals; 'good at running the household kitchen' stands for good housekeeping. 'Loss and Robbery' are the Wangshen and Jiesha stars.

zh: 以本宫内卦出现妻财为主，不现，则看内卦伏神，如不现，又无伏，则取飞宫论之。
以世克之爻为妻，妻克之爻为妾。
又自占以应爻为正妻，即以应克之爻为妾，亦可也。
如临阳宫阳爻，旺相带吉神者，必貌都丽而行贞洁，善主中馈也。
临阴宫阴爻，衰墓带刑刃亡劫者，必丑陋无能而夭折也。
yi: 以本宫内卦上出现的妻财为主；不出现，就看内卦的伏神；如果不出现、又没有伏神，就取飞宫来论。
以世爻所克的爻为妻，妻爻所克的爻为妾。
另外自己占的，以应爻为正妻，就以应爻所克的爻为妾，也可以。
如果临在阳宫阳爻，旺相又带吉神的，一定相貌秀丽、品行贞洁，善于主持家里的饮食（持家）。
如果临在阴宫阴爻，衰弱入墓，又带刑、刃、亡神、劫煞的，一定丑陋无能，而且短命。
en: Take the Wealth line that appears in the inner trigram of the home palace as the main one; if it does not appear, look at the hidden spirit of the inner trigram; if it neither appears nor is hidden, reckon from the flying palace.
The line controlled by the Self line is the wife, and the line controlled by the wife's line is the concubine.
Again, when divining for oneself, one may take the Other line as the principal wife and the line controlled by the Other as the concubine.
If it sits on a yang palace and a yang line, strong and with auspicious spirits, she is surely beautiful and chaste in conduct and good at running the household kitchen.
If it sits on a yin palace and a yin line, weak and in a tomb, and with the punishment, blade, Loss and Robbery stars, she is surely ugly and incapable, and dies young.

title: 兄持世动、兄独发、有兄无财、财无故自空俱克妻否则分离；财旺自刑夫妻不睦终生离；财动冲克世、世应刑害夫妇无情；世动夫凌妻、应动妻欺夫；财临死墓绝胎加刑刃兼兄克刑克三妻；旺相无伤亦妻不贤

rule.yi: 兄弟爻持世而动，或兄弟爻独自发动，或卦里有兄弟爻没有财爻，或财爻无缘无故自己落空，都主克妻，否则也分离。财爻旺相又自刑（财持辰、午、酉、亥），主夫妻不和，终究生离——因为旺的不会死，只会离。兄弟爻在旁边动，或持世不动而财爻不空，也主不和睦。财动冲克世，或世应互相刑害，主夫妇无情。世爻动，丈夫欺凌妻子；应爻动，妻子欺压丈夫；世应都动，必常争斗。财爻临死、墓、绝、胎，又加刑、刃，再有兄弟爻动来克，主刑克三个妻子；得月日生合，或许带病延年。飞爻财入兄乡，或应爻持兄弟爻动，遇月日刑害克破，死。即使旺相没有受伤，也是妻子不贤：爱生是非，和妯娌不和，和丈夫不一条心，多偷财物、私藏归己、漏给别家。
rule.en: A Peer line holding the Self line and moving, or a Peer line moving alone, or the hexagram having a Peer line but no Wealth, or the Wealth line going Void for no reason: all mean the wife is harmed, or else they part. A Wealth line strong yet self-punishing (Wealth on Chen, Wu, You or Hai): husband and wife are at odds and in the end part alive, since a strong line does not die but leaves. A Peer line moving elsewhere, or holding the Self line without moving while Wealth is not Void: this too means discord. Wealth moving to clash with and control the Self line, or the Self and Other punishing and harming each other: the couple have no affection. When the Self line moves the husband bullies the wife; when the Other line moves the wife overrides the husband; when both move they quarrel often. Wealth on death, tomb, extinction or womb stages with the punishment and blade stars added and a Peer line moving to control it: three wives are punished and harmed; with generation and combination from the Month and Day she may live on with illness. Wealth on the flying line entering the Peer's branch, or the Other line holding a Peer line and moving, meeting punishment, harm, control or break from the Month and Day: she dies. Even strong and unharmed, the wife is not virtuous: she stirs up quarrels, is at odds with her sisters-in-law and not of one mind with her husband, often steals goods, hides them for herself and leaks them to another house.

zh: 若兄持世动，及兄爻独发，或卦有兄无财，或财爻无故自空者，俱主克妻也，否则分离。
或财爻旺相自刑(财持辰午酉亥)，主夫妻不睦，终见生离，以旺者不死离也。
或兄爻旁动，及持世不动，而财爻不空者，亦主不睦也。
或财动冲克世，与世应相刑害者，俱主夫妇无情也。
世动，夫凌妻，应动，妻欺夫，世应俱动，必常争斗，化爻相刑害者，亦然也。
如财临死墓绝胎，加刑刃，兼兄动克者，主刑克三妻。
若得月日生合，或可带疾延年也。
飞爻财入兄乡，或应持兄动，遇月日刑害克破者，死也。
若得旺相无伤，亦主妻不贤，好生是非，与妯娌不和，或不与夫主一心，多偷财物，私藏匿己，漏去他家也。
yi: 如果兄弟爻持世而动，以及兄弟爻独自发动，或者卦里有兄弟爻没有财爻，或者财爻无缘无故自己空了的，都主克妻，否则也分离。
或者财爻旺相又自刑（财爻持辰、午、酉、亥），主夫妻不和睦，终究生离，因为旺相的不会死，只会离。
或者兄弟爻在旁边动，以及兄弟爻持世不动，而财爻不空的，也主不和睦。
或者财爻动而冲克世爻，以及世应互相刑害的，都主夫妇无情。
世爻动，丈夫欺凌妻子；应爻动，妻子欺压丈夫；世应都动，必定常争斗；变出的爻互相刑害的，也是这样。
如果财爻临在死、墓、绝、胎，又加刑、刃，再加兄弟爻动来克的，主刑克三个妻子。
如果得到月建、日辰生合，或许能带着病延年。
飞爻上的财爻进入兄弟的地支，或者应爻持兄弟爻而动，遇到月建日辰刑害克破的，死。
如果旺相、没有受伤，也主妻子不贤惠，爱生是非，和妯娌不和，或者和丈夫不一条心，常偷财物，私自藏起来归己，漏给别人家。
en: If a Peer line holds the Self line and moves, or a Peer line alone moves, or the hexagram has a Peer line but no Wealth, or the Wealth line goes Void for no reason, all mean the wife is harmed, or else they part.
Or the Wealth line is strong yet self-punishing (Wealth on Chen, Wu, You or Hai): husband and wife are at odds and in the end part alive, since a strong line does not die but leaves.
Or a Peer line moves elsewhere, or holds the Self line without moving while the Wealth line is not Void: this too means discord.
Or Wealth moves to clash with and control the Self line, or the Self and Other punish and harm each other: all mean the couple have no affection.

When the Self line moves the husband bullies the wife; when the Other line moves the wife overrides the husband; when both move, they surely quarrel often; the same if the changed lines punish and harm each other.
If Wealth sits on death, tomb, extinction or womb stages and adds the punishment and blade stars, and a Peer line moves to control it as well: three wives are punished and harmed.
If it receives generation and combination from the Month and Day, she may live on with illness.
If the Wealth on the flying line enters the Peer's branch, or the Other line holds a Peer line and moves, meeting punishment, harm, control or break from the Month and Day: she dies.

If it is strong and unharmed, the wife is still not virtuous: she stirs up quarrels, is at odds with her sisters-in-law, or is not of one mind with her husband, often steals goods, hides them for herself and leaks them to another house.

title: 妻爻生合父母敬事公姑、生合兄弟妯娌和好、生合子孙善抚卑幼，冲克者反是；妻居五爻生合世必掌家；女作家公冲克世带岁月日破二耗暴败破碎杀必凌夫破家

rule.yi: 妻爻生合父母爻，恭敬侍奉公婆；生合兄弟爻，和妯娌和好；生合子孙爻，善于抚育晚辈幼小；冲克父母、兄弟、子孙爻的，相反。妻爻在五爻尊位、生合世爻的，一定掌管家事。妻子当家作主时，如果冲克世爻，又带岁破、月破、日破和二耗、暴败、破碎煞，一定欺凌丈夫、败家。
rule.en: The wife's line generating or combining with the Resource line: she serves her parents-in-law respectfully; with a Peer line: she gets along with her sisters-in-law; with Output: she cares well for the juniors and the young; clashing with or controlling the Resource, Peer or Output lines: the opposite. If the wife's line sits on the fifth line, the place of honor, and generates or combines with the Self line, she surely manages the household. A wife who acts as head of the household, if she clashes with and controls the Self line, or carries a Year-break, Month-break or Day-break and the Two Depletions, Sudden Ruin and Shattering stars, will surely bully her husband and ruin the house.

zh: 妻爻生合父母者，敬事公姑也。
生合兄弟者，妯娌和好也。
生合子孙者，善抚卑幼也。
冲克父母兄弟子孙者，反是。
若妻居五爻尊位，生合世爻者，必掌管家事。
女作家公，如冲克世爻及带岁月日破，与二耗暴败破碎杀者，必凌夫破家也。
yi: 妻爻生合父母爻的，恭敬侍奉公婆。
生合兄弟爻的，和妯娌和好。
生合子孙爻的，善于抚育晚辈幼小。
冲克父母、兄弟、子孙爻的，相反。
如果妻爻居五爻尊位、生合世爻的，一定掌管家事。
妻子当家作主时，如果冲克世爻，以及带岁破、月破、日破，和二耗、暴败、破碎煞的，一定欺凌丈夫、败家。
en: A wife's line generating or combining with the Resource line: she serves her parents-in-law respectfully.
generating or combining with a Peer line: she gets along with her sisters-in-law;
generating or combining with Output: she cares well for the juniors and the young;
clashing with or controlling the Resource, Peer or Output lines: the opposite.
If the wife's line sits on the fifth line, the place of honor, and generates or combines with the Self line, she surely manages the household.

A wife who acts as head of the household, if she clashes with and controls the Self line, or carries a Year-break, Month-break or Day-break and the Two Depletions, Sudden Ruin and Shattering stars, will surely bully her husband and ruin the house.

title: 妻爻带玄武咸池红艳杀加驿马动必贪淫；合应爻旁爻必与外人私通，进神动来生合淫无度，退神动来合制眼去眉来无实，合逢冲被人撞见；兄合财兄私弟妇、父合财翁妇相通、子合财义男共枕；福（子）动化鬼合财亦然；此断须带咸池红艳杀

rule.yi: 妻爻带玄武、咸池、红艳煞，又加驿马而动，一定放纵贪淫。妻爻去合应爻旁边的爻，一定和外人私通：遇进神动来生合，淫乱没有节度；遇退神动来合住，只是眉目传情、没有实事（合又逢空也是这样）；合又逢冲，被人撞见，虽然淫乱但不泛滥。妻爻暗动、去合应爻旁的爻，要防私奔。兄弟爻合财爻，是哥哥私通弟媳；父母爻合财爻，是公公与儿媳相通；子孙爻合财爻，是义子与她同枕；福德爻动化鬼合财、财动化鬼合福德，也是这样——但这些都要带咸池、红艳煞才可以断。应爻与妻爻临兄弟爻，动化财爻来合世的，是姨妹一同的事。《黄金策》说合多而刑煞临身，女子必为娼；《涯泉摘锦》说贵人多是舞裙歌扇，合多是暗约偷期。
rule.en: The wife's line carrying the Dark Tortoise, the Xianchi star and the Red Allure star, with the Post Horse added and moving: she is surely willful and lustful. If the wife's line combines with a line beside the Other line, she surely has an affair with an outsider: if an Advancing spirit moves to generate or combine with it, her licentiousness is without measure; if a Retreating spirit moves to combine with and restrain it, there are only glances and looks with no actual act (a combination meeting Void is the same); if the combination meets a clash and she is caught by someone, although licentious she is not indiscriminate. If the wife's line stirs in secret and combines with a line beside the Other line, beware of an elopement. A Peer line combining with Wealth: an elder brother has an affair with his younger brother's wife; the Resource line combining with Wealth: a father-in-law and daughter-in-law are involved; Output combining with Wealth: an adopted son shares a pillow with her; Output moving, changing into Pressure and combining with Wealth, or Wealth moving, changing into Pressure and combining with Output, is the same — but all this may be judged only where the Xianchi and Red Allure stars are carried. The Other line and the wife's line on a Peer line, moving and changing into Wealth to combine with the Self line: the wife's younger sister is involved too. The Huangjin Ce says that many combinations with punishment and baleful stars on the Body make the woman a prostitute; the Yaquan Zhaijin says that many Noblemen mean entertainers and many combinations mean secret trysts.

note.yi: 「姨妹同腔」的意思原文没有解释，按上下文译作「妻子的妹妹也牵涉在内」。「中媾」是「中冓」（闺房之内）的写法。
note.en: 'Yi mei tong qiang' (literally something like 'the wife's younger sister and she share one cavity') is not explained and is rendered from the context as the wife's younger sister being involved too. 'Zhong gou' in the closing note is a variant writing of 'zhong gou', the inner chambers.

zh: 妻爻带玄武咸池红艳杀，加驿马动者，必恣意贪淫也。
妻如合应爻旁爻，必与外人私通。
会进神动来生合，则淫继无度。
会退神动来合制，只眼去眉来，欲淫无实也，合逢空亦然。
合若逢冲，被人撞见，虽淫不滥也。
妻如暗动，合应爻旁爻，防有私奔之事也。
兄弟合财者，兄私弟妇也。
父母合财者，翁妇相通也。
子孙合财者，义男共枕也。
福动化鬼合财，财动化鬼合福亦然。
(带咸池红艳杀者方可断之)。
应爻与妻爻，如临兄弟，动化财来合世者，必姨妹同腔也。
黄金策曰，合多而刑杀临身，女必为娼。
涯泉摘锦曰，贵多则舞裙歌扇，合多则暗约偷期是也。
(按中媾丑秽之行，本不欲载，只因暗室亏心者，自谓神人莫觉，殊不知卜筮能烛其奸也，故特志此以垂戒云)。
yi: 妻爻带玄武、咸池、红艳煞，又加驿马而动的，一定放纵任意、贪淫。
妻爻如果去合应爻旁边的爻，一定和外人私通。
遇到进神动来生合，就淫乱没有节度。
遇到退神动来合住并制约，只是眉目传情，想淫乱而没有实事；合又逢空也是这样。
合又逢冲，被人撞见，虽然淫乱但不泛滥。
妻爻如果暗动，去合应爻旁边的爻，要防有私奔的事。
兄弟爻合财爻的，是哥哥私通弟媳。
父母爻合财爻的，是公公与儿媳相通。
子孙爻合财爻的，是义子与她同枕。
福德爻动化成鬼爻去合财爻，财爻动化成鬼爻去合福德爻，也是这样。
（带咸池、红艳煞的才可以这样断。）
应爻和妻爻，如果临着兄弟爻，动化成财爻来合世爻的，一定是姨妹一同的事。
《黄金策》说：合多而刑煞临身，女子必定为娼。
《涯泉摘锦》说：贵人多就是舞裙歌扇，合多就是暗约偷期。
（按：闺房里丑秽的行为，本来不想记载，只因为在暗室里做亏心事的人，自以为神和人都不知道，殊不知卜筮能照出他们的奸情，所以特意记下这些来告诫。）
en: The wife's line carrying the Dark Tortoise, the Xianchi star and the Red Allure star, with the Post Horse added and moving: she is surely willful and lustful.
If the wife's line combines with a line beside the Other line, she surely has an affair with an outsider.
If an Advancing spirit moves to generate or combine with it, her licentiousness is without measure.
If a Retreating spirit moves to combine with and restrain it, there are only glances and looks with no actual act; a combination meeting Void is the same.
If the combination meets a clash, she is caught by someone, and although licentious is not indiscriminate.
If the wife's line stirs in secret and combines with a line beside the Other line, beware of an elopement.
A Peer line combining with Wealth: an elder brother has an affair with his younger brother's wife.
The Resource line combining with Wealth: a father-in-law and daughter-in-law are involved.
Output combining with Wealth: an adopted son shares a pillow with her.
Output (the fortune-and-virtue line) moving, changing into Pressure and combining with Wealth, or Wealth moving, changing into Pressure and combining with Output: the same.
(Only where the Xianchi and Red Allure stars are carried may this be judged.)
The Other line and the wife's line, if they sit on a Peer line and move, changing into Wealth to combine with the Self line: surely the wife's younger sister is involved too.
The Huangjin Ce says: many combinations with punishment and baleful stars on the Body, and the woman is surely a prostitute.
The Yaquan Zhaijin says: many Noblemen mean dancing skirts and singing fans, and many combinations mean secret trysts.

(Note: foul and filthy behavior of the inner chambers was not meant to be recorded; but those who do shameful things in the dark think neither gods nor men will notice, not knowing that divination can light up their treachery; so these are set down on purpose as a warning.)

title: 几妻几妾：看正卦伏卦变卦互卦中内卦妻财执本宫者，与应爻持世、伏财、化财，不问旺衰即断；子寅辰午申戌阳爻为妻、丑亥酉未巳卯阴爻为妾，一财一位；二财并旺两妻营活；一空一旺续一弦；二财俱旺一带咸池一偏一正；看何爻得日月世生合知谁得宠

rule.yi: 问一个人有几个妻、几个妾：只看正卦、伏卦、变卦、互卦里，内卦上属本宫的妻财爻，以及应爻持世、伏着的财、化出的财，不问旺衰、有没有德合，就断有几个妻、几个妾。子、寅、辰、午、申、戌属阳爻的是妻，丑、亥、酉、未、巳、卯属阴爻的是妾；一个财爻算一个位。内卦本宫一个财爻、应爻又一个财爻，两个财爻都旺的，一定是两个妻子一起操持生计。一个空一个旺的，会续一次弦；两个空一个旺的，续两次；三个空一个旺的，续三次。两个财爻都旺而其中一个带咸池煞的，一定一偏一正。看哪个爻和日月、世爻生合，就知道谁得宠掌权。
rule.en: To ask how many wives and how many concubines a man has, look only at the main, hidden, changed and nuclear hexagrams for Wealth lines in the inner trigram that belong to the home palace, an Other line holding the Self line, hidden Wealth and changed-out Wealth; regardless of strength, weakness, virtue or combination, count them as so many wives and concubines. Those on the yang branches Zi, Yin, Chen, Wu, Shen and Xu are wives, those on the yin branches Chou, Hai, You, Wei, Si and Mao are concubines; one Wealth line is one place. If the inner trigram's home palace has one Wealth line and the Other line has another, and both are strong, two wives surely make a living together. One Void and one strong: he will take another wife once; two Void and one strong: twice; three Void and one strong: three times. If both Wealth lines are strong and one carries the Xianchi star, one is surely a secondary wife and one the principal wife. See which line is generated or combined by the Day, Month and Self line, and you know who is favored and holds power.

note.yi: 「续弦」是妻死后再娶（琴弦断了再续）。
note.en: 'Continuing the string' means marrying again after a wife's death (the broken string of a zither is joined).

zh: 若问人有几妻，几妾，但看正卦，伏卦，变卦，互卦中，有内卦妻财，执本宫者，与应爻持世，伏财化财者，不问旺衰德合有无，即断几妻几妾也。
子寅辰午申戌阳爻者，为妻。
丑亥酉未巳卯阴爻者，为妾也。
一财一位，二财二位，三财三位也。
又如内卦本宫一财，应爻又一财，二财并旺者，必两妻营活也。
一空一旺者，会续一弦。
二空一旺者，会续二弦。
三空一旺者，会续三弦也。
如两财俱旺，而一财带咸池杀者，必一偏一正也。
看何爻与日月世爻生合，便知何人得宠操权也。
yi: 如果问一个人有几个妻、几个妾，只看正卦、伏卦、变卦、互卦中，有内卦的妻财、属本宫的，以及应爻持世、伏着的财、化出的财，不问旺衰、有没有德合，就断作有几个妻、几个妾。
子、寅、辰、午、申、戌属阳爻的，是妻。
丑、亥、酉、未、巳、卯属阴爻的，是妾。
一个财爻算一个位，两个财爻算两个位，三个财爻算三个位。
又如内卦本宫有一个财爻，应爻上又有一个财爻，两个财爻都旺的，一定是两个妻子一起操持生计。
一个空、一个旺的，会续一次弦（再娶一次）。
两个空、一个旺的，会续两次弦。
三个空、一个旺的，会续三次弦。
如果两个财爻都旺，而其中一个带咸池煞的，一定是一个偏房、一个正室。
看哪个爻和日月、世爻生合，就知道哪个人得宠掌权。
en: To ask how many wives and how many concubines a man has, look only at the main, hidden, changed and nuclear hexagrams for Wealth lines in the inner trigram that belong to the home palace, an Other line holding the Self line, hidden Wealth and changed-out Wealth; regardless of strength, weakness, virtue or combination, count them as so many wives and concubines.
Those on the yang branches Zi, Yin, Chen, Wu, Shen and Xu are wives.
Those on the yin branches Chou, Hai, You, Wei, Si and Mao are concubines.
One Wealth line is one place, two are two, three are three.
Again, if the inner trigram's home palace has one Wealth line and the Other line has another, and both are strong, two wives surely make a living together.
One Void and one strong: he will take another wife once.
Two Void and one strong: he will do so twice.
Three Void and one strong: three times.
If both Wealth lines are strong and one carries the Xianchi star, one is surely a secondary wife and one the principal wife.
See which line is generated or combined by the Day, Month and Self line, and you know who is favored and holds power.

title: 妻为闺女为再醮：卦中一财不见鬼是闺女；财鬼相合或财下伏鬼已见一夫，一财二鬼相合或财下伏鬼又化鬼已见二夫；二鬼一空一旺必再醮，二鬼旺而财被刑冲克害生离改嫁；《黄金策》妻克世身重合应妻必重婚；床帐香闺法

rule.yi: 问妻子是闺女还是再嫁：卦中只有一个财爻、不见鬼爻的，是闺女。财鬼相合，或财爻下伏着鬼爻的，已经有过一个丈夫；一个财爻和两个鬼爻相合，或财爻下伏鬼又化出鬼的，已经有过两个丈夫。卦里有两个鬼爻，一个空一个旺的，一定是再嫁；两个鬼爻都旺，而日月、动爻刑冲克害财爻的，主生离改嫁。《黄金策》说：妻爻克世身、又重复合应爻，妻子必定重婚；世、应、妻爻三合，该招偏正两种丈夫；官爻多而没有凶煞冲犯，妇人该再嫁。《明睿抄本》说：男子取卦身所生的爻为床帐（卦身所生之爻），女子取卦身所克的爻为香闺（卦身所克之爻）。香闺入墓、绝，还没配成；床帐空亡，还没娶妻。这个办法灵验，不要传给不该传的人。
rule.en: To ask whether the wife is a maiden or has married before: a hexagram with a single Wealth line and no Pressure means a maiden. If Wealth and Pressure combine, or Pressure is hidden beneath Wealth, she has already had one husband; one Wealth line combining with two Pressure lines, or Pressure hidden beneath Wealth and again changing into Pressure, means two husbands. A hexagram with two Pressure lines, one Void and one strong, means she has surely married again; two strong Pressure lines while the Day, Month and moving lines punish, clash, control or harm Wealth mean parting alive and remarriage. The Huangjin Ce says: the wife's line controlling the Self (Body) and doubly combining with the Other line, the wife will surely marry twice; the Self, Other and wife's lines forming a three-harmony, she takes both a secondary and a principal husband; many Pressure lines with no ill omens touching them, the woman should remarry. The Mingrui manuscript says: a man takes the line the hexagram Body generates as the bed-curtains, a woman takes the line the Body controls as the fragrant chamber. If the fragrant chamber is in a tomb or extinct, the match is not yet made; if the bed-curtains are Void, he has not yet taken a wife. This method is wonderfully accurate; do not pass it to the unworthy.

note.yi: 最后一句原文是「香闺墓绝未谐配，床帐空亡未娶妻，此法神验，莫传匪人」，一个句号里含三个分句，这里合为一段译。
note.en: The last sentence has three clauses under one full stop and is translated as one passage.

zh: 若问妻为闺女，为再醮，但看卦中一财不见鬼者闺女也。
或财鬼相合，或财下伏鬼者，已见一夫。
一财而二鬼相合，或财下伏鬼，又化鬼者，已见二夫。
又卦有二鬼，一空一旺者，必再醮也。
二鬼旺，而日月动爻刑冲克害财爻者，主生离改嫁也。
黄金策曰，妻克世身重合应，妻必重婚。
世应妻爻三合，当招偏正之夫。
官众而诸凶不犯，妇当再醮。
明睿抄本曰，男取身生为床帐(卦身所生之爻)，女取身克为香闺。
(卦身所克之爻)。
香闺墓绝未谐配，床帐空亡未娶妻，此法神验，莫传匪人。
yi: 如果问妻子是未嫁的闺女还是再嫁的，只看卦中只有一个财爻、不见鬼爻的，是闺女。
或者财鬼相合，或者财爻下面伏着鬼爻的，已经有过一个丈夫。
一个财爻和两个鬼爻相合，或者财爻下伏鬼、又化出鬼的，已经有过两个丈夫。
又卦里有两个鬼爻，一个空一个旺的，一定是再嫁。
两个鬼爻都旺，而日月、动爻刑冲克害财爻的，主生离改嫁。
《黄金策》说：妻爻克世爻（身）、又重复合应爻，妻子必定重婚。
世、应、妻爻三合，应当招来偏房和正室两种丈夫。
官爻多而各种凶煞不犯，妇人该再嫁。
《明睿抄本》说：男子取卦身所生的爻为床帐（卦身所生之爻），女子取卦身所克的爻为香闺。
（卦身所克之爻。）
香闺入墓、绝，还没配成；床帐空亡，还没娶妻。这个办法灵验，不要传给不该传的人。
en: To ask whether the wife is a maiden or has been married before: a hexagram with a single Wealth line and no Pressure means a maiden.
If Wealth and Pressure combine, or Pressure is hidden beneath Wealth, she has already had one husband.
One Wealth line combining with two Pressure lines, or Pressure hidden beneath Wealth and again changing into Pressure: she has had two husbands.
Again, a hexagram with two Pressure lines, one Void and one strong: she has surely married again.
Two strong Pressure lines while the Day, Month and moving lines punish, clash, control or harm Wealth: parting alive and remarriage.
The Huangjin Ce says: the wife's line controlling the Self (Body) and doubly combining with the Other line, the wife will surely marry again.
The Self, Other and wife's lines forming a three-harmony: she takes both a secondary and a principal husband.
Many Pressure lines with no ill omens touching them: the woman should remarry.
The Mingrui manuscript says: a man takes what the Body generates as the bed-curtains (the line the hexagram Body generates), a woman takes what the Body controls as the fragrant chamber.
(The line the hexagram Body controls.)

If the fragrant chamber is in a tomb or extinct, the match is not yet made; if the bed-curtains are Void, he has not yet taken a wife. This method is wonderfully accurate; do not pass it to the unworthy.

title: 妻妾德色：妻临金色白净身瘦小性刚烈，木色青身长妖娆性宽慢，火赤颜身矮性躁急，土色黄身肥矮性温和迟慢，水色紫黑身活动性和宽；妻持父寿高伶俐、持兄损物耗财、持子性善多识见、持财貌美安和、持官貌丑狠毒

rule.yi: 问妻妾的品德容色：妻爻临金，肤色白净，身体瘦小，性情刚烈；临木，肤色青，身材长，妖娆多姿，性情宽缓；临火，红脸，身矮，性急躁；临土，肤色黄，身体又胖又矮，性温和，做事迟慢；临水，肤色紫黑，身体灵活敏捷，性情温和宽厚，衰就急躁，动就多机变，冲就没有主见，合就没有知觉。妻爻持父母爻，长寿伶俐，能当家，会读书算账；持兄弟爻，性情损物耗财，留不住奴婢，旺相的败家好赌，和妯娌不和；持子孙爻，性善、见识多，旺相的能当家、生贵子，带朱雀的常念经；持财爻，貌美、安和，能当家开店，旺相的旺夫有财；持官鬼爻，貌丑、性狠毒，旺相的好杀，带贵人的有封赠荫庇。
rule.en: Asking the virtue and looks of a wife or concubine: the wife's line on Metal, her complexion is fair and clean, her body slight, her nature fierce; on Wood, greenish, tall, alluring and graceful, easy and slow in nature; on Fire, a red face, short, hasty; on Earth, yellow, stout and short, mild and slow in her affairs; on Water, a dark purplish complexion, a nimble body, a gentle and generous nature, hasty if weak, full of shifts if moving, without a mind of her own if clashed, without awareness if combined. The wife's line holding the Resource line: long-lived, clever, able to run the house and to write and reckon; holding a Peer line: she wastes goods and squanders money and keeps no servants, and if strong ruins the house, gambles and is at odds with her sisters-in-law; holding Output: good-natured with much insight, and if strong able to run the house and bear a noble son, with the Vermilion Bird often chanting scripture; holding Wealth: fair, calm and gentle, able to run the house and a shop, and if strong benefits her husband and has money; holding Pressure: ugly and cruel, if strong given to killing, and with the Nobleman having honors and protection.

zh: 若问妻妾德色何如，妻临金色白净，身瘦小，性刚烈也。
临木色青，身长，妖娆多态，性宽慢也。
临火赤颜，身矮，性躁急也。
临土色黄，身肥矮，性温和，为事迟慢也。
临水色紫黑，身活动便捷，性和宽，衰急，动多机变，冲无主心，合无知觉也。
妻持父寿高，伶俐，为掌家，能书算，为事分明也。
妻持兄性损物，耗财，不招奴婢，旺相，破家好赌，妯娌不和也。
妻持子性善，多识见，旺相，能掌家，生贵子，带雀，常诵经也。
妻持财貌美，性安和，能掌家开铺，旺相益夫，有财帛也。
妻持官貌丑，性狠毒，旺相，好杀，带贵，有封荫也。
yi: 如果问妻妾的品德容色如何：妻爻临金，肤色白净，身体瘦小，性情刚烈。
临木，肤色青，身材长，妖娆多姿态，性情宽缓。
临火，红脸，身矮，性情急躁。
临土，肤色黄，身体又胖又矮，性情温和，做事迟慢。
临水，肤色紫黑，身体灵活敏捷，性情温和宽厚；衰就急躁，动就多机变，冲就没有主见，合就没有知觉。
妻爻持父母爻，长寿，伶俐，能当家，会读书算账，做事分明。
妻爻持兄弟爻，性情损物耗财，留不住奴婢；旺相的，败家好赌，和妯娌不和。
妻爻持子孙爻，性情善良，见识多；旺相的，能当家，生贵子；带朱雀的，常念经。
妻爻持财爻，容貌美，性情安和，能当家开店铺；旺相的，有益于丈夫，有钱财。
妻爻持官鬼爻，容貌丑，性情狠毒；旺相的，好杀；带贵人的，有封赠荫庇。
en: To ask how the wife or concubine is in virtue and looks: the wife's line on Metal, her complexion is fair and clean, her body slight, her nature fierce.
On Wood, her complexion is greenish, her build tall, she is alluring and graceful, her nature easy and slow.
On Fire, a red face, short build, hasty temper.
On Earth, a yellow complexion, a stout short body, a mild nature, slow in her affairs.

On Water, a dark purplish complexion, a nimble and quick body, a gentle and generous nature; if weak, hasty; if moving, full of shifts; if clashed, without a mind of her own; if combined, without awareness.
The wife's line holding the Resource line: long-lived, clever, able to run the house, able to write and reckon, clear in her affairs.
The wife's line holding a Peer line: she wastes goods and squanders money and keeps no servants; if strong, she ruins the house and gambles and is at odds with her sisters-in-law.
The wife's line holding Output: good-natured with much insight; if strong, able to run the house and bear a noble son; with the Vermilion Bird, she often chants scripture.
The wife's line holding Wealth: fair, of a calm and gentle nature, able to run the house and a shop; if strong, she benefits her husband and has money.
The wife's line holding Pressure: ugly and of a cruel nature; if strong, given to killing; with the Nobleman, she has honors and protection.

title: 财伏父下尊重不苟、伏子下性善喜打扮、伏兄下貌丑贪淫好赌、伏官下性酷劣有病夫妻大吉；阳卦阳爻工巧无双、阴卦阴爻丑拙第一；阳化入阴幼巧长拙、阴化入阳小陋大姣

rule.yi: 财爻伏在父母爻下，为人庄重不苟；伏在子孙爻下，性善不损物，喜打扮；伏在兄弟爻下，貌丑，贪淫好赌；伏在官鬼爻下，性情残酷恶劣，有病，但夫妻大吉。阳卦阳爻，工巧无双；阴卦阴爻，丑拙第一。阳变入阴，小时灵巧、长大笨拙；阴变入阳，小时丑陋、长大美好。详见性情容貌篇。
rule.en: Wealth hidden beneath the Resource line: dignified and not careless; beneath Output: good-natured, does not waste goods, likes to dress up; beneath a Peer line: ugly, lustful and given to gambling; beneath Pressure: cruel and bad-tempered, ill, yet the couple is greatly auspicious. A yang trigram and yang line: skilled and clever beyond compare; a yin trigram and yin line: the ugliest and clumsiest. Yang changing into yin: clever when young and clumsy when grown; yin changing into yang: plain when small and lovely when grown. See the section on nature and looks.

note.yi: 末尾说「详见性情容貌篇」，那一篇不在婚姻域里，这里没有收。
note.en: The end refers to the section on nature and looks, which is not part of the marriage domain and is not included here.

zh: 财伏父下，为人尊重不苟也。
财伏子下，性善不损物，喜打扮也。
财伏兄下，貌丑，贪淫好赌也。
财伏官下，性酷劣，有病，夫妻大吉也。
阳卦阳爻，工巧无双也。
阴卦阴爻，丑拙第一也。
阳化入阴，幼巧而长拙也。
阴化入阳，小陋而大姣也，详见性情容貌篇。

en: Wealth hidden beneath the Resource line: dignified and not careless.
Wealth hidden beneath Output: good-natured, does not waste goods, likes to dress up.
Wealth hidden beneath a Peer line: ugly, lustful and given to gambling.
Wealth hidden beneath Pressure: cruel and bad-tempered, ill, yet the couple is greatly auspicious.
A yang trigram and yang line: skilled and clever beyond compare.
A yin trigram and yin line: the ugliest and clumsiest.

Yin changing into yang: plain when small and lovely when grown; see the section on nature and looks.

title: 妻之富贵贫贱：未娶从父断、出嫁从夫断；看外卦本宫父母爻（不现看伏，再不现以生妻之爻为妻母、克妻母之爻为岳父）；带禄马贵人宦家女，带财禄德福生气富家女，带咸池沐浴玄武休囚死气贫贱家女；虎贵武职女、虎刃劫杀军匠女、勾土田家女、雀火旺财牙人女、玄武红艳淫家女、刑害亡劫无气贱人女；蛇分九流艺术之女

rule.yi: 问妻子的富贵贫贱：还没娶，按她父亲那边断；出嫁了，按丈夫这边断。没娶的时候，只看外卦本宫的父母爻；外卦的父母爻不出现，就看伏爻；不现又不伏，就把生妻爻的那个爻当妻母，克妻母的爻当岳父，和真的父母一样分阴阳、真假来断。妻父妻母爻带禄、马、贵人，是官宦人家的女儿；带财、禄、德、福、生气，是富家女；带咸池、沐浴、玄武和休囚死气，是贫贱人家的女儿；带白虎和贵人，武职的女儿；带白虎、刃、劫杀，军人工匠的女儿；带勾陈、土旺相，农家女；带朱雀、火、财旺，牙人的女儿；带玄武、红艳，行为放荡人家的女儿；带刑害亡劫又无气，低贱人的女儿；再加金、白虎、刑、刃，是不务农而追逐末业者的女儿。螣蛇逢生旺，是九流人的女儿；螣蛇逢冲并、墓、合，是有艺术技能的人的女儿，按五行定是哪一种技艺。衰败就贫，空绝就断绝，生合世爻能得她家的荫庇，刑害冲克世爻就被她家欺凌。
rule.en: To ask the wealth, rank, poverty or lowliness of the wife: before the marriage, judge from her father's side; once married, from the husband's. Before the marriage, look only at the Resource line of the home palace in the outer trigram; if it does not appear, look at the hidden line; if it neither appears nor is hidden, take the line that generates the wife's line as the wife's mother and the line that controls the wife's mother as the father-in-law, and judge them like real parents by dividing yin and yang, true and false. The wife's father and mother lines carrying Emolument, the Horse and the Nobleman: a daughter of an official family; carrying Wealth, Emolument, Virtue, Fortune and the Birth-breath: a rich family; carrying the Xianchi star, the Bathing stage, the Dark Tortoise and the breaths of rest, trap and death: a poor and lowly family; the White Tiger and the Nobleman: a military officer's daughter; the White Tiger, the blade and the Robbery star: a soldier's or artisan's; Hook Earth with strong Earth: a farmer's; the Vermilion Bird and Fire with strong Wealth: a broker's; the Dark Tortoise and the Red Allure star: a licentious household's; punishment, harm, the Loss and Robbery stars without breath: a low person's; with Metal, the White Tiger, punishment and blade added: one who does not farm but pursues the lesser trades.
