The Pressure line must be thriving and must generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; then it is good.
If it punishes or controls the Self line, expect a beating or punishment.
A dead or extinguished Pressure line is no use either; only with both Wealth and Pressure sound is it very good.

zh: 占财皆忌官动，主有阻隔，
唯求公门之财，必然倚托官府，
必得旺相生合世身则吉，刑克世爻祸害立至。
yi: 占财一般忌官鬼动，主阻隔；
只有求官府的财，一定要依靠官府，
官鬼要旺相、生合世爻卦身才吉，刑克世爻，祸害马上就来。
en: Money questions generally fear a moving Pressure line, which means obstruction;
only money from official quarters depends on the officials,
so the Pressure line must be thriving and generate or combine with the Self and Body lines; if it punishes or controls the Self line, disaster comes at once.

title: 九流术士，偏宜鬼动生身

rule.yi: 空手求财（百工九流）以官鬼为主顾：无官鬼最不利；官鬼出现发动、生合世爻则如意，化财更有大利；官鬼刑克世爻或化兄主是非；应爻空更不吉。但仍须财爻旺相、兄弟不动，才有实利。
rule.en: Earning without capital (craftsmen and the trades) takes the Pressure line as the client: no Pressure is the worst; Pressure appearing, moving and generating or combining with the Self line goes as wished, and turning into Wealth brings a large profit; Pressure punishing or controlling the Self line, or turning into Peer, means trouble; a void Other line is worse still. Yet there is real profit only if Wealth is also thriving and Peer still.

zh: 九流术士，
偏宜鬼动生身；
yi: 靠手艺、方术吃饭的人，
偏偏宜官鬼发动来生世身；
en: For those who live by a trade or an art,
a moving Pressure line that generates the Self line is exactly what is wanted;

zh: 百工九流求财，以鬼爻为主顾，无鬼最不利。
出现发动，生合世爻，必然称意。
更化财爻，决得大利。
须忌刑克世爻，或化兄，皆主惹是招非，不能遂意。
应空尤不吉。
大抵空手求财，虽要官爻，然须财爻旺相，兄弟不动，方主有财。
否则空好看，终无财利。
yi: 百工九流求财，以官鬼为主顾（出钱的客人），没有官鬼最不利。
官鬼出现、发动，生合世爻，一定如意。
再化出财爻，一定得大利。
要忌它刑克世爻，或化出兄弟，都主招惹是非，不能如意。
应爻落空更不吉。
总之空手求财，虽然要官鬼，但还必须财爻旺相、兄弟不动，才有财。
否则只是好看，终究没有财利。
en: Craftsmen and people of the trades seek money with the Pressure line as their client; no Pressure line is the worst.
If it appears, moves and generates or combines with the Self line, it will go as wished.
If it also turns into a Wealth line, a large profit is certain.
Beware of it punishing or controlling the Self line, or turning into Peer: both mean trouble and disappointment.
A void Other line is worse still.
In short, earning without capital needs the Pressure line, but it also needs a thriving Wealth line and a still Peer before there is money.
Otherwise it only looks good, and in the end there is no profit.

zh: 九流求财，以鬼爻为主顾，
出现发动，生合世爻，必然称意，忌刑克世爻。
yi: 九流求财，以官鬼为主顾，
官鬼出现发动，生合世爻，一定如意；忌它刑克世爻。
en: The trades seek money with the Pressure line as their client;
if it appears, moves and generates or combines with the Self line, it will go as wished; beware of it punishing or controlling the Self line.

title: 六畜血财，尤喜福兴持世

rule.yi: 占六畜（贩卖或饲养）以子孙为主：子孙旺相不空、持世临身则吉；父母发动有伤损；化出土鬼防瘟死；子孙旺而财空，畜好无利。
rule.en: For livestock, bought and sold or raised, Output is the main line: Output thriving, not void, on the Self or Body line is good; a moving Resource line means losses; turning into an Earth Pressure line, beware of plague; Output strong but Wealth void, the animals do well but there is no profit.

zh: 六畜血财，
尤喜福兴持世。
yi: 牲畜这类活物的财，
尤其喜欢子孙兴旺并持世。
en: For livestock and other living goods,
an Output line flourishing on the Self line is especially welcome.

zh: 凡占贩卖牲口，蓄养六畜，皆要子孙旺相不空，则吉。持世临身尤好。
父母发动，则有伤损。
化出土鬼，须防瘟死。
福旺财空。六畜虽好而无利。
yi: 凡是占贩卖牲口、饲养六畜，都要子孙旺相不空才吉；持世、临卦身更好。
父母发动，就有伤损。
（子孙）化出属土的官鬼，要防瘟疫死亡。
子孙旺而财空：六畜虽然好，却没有利。
en: Whether dealing in animals or raising livestock, Output must be thriving and not void; then it is good, and better still on the Self or Body line.
A moving Resource line means losses.
If it turns into an Earth Pressure line, beware of the animals dying of plague.
Output strong but Wealth void: the animals do well but there is no profit.

zh: 凡卜贩卖牲口、畜养六畜，皆要子孙旺相，持世临身则吉；
父母发动则有损伤；化出土鬼须防瘟死；
福旺财空，六畜虽好而无利。
yi: 凡是卜贩卖牲口、饲养六畜，都要子孙旺相，持世、临卦身就吉；
父母发动就有损伤；化出土鬼，要防瘟死；
子孙旺而财空，六畜虽好却没有利。
en: In dealing in or raising livestock, Output must be thriving; on the Self or Body line it is good;
a moving Resource line means losses; turning into an Earth Pressure line, beware of plague;
Output strong but Wealth void: the animals do well but there is no profit.

title: 世应同人，放债必然连本失

rule.yi: 放债：世、应都是兄弟（同人），讨不回来；财爻再绝，连本俱失；世应落空亦然。应爻生合世爻、妻财有气、子孙发动则吉；间爻兄鬼发动防经手人抽分；卦无财而官鬼化出财，要打官司才讨得回。
rule.en: Lending: Peer on both the Self and Other lines means the money cannot be recovered; with Wealth extinguished as well, the principal is lost; the same if Self and Other are void. Good if the Other line generates or combines with the Self line, Wealth has force and Output moves. A moving Peer or Pressure on the between lines: the middleman skims a share. No Wealth, but Pressure turning into it: recoverable only through a lawsuit.

zh: 世应同人，
放债必然连本失；
yi: 世、应都是兄弟，
放债一定连本钱都丢掉；
en: If the Self and Other lines are both Peer,
lending money means losing even the principal;

zh: 凡放私债，最忌世应值兄弟，必无讨处。
财爻更绝，连本俱失。世应值空，亦然。
须得应爻生合世爻，妻财有气，子孙发动则吉。
间临兄鬼动，恐放头抽分财利。
卦中无财，而官爻变出者，必讼于官府而后可取。
yi: 凡是放私人债，最忌世、应都是兄弟，一定讨不回来。
财爻再临绝，连本钱都丢；世应落空也一样。
要应爻生合世爻、妻财有气、子孙发动才吉。
间爻是兄弟或官鬼而发动，怕中间经手的人抽成分利。
卦里没有财，而官鬼变出财来，一定要到官府打官司才能讨回。
en: In private lending the thing most feared is Peer on both the Self and Other lines: there will be no one to collect from.
If the Wealth line is also extinguished, the principal is lost too; the same if Self and Other are void.
It is good only if the Other line generates or combines with the Self line, Wealth has force, and Output moves.
If the between lines carry a moving Peer or Pressure, the middleman may skim off a share of the interest.
If there is no Wealth in the hexagram and a Pressure line turns into it, the money can be recovered only through a lawsuit.

zh: 凡放私债，最忌世应值兄弟，必无讨处；
财爻更绝，连本俱无，世应值空亦然。
yi: 凡是放私人债，最忌世、应都是兄弟，一定讨不回来；
财爻再临绝，连本都没了；世应落空也一样。
en: In private lending the thing most feared is Peer on both Self and Other: nowhere to collect from;
if the Wealth line is also extinguished, the principal is gone too; the same if Self and Other are void.

title: 日月相合，开行定主有人投

rule.yi: 开行（牙行、铺面）：世应不空，财福齐全，官鬼有气，父兄衰静，为上吉；再得月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，客人远近来投。卦无财而世爻只得生合：门口热闹、无实利（鬼旺财空同）；动出兄官多是非；世应空，开不成。
rule.en: Opening a brokerage or shop: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still is first-class; if the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, clients come from near and far. With no Wealth, support for the Self line is only a busy doorway without profit (the same for strong Pressure and void Wealth); Peer or Pressure moving means quarrels; Self and Other void, it will not open.

zh: 日月相合，
开行定主有人投。
yi: 日辰、月建来合世爻，
开牙行一定有客人来投。
en: When the Day and Month combine with the Self line,
a brokerage that opens will surely draw clients.

zh: 开行牙人占财，世应要不空，财福要全备，官鬼要有气，父兄要衰静，斯为上吉卦。
更得月建日辰动爻生合世爻，则近悦远来，人皆投我，财利必顺。
卦若无财，而世得月日动爻生合者，不过门头闹热，无实利。
鬼旺财空，亦然。
动出兄官，常有是非口舌，或有恶人搅扰。
世应空，开不成。
yi: 开牙行的经纪人占财，世、应要不空，妻财、子孙要齐全，官鬼要有气，父母、兄弟要衰弱安静，这是上吉卦。
再有月建、日辰、动爻来生合世爻，就近者喜欢、远者来投，人人都来找我，财利一定顺。
卦里如果没有财，只是世爻得到月、日、动爻生合，不过是门口热闹，没有实利。
官鬼旺而财空，也一样。
动出兄弟、官鬼，常有是非口舌，或有恶人来捣乱。
世应落空，开不成。
en: When a broker opening a brokerage asks about money: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still; that is a first-class hexagram.
If the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, near and far will come gladly and everyone will bring business to me; the profit will flow.
If there is no Wealth, and the Self line merely gets support from Month, Day and moving lines, it is only a busy doorway with no real profit.
Pressure strong and Wealth void: the same.
Peer or Pressure moving means constant quarrels, or bad characters making trouble.
Self and Other void: it will not open.

zh: 开行人占财，世应要不空，财福要全备，官鬼要有气，父兄要衰静，斯为上吉。
更得月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，则近悦远来，财利必顺。
动出官兄常有是非口舌，应空主开不成。
yi: 开行的人占财，世、应要不空，财福齐全，官鬼有气，父兄衰静，这是上吉。
再有月建、日辰、动爻生合世爻，近者喜欢、远者来投，财利一定顺。
动出官鬼、兄弟，常有是非口舌；应爻落空，开不成。
en: When one opening a brokerage asks about money: Self and Other not void, Wealth and Output both present, Pressure with force, Resource and Peer weak and still; that is first-class.
If the Month, the Day and moving lines also generate or combine with the Self line, near and far come gladly and the profit flows.
Pressure or Peer moving means constant quarrels; a void Other line means it will not open.

title: 应落空亡，索借者失望

rule.yi: 向人讨要、借贷：应爻空（见不到人、不实）或动（对方变卦）都不宜；应爻生合世爻则对方慷慨。代表所借之物的爻也要不空：衣服书籍看父母，六畜酒器看子孙，财物（食物）看妻财。
rule.en: Asking for something or borrowing it: the Other line should be neither void (you will not find them, nothing is real) nor moving (they change their mind); if it generates or combines with the Self line they give generously. The line for the thing itself must also not be void: Resource for clothes and books, Output for livestock and wine vessels, Wealth for money, goods and food.

zh: 应落空亡，
索借者失望。
yi: 应爻落空亡，
去讨要、去借的人要失望。
en: If the Other line is void,
whoever goes to ask or borrow will be disappointed.

zh: 求索假借，不宜应空，应动。
动则更变，空则不遇。
生合世爻，慨然不吝。
必得物爻不空为妙。
如衣服经史看父爻，六畜酒器看福爻，其余财物看财爻。
又如花果看木爻，砖瓦看土爻类，亦是。
yi: 向人讨要、借东西，不宜应爻落空，也不宜应爻发动。
动就会变卦，空就见不到人。
应爻生合世爻，对方慷慨不吝啬。
还要代表那样东西的爻不空才好。
比如衣服、书籍看父母，六畜、酒器看子孙，其余财物看妻财。
又比如花果看木爻，砖瓦看土爻，诸如此类，也可以。
en: In asking for something or borrowing it, the Other line should be neither void nor moving.
Moving, the other party changes their mind; void, you will not find them.
If it generates or combines with the Self line, they give generously.
It is best if the line for the thing itself is not void.
For clothes and books, look at the Resource line; for livestock and wine vessels, the Output line; for other goods and money, the Wealth line.
Flowers and fruit can also be read from the Wood line, bricks and tiles from the Earth line, and so on.

zh: 求索假借不宜应空，空则不实，
必得物爻不空，缓图庶可有望。
如衣服经史看父母，六畜酒器看福爻，其余财物食物皆看财爻。
yi: 讨要、借东西不宜应爻空，空就不实在；
一定要代表那样东西的爻不空，慢慢图谋才有指望。
比如衣服、书籍看父母，六畜、酒器看子孙，其余财物、食物都看妻财。
en: In asking or borrowing, the Other line should not be void; void, nothing is real;
the line for the thing itself must not be void; then, pursued patiently, there is some hope.
Clothes and books by Resource, livestock and wine vessels by Output, other goods and food by the Wealth line.

title: 世遭刑克，赌博者必输

rule.yi: 赌博：世旺应衰、世动应静为好；世克应我胜，应克世他胜。兄鬼动来刑克世爻、世临兄弟或世空：不胜；世应静空：赌不成；世坐官鬼：防合谋骗局；间爻动出兄鬼：争斗；内外无财：难胜；世应空动：赊账赌；兄鬼化财先败后胜，财化兄鬼先胜后败；卦身临兄：终是输兆。
rule.en: Gambling: best with the Self line strong and the Other weak, the Self moving and the Other still; Self controlling Other, I win; Other controlling Self, they win. Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, Peer on the Self line, or a void Self line: no win; Self and Other still and void: no game; Pressure on the Self line: beware of a conspiracy; Peer or Pressure moving on the between lines: a fight; no Wealth in either trigram: hard to win; Self and Other void yet moving: gambling on credit; Peer or Pressure turning into Wealth, lose then win; Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure, win then lose; Peer on the Body line: a losing sign whatever you do.

zh: 世遭刑克，
赌博者必输。
yi: 世爻受刑克，
赌博一定输。
en: If the Self line is punished or controlled,
the gambler is sure to lose.

zh: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰，世动应静。
世克应我胜，应克世他胜。
兄鬼动来刑克世爻，或临兄弟，或临自空，皆主不胜。
世应静空，赌博不成。
世坐官爻，防他合谋骗我。
间爻动出兄弟官鬼，多主争斗。
内外俱无财，亦不能胜。
更遇世应空动，必是赌赊。
兄鬼化财，先败后胜；财化兄鬼，先胜后败。
坐方宜财福之地，世变财福，更宜易换赌色。
大怕卦身临兄弟，任换赌色，终是输兆。
yi: 凡是占赌博，要世爻旺、应爻衰，世爻动、应爻静。
世克应我赢，应克世对方赢。
兄弟、官鬼动来刑克世爻，或世爻临兄弟，或世爻自己落空，都主不赢。
世应安静而落空，赌局开不成。
世爻坐官鬼，防对方合伙骗我。
间爻动出兄弟、官鬼，多半有争斗。
内外卦都没有财，也赢不了。
再遇世应空而发动，一定是赊账的赌。
兄弟、官鬼化财，先输后赢；财化兄弟、官鬼，先赢后输。
坐的方位宜在财、福所临之方；世爻变出财、福，更宜换换赌具。
最怕卦身临兄弟，怎么换赌具都是输的兆头。
en: In any gambling question, the Self line should be strong and the Other weak, the Self moving and the Other still.
Self controlling Other: I win; Other controlling Self: they win.
Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, or the Self line carrying Peer, or the Self line void: all mean no win.
Self and Other still and void: the game does not happen.
Pressure on the Self line: beware of the others conspiring to cheat me.
Peer or Pressure moving on the between lines: most likely a fight.
No Wealth in either trigram: no win either.
If Self and Other are void yet moving, it is gambling on credit.
Peer or Pressure turning into Wealth: lose first, win later; Wealth turning into Peer or Pressure: win first, lose later.
Sit facing the direction of Wealth or Output; if the Self line turns into Wealth or Output, it is a good time to change the dice or the game.
Worst of all is the Body line carrying Peer: whatever you change, it is a losing sign.

zh: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰，世克应我胜，应克世他胜。
兄鬼动来刑克世爻，或临兄弟，或世爻空，皆主不胜。
世应静空赌博不成；世坐官爻防他合谋骗我；
间爻动出官鬼兄弟，多致争斗。
yi: 凡占赌博，要世旺应衰；世克应我赢，应克世对方赢。
兄弟、官鬼动来刑克世爻，或世临兄弟，或世爻空，都主不赢。
世应静而空，赌不成；世爻坐官鬼，防对方合谋骗我；
间爻动出官鬼、兄弟，多半引起争斗。
en: In gambling, the Self line should be strong and the Other weak; Self controlling Other, I win; Other controlling Self, they win.
Peer or Pressure moving to punish or control the Self line, the Self line on Peer, or the Self line void: no win.
Self and Other still and void: no game; Pressure on the Self line: beware of a conspiracy to cheat me;
Pressure or Peer moving on the between lines: it usually ends in a fight.

title: 鬼克身爻，商贩者必遭盗贼

rule.yi: 外出贩货：世应生合、官鬼空伏、动爻日辰不伤世爻则平安，财旺福兴大吉。兄鬼发动又玄武发动，遇劫窃；再克世，大祸；世空可避；官鬼动在第五爻（路），途中小心。王洪绪：官临玄武动来克世，必遭盗贼。
rule.en: Travelling to trade: Self and Other generating or combining, Pressure void or hidden, and no moving line or Day harming the Self line means safety; with Wealth strong and Output flourishing, very good. Peer and Pressure moving with the Dark Tortoise moving: robbers or thieves; if they also control the Self line, disaster; a void Self line may escape; Pressure moving on the fifth line (the road): take care on the way. Wang Hongxu: Pressure on the Dark Tortoise moving to control the Self line means certain robbery.

zh: 鬼克身爻，
商贩者必遭盗贼；
yi: 官鬼克世身，
做买卖的人一定遭盗贼；
en: If Pressure controls the Self line,
the trader is sure to meet thieves;

zh: 贩卖经商，要世应生合，鬼爻空伏，动爻日辰不伤乎我，则安然无事。
更得财旺福兴，大吉之兆。
遇兄鬼发动，玄武交重，必遇劫窃之人。
更克世爻，决有大祸。
世若空亡，庶可回避。
鬼动五爻，途中仔细。
yi: 贩运经商，要世应相生相合，官鬼空或伏，动爻、日辰不伤世爻，就平安无事。
再加上财旺福兴，是大吉之兆。
遇到兄弟、官鬼发动，玄武又发动，一定遇到抢劫偷窃的人。
再来克世爻，一定有大祸。
世爻如果落空，大概能躲过。
官鬼在第五爻发动，路上要小心。
en: For a travelling trader: Self and Other generating or combining, the Pressure line void or hidden, and no moving line or Day harming me; then all is safe.
With Wealth strong and Output flourishing as well, it is a very good sign.
If Peer and Pressure move and the Dark Tortoise line moves too, you will meet robbers or thieves.
If they also control the Self line, a great disaster is certain.
If the Self line is void, you may escape it.
Pressure moving on the fifth line: be careful on the road.

zh: 买卖经商，若遇官临玄武动来克世，必遭盗贼之祸。
yi: 做买卖经商，如果官鬼临玄武、动来克世，一定遭盗贼之祸。
en: In trade, if Pressure on the Dark Tortoise moves to control the Self line, robbery is certain.

title: 间兴害世，置货者当虑牙人

rule.yi: 买货：应爻生合世爻易成，刑克世爻难买。代表货物的爻（六畜看子孙、五谷看妻财、布帛看父母）太过货多、不及货少、空伏无货。兄鬼发动防骗；兄鬼在间爻是牙人虚诈、口舌；间爻伤克世爻防牙人谋财；出门买货而应爻空，多不顺。
rule.en: Buying goods: the Other line generating or combining with the Self line makes it easy; punishing or controlling it makes it hard. The line for the goods (Output for livestock, Wealth for grain, Resource for cloth) in excess means plenty, falling short means few, void or hidden means none. Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers; on the between lines, a false broker or quarrels; a between line harming or controlling the Self line: the broker is after your goods; travelling to buy with the Other line void, it mostly goes badly.

zh: 间兴害世，
置货者当虑牙人。
yi: 间爻发动来害世爻，
买货的人要提防经纪人。
en: If a between line moves and harms the Self line,
a buyer of goods should beware of the broker.

zh: 买货者，应要生合世爻，必然易成。刑克世，必难置买。
物爻太过，其货必多；物爻不及，其货必少；物爻空伏，其货必无。
物爻者，六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，丝绵布帛看父母类。
最怕兄鬼交重，须防光棍诓骗。
在间爻，则是牙人虚诈不实，或有口舌争竞。
伤克世爻，当虑牙人谋劫财物。
出路买货，应空多不顺利。
yi: 买货的，要应爻生合世爻，一定容易成交；应爻刑克世爻，一定难买到。
代表货物的那一爻太旺太多，货一定多；不及，货一定少；空或伏，一定没有货。
货物那一爻：六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，丝绵布匹看父母，诸如此类。
最怕兄弟、官鬼发动，要防骗子诓骗。
（兄鬼）在间爻上，就是经纪人虚假不实，或有口舌争执。
来伤克世爻，要提防经纪人图谋侵吞财物。
出门去买货，应爻落空，多半不顺利。
en: For a buyer, the Other line should generate or combine with the Self line; then the deal is easy. If it punishes or controls the Self line, it will be hard to buy.
If the line for the goods is in excess, there will be plenty of goods; if it falls short, few; if it is void or hidden, none.
The line for the goods: Output for livestock, the Wealth line for grain, Resource for silk, cotton and cloth, and so on.
The worst is Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers.
On the between lines, it is the broker being false and dishonest, or quarrels and disputes.
If they harm or control the Self line, beware of the broker plotting to seize the goods.
If you travel to buy and the Other line is void, it will mostly go badly.

zh: 买货要应爻生合世位，必然易成，刑克世必难置。
物爻太过货多，物爻不及货少，空伏货无。
物爻者，六畜看子，五谷看财爻类。
最怕兄鬼交重，须防光棍谎骗。
间爻伤克世爻，当虑牙人谋劫财物。
出路买货应空，多不顺利。
yi: 买货要应爻生合世爻，一定容易成交；刑克世爻，一定难买。
货物那一爻太过货多，不及货少，空伏没货。
货物那一爻：六畜看子孙，五谷看财爻，诸如此类。
最怕兄弟、官鬼发动，要防骗子。
间爻伤克世爻，要提防经纪人图谋财物。
出门买货而应爻空，多半不顺。
en: To buy goods, the Other line should generate or combine with the Self line: easy; punishing or controlling it: hard to buy.
The goods line in excess, plenty; falling short, few; void or hidden, none.
The goods line: Output for livestock, the Wealth line for grain, and so on.
The worst is Peer and Pressure moving: beware of swindlers.
A between line harming or controlling the Self line: beware of the broker plotting to take the goods.
Travelling to buy with the Other line void: mostly it goes badly.

title: 停榻者，喜财安而鬼静

rule.yi: 囤货：财爻不宜动、不宜空，不宜被动爻日辰克劫；财坐胎、养、长生，日后得利。兄官交变或同动防盗；兄弟独发多耗折；水爻父母（王洪绪：父化官鬼）刑克世爻，货被雨水淹腐；财化死墓空绝，日后价贱。
rule.en: Holding goods in store: Wealth should neither move nor be void, nor be attacked by moving lines or the Day; Wealth at the Embryo, Nurture or Birth stage means profit later. Peer and Pressure turning into each other or moving together: beware of theft; Peer moving alone: waste and loss; a Water Resource line (Wang Hongxu: Resource turning into Pressure) punishing or controlling the Self line: the goods are spoiled by rain; Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: the price will fall.

note.yi: 王洪绪本经文作「停脱者」，注末又说「故脱货者宜六爻安静」，和下一句经文「脱货者宜财动而身兴」正相反；旧注本作「停榻者」（囤货）。按上下文，这一条讲的是囤货，王本的「脱」字疑有讹误。原文照录。
note.en: Wang Hongxu's edition reads 'holding and disposing' in the base text, and his note ends 'so for goods to be disposed of, all six lines should be still', which contradicts the very next line ('for goods to be sold off, Wealth should move'). The old-commentary edition reads 'goods held in store'. From the context this rule is about stockpiling, and 'dispose' in Wang's edition is probably a corruption. We quote it as it stands.

zh: 停榻者，
喜财安而鬼静；
yi: 囤货存放的人，
喜欢财爻安静、官鬼也安静；
en: For goods held in store,
it is best that Wealth rests and Pressure is still;

zh: 积货不宜财动，亦不宜空亡，又不宜动爻日辰克劫。
更得坐于胎养长生爻上，后必得利。
若遇兄官交变，或俱发动，须防窃盗。
兄弟独发，则多耗折。
水爻父母刑克世爻，主被雨水淹腐。
财化死墓空绝，后必价贱。
yi: 囤积货物不宜财爻发动，也不宜财爻落空，又不宜被动爻、日辰克劫。
再加上财爻坐在胎、养、长生的位置，日后一定得利。
如果兄弟、官鬼相互变化，或都发动，要防盗窃。
只有兄弟发动，多耗损折本。
属水的父母爻刑克世爻，主货被雨水淹坏。
财化入死、墓、空、绝，日后一定价贱。
en: Stored goods do not want the Wealth line moving, nor void, nor attacked by moving lines or the Day.
If the Wealth line sits at the Embryo, Nurture or Birth stage, profit will come later.
If Peer and Pressure turn into each other or both move, beware of theft.
Peer moving alone: much waste and loss.
A Water Resource line punishing or controlling the Self line: the goods will be spoiled by rain or flood.
Wealth turning into death, tomb, void or extinction: the price will fall later.

zh: 积货不宜财动，动恐有变；亦不宜空，空恐有更。
官鬼若动，兴灾作祸莫测；
如父母化官鬼刑克世爻，货被雨水污腐。
故脱货者宜六爻安静，唯子孙喜动。
yi: 囤货不宜财动，动了怕有变故；也不宜空，空了怕有更改。
官鬼若发动，会兴起难以预料的灾祸；
如果父母化官鬼来刑克世爻，货被雨水弄脏腐坏。
所以脱货的人宜六爻安静，只喜子孙发动。
en: Stored goods do not want Wealth moving, for fear of a change; nor void, for fear of an upset.
If Pressure moves, it brings unforeseeable trouble;
if Resource turns into Pressure and punishes or controls the Self line, the goods will be soiled and rot in the rain.
So for goods to be disposed of, all six lines should be still; only Output is welcome to move.

title: 脱货者，宜财动而身兴

rule.yi: 卖货：财动易脱、世动易卖；应空无买主，世空自己卖不成；动变日辰来生合，有人争买；遇刑冲多阻；财在内卦动（生世）本地卖，在外卦动外地卖（财持世而子孙在外卦动，也宜外卖）；动而遇合将成不成，动而逢空欲卖不卖；卦无官鬼难成交。
rule.en: Selling goods: a moving Wealth means they go easily, a moving Self line that they sell easily; a void Other line, no buyer; a void Self line, you fail to sell; moving and changed lines and the Day generating or combining, buyers compete; punishment or clash, obstacles; Wealth moving in the inner trigram (generating the Self line), sell locally; in the outer, sell elsewhere (also when Wealth is on the Self line and Output moves in the outer trigram); moving but combined, almost closed yet not; moving but void, wanting to sell yet not; no Pressure in the hexagram, hard to close.

zh: 脱货者，
宜财动而身兴。
yi: 要卖出货物的人，
宜财爻发动、世身也动。
en: For goods to be sold off,
Wealth should move and the Self line should stir.

zh: 脱货财动，则主易脱。
应空，无人置买；世空，自卖不成；
动变日辰，俱来生合，有人争买。
若遇刑冲，则主多破阻难成。
财在内动，宜在本处卖；在外动，宜向他处脱之。
动而遇合，将成不成；动而逢空，欲卖不卖。
卦无官鬼，亦是难成之象。
yi: 卖货时财爻发动，主容易卖掉。
应爻空，没人来买；世爻空，自己卖不成；
动爻、变爻、日辰都来生合，有人争着买。
如果遇刑冲，主多阻碍，难以成交。
财在内卦发动，宜在本地卖；在外卦发动，宜到外地卖。
财动而遇合，快成交却成不了；动而逢空，想卖又卖不掉。
卦里没有官鬼，也是难以成交之象。
en: When selling off goods, a moving Wealth line means they sell easily.
Other void: no buyer; Self void: you fail to sell;
moving and changed lines and the Day all generating or combining: buyers compete.
If met by punishment or clash, many obstacles; hard to close.
Wealth moving in the inner trigram: sell locally; in the outer: sell elsewhere.
Moving but combined: almost closed, yet not; moving but void: wanting to sell, yet not selling.
No Pressure in the hexagram is also a sign that it will be hard to close.

zh: 财动则主易脱，世动主易卖也。
如财在外生世，宜往他处卖；如在内动生世，就本地脱之可也。
倘财爻持世，有子孙爻在外动，亦宜往他处脱，学者宜通变。
yi: 财动主容易脱手，世动主容易卖出。
如果财在外卦生世爻，宜到外地去卖；如果在内卦动来生世，就在本地卖掉。
如果财爻持世，有子孙在外卦发动，也宜到外地卖，学的人要会变通。
en: A moving Wealth means the goods go easily; a moving Self line means they sell easily.
If Wealth in the outer trigram generates the Self line, sell elsewhere; if it moves in the inner trigram and generates the Self line, sell locally.
If the Wealth line is on the Self line and an Output line moves in the outer trigram, also sell elsewhere; students should judge flexibly.

title: 路上有官，休出外

rule.yi: 第五爻为道路：临官鬼发动，途中多惊险，不宜出外求财，灾祸看所临六神（白虎风波、玄武盗贼）；道路爻空亡也不宜出外；临财、福则吉。
rule.en: The fifth line is the road: Pressure on it and moving means many dangers on the way, so do not go abroad for money; the kind of trouble shows in its spirit (White Tiger, storms; Dark Tortoise, thieves); a void road line is also against travel; Wealth or Output on it is good.

zh: 路上有官，
休出外；
yi: 道路爻上有官鬼，
不要出门；
en: If Pressure sits on the road,
do not go out;

zh: 五爻为路。临官发动，途中必多惊险，出外求财大宜避之。
要知有何灾咎，以所临六神断。如白虎为风波，玄武为盗贼类。
路爻空亡，亦不宜出外。惟临财福则吉。
yi: 第五爻是道路。道路爻临官鬼发动，途中一定多惊险，出门求财最好避开。
要知道有什么灾祸，看它所临的六神：比如白虎是风浪，玄武是盗贼，诸如此类。
道路爻落空亡，也不宜出门。只有临财、福才吉。
en: The fifth line is the road. If it carries Pressure and moves, there will be many dangers on the way; seeking money abroad should be avoided.
To know what trouble, look at the spirit it carries: the White Tiger means storms, the Dark Tortoise thieves, and so on.
A void road line is also against going out. Only Wealth or Output on it is good.

zh: 五爻为道路，临官发动，途中必多惊险，不宜出外。
要知有何灾咎，以所临六神断，如白虎为风波，玄武为盗贼之类。
yi: 第五爻是道路，临官鬼发动，途中一定多惊险，不宜出门。
要知道有什么灾祸，看所临六神：比如白虎是风浪，玄武是盗贼。
en: The fifth line is the road; with Pressure on it moving there will be many dangers on the way; do not go out.
To know what trouble, look at its spirit: the White Tiger means storms, the Dark Tortoise thieves, and so on.

title: 宅中有鬼，勿居家

rule.yi: 第二爻为宅：在家求财而官鬼在宅爻发动，必不利，按官鬼五行断灾（火鬼火灾、水鬼盗贼）；子孙持世发动可解，否则宜迁店铺（王洪绪）；宅爻空亡，只宜在外开铺。
rule.en: The second line is the house: seeking money at home with Pressure moving on the house line goes badly; judge the trouble by its element (Fire, fire; Water, thieves). Output on the Self line and moving resolves it, otherwise move the shop (Wang Hongxu); a void house line means trade only from a shop outside.

zh: 宅中有鬼，
勿居家。
yi: 宅爻上有官鬼，
不要在家（求财）。
en: If Pressure sits in the house,
do not stay at home.

zh: 二爻为宅。在家求财，鬼动此爻，必然不利。
以所临五行断。如火鬼忌火烛，水鬼忌盗贼类。
得子孙持世发动，庶几无害。
宅爻空亡，只宜出铺。
yi: 第二爻是宅。在家求财，官鬼在这一爻发动，一定不利。
看官鬼属什么五行来断：比如火鬼防火灾，水鬼防盗贼，诸如此类。
如果子孙持世发动，大概没有害处。
宅爻落空亡，只宜到外面开铺。
en: The second line is the house. For money sought at home, Pressure moving on this line is sure to go badly.
Judge by its element: a Fire Pressure warns of fire, a Water Pressure of thieves, and so on.
If Output is on the Self line and moving, there may be no harm.
If the house line is void, it is only good to trade from a shop outside.

zh: 二爻为住宅，在家求财，鬼动此爻必然不利，
以所临五行断，火鬼忌火烛类。
得子孙持世发动，庶几无害，如无子孙发动，宜迁店铺可解。
yi: 第二爻是住宅，在家求财，官鬼在这一爻发动一定不利，
看它的五行来断，比如火鬼防火灾。
子孙持世发动，大概无害；如果没有子孙发动，把店铺迁走可以化解。
en: The second line is the dwelling; for money sought at home, Pressure moving on it is sure to go badly;
judge by its element: a Fire Pressure warns of fire, and so on.
Output on the Self line and moving: probably no harm; without a moving Output, moving the shop elsewhere will resolve it.

title: 内外无财伏又空，必然乏本

rule.yi: 六爻（内外卦）无财，本宫财爻又伏在空亡之地：缺本钱，勉强经营也无利；若动爻化出财来，有小利。野鹤说屡试屡验。
rule.en: No Wealth among the six lines, and the home palace's Wealth line hidden in a void place: no capital, and forcing a venture brings no profit; if a moving line turns into Wealth, a small profit. Yehe says this has proved true again and again.

zh: 内外无财伏又空，
必然乏本；
yi: 内外卦都没有财，伏着的财又落空，
一定缺本钱；
en: No Wealth in either trigram, and the hidden Wealth void as well:
there is surely no capital;

zh: 六爻无财，本宫财爻又伏空地，其人虽欲经营，必无资本。
勉强为之，亦无利息。
若得动爻化出，主有小小财利。
yi: 六爻没有财，本宫的财爻又伏在空亡之地，这个人即使想经营，也一定没有本钱。
勉强去做，也没有利。
如果有动爻化出财来，主有小小的财利。
en: No Wealth among the six lines, and the Wealth line of the home palace hidden in a void place: though the person wants to trade, there is no capital.
Forcing it brings no profit.
If a moving line turns into Wealth, there is a small profit.

zh: 动变必无财，又伏空地，其人虽欲经营，必然乏本。
yi: 动爻、变爻都没有财，财又伏在空亡之地，这个人即使想经营，一定缺本钱。
en: No Wealth among moving or changed lines, and it lies hidden in a void place: though the person wants to trade, there is surely no capital.

zh: 内外无财，伏而又空，必然乏本，屡试屡验。
yi: 内外卦都没有财，伏着又落空，一定缺本钱，屡试屡验。
en: No Wealth inside or out, and hidden and void as well: surely no capital; proved again and again.

title: 父兄有气财还绝，莫若安贫

rule.yi: 父母、兄弟有气（或发动刑冲克害）而财爻弱、临绝：利少，恐怕折本，不如不做。
rule.en: Resource and Peer strong (or moving to punish, clash, control or harm) while Wealth is weak or extinguished: little profit and a risk to the capital; better not to go ahead.

zh: 父兄有气财还绝，
莫若安贫。
yi: 父母、兄弟有气，财爻却临绝，
不如安于贫困。
en: Resource and Peer strong while Wealth is extinguished:
better to accept being poor.

zh: 父兄二爻，占财大忌。
有发动刑冲克害，利必不多。
财爻更弱，恐防折本。
故不若安贫守分之为高也。
yi: 父母、兄弟两爻，是占财的大忌。
它们发动刑冲克害，利一定不多。
财爻再弱，恐怕要折本。
所以不如安贫守分为好。
en: Resource and Peer are the two great enemies in a money question.
If they move to punish, clash, control or harm, the profit will be small.
If the Wealth line is weak as well, beware of losing the capital.
So it is wiser to accept being poor and keep to one's lot.

zh: 父兄二爻有气恐防折本，故不若安贫守份为高也。
yi: 父母、兄弟两爻有气，怕要折本，所以不如安贫守分为好。
en: With Resource and Peer strong, beware of losing the capital; it is wiser to accept being poor and keep to one's lot.

title: 生计多端，占法不一

rule.yi: 《黄金策》求财章的结语：谋生的门路多，占法要随所问之事变；以诚敬之心求卦。
rule.en: The closing words of the Golden Strategy's chapter on wealth: there are many ways to make a living, and the reading must fit the particular matter; ask with sincerity and reverence.

zh: 生计多端，占法不一。
但宜诚敬以祈求，自可预知其得失。
yi: 谋生的门路很多，占法也不一样。
只要诚心恭敬地去求卦，自然能预先知道得失。
en: There are many ways to make a living and many ways to read them.
Ask with sincerity and reverence, and you can know in advance what you will gain or lose.

hits.text: 但能诚敬以祈求，自可预知其得失
但宜诚敬以祈求，自可预知其得失

title: 公私用事：占买卖、占求财看财爻；占财必用子孙；兄弟是破财之人，不主不辅

rule.yi: 公事用官爻，私事用财爻：占买卖钱财、占家事、占婚姻、占求财，都看财爻。天下的事总起来不出财、官两个字；占官必用父母，占财必用子孙；兄弟是破财的人，既不是主也不是辅，不必去看。
rule.en: Public business takes the Pressure line and private business the Wealth line: trade and money, household affairs, marriage and money-seeking all look to the Wealth line. The affairs of the world come down to the two words Wealth and Pressure; seeking office always uses Resource and seeking wealth always uses Output; Peer is the one who breaks Wealth, neither chief nor helper, and need not be looked at.

dispute.yi: 兄弟要不要看：《火珠林》说兄弟是破财的人、不主不辅，不必去看；《黄金策》《易隐》《增删卜易》里却有大量条目专看兄弟动不动、旺不旺、持世还是克世（如兄弟交重、兄弟持世、兄弟克世）。
dispute.en: Whether to look at Peer: the Huozhu Lin says Peer is only the one who breaks Wealth, neither chief nor helper, and need not be looked at; the Huangjin Ce, the Yi Yin and the Zengshan Buyi devote a great many entries to whether Peer moves, is strong, sits on the Self or controls it.

zh: 阴阳男女，次策推排；
官用取官，私用取财。
yi: 分清阴阳男女，依次推算；
公事用官爻，私事用财爻。
en: Sort out yin and yang, male and female, and work through them in turn;
for public business take Pressure, for private business take Wealth.

zh: 占病鬼祟，占失看贼，占求官事，占官词讼，占婚问夫，
以上皆看官爻。
占买卖财，占家事，占婚婢事，占求财事，占婚姻事，
以上皆看财爻。
yi: 占病与鬼祟、占失物要看贼、占求官、占官司词讼、占婚姻问丈夫，
以上都看官爻。
占买卖钱财、占家事、占娶婢女的事、占求财的事、占婚姻的事，
以上都看财爻。
en: Illness and haunting, lost things (look for the thief), seeking office, lawsuits, and asking about a husband in marriage:
all look to the Pressure line.
Trade and money, household affairs, taking a maidservant, seeking money, and matters of marriage:
all look to the Wealth line.

hits.text: 占病鬼祟，占失看贼，占求官事，占官词讼，占婚问夫
占买卖财，占家事，占奴婢事，占求财事，占婚姻事

zh: 或问：言公私用事，只言财官，而不及父子兄弟，何也？
答曰：
天下之事，散而言之，纷若物色；
总而言之，不出财官二字。
占官必用父母，占财必用子孙。
兄弟是破财之人，不为主、不为辅，何必看也？
yi: 有人问：说公事私事，只说财和官，而不说父母、子孙、兄弟，为什么？
回答说：
天下的事，分开来说，纷纷杂杂像各种颜色；
总起来说，逃不出财、官两个字。
占官一定用到父母，占财一定用到子孙；
兄弟是破财的人，既不是主，也不是辅，何必去看它？
en: Someone asks: in speaking of public and private business you speak only of Wealth and Pressure and not of Resource, Output and Peer - why?
The answer:
the affairs of the world, spoken of one by one, are as varied as colours;
taken together, they come down to the two words Wealth and Pressure.
seeking office always uses Resource, seeking wealth always uses Output;
Peer is the one who breaks Wealth, neither chief nor helper; why look at it?

title: 买卖：财福出现必利，世应相生交易可成；兄发上爻地头不吉，凶杀在四五途路坎坷

rule.yi: 占买卖只要财、福（子孙）出现，没有就不利；世应相生，交易能成。兄弟宫在上爻发动，那个地方不吉；凶杀落在四爻、五爻，路上多坎坷。
rule.en: In a trade hexagram all that is needed is Wealth and Output showing, and without them it is unfavourable; Self and Other generating each other, the deal can be made. Peer moving on the top line, the place is inauspicious; the ill stars on the fourth or fifth line, the road is full of hardships.

note.yi: 「兄宫」按字面译成兄弟宫（兄弟所在的爻）。
note.en: 'Peer palace' is translated literally as the position where Peer stands.

zh: 财福出现，买卖必利；
世应相生，交易可成。
yi: 财和福神出现，买卖一定有利；
世应相生，交易可以成功。
en: Wealth and Output showing, buying and selling surely profits;
Self and Other generating each other, the deal can be made.

zh: 卦占买卖，惟要财福出现，如无不利。
若是兄宫发动于上爻，必知地头不吉。
凶杀泊四五，途路坎坷多。
yi: 占买卖的卦，只要财和福神出现；如果没有，就不利。
如果兄弟宫在上爻发动，一定知道那个地方不吉；
凶杀落在四爻、五爻，路上多有坎坷。
en: In a trade hexagram all that is needed is Wealth and Output showing; without them, it is unfavourable.
If the Peer palace moves on the top line, know that the place is inauspicious;
with the ill stars on the fourth or fifth line, the road is full of hardships.

title: 买卖：财爻持世克身得利，发动克身亦利；外克内、应克世易得财，内克外、世克应难得利

rule.yi: 买卖：财爻持世、克卦身，得利；发动去克卦身，也得利。外卦克内卦、应克世，容易得财；内卦克外卦、世克应，难得利。
rule.en: In a trade: Wealth sitting on the Self and controlling the Body brings profit, and moving to control the Body also brings profit. The outer trigram controlling the inner and the Other controlling the Self: money comes easily; the inner controlling the outer and the Self controlling the Other: profit is hard to get.

zh: 财支持世克身得利，发动克身亦利。
外克内，应克世，易得财；
内克外，世克应难得利。
yi: 财爻持世、克卦身，得利；发动去克卦身，也得利；
外卦克内卦、应克世，容易得财；
内卦克外卦、世克应，难得利。
en: Wealth on the Self line and controlling the Body brings profit, and moving to control the Body brings profit too;
the outer trigram controlling the inner and the Other controlling the Self: money comes easily;
the inner trigram controlling the outer and the Self controlling the Other: profit is hard to get.

title: 买卖：内旺外无气先贵后贱；财旺主贵宜卖，财休囚主贱宜买

rule.yi: 内卦旺相、外卦没有气，货先贵后贱；财旺相，价贵，宜卖；财休囚，价贱，宜买。
rule.en: Inner strong and outer without breath: the goods are dear first and cheap later; Wealth strong means dear and the time to sell; Wealth resting or trapped means cheap and the time to buy.

note.yi: 原文这两句的「内」「外」没有写「卦」字，按内卦、外卦读，与《易林补遗》「内卦为近时，外卦为远期」同一套。
note.en: The source writes just 'inner' and 'outer' without 'trigram'; they are read as the inner and outer trigrams, the same scheme as the Yilin Buyi's 'the inner is the near term, the outer the far term'.

zh: 内旺相，外无气，其物先贵后贱。
yi: 内卦旺相、外卦没有气，货先贵后贱；
en: Inner strong and outer without breath: the goods are dear first and cheap later;

zh: 财旺相，主贵、宜卖；
财休囚主贱，宜买。
yi: 财旺相，主价贵，宜卖；
财休囚，主价贱，宜买。
en: Wealth strong means dear and time to sell;
Wealth resting and trapped means cheap and time to buy.

title: 买卖：月建临财则吉；官鬼临库，公财吉私财凶

rule.yi: 买卖：兄弟和财不利，官鬼动则价贱、货要出手；月建临财就吉；官鬼临库，公家的财吉，私人的财凶。
rule.en: In a trade: Peer and Wealth are unfavourable, and Pressure moving means cheap and the goods should go out; the Month on Wealth is auspicious; Pressure on the tomb-store: public money is auspicious and private money ill.

note.yi: 「兄财不利，鬼动贱发」两句很省，读法不止一种，这里照字面译。
note.en: 'Peer and Wealth unfavourable, Pressure moving, cheap, send out' is terse and has more than one reading; it is translated literally.

zh: 兄财不利，鬼动贱发，
月建临财则吉，
官鬼临库，公财吉，私财凶。
yi: 兄弟和财不利，官鬼动则价贱、货要发出去；
月建临财就吉；
官鬼临库，公家的财吉，私人的财凶。
en: Peer and Wealth are unfavourable, and Pressure moving means cheap and the goods should go out;
the Month on Wealth is auspicious;
Pressure on the tomb-store: public money is auspicious and private money ill.

title: 买卖：卦有二身三身，财与人分共；本宫鬼化财可求，本宫财化鬼防失

rule.yi: 卦里有两个、三个卦身的，财要和别人分；本宫的官鬼化成财，可以求；本宫的财化成官鬼，要防损失。
rule.en: A hexagram with two or three Body lines: the money is to be shared with others; the home palace's Pressure turning into Wealth can be sought; the home palace's Wealth turning into Pressure, guard against loss.

zh: 卦有二身三身者，财当与人分共，
本宫鬼化财可求，本宫财化鬼防失。
yi: 卦里有两个、三个卦身的，财要和别人分共有；
本宫的官鬼化成财，可以求；本宫的财化成官鬼，要防损失。
en: A hexagram with two or three Body lines: the money is to be shared with others;
the home palace's Pressure turning into Wealth can be sought; the home palace's Wealth turning into Pressure, guard against loss.

title: 求财总则：财来扶世不难，财空鬼旺山水阻隔；应生世无财也可求；外克内宜出财，内克外宜入财

rule.yi: 求财：财来扶世，求起来不难；财空、官鬼旺，隔着千山万水。与吉神合、并与世应相合，六爻上有财就可以得到。白虎临财、临应，先生气；比和无关；官鬼动就要费力经营。应生世，没有财也可以求；外生内、应生世，或比和不落空，现在没有，将来还有钱回来。死气的财在长生日得到。外卦克内卦宜出钱，内卦克外卦宜进钱。
rule.en: Seeking wealth: Wealth coming to support the Self, seeking is not hard; Wealth void and Pressure strong, a thousand rivers and ten thousand hills lie in the way. Combining with an auspicious spirit and with the Self and the Other, and with Wealth among the six lines, it can be had. The White Tiger on Wealth or on the Other is angry first; in harmony it does not matter; Pressure moving, you must work at it. The Other generating the Self, even with no Wealth it can be sought; the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self, or harmony without void: none yet, but money still comes back. Wealth in the dead state is got on a Birth day. The outer trigram controlling the inner suits paying out; the inner controlling the outer suits bringing in.

zh: 财来扶世，求之不难；
财空鬼旺，千水万山。
yi: 财来扶世，求起来不难；
财落空、官鬼旺，隔着千山万水。
en: Wealth coming to support the Self, seeking is not hard;
Wealth void and Pressure strong, a thousand rivers and ten thousand hills lie in the way.

zh: 合吉神并世应，而六位有财可得。
白虎临财已先嗔、临应也先嗔，
比和则无关，
鬼动则必经营也。
应生世，虽无财亦可求，
外生内、应生世，或比和不落空者，
虽未有，尚有还财。
子爻动彼自不还。
死气财必长生日得。
外克内卦宜出财、内克外卦宜入财。
yi: 与吉神合，并与世应相合，而六爻上有财，就可以得到；
白虎临财，已经先生气；临应，也先生气；
比和就没有关系；
官鬼动，就一定要费力经营。
应生世，即使没有财也可以求；
外生内、应生世，或者比和而不落空的，
现在虽然还没有，将来还有钱回来。
子孙爻一动，对方自然不还。
死气的财，一定在长生的日子得到。
外卦克内卦，宜出财；内卦克外卦，宜入财。
en: Combining with an auspicious spirit and with the Self and the Other, and with Wealth among the six lines, it can be had;
the White Tiger on Wealth is already angry first, and on the Other likewise;
in harmony it does not matter;
Pressure moving, you must work at it.
The Other generating the Self, even with no Wealth it can be sought;
the outer generating the inner and the Other generating the Self, or harmony without void,
though there is none yet, money still comes back.
Output moving, he will not repay of himself.
Wealth in the dead state is got on a Birth day.
The outer trigram controlling the inner suits paying out; the inner controlling the outer suits bringing in.

hits.text: 卦克内卦宜出财，内卦克外卦宜入财

title: 将本求利：财爻持世、应旺相有气大吉；无气不多，空亡必无，生旺倍加、休囚减半，逢冲有阻

rule.yi: 有本钱求利：要财爻持世，应旺相有气，才大吉；财爻没气，有也不多；财爻空亡，那财一定没有，还要防破失；财爻生旺可以加倍，休囚减半；遇冲，快到手时有阻碍。
rule.en: Seeking profit with capital: the Wealth line must sit on the Self and the Other be strong and with breath for great good fortune; a Wealth line without breath gives little even if there is some; a Wealth line in Void means there is surely none, and beware of breakage and loss; born or strong, it can double, resting or trapped, it halves; clashed, there is an obstruction just as it reaches the hand.

zh: 将本求利，须要财爻持世，
应旺相，有气，乃大吉。
财爻无气，虽有亦无多。
财爻空亡。其财决无，尤防破失。
财爻生旺可倍加，休囚减半。
逢冲，将入手有阻。
yi: 有本钱求利，要财爻持世，
应旺相、有气，才大吉；
财爻没有气，即使有也不多；
财爻空亡，那财一定没有，更要防破财损失；
财爻生旺可以加倍，休囚减半；
遇冲，快到手时有阻碍。
en: Seeking profit with capital, the Wealth line must sit on the Self;
the Other strong and with breath is greatly auspicious;
a Wealth line without breath gives little even if there is some;
a Wealth line in Void means there is surely none, and beware of breakage and loss;
a Wealth line born or strong can double it, resting or trapped, half;
when clashed, there is an obstruction just as it reaches the hand.

title: 空手求财：有财爻还要鬼旺才全吉；财旺无鬼、有鬼无财都得不到，二者齐全才大吉

rule.yi: 空手求财：虽有财爻，还要官鬼旺相才算全吉；财爻旺相而卦里没有官鬼，财虽可求却实际得不到；有官鬼没有财，即使有高明的手艺也得不到财；两样都要齐全，才是大吉。
rule.en: Seeking money empty-handed: even with a Wealth line, Pressure must also be strong to be fully auspicious; a strong Wealth line with no Pressure in the hexagram can be sought yet in fact cannot be had; Pressure with no Wealth gives no money even to a fine skill; both must be there for great good fortune.

zh: 空手求财，虽有财爻，
却要鬼旺方为全吉。
如财爻旺相，卦中无鬼，虽财可求，实无可得。
若有鬼无财，虽有高术，亦不得财。
二者必用二全，方为大吉。
yi: 空手求财，虽然有财爻，
还要官鬼旺相才算全吉；
如果财爻旺相，但卦里没有官鬼，财虽然可以求，实际得不到；
如果有官鬼没有财，即使有高明的手艺，也得不到财；
两者必须都齐全，才是大吉。
en: Seeking money empty-handed, even with a Wealth line,
Pressure must also be strong to be fully auspicious;
if the Wealth line is strong but the hexagram has no Pressure, money may be sought yet in fact cannot be had;
if there is Pressure but no Wealth, even a fine skill will not bring money;
the two must both be there for great good fortune.

title: 动变：父母化财先难后易，财化父母先易后难；财化兄弟先聚后散，兄弟化财先散后聚；前卦有财速谋，前卦无财迟取

rule.yi: 父母化成财，先难后易；财化成父母，先易后难。财化成兄弟，先聚后散；兄弟化成财，先散后聚。本卦有财、变卦无财，赶快谋求有得，迟了就没有；本卦无财、变卦有财，迟一些取才有，眼下还不当值。钱财多少，要凭爻的衰旺来定。书中例：九二的财动，求就一定有；九五的比肩爻动，被阻拦还没得到；买卖同样推。
rule.en: Resource turning into Wealth: hard first, easy later; Wealth turning into Resource: easy first, hard later. Wealth turning into Peer: gathered first, scattered later; Peer turning into Wealth: scattered first, gathered later. Wealth in the first hexagram and none in the later one: act quickly and you get it, late and you do not; no Wealth in the first and Wealth in the later one: take it late and you have it, it is not on duty now. How much money there is must be decided by the strength or weakness of the line. Case in the book: the Wealth on the second line moves, so seeking will surely bring it; the Peer on the fifth line moves, so it is blocked and not yet obtained; trade is worked out the same way.

note.yi: 最后一段是书里的占例：那一卦是乾变离，九二、九五两爻动（前面「占来情」等各项说的是同一卦）。「前卦」「后卦」指本卦和变卦。「比肩」是和世爻同五行的爻，这里就是兄弟。
note.en: The last passage is a case from the book: the hexagram is Qian changing to Li with the second and fifth lines moving (the earlier items on the arrival of the question and so on speak of the same hexagram). 'Former' and 'later' hexagram mean the main and the changed hexagram. 'Bijian' is a line of the same element as the Self line, here Peer.

zh: 父母化财，先难后易，
财化父母，先易后难。
财化兄弟，先聚后散，
兄弟化财，先散后聚。
yi: 父母化成财，先难后易；
财化成父母，先易后难；
财化成兄弟，先聚后散；
兄弟化成财，先散后聚。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: hard first, easy later;
Wealth turning into Resource: easy first, hard later;
Wealth turning into Peer: gathered first, scattered later;
Peer turning into Wealth: scattered first, gathered later.

zh: 前卦有财，后卦无财，速谋有得，迟则无。
前卦无财，后卦有财，迟取方有，目下未值。
财之多寡，须凭爻之衰旺决之。
yi: 本卦有财、变卦无财，赶快谋求有得，迟了就没有；
本卦无财、变卦有财，迟一些取才有，眼下还不当值；
钱财多少，要凭爻的衰旺来定。
en: Wealth in the first hexagram and none in the later one: act quickly and you get it, late and you do not;
no Wealth in the first hexagram and Wealth in the later one: take it late and you have it, it is not on duty now;
how much money there is must be decided by the strength or weakness of the line.

zh: （二十）占求财
九二财动、求之必有；
九五比肩爻动，
阻而未得也。
买卖同此推之。
yi: （第二十项）占求财：
九二爻的财发动，求就一定有；
九五爻的比肩爻发动，
被阻拦，还没有得到。
买卖也照这个来推。
en: (No. 20) A money question:
the Wealth on the second line moves: seek and you will surely have it;
the Peer on the fifth line moves,
and it is blocked and not yet obtained.
Trade is worked out the same way.

title: 子孙为财之源：加青龙发动，不问财衰旺可求；父母动、财源绝再遇白虎凶；财旺生世也只一度

rule.yi: 子孙是财的源头，再加青龙发动，不管财爻旺衰，一定可以谋求，是大吉之兆；父母动则子孙受伤，不能生财；财源已断再遇白虎同上，凶；即使财旺、生合世爻，也只能得一次，不能再谋。
rule.en: Output is the source of Wealth; with the Azure Dragon added and moving, then whether the Wealth line is strong or weak it can surely be sought, a sign of great good fortune; Resource moving hurts Output, which then cannot generate Wealth; the source already cut and the White Tiger joining is ill; even if Wealth is strong and generates or combines with the Self line it allows one time only and cannot be sought again.

zh: 子孙为财之源，若加青龙发动，
不问财爻衰旺，决可求谋，乃大吉之兆。
父母动则子受伤，不能生财。
财源已绝，若遇白虎同登，凶。
纵其财旺生合世爻，只许一度，不可再图。
yi: 子孙是财的源头，如果再加青龙发动，
不管财爻旺衰，一定可以谋求，是大吉的兆头；
父母一动，子孙受伤，就不能生财；
财源已断，如果再遇白虎同上，凶；
即使财旺、生合世爻，也只能得一次，不能再谋。
en: Output is the source of Wealth; if the Azure Dragon is added and it moves,
then whether the Wealth line is strong or weak, it can surely be sought: a sign of great good fortune;
Resource moving hurts Output, which then cannot generate Wealth;
the source of Wealth already cut, and if the White Tiger also joins, it is ill;
even if Wealth is strong and generates or combines with the Self line, it allows one time only and cannot be sought again.

title: 求财难易：财来生我、克我易得；我克财为克退，财动追不上；世静财动来生克我，财来逐我易求

rule.yi: 世是我：财来生我、克我，都吉，是容易得到的象；我克财爻叫克退，财静还可以，财动就像下面追高处，追不上；世安静、财爻发动来生我、克我，是财追着我的象，一定容易求。
rule.en: The Self is me: Wealth coming to generate or control me is auspicious, the image of easy gain; my controlling the Wealth line is called driving it back, and if Wealth is still it is tolerable but if it moves it is like chasing something above from below and you cannot reach it; the Self still and the Wealth line moving to generate or control me is the image of wealth coming after me, and it is sure to be easy to seek.

zh: 世为我，若财来生我，克我皆吉，乃易得之象；
若我克财爻，谓之克退，财静犹可，
若动，如入下逐高，不能及也。
若世安静，财爻发动，生我、克我，
此财来逐我之象，决主易求。
yi: 世是我，如果财来生我、克我，都吉，是容易得到的象；
如果是我克财爻，叫做克退，财安静还可以；
如果财发动，像是在下面追高处的东西，追不上。
如果世安静，财爻发动，来生我、克我，
这是财追着我来的象，一定容易求得。
en: The Self is me; if Wealth comes to generate or control me, both are auspicious, the image of easy gain;
if I control the Wealth line, that is called driving it back, and if Wealth is still it is tolerable;
if it moves, it is like chasing from below something above, and you cannot reach it.
If the Self is still and the Wealth line moves to generate or control me,
this is the image of wealth coming after me, and it is sure to be easy to seek.

title: 得财日：与日辰合方得入手；旺相之财墓日可得，无气之财生旺日得

rule.yi: 看得财的日子，要和日辰相合才能到手；旺相的财，墓日可以得到；没有气的财，要生旺的日子才得到。
rule.en: To find the day money is got, it must combine with the Day to come into the hand; a strong Wealth can be had on a tomb day; a Wealth without breath is had only on a day of Birth or strength.

zh: 看得财日，须与日辰合方得入手。
若旺相之财，墓日可得；
无气之财，生旺日乃得也。
yi: 看得财的日子，要和日辰相合才能到手；
旺相的财，墓日可以得到；
没有气的财，要到生旺的日子才得到。
en: To find the day money is got, it must combine with the Day to come into the hand;
a strong Wealth can be had on a tomb day;
a Wealth without breath is had only on a day of Birth or strength.

title: 占博戏：世旺克应我胜，应旺克世彼胜；子孙妻财扶世胜；斗禽虫要子孙持世旺相，鬼兄财动输

rule.yi: 赌博斗禽：福神旺，才有真物（能赢）；财是利息，官鬼动就不赢。世应上见鬼爻都败；世旺克应，我胜；应旺克世，对方胜；子孙、妻财扶世，我胜；子孙旺相喜动。斗禽虫要子孙持世旺相，或子孙独发才赢，鬼、兄、财爻动就输。
rule.en: Gambling and setting birds to fight: Output strong makes the creature true (able to win); Wealth is the winnings, and Pressure moving means no win. Pressure showing on the Self or the Other means defeat; a strong Self controlling the Other, I win; a strong Other controlling the Self, he wins; Output and Wealth supporting the Self, I win; Output strong is glad to move. For fighting birds and insects Output must sit on the Self and be strong, or move alone, and you win; if Pressure, Peer or the Wealth line moves, you lose.

note.yi: 「妻为我物，鬼为彼虫」是斗禽虫时的取法，财是我的、鬼是对方的；「若转变之事」一句很省，这里照字面译。
note.en: 'Wealth is my creature, Pressure his insect' is how the roles are taken when birds and insects are pitted against each other; 'if a matter of change' is terse and translated literally.

zh: 博戏斗禽，福旺物真；
财为利息，鬼动不赢。
yi: 赌博、斗禽，福神旺，物才真（能赢）；
财是利息（赢头），官鬼动就不赢。
en: In gambling and fighting birds, Output strong makes the creature true;
Wealth is the winnings; Pressure moving, no win.

zh: 世应见鬼爻皆败，乃彼我不得地，
世旺克应，我胜；
应旺克也，彼胜。
子孙妻财喜扶世，我胜。
子孙旺相喜动。
yi: 世应上见到鬼爻，都要败，是彼此都不得地；
世旺克应，我胜；
应旺克世，对方胜；
子孙、妻财喜欢扶助世，我胜；
子孙旺相，喜欢发动。
en: The Self and the Other both showing a Pressure line lose - neither side is in a good position;
a strong Self controlling the Other: I win;
a strong Other controlling the Self: he wins;
Output and Wealth supporting the Self: I win;
Output strong is glad to move.

zh: 或问：妻为我物，鬼为彼虫，如何取用？
答曰：此言斗禽虫也。
若转变之事，则不一同专，
要子孙持世旺相，或独发便赢，若鬼兄财爻动便输。
要知当日，俱以时辰取福德言之。
yi: 有人问：妻财是我的东西，官鬼是对方的虫，怎么取用神？
回答说：这说的是斗禽虫（斗鸡、斗蟋蟀之类）。
如果是别的转变之事，就不专一同论；
要子孙持世旺相，或子孙独发就赢；如果鬼、兄、财爻动就输。
想知道当天（结果），都用时辰取福德来说。
en: Someone asks: Wealth is my creature and Pressure his insect - how is the Subject chosen?
The answer: this speaks of pitting birds and insects.
For other kinds of matter it is not judged as one;
Output must sit on the Self strong, or move alone, and you win; if Pressure, Peer or the Wealth line moves, you lose.
To know the day's result, take Output by the hour.

title: 占畜养：财福上卦，虎动鬼兴防损失；鬼持初爻鸡鸭不吉，官坐五爻牛马难安

rule.yi: 占畜养：财旺、福神相，牲畜有益；虎动、鬼兴，要防损失。占畜养先定体：关键要财、福上卦，没有就不利；官鬼在初爻，鸡鸭不吉；官鬼在五爻，牛马难安；还要配合六神来断。
rule.en: Livestock: Wealth strong and Output thriving, the animals do well; the Tiger moving and Pressure rising, guard against loss. First fix the body of the question: the essential is Wealth and Output in the hexagram, and without them it is unfavourable; Pressure on the first line, poultry do badly; Pressure on the fifth line, cattle and horses are unsettled; and the six spirits are consulted together.

zh: 旺财相福，牲畜有益；
虎动鬼兴；必防损失。
yi: 财旺、福神相（旺相），牲畜有益；
白虎动、官鬼兴，必须防损失。
en: Wealth strong and Output thriving, the animals do well;
the Tiger moving and Pressure rising, guard against loss.

zh: 卦之畜养，须论定体。
端要财福上卦，如无不利。
鬼持初爻，鸡鸭不吉，
官坐五爻，牛马难安，
参合六神论断。
yi: 占畜养的卦，要论定它的体；
关键要财和福神上卦，没有就不利；
官鬼在初爻，鸡鸭不吉；
官鬼在五爻，牛马难安；
还要配合六神来断。
en: In a livestock hexagram, first fix its body;
the essential is Wealth and Output in the hexagram; without them it is unfavourable;
Pressure on the first line: poultry do badly;
Pressure on the fifth line: cattle and horses are unsettled;
and the six spirits are consulted together.

title: 畜养：最忌兄弟官鬼；官鬼五行各主一样病；本命爻临财福无伤则吉

rule.yi: 畜养最忌兄弟、官鬼。官鬼落在上爻（或说以五爻为主）：金鬼，牛极瘦；木鬼，脚疼或肚子受风；水鬼，牲畜散失；火鬼，中热；土鬼，发痒、瘟疫、发黄。所属牲畜的本命爻临在财、福上、没有受伤，就吉；比如兄弟、官鬼临三爻本来不好，但有亥爻这个本命临财福，就吉，不为害，其余照此类推。
rule.en: Livestock most fear Peer and Pressure. With Pressure on the top line (or, some say, the fifth line as the chief): a Metal Pressure, the ox grows very thin; Wood, sore feet or wind in the belly; Water, the animals scatter; Fire, heat stroke; Earth, itching, plague and jaundice. The animal's own natal line on Wealth or Output and unharmed is auspicious; for instance Peer or Pressure on the third line is bad in itself, but if the Hai line, the natal one, sits on Wealth or Output it is auspicious and does no harm; the rest follow from this.

note.yi: 「本命爻」是牲畜属相所对的地支爻，例子里的亥就是猪。
note.en: The natal line is the branch line matching the animal's zodiac sign; in the example Hai is the pig.

zh: 诸爻最忌兄弟、官鬼。
如鬼值上爻或曰五爻为主：
金鬼牛极瘦，
木鬼脚疼或腹风，
水鬼散，
火鬼触热，
土鬼发痒瘟黄。
yi: 各爻最忌兄弟、官鬼；
比如官鬼落在上爻（或说以五爻为主）：
金鬼，牛极瘦；
木鬼，脚疼或肚子受风；
水鬼，牲畜散失；
火鬼，中热；
土鬼，发痒、瘟疫、发黄。
en: Of all the lines, Peer and Pressure are the most feared;
with Pressure on the top line (or, some say, the fifth line as the chief):
a Metal Pressure: the ox grows very thin;
a Wood Pressure: sore feet or wind in the belly;
a Water Pressure: the animals scatter;
a Fire Pressure: heat stroke;
an Earth Pressure: itching, plague and jaundice.

zh: 逢所属本命爻临财福，无伤则吉。
且如兄鬼临三爻，本为不佳，
却有亥爻本命临财福，吉，亦不为害，
余仿此推。
yi: 碰到所属牲畜的本命爻临在财、福上，没有受伤，就吉；
比如兄弟、官鬼临三爻，本来不好，
但有亥爻这个本命临在财、福上，吉，也没有害；
其余照这个类推。
en: The animal's own natal line on Wealth or Output, unharmed, is auspicious;
for instance, Peer or Pressure on the third line is bad in itself,
but if the Hai line, the natal one, sits on Wealth or Output, it is auspicious and does no harm;
the rest follow from this.

title: 占渔猎：以世为主、以财为物，财子旺相大吉；财在四爻遇兔豕，鬼在六爻防虎豹；内克外、世克应、青龙财动不空可得

rule.yi: 占渔猎：以世为主，以财为猎物；福神兴旺、财旺，前程可望；财、官鬼落空，一无所获。财和子孙都旺相大吉；财在四爻，可遇兔和猪；官鬼在六爻，要防虎豹。内克外、内旺相、世克应，有青龙、财爻发动又不空亡，猎物可得；恶杀临在旺相的财上，发动克世，主有野兽伤人，凶。
rule.en: Fishing and hunting: the Self is the chief and Wealth the quarry; Output rising and Wealth strong, the prospect is bright; Wealth and Pressure falling void, nothing is caught. Wealth and Output both strong is greatly auspicious; Wealth on the fourth line, hares and boars may be met; Pressure on the sixth line, beware of tigers and leopards. The inner controlling the outer, the inner strong and the Self controlling the Other, with the Azure Dragon and the Wealth line moving and not void, the quarry can be had; the ill stars on a strong Wealth, moving and controlling the Self, mean a wound from a beast: ill.

note.yi: 「器弓」「财艾值断」两处字不通，译文只译能读的部分并标出；八卦配的动物是原文所列，照抄。
note.en: 'Qi bow' and 'Wealth ai on duty and cut' are corrupt; only the readable parts are translated and marked. The animals assigned to the trigrams are as the source lists them.

zh: 福兴财旺，前程可望；
财鬼虚临，山枯海旷。
yi: 福神兴、财旺，前程可望；
财、官鬼落空，山空海阔（一无所获）。
en: Output rising and Wealth strong, the prospect is bright;
Wealth and Pressure falling void, the mountains are dry and the sea empty.

zh: 卦之渔猎，
以世为主，以财为物，
财子俱见旺相大吉。
财值四爻，兔豕堪遇，
鬼临六爻，虎豹须防。
震棒、器弓、离网、艮犬，克财者宜用之。
若财艾值断，如巽鸡、艮豹、震兔、坎狐、野豕、兑羊、乾虎、离雉、坤羊之类。
yi: 占渔猎的卦，
以世为主，以财为猎物，
财和子孙都见旺相，大吉；
财在四爻，可以遇到兔和猪；
官鬼在六爻，要防虎豹；
震用棒、（器）用弓、离用网、艮用狗，哪个能克财，就宜用哪个。
如果「财艾值断」（原文不通，「艾」疑是「爻」），猎物就是这一类：巽鸡、艮豹、震兔、坎狐、野猪、兑羊、乾虎、离雉、坤羊。
en: In a fishing-and-hunting hexagram,
the Self is the chief and Wealth is the quarry;
Wealth and Output both seen strong is greatly auspicious;
Wealth on the fourth line, hares and boars may be met;
Pressure on the sixth line, beware of tigers and leopards;
Zhen a club, 'qi' a bow, Li a net, Gen a dog: use whichever controls Wealth.

If the 'Wealth ai on duty and cut' (the source is corrupt, and 'ai' is probably a slip for 'line'), the quarry is of this kind: Xun the chicken, Gen the leopard, Zhen the hare, Kan the fox, the wild boar, Dui the sheep, Qian the tiger, Li the pheasant, Kun the sheep.

zh: 内克外，内旺相，世克应，
得青龙财爻动，不空亡，物可得。
恶杀临财旺相，发动、克世，主有兽伤，凶。
yi: 内克外、内旺相、世克应，
得到青龙、财爻发动、又不空亡，猎物可以得到；
恶杀临在旺相的财上，发动、克世，主有野兽伤人，凶。
en: The inner controlling the outer, the inner strong, the Self controlling the Other,
with the Azure Dragon and the Wealth line moving and not void, the quarry can be had;
the ill stars on a strong Wealth, moving and controlling the Self, mean a wound from a beast: ill.

title: 饥寒起盗心，富贵享遐福

rule.yi: 求财本身艰险，卜卦是为了决疑；出外求财重在分祸福，在家求财重在分得失。见妻财、子孙为吉，见兄弟、官鬼为凶。
rule.en: Seeking money is hazardous, and we divine to settle doubt; for money sought abroad the question is danger or safety, at home it is gain or loss. Wealth and Output are friends; Peer and Pressure are enemies.

zh: 饥寒起盗心，亦为困穷而至此；
富贵享遐福，莫非营运而后能。
赍财于蛟龙背上行舟，负命于虎狼丛中取路。
欲决心中之疑虑，端详爻上之吉凶。
yi: 人饥寒交迫就会起偷盗之心，也是穷困才走到这一步；
富贵之人享长久之福，无不是经营之后才得到。
带着钱财在蛟龙背上行船，背着性命在虎狼群里找路。
想要解开心中的疑虑，就要仔细看爻上的吉凶。
en: Hunger and cold breed the thought of theft; it is poverty that brings people to it;
the rich enjoy lasting fortune only because they worked their trade to get it.
Carrying money, one sails on a dragon's back; carrying one's life, one picks a path among tigers and wolves.
To settle the doubt in your heart, study the omens in the lines.

hits.text: 饥寒起盗心，亦为困穷而至此
富贵享遐福，莫非营运而后能

饥寒起盗心，亦为困穷而至此
富贵享遐福，莫非营运而后能
赍财于蛟龙背上行舟，负命于虎狼丛中取路
欲决心中之疑虑，端详爻上之吉凶

zh: 求财之言艰险，于斯可见。
但能信占卜，必无不测之祸。
若出外求财，须言祸福之分。在家求财，亦有得失之别。学者可不究哉。
卜以决疑，不疑何卜？
凡来占者，必有疑虑之事，当详吉凶衰旺。
见财福如值故人，遇兄鬼如逢仇敌。
yi: 求财的艰险，从这几句就能看出来。
只要相信占卜，就不会有意外之祸。
出门求财，要说清祸福；在家求财，也有得失的分别。学的人能不深究吗？
卜卦是为了决断疑惑，不疑惑还卜什么？
来占卦的人，一定有疑虑的事，要细看吉凶衰旺。
见到妻财、子孙像遇见老朋友，遇到兄弟、官鬼像碰上仇人。
en: How hard and dangerous the pursuit of money is can be seen from these words.
If one trusts divination, there will be no unforeseen disaster.
For money sought away from home one must tell danger from safety; for money sought at home there is still gain and loss to tell apart. Should a student not look into it?
We divine to resolve doubt; without doubt, why divine?
Whoever comes to ask has something in doubt; examine the good and bad, the strong and weak.
Meeting Wealth and Output is like meeting old friends; meeting Peer and Pressure is like running into enemies.

title: 将本求财，妻位偏宜旺相；空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆

rule.yi: 将本求财看妻财：财爻旺相、克世或生世吉，世克财凶；卦有两财，外旺内冲本少利多，内旺外冲只能保本；内外财死绝、财不上卦或空亡则折本；财绝逢生仍有利。空手求财（百工技艺）看官鬼：鬼旺财厚；《断易天机》本说官鬼所临六神指财的来路（青龙馈送、朱雀文书口舌、勾陈稳当、螣蛇靠人带挈、白虎诈取、玄武暗昧）。
rule.en: Trading with capital: read the Wealth line; thriving and controlling or generating the Self line is good, the Self line controlling Wealth is bad; with two Wealth lines, outer strong and inner clashed means small capital and large profit, inner strong and outer clashed means only the capital is kept; both dead, absent or void means losing the capital; Wealth at extinction meeting birth still profits. Earning without capital (crafts and trades): read the Pressure line; strong Pressure, ample money. The Duanyi Tianji text adds that the spirit on the Pressure line shows where the money comes from (Azure Dragon gifts, Vermilion Bird documents or talk, Hook Earth steady, Coiling Snake through others, White Tiger fraud, Dark Tortoise hidden dealings).

note.yi: 《断易天机》本这一段注比《卜筮大全》本多出官鬼临六神那几句；这里只引多出来的部分，相同的部分见上一段。
note.en: The Duanyi Tianji text of this commentary has extra sentences on the six spirits over the Pressure line; only those extra sentences are quoted here, the shared part is in the previous quote.

zh: 将本求财，妻位偏宜旺相；
空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆。
yi: 拿本钱求财，妻财尤其宜旺相；
空手求利，喜欢官鬼兴旺。
en: Trading with capital: the Wealth line above all should be thriving;
earning without capital: the Pressure line is welcome to flourish.

hits.text: 将本求财，妻位偏宜旺相
空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆
空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆
将本求财，妻位偏宜旺相
空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆

zh: 凡占求财，先达人事，然后决断。
若将本求财，必要财爻旺相，克世生世则吉，世克财则凶。
若卦有两财，外财旺而内财冲，本虽少而利则多；
若内财旺而外财冲，利息淡薄，但可正本。
若：内外财爻俱死绝，将本生涯敛手折。
财不上卦及空亡，买卖经商连本灭。
财爻绝处又逢生，利息依然动欢悦。
妻财虽旺不克世，却向爻中看亡劫。
先生若也问求财，请看天仙玄妙诀。
空手求财者，不过是百工技艺之人，以鬼爻为用，鬼旺则财丰厚。
yi: 凡是占求财，先要了解他实际在做什么事，然后再下断。
如果是拿本钱求财，一定要财爻旺相；财克世、生世就吉，世克财就凶。
如果卦里有两个财爻，外卦的财旺而内卦的财被冲，本钱虽少利却多；
如果内卦的财旺而外卦的财被冲，利息微薄，只能保本。
（有诗说：）内外卦的财爻都死绝，拿本钱的生意只能收手认赔；
财不在卦上或落空亡，做买卖经商连本钱都没了。
财爻在绝地又遇到生扶，利息照样让人高兴。
妻财虽旺却不克世，就要到爻中去看亡神、劫杀。
先生如果也来问求财，请看这天仙玄妙的口诀。
空手求财的，不过是各行手艺之人，以官鬼为用神，官鬼旺财就丰厚。
en: In every money question, first understand the person's actual affairs, then judge.
When trading with capital, the Wealth line must be thriving; Wealth controlling or generating the Self line is good, the Self line controlling Wealth is bad.
If there are two Wealth lines, the outer one strong and the inner one clashed, the capital is small but the profit large;
if the inner one is strong and the outer one clashed, the profit is thin, and only the capital is kept.
(As the verse says:) if inner and outer Wealth lines are both dead or extinguished, a capital venture ends with hands folded and money lost;
Wealth absent from the hexagram or void: trade and commerce lose even the capital;
a Wealth line at extinction that meets birth again: the profit still brings joy;
if Wealth is strong but does not control the Self line, look among the lines for the Loss and Robbery stars.
Sir, if you too ask about money, see this marvellous formula of the immortals.
Those who earn without capital are craftsmen and artisans; the Pressure line is what they read, and when it is strong the money is plentiful.

zh: 旺相财空，闹处得财。
青龙鬼，馈送得财。
朱雀鬼，文书口舌之财。
勾陈鬼，财稳无反复。
蛇鬼，事未伶俐，是于人之财，或是人带挈之财。
白虎鬼，必是诈取。
玄武鬼，是骗人，阴私不明之财，阴鬼加咸池，必得女人财。
yi: （官鬼）旺相而财爻落空，在热闹的地方得财。
官鬼临青龙，因馈赠得财。
官鬼临朱雀，是文书、口舌（说话）得来的财。
官鬼临勾陈，财稳当，不反复。
官鬼临螣蛇，事情不太利索，是从别人那里来的财，或是别人提携带来的财。
官鬼临白虎，一定是诈取来的。
官鬼临玄武，是骗来的、见不得光的财；阴爻官鬼加咸池，一定得女人的财。
en: Pressure strong while Wealth is void: the money comes from crowded places.
Pressure on the Azure Dragon: money from gifts.
On the Vermilion Bird: money from documents or from talking.
On the Hook Earth: steady money, no reversals.
On the Coiling Snake: the matter is not clean-cut; the money comes from others, or through someone taking you along.
On the White Tiger: it must be taken by fraud.
On the Dark Tortoise: money got by deceit, hidden and unclear; a yin Pressure line with the Salt Pool star: money from a woman.

title: 鬼化为财克世大吉，财爻化鬼逢空全凶

rule.yi: 官鬼化财（鬼送财）而来克世：大吉；若世爻去克官鬼则无财。财化官鬼：从有到无，再逢空为全凶。《断易天机》本：得日辰扶合、动爻生扶为「财入鬼手」，可无伤；旺财化衰鬼，财不全；衰财化旺鬼，防加倍折财。财化财：本卦财旺而变出的财无气，宜速求；反之宜待。
rule.en: Pressure turning into Wealth ('the ghost bringing money') that controls the Self line: very lucky; if the Self line controls the Pressure line instead, no money. Wealth turning into Pressure: something becomes nothing, and void as well it is wholly unlucky. The Duanyi Tianji text: with the Day supporting or combining, or a moving line generating it, it is 'money in the ghost's hand' and may do no harm; strong Wealth into weak Pressure, the money is not whole; weak Wealth into strong Pressure, beware of double loss. Wealth into Wealth: a strong original turning into a forceless one, seek quickly; the reverse, wait.

note.yi: 《断易天机》本的注比《卜筮大全》本详细，而且是穿插着多出来的，所以两段都全文引出，方便对照。
note.en: The Duanyi Tianji commentary is fuller than the Bushi Daquan one, with its extra sentences woven through, so both are quoted in full for comparison.

zh: 鬼化为财，克世须云大吉；
财爻化鬼，逢空可谓全凶。
yi: 官鬼化出财来，又来克世，应当说大吉；
财爻化出官鬼，再逢空亡，可说全凶。
en: Pressure turning into Wealth that controls the Self line: call it very lucky;
the Wealth line turning into Pressure and falling void: call it wholly unlucky.

hits.text: 鬼化为财克世，须云大吉
财爻化鬼逢空，可谓全凶
鬼化为财，克世须云大吉
财爻化鬼，逢空可谓全凶

zh: 鬼化财，从空而至。
且来克世，是利追我而走，故云大吉；
财化鬼，自有化无。
又落空亡，是消磨殆尽，故曰全凶。
yi: 官鬼化财，财是从无中来的。
又来克世，是利追着我跑，所以说大吉；
财化官鬼，是从有变成无。
又落空亡，是消耗殆尽，所以说全凶。
en: Pressure turning into Wealth: the money comes out of nothing.
If it also controls the Self line, the profit is chasing after me; hence very lucky;
Wealth turning into Pressure: what exists turns into nothing.
Falling void as well, it wears away to nothing; hence wholly unlucky.

zh: 鬼化财，是财从空而至。
财本是生鬼的，而鬼反而化财，谓之鬼送财。
且来克世，是利追我而走，故云大吉。
若世爻克鬼，则无财。
财化鬼，是财自有化无。
午前占，谓之鬼偷财。
若得日辰扶合，或动爻生扶，谓之财入鬼手，庶无伤也。
若旺财化衰鬼，其财不全。
若衰财化旺鬼，须防两倍折财。
又落空亡，是消磨殆尽，故曰全凶。
凡遇财化财，本来是吉，但其中也有分别。
若前卦财旺化财无气，午前占，宜速求，向后财必薄。
午后占，宜早求，财利丰盈，今财稍薄不如前。
若前卦财衰而化财旺，反此断之必无差。
yi: 官鬼化财，是财从无中来。
本来是财生官鬼，现在官鬼反而化出财来，叫作「鬼送财」。
又来克世，是利追着我跑，所以说大吉。
如果是世爻去克官鬼，就没有财。
财化官鬼，是财从有变无。
午前占得，叫作「鬼偷财」。
如果有日辰扶合，或动爻生扶，叫作「财入鬼手」，大概没有伤害。
旺的财化成衰的官鬼，财不能全得。
衰的财化成旺的官鬼，要防加倍折财。
又落空亡，是消耗殆尽，所以说全凶。
凡是财化财，本来是吉，但其中也有分别。
如果本卦的财旺、化出的财无气：午前占得，宜赶快求，往后财一定薄；
午后占得，宜早点求，财利丰厚，现在的财比先前稍薄。
如果本卦的财衰而化出的财旺，就反过来断，一定不会错。
en: Pressure turning into Wealth: the money comes out of nothing.
Normally Wealth feeds Pressure; when Pressure turns into Wealth instead, it is called 'the ghost bringing money'.
If it also controls the Self line, the profit is chasing me; hence very lucky.
If instead the Self line controls the Pressure line, there is no money.
Wealth turning into Pressure: the money turns from something into nothing.
Cast before noon, it is called 'the ghost stealing money'.
If the Day supports or combines with it, or a moving line generates and supports it, it is called 'money in the ghost's hand', and there may be no harm.
A strong Wealth turning into a weak Pressure: the money does not come whole.
A weak Wealth turning into a strong Pressure: beware of losing twice as much.
Falling void as well, it wears away to nothing; hence wholly unlucky.
Wealth turning into Wealth is normally lucky, but there are distinctions.
If the original Wealth is strong and the Wealth it turns into has no force: cast before noon, seek it quickly, for later the money will be thin;
cast after noon, seek it early; the profit is ample, though the money now is a little thinner than before.
If the original Wealth is weak and the Wealth it turns into is strong, judge the other way round and you will not err.

title: 父化妻爻当涉艰辛，财连兄位积聚当分

rule.yi: 父母化财：先难后得；父旺财衰，辛苦多财少；父衰财旺，用力少财多。财化兄弟：有侵夺，积蓄也要分散（本就与人分利则无妨）。兄弟化财：先散后聚。《断易天机》本：父母、兄弟化财，虽辛苦亦吉；父爻带贵人有依靠，带太岁凶煞防因财染病。
rule.en: Resource turning into Wealth: difficulty first, gain later; Resource strong and Wealth weak, much toil and little money; the reverse, little effort and much money. Wealth turning into Peer: encroachment, savings scattered (no harm if you were sharing the profit anyway). Peer turning into Wealth: scattered first, gathered later. The Duanyi Tianji text: Resource or Peer turning into Wealth is lucky however hard the way; the Resource line with the Noble star means someone to lean on, with the Tai Sui's killing star beware of falling ill over the money.

zh: 父化妻爻，当涉艰辛始得；
财连兄位，纵然积聚当分。
yi: 父母化出妻财，要经历艰辛才得到；
财连着兄弟（财化兄弟），即使积聚了也要分掉。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: gain comes only after hardship;
Wealth linked with Peer: whatever is gathered will be shared out.

hits.text: 父化妻爻，当涉艰辛始得
财连兄位，纵然积聚当分
父化妻爻，当涉艰辛始得
财连兄位，纵然积聚当分

zh: 凡父化财，必先难后获。
父旺财衰，则艰辛多而财少；父衰财旺，则用力少而财多。
财化弟兄，将有侵夺之患，虽有积蓄，亦当分散也。
yi: 凡是父母化财，一定先难后得。
父母旺、财衰，辛苦多而财少；父母衰、财旺，用力少而财多。
财化兄弟，会有被侵夺的祸患，即使有积蓄，也要分散。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: first difficulty, then gain.
Resource strong and Wealth weak: much toil, little money; Resource weak and Wealth strong: little effort, much money.
Wealth turning into Peer: there will be encroachment; even savings will be scattered.

zh: 凡父化财，必先难后获。
父旺财衰，则艰辛多而财少。父衰财旺，则用力少而财多。
父爻带贵，可言倚靠，若加太岁杀，因财染病归。
财化弟兄，纵来克世，亦无全得，将有侵夺之患，虽有积蓄，亦当分散也。
若持世，难取谋望之心。
财爻旺化兄弟，当见聚而后分，若果与人分利则无妨。
若兄弟化财，则主先散后聚，或谋出于众，利归一源，或始艰辛，然后称心。
凡父兄化财，纵有艰辛，亦吉。
yi: 凡是父母化财，一定先难后得。
父母旺、财衰，辛苦多而财少；父母衰、财旺，用力少而财多。
父母爻带贵人，可以说有依靠；如果带太岁凶煞，会因为求财染病而归。
财化兄弟，即使来克世，也不能全得，会有被侵夺的祸患，即使有积蓄，也要分散。
如果（化出的兄弟）持世，所谋所望难以达成。
财爻旺而化兄弟，会先聚后分；如果本来就是和人分利，就不要紧。
如果兄弟化财，主先散后聚；或者是大家出主意、利归一处；或者开头艰辛，后来称心。
凡是父母、兄弟化财，即使有艰辛，也是吉。
en: Resource turning into Wealth: first difficulty, then gain.
Resource strong and Wealth weak: much toil, little money; Resource weak and Wealth strong: little effort, much money.
If the Resource line carries the Noble star, there is someone to lean on; if it carries the Tai Sui's killing star, you will come home ill because of the money.
Wealth turning into Peer: even if it controls the Self line, you will not get it all; there will be encroachment, and even savings will be scattered.
If that Peer sits on the Self line, what you hope for is hard to reach.
A strong Wealth line turning into Peer: gathered first, then divided; if you were sharing the profit with others anyway, no harm.
Peer turning into Wealth: first scattered, then gathered; or many plan together and the profit flows to one place; or hardship first, then satisfaction.
Whenever Resource or Peer turns into Wealth, it is lucky, however hard the way.

title: 凶神冲散财爻，劫杀加临兄位

rule.yi: 凶神（如白虎、螣蛇）冲克财爻：出外行船防风波，世爻临吉神则人无事而财散，虎蛇克世则财命难保；在家求财则主恶人搅扰或因财惹官非，有解神无事。劫杀（神煞）临财，财不可得；临发动的兄弟，得财后防失，再加玄武有盗劫；贵人临官鬼持世，或官鬼动而制住兄弟，可免；官鬼无气则兄弟仍为祸。
rule.en: A baleful spirit (such as the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake) clashing or controlling the Wealth line: abroad, beware of storms on the water; with a good spirit on the Self line you are safe but the money drifts off; the Tiger or Snake controlling the Self line endangers both money and life. At home it means troublemakers or the money dragging you into an official matter; a relieving spirit ends it. The Robbery star on Wealth: the money cannot be had; on a moving Peer: beware of losing it afterwards, and with the Dark Tortoise, of robbery; the Noble star on a Pressure line holding the Self line, or a moving Pressure restraining Peer, averts it; a forceless Pressure line cannot.

note.yi: 这里的「劫杀」是神煞，和《黄金策》「岁君逢劫杀」里指兄弟爻的「劫杀」不是一回事。
note.en: The Robbery star here is a spirit-star; it is not the 'robber' of the Golden Strategy's 'Tai Sui meets the robber', which means the Peer line.

zh: 凶神冲散财爻，切忌风波险阻；
劫杀加临兄位，须防盗贼相侵。
yi: 凶神冲散财爻，千万要防风波险阻；
劫杀临在兄弟爻上，要防盗贼来侵犯。
en: If a baleful spirit clashes the Wealth line apart, beware of storms and perils;
if the Robbery star falls on the Peer line, beware of thieves.

hits.text: 凶神冲散财爻，切忌风波险阻
劫杀加临兄位，须防盗贼相侵
凶神冲散财爻，切忌风波险阻
劫杀加临兄位，须防盗贼相侵

zh: 凡凶神来冲克财爻，行船便见风波之患。
世爻若值吉神，身虽无咎，财必飘零。
凶神若遇虎蛇克世，财命不可保全。
若就家中求，却不如此断。
必是凶人搅乱，或因财引惹公事。
若值解神，却得无事。
劫杀乃求财之大忌，若临财位，必不可得。
若临兄弟发动，得财之后，防有失脱；
若更玄武加临，必有盗贼劫掠之祸；
若得贵人临鬼持世，虽有贼来，无伤于我；
如逢鬼动，兄弟受制，纵有凶神，亦无大患。
鬼爻无气则无权，兄弟依然来作祸。
yi: 凡是凶神来冲克财爻，行船就有风浪之患。
世爻如果临吉神，人虽然没事，财一定散失。
凶神如果是白虎、螣蛇来克世，钱财和性命都难保。
如果是在家里求财，就不这样断。
那一定是有恶人捣乱，或因为财惹上官司。
如果遇到解神，就能没事。
劫杀是求财的大忌，如果临在财爻上，一定得不到。
如果临在发动的兄弟上，得财之后，要防失落；
如果再加玄武，一定有盗贼抢劫之祸；
如果贵人临官鬼持世，即使有贼来，也伤不到我；
如果官鬼发动，兄弟受制，即使有凶神，也没有大患。
官鬼无气就没有力量，兄弟照样来作祸。
en: Whenever a baleful spirit clashes with or controls the Wealth line, a voyage will meet storms.
If the Self line carries a good spirit, you yourself are unharmed but the money drifts away.
If the baleful spirit is the White Tiger or the Coiling Snake controlling the Self line, neither money nor life is safe.
If the money is sought at home, do not judge it this way.
It will be bad people making trouble, or the money dragging you into an official matter.
If a relieving spirit is present, all will be well.
The Robbery star is the great enemy of seeking money; if it falls on the Wealth line, the money cannot be had.
If it falls on a moving Peer line, after you get the money, beware of losing it;
if the Dark Tortoise is there as well, robbery is certain;
if the Noble star falls on a Pressure line sitting on the Self line, thieves may come but cannot hurt me;
if Pressure moves and Peer is held down, there is no great harm even with baleful spirits about.
But a Pressure line without force has no power, and Peer will still do its damage.

title: 子动会青龙，生财大道；父兴临白虎，绝利根源

rule.yi: 子孙是财源：卦无财而子孙旺动仍可求，临青龙等同有财；鬼化财或化子孙最利；子孙化子孙，财从两处来，宜两处求或与人同求；财逢长生、子孙临官，绵绵不绝；财旺而子孙死绝，只得一次；子孙旺而被父母克（父母发动临白虎），断绝财源，日辰合子孙可免。
rule.en: Output is the source of money: with no Wealth in the hexagram, a strong moving Output still allows the venture, and with the Azure Dragon it counts as having money; Pressure turning into Wealth or into Output is the best of luck; Output turning into Output, money from two places, so seek in two places or with a partner; Wealth at Birth and Output at its Official stage, the money keeps coming; Wealth strong but Output dead or extinguished, only once; Output strong but controlled by Resource (Resource moving with the White Tiger), the source is cut, unless the Day combines with Output.

zh: 子动会青龙，乃生财之大道；
父兴临白虎，为绝利之根源。
yi: 子孙发动又临青龙，是生财的大道；
父母发动又临白虎，是断绝财利的根源。
en: Output moving with the Azure Dragon: the great road to making money;
Resource moving with the White Tiger: the root that cuts off profit.

hits.text: 子动会青龙，乃生财之大道
父兴临白虎，为绝利之根源
子动会青龙，乃生财之大道
父兴临白虎，为绝利之根源
子动会青龙，乃生财之大道
父兴临白虎，为绝利之根源

zh: 若卦内无财，而子孙旺动，亦可求谋。
更临青龙，比同有财之卦；若值休囚，更宜斟酌；
若鬼化子孙，谓之鬼运财来付好人。
苍屏有歌曰：鬼化为财及子孙，求财最利称心情。更逢福德来生世，安坐高堂也获珍。
若子孙化子孙，财从两处生。财既是两处生，宜两处求，或与人同求，大吉。
子孙乃生财之神，比同水之有源，源头受克则泉竭，泉水旺盛则流长。
若财位逢长生，福德临官，此等求财，绵绵不绝。
或财虽旺，子孙死绝，只许一度，后再难求。
子孙虽旺，父母来克，谓之绝生财之源，虽有钱财，亦无接济。
若遇日辰相合，庶几不被克伤。
yi: 如果卦里没有财，而子孙旺相发动，也可以去求。
再临青龙，就等同有财的卦；如果子孙休囚，就要再斟酌；
如果官鬼化子孙，叫作「鬼把财运来交给好人」。
苍屏有歌说：官鬼化财或化子孙，求财最有利、最称心；再有子孙来生世，安坐家中也能得宝。
如果子孙化子孙，财从两处来。既然从两处来，宜在两处求，或和别人一起求，大吉。
子孙是生财之神，就像水有源头：源头受克泉水就干，泉水旺盛水流就长。
如果财爻逢长生，子孙临官，这样求财绵绵不绝。
如果财虽旺而子孙死绝，只能得一次，以后难再求。
子孙虽旺，父母来克它，叫作断绝生财之源，即使有钱也没有后续。
如果子孙遇日辰相合，大概不会被克伤。
en: If there is no Wealth in the hexagram but Output is strong and moving, the venture can still be pursued.
With the Azure Dragon as well, it counts as a hexagram with money; if Output is resting or trapped, weigh it further;
Pressure turning into Output is called 'the ghost carrying money to a good person'.
Cangping's song says: Pressure turning into Wealth or into Output is the best of luck for money; if Output also generates the Self line, you gain treasure sitting at home.
Output turning into Output: money arises from two places; so seek it in two places, or together with someone; very lucky.
Output is the spirit that generates money, like the spring of a stream: controlled at the source, the spring dries; strong at the source, the stream runs long.
If Wealth is at its Birth stage and Output at its Official stage, the money keeps coming.
If Wealth is strong but Output dead or extinguished, you get it once, and not again.
If Output is strong but Resource controls it, it is called cutting off the source; even with money now, nothing follows.
If the Day combines with Output, it may escape the harm.

title: 世克动财若赶沙场之马，财生静世如逢涸泽之鱼

rule.yi: 财来生、克、合世爻或持世：财来就我，伸手可得；世爻去克发动的财：我去追财，难得（即使日辰合财也不得）；世生动财而日辰合住，或许可得。《断易天机》本：财在内卦动易，在外卦动难。
rule.en: Wealth generating, controlling or combining with the Self line, or sitting on it: the money comes to me, reach out and take it. The Self line controlling a moving Wealth: I chase the money and do not catch it (even if the Day combines with it). The Self line generating a moving Wealth that the Day holds by combination: it may be had. The Duanyi Tianji text: Wealth moving in the inner trigram is easy, in the outer hard.

zh: 世克动财，若赶沙场之马；
财生静世，如逢涸泽之鱼。
yi: 世爻去克发动的财，像在沙场上追马；
财来生安静的世爻，像在干涸的水塘里捉鱼。
en: The Self line controlling a moving Wealth: like chasing a horse across the sands;
Wealth generating a still Self line: like catching fish in a dried-up pond.

hits.text: 世克动财，若赶沙场之马
财生静世，如逢涸泽之鱼
世克动财若越沙场之马
世克动财，若赶沙场之马
财生静世，如逢涸泽之鱼

zh: 大凡求财，财来生世克世则易。
财来逐我，如涸泽取鱼，伸手便得。
若世克动财，是我去逐利，如沙丘劣马，愈赶愈奔，终难上手。
yi: 大凡求财，财来生世、克世就容易。
财来追我，像在干塘里取鱼，伸手就得。
如果世爻克发动的财，是我去追利，像沙丘上的劣马，越赶跑得越远，终究抓不到手。
en: In seeking money, Wealth generating or controlling the Self line makes it easy.
The money chases me, like taking fish from a dry pond: reach out and it is yours.
If the Self line controls a moving Wealth, I am the one chasing profit, like an unruly horse on the dunes: the more you chase, the farther it runs, and you never catch it.

zh: 大凡求财，财在内动易求，外动难求。
财来生世、克世、合世、持世则易，是财来逐我，如涸泽取鱼，伸手便得。
若世生动财，得日辰合住，财庶几可以得。
若世克动财，是我去逐利，纵与日辰相合，亦不可得。
倘世爻无杀，财在内动稍可，若在外动，则如沙丘劣马，愈赶愈奔，终难上手。
yi: 大凡求财，财在内卦动容易求，在外卦动难求。
财来生世、克世、合世、持世就容易，是财来追我，像在干塘里取鱼，伸手就得。
如果世爻去生发动的财，有日辰把财合住，财大概还能得到。
如果世爻克发动的财，是我去追利，即使（财）和日辰相合，也得不到。
如果世爻上没有凶煞，财在内卦动还稍可；如果在外卦动，就像沙丘上的劣马，越赶越跑，终究抓不到手。
en: In seeking money, Wealth moving in the inner trigram is easy to get, in the outer hard.
Wealth generating, controlling, combining with or sitting on the Self line is easy: the money chases me, like taking fish from a dry pond.
If the Self line generates a moving Wealth and the Day combines with and holds it, the money may still be had.
If the Self line controls a moving Wealth, I am chasing profit; even if the Day combines with it, it cannot be had.
If the Self line carries no killing star, Wealth moving in the inner trigram is just possible; moving in the outer, it is the unruly horse on the dunes that runs the harder you chase.

title: 克害刑冲迫兄鬼，则灾殃消散

rule.yi: 兄弟、官鬼是求财的忌神，它们受克、害、刑、冲就灾消、财有望。《断易天机》本细分：吉神克我吉、凶神克我凶，我克兄鬼愁散、我克财福无财；害财则财有妨，害鬼则鬼无作，还要看衰旺；刑鬼煞吉、刑财福凶，刑世伤我、刑应伤彼，应合世而被刑难成；日辰冲世应或冲财难成，冲散财则无财；吉神逢冲凶，凶神逢冲吉。
rule.en: Peer and Pressure are the adversaries of money; when they are controlled, harmed, punished or clashed, trouble disperses and money becomes possible. The Duanyi Tianji text details it: a good spirit controlling me is good, a baleful one bad; my controlling Peer or Pressure dispels worry, my controlling Wealth or Output means no money; harming Wealth hinders it, harming Pressure disarms it, strength decides; punishing Pressure or a killing star is good, punishing Wealth or Output bad, punishing the Self line hurts me, the Other line the other side, and an Other line combining with the Self but punished will not close; the Day clashing Self, Other or Wealth makes it hard, clashing Wealth apart leaves no money; a good spirit clashed is bad, a baleful one clashed is good.

note.yi: 《断易天机》本在这一句下有一大段讲克、害、刑、冲的通论（包括哪几对地支相害、各家说法），这里只引和求财有关的几句。
note.en: Under this line the Duanyi Tianji text has a long general essay on control, harm, punishment and clash (including which branch pairs harm each other and what various authorities say); only the sentences bearing on money are quoted here.

zh: 克害刑冲迫兄鬼，
则灾殃消散；
yi: 兄弟、官鬼受到克、害、刑、冲的逼迫，
灾祸就消散；
en: When Peer and Pressure are pressed by control, harm, punishment and clash,
disaster melts away;

zh: 兄鬼：皆求财之忌神。
今彼受制，不惟求财有望，抑且灾散祸消矣。
yi: 兄弟、官鬼都是求财的忌神。
现在它们受制，不但求财有望，而且灾祸都消散了。
en: Peer and Pressure are both Adversary lines in seeking money.
Now that they are held down, not only is there hope of money, but disaster disperses as well.

zh: 凡占求财福，吉神克我则吉，兄鬼凶神克我则凶，
我克兄鬼则愁散，我克财福则无财。
yi: 凡是占求财，吉神（财、福）来克我就吉，兄弟、官鬼这些凶神来克我就凶；
我去克兄弟、官鬼，忧愁消散；我去克妻财、子孙，就没有财。
en: In seeking money, a good spirit (Wealth, Output) controlling me is good; Peer, Pressure or a baleful spirit controlling me is bad;
my controlling Peer and Pressure dispels worry; my controlling Wealth and Output means no money.

zh: 凡遇害妻财，则财有妨。害鬼杀，则鬼无作。
害彼则吉，害我则凶。
占者当分衰旺，若我世旺，彼虽欲害而无伤，若害爻旺，则凶。
刑者：阴阳反德也。若加羊刃，可谓逞凶刑伤也。刃者，煞也。有刑而无刃，则不杀。
凡占刑，刑鬼煞凶神则吉，刑财福吉神则凶。
世应皆怕逢刑，刑世伤我，刑应则对方遭伤。
求财必应合世，若被刑伤，安可就也。
冲者：十二支战击之象。
有日辰冲世应，冲财，则难就，冲散财则无财。
吉神逢冲凶，凶神恶煞逢冲则吉。
yi: 凡是（某爻）害妻财，财就受妨碍；害官鬼凶煞，鬼就作不了祸。
害别人就吉，害自己就凶。
占的人要分清衰旺：如果我的世爻旺，对方虽想害也伤不着；如果害我的那一爻旺，就凶。
刑，是阴阳违背了本德。若再加羊刃，就是逞凶的刑伤。刃就是煞。有刑而没有刃，就不至于杀伤。
凡是看刑：刑官鬼、凶煞就吉，刑妻财、子孙这些吉神就凶。
世、应都怕逢刑：刑世伤我，刑应就是对方受伤。
求财一定要应爻合世爻，如果被刑伤，怎么能成呢。
冲，是十二地支相互攻击的象。
日辰冲世、应，或冲财，事情难成；把财冲散，就没有财。
吉神逢冲凶，凶神恶煞逢冲反而吉。
en: When something harms Wealth, the money is hindered; when it harms the Pressure line or a killing star, that ghost can do nothing.
Harm done to the other side is good; harm done to me is bad.
Distinguish strength: if my Self line is strong, the other cannot hurt it though it tries; if the harming line is strong, it is bad.
Punishment is yin and yang turned against their virtue. With the Goat Blade star added, it is a punishment that wounds. The blade is the killing star; punishment without the blade does not kill.
As for punishment: punishing Pressure or a baleful star is good; punishing Wealth, Output or a good spirit is bad.
Both Self and Other fear punishment: punishing the Self line hurts me, punishing the Other hurts the other side.
Seeking money needs the Other line to combine with the Self line; if that is punished, how can it succeed?
A clash is the twelve branches striking at each other.
If the Day clashes with Self, Other or Wealth, the matter is hard to close; if it clashes the Wealth apart, there is no money.
A good spirit clashed is bad; a baleful spirit or killing star clashed is good.

title: 生扶拱合辅财福，则货宝丰盈

rule.yi: 妻财、子孙得生扶拱合，财货丰盈。《断易天机》本细分：日辰生财福吉、生鬼杀凶；财生世易求、世生财难求；应生世是人来就我，世生应是我赶他人；世应相生逢冲仍有阻；财福拱我得人相助，我拱兄弟是他人把权；合财福吉、合鬼杀凶，合处逢生十拿九稳。
rule.en: Wealth and Output helped by generation, support, propping and combination: goods and money abound. The Duanyi Tianji text details it: the Day generating Wealth or Output is good, generating Pressure or a killing star bad; Wealth generating the Self line is easy money, the Self generating Wealth hard; the Other generating the Self means they come to me, the reverse means I run after them; Self and Other generating each other can still be blocked by a clash; Wealth or Output propping me means help from others, my propping Peer means others hold the power; combining with Wealth or Output is good, with Pressure or a killing star bad; a combination that also meets generation is a sure thing.

note.yi: 《断易天机》本在这一句下也有一段讲生、扶、拱、合的通论，这里只引和求财有关的几句。
note.en: Here too the Duanyi Tianji text has a general essay on generation, support, propping and combination; only the sentences bearing on money are quoted.

zh: 生扶拱合辅财福，
则货宝丰盈。
yi: 妻财、子孙得到生、扶、拱、合的辅助，
货物财宝就丰盈。
en: When Wealth and Output are helped by generation, support, propping and combination,
goods and treasure abound.

zh: 妻财子孙，生涯紧要。
且有生扶拱合，岂不财货盈溢，珍宝满箱。
yi: 妻财、子孙，是谋生的要害。
再有生扶拱合，岂不是财货满溢、珍宝满箱。
en: Wealth and Output are what a livelihood hangs on.
Add generation, support, propping and combination, and how could the goods not overflow and the chests fill with treasure?

zh: 生者：阴阳交会而相生也。
日辰生财福则吉，生鬼杀则凶。
财生世易求，世生财难求。
若应生世，他人就我，世生应，我赶他人。
世应相生，逢冲亦有阻。
yi: 生，是阴阳交会而相生。
日辰生妻财、子孙就吉，生官鬼凶煞就凶。
财生世容易求，世生财难求。
应生世，是别人来就我；世生应，是我去追别人。
世应相生，但逢冲也会有阻碍。
en: Generation is yin and yang meeting and giving rise to each other.
The Day generating Wealth or Output is good; generating Pressure or a killing star is bad.
Wealth generating the Self line: easy to get; the Self line generating Wealth: hard.
The Other generating the Self: the other party comes to me; the Self generating the Other: I run after them.
Self and Other generating each other can still be blocked by a clash.

zh: 凡遇财福拱，我则得人佐助，财力倍常。
若我拱兄弟，是他人把权，其财爻纵旺，亦难遂意。
合者：阴阳之和，天地之德也。
凡合财福则吉，合鬼杀则凶也。
合处逢生，如同瓮中捉鳖。
yi: 凡是财、福来拱我，就得人帮助，财力加倍。
如果是我去拱兄弟，就是别人掌权，财爻即使旺，也难如意。
合，是阴阳和谐、天地之德。
凡是合财、福就吉，合官鬼凶煞就凶。
合住之处又逢生，就像瓮中捉鳖（十拿九稳）。
en: When Wealth or Output props me up, others come to my aid and my means double.
If I prop up Peer, others hold the power, and even a strong Wealth line will not go as I wish.
Combination is the harmony of yin and yang, the virtue of heaven and earth.
Combining with Wealth or Output is good; combining with Pressure or a killing star is bad.
A combination that also meets generation is like catching a turtle in a jar: a sure thing.

title: 前卦有财后卦无，前卦无财后卦有

rule.yi: 本卦有财、变卦无财：宜速求，迟则难得；本卦无财、变卦有财：先难后得，宜等时机，或等财爻旺相的年月。
rule.en: Wealth in the original hexagram but not in the changed one: seek quickly, for later it is hard to get. No Wealth in the original but Wealth in the changed one: hardship first, gain later; wait for the moment, or for the year and month in which Wealth is strong.

zh: 前卦有财后卦无，不利于后；
前卦无财后卦有，艰难在前。
yi: 本卦有财、变卦没有，不利于后面；
本卦没有财、变卦有，艰难在前面。
en: Wealth in the original hexagram but not in the changed one: bad for later;
no Wealth in the original but Wealth in the changed one: the hardship comes first.

hits.text: 前卦有财后卦无，不利于后
前卦无财后卦有，艰难在前
前卦有财后卦无，不利于后
前卦无财后卦有，艰难在前

zh: 前卦有财后卦无，宜速求，迟则难得；
前卦无财后卦有，宜待时行事，或看财爻旺相年月，方可谋望。
yi: 本卦有财、变卦无财，宜赶快求，晚了难得；
本卦无财、变卦有财，宜等时机再做，或看财爻旺相的年月，才可谋求。
en: Wealth before but not after: seek it quickly; later it is hard to get;
no Wealth before but Wealth after: wait for the right time, or for the year and month in which the Wealth line is strong, before making a move.

title: 财合日辰方能入手，财逢墓库便可归怀

rule.yi: 得财之日：财与日辰相合之日（或财爻值日）、财爻入墓之日；《断易天机》本细分：财旺逢入墓之日得，财衰逢生旺之日得。
rule.en: The day the money comes: the day that combines with Wealth (or Wealth's own day), or the day Wealth enters its tomb. The Duanyi Tianji text: a strong Wealth on its tomb day, a weak one on a day that births or empowers it.

zh: 财合日辰，方能入手；
财逢墓库，便可归怀。
yi: 财爻逢日辰相合，才能到手；
财爻逢墓库，就能收进怀里。
en: Only when Wealth combines with the Day does it come into hand;
when Wealth meets its tomb, you can take it home.

zh: 财与日辰合，财爻入墓日，方可断其上手。
yi: 财和日辰相合的日子、财爻入墓的日子，才可以断它到手。
en: The day that combines with Wealth, or the day the Wealth line enters its tomb: only then can you say it is in hand.

zh: 欲知何日财可到手，但看财爻旺衰。
财与日辰合，临财值日可得。
财爻旺相，逢入墓日可得。
财衰则逢生旺日可得。
yi: 要知道哪天财可以到手，只看财爻旺衰。
财与日辰相合（的日子），或者财爻本身值日的那天，可以得。
财爻旺相，逢入墓的日子可以得。
财爻衰弱，逢生旺的日子可以得。
en: To know on what day the money arrives, look at the strength of the Wealth line.
On the day that combines with Wealth, or on the day of Wealth's own branch, it can be had.
A thriving Wealth line: on the day it enters its tomb.
A weak one: on a day that births or empowers it.

title: 有本钱求财：以财为用，不可空破；旺来克世、生世得利；子动会青龙是生财大道；兄动、父动加白虎，本利俱无

rule.yi: 有本钱去求财，以财爻为用神：不能空无，逢旬空月破，不但没有利，连本也亏；财旺来克世爻，利息滚滚，生世，财源滚滚。子孙发动是生财之神，会青龙是生财的大道；兄弟动而子孙不动，本利都没有；父母动、兄弟不动再加白虎，克伤子孙这个元神，财得不到生助，是断利的根源。福德发动财源增，兄弟发动资本亏。
